sql_infos.sql: SELECT c.circuitid, c.name AS circuit_name, c.country, r.year, r.round, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.driverid) AS unique_drivers_lapped, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.driverid) AS unique_drivers_pitted, COUNT(DISTINCT q.driverid) AS unique_drivers_qualified, COUNT(DISTINCT res.driverid) AS unique_drivers_finished, COUNT(DISTINCT ds.driverid) AS unique_drivers_standing, COUNT(DISTINCT cs.constructorid) AS unique_constructors_standing, SUM(res.points) AS total_points_awarded, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, SUM(ps.milliseconds) AS total_pitstop_ms, MAX(ds.wins) AS max_driver_wins, MAX(cs.wins) AS max_constructor_wins FROM circuits c JOIN races r ON c.circuitid = r.circuitid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND lt.driverid = ps.driverid AND lt.lap = ps.lap LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid LEFT JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid AND q.driverid = res.driverid AND q.constructorid = res.constructorid LEFT JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid LEFT JOIN constructorstandings cs ON r.raceid = cs.raceid AND res.constructorid = cs.constructorid LEFT JOIN constructorresults cr ON r.raceid = cr.raceid AND cs.constructorid = cr.constructorid LEFT JOIN drivers d ON lt.driverid = d.driverid LEFT JOIN constructors con ON q.constructorid = con.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 1973 AND r.date <= '1950-01-01' AND c.alt >= 475 GROUP BY c.circuitid, c.name, c.country, r.year, r.round HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lt.driverid) > 1 AND SUM(res.points) >= '0' ORDER BY r.year DESC, r.round ASC, total_points_awarded DESC;

SELECT c.circuitid, c.name AS circuit_name, c.country, r.year, r.round, d.driverid, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, con.name AS constructor_name, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) AS distinct_laps_driven, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS distinct_pit_stops, COUNT(DISTINCT q.position) AS distinct_qualifying_positions, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, MAX(ds.wins) AS max_wins_in_season, SUM(cr.points) AS total_constructor_points FROM circuits c JOIN races r ON c.circuitid = r.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND d.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND d.driverid = q.driverid AND res.constructorid = q.constructorid JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND d.driverid = ds.driverid JOIN constructorresults cr ON r.raceid = cr.raceid AND con.constructorid = cr.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 2014 AND r.date <= '1950-01-01' AND res.grid <= 15 AND lt.position <= 1 AND ds.position <= 7 GROUP BY c.circuitid, c.name, c.country, r.year, r.round, d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, con.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 162266 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_lap_time_ms ASC LIMIT 68;

SELECT c.circuitid, c.name AS circuit_name, c.country, r.year, r.round, d.driverid, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, con.name AS constructor_name, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position AS lap_position, lt.milliseconds AS lap_time_ms, ps.stop AS pit_stop_number, ps.lap AS pit_stop_lap, ps.milliseconds AS pit_stop_duration_ms, q.position AS qualifying_position, ds.points AS driver_standing_points, ds.wins AS driver_wins, cs.points AS constructor_standing_points, cs.wins AS constructor_wins, cr.points AS constructor_result_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) OVER (PARTITION BY r.raceid, d.driverid) AS avg_lap_time_per_race_driver, SUM(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY r.year, d.driverid ORDER BY r.date) AS cumulative_points_driver_season, COUNT(ps.stop) OVER (PARTITION BY r.raceid, d.driverid) AS total_pit_stops_per_race_driver FROM circuits c JOIN races r ON c.circuitid = r.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND d.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND d.driverid = q.driverid AND res.constructorid = q.constructorid LEFT JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND d.driverid = ds.driverid LEFT JOIN constructorstandings cs ON r.raceid = cs.raceid AND con.constructorid = cs.constructorid LEFT JOIN constructorresults cr ON r.raceid = cr.raceid AND con.constructorid = cr.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 1982 AND r.year <= 2023 AND c.country = 'UK' AND res.positionorder <= 1 AND lt.milliseconds > 63970 GROUP BY c.circuitid, c.name, c.country, r.year, r.round, d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, con.name, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position, lt.milliseconds, ps.stop, ps.lap, ps.milliseconds, q.position, ds.points, ds.wins, cs.points, cs.wins, cr.points, r.raceid, r.date HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 85891 AND COUNT(ps.stop) >= 4 ORDER BY r.year DESC, r.round DESC, res.positionorder ASC, lt.lap ASC;

SELECT c.circuitid, c.name AS circuit_name, c.country, r.year, r.round, r.date, d.driverid, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, con.name AS constructor_name, res.positionorder, res.points, ds.wins AS driver_wins, cs.wins AS constructor_wins, lt.lap, lt.position AS lap_position, lt.milliseconds AS lap_time_ms, ps.stop AS pit_stop_number, ps.lap AS pit_stop_lap, ps.milliseconds AS pit_stop_duration_ms, q.position AS qualifying_position, AVG(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY r.raceid, con.constructorid) AS avg_constructor_points_per_race, SUM(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY r.year, d.driverid ORDER BY r.date) AS cumulative_driver_points_year, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY r.circuitid, r.year) AS races_per_circuit_year, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.raceid ORDER BY res.positionorder) AS race_finish_rank FROM circuits c JOIN races r ON c.circuitid = r.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND d.driverid = ds.driverid JOIN constructorstandings cs ON r.raceid = cs.raceid AND con.constructorid = cs.constructorid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND d.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND d.driverid = q.driverid AND con.constructorid = q.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 1994 AND r.date <= '1950-01-01' AND res.points > '0' AND ds.position <= 20 AND cs.position <= 4 AND lt.milliseconds IS NOT NULL AND lt.milliseconds < 70014 GROUP BY c.circuitid, c.name, c.country, r.year, r.round, r.date, d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, con.name, res.positionorder, res.points, ds.wins, cs.wins, lt.lap, lt.position, lt.milliseconds, ps.stop, ps.lap, ps.milliseconds, q.position, r.raceid, con.constructorid, r.circuitid HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) >= 30 AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 63338 ORDER BY r.year DESC, r.round DESC, res.positionorder ASC, lt.lap ASC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, COUNT(*) AS races_entered FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid WHERE r.year = 1983 AND res.grid <= 29 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' UNION ALL SELECT d.driverid, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) AS laps_analyzed FROM drivers d JOIN laptimes lt ON d.driverid = lt.driverid JOIN races r ON lt.raceid = r.raceid JOIN results res ON lt.raceid = res.raceid AND lt.driverid = res.driverid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid WHERE r.year = 2009 AND lt.position <= 12 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round HAVING AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 130096 ORDER BY driver_name, year, round;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, COUNT(*) AS races_entered FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid WHERE r.year = 2003 AND res.grid <= 21 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' UNION ALL SELECT d.driverid, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) AS laps_analyzed FROM drivers d JOIN laptimes lt ON d.driverid = lt.driverid JOIN races r ON lt.raceid = r.raceid JOIN results res ON lt.raceid = res.raceid AND lt.driverid = res.driverid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid WHERE r.year = 2021 AND lt.position <= 20 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round HAVING AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 129700 ORDER BY driver_name, year, round;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM results r2 WHERE r2.driverid = d.driverid AND r2.position = 1) AS career_wins, COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) AS races_entered, SUM(r.points) AS total_points, AVG(l.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms FROM drivers d JOIN results r ON d.driverid = r.driverid JOIN races rc ON r.raceid = rc.raceid JOIN laptimes l ON r.raceid = l.raceid AND r.driverid = l.driverid WHERE rc.year >= 1950 AND rc.year <= 2014 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(r.points) > '0' ORDER BY total_points DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) AS races_entered, SUM(r.points) AS total_points, (SELECT AVG(lt.milliseconds) FROM laptimes lt WHERE lt.driverid = d.driverid AND lt.lap = 47) AS avg_lap_time_ms FROM drivers d JOIN results r ON d.driverid = r.driverid JOIN races rc ON r.raceid = rc.raceid WHERE rc.year >= 2002 AND rc.year <= 1960 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(r.points) > '0' ORDER BY total_points DESC LIMIT 30;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) AS races_entered, SUM(r.points) AS total_points, (SELECT AVG(lt.milliseconds) FROM laptimes lt WHERE lt.driverid = d.driverid AND lt.lap = 60) AS avg_lap_time_ms FROM drivers d JOIN results r ON d.driverid = r.driverid JOIN races rc ON r.raceid = rc.raceid WHERE rc.year >= 1979 AND rc.year <= 1958 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(r.points) > '0' ORDER BY total_points DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) AS races_entered, SUM(r.points) AS total_points, (SELECT AVG(lt.milliseconds) FROM laptimes lt WHERE lt.driverid = d.driverid AND lt.raceid IN (SELECT raceid FROM races WHERE year = 2005)) AS avg_lap_time_ms FROM drivers d JOIN results r ON d.driverid = r.driverid JOIN races rc ON r.raceid = rc.raceid JOIN circuits c ON rc.circuitid = c.circuitid WHERE rc.year >= 2021 AND rc.year <= 2003 AND c.country = 'UK' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(r.points) > '10' ORDER BY total_points DESC LIMIT 20;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) AS races_entered, SUM(r.points) AS total_points, AVG(r.positionorder) AS avg_finish_position FROM drivers d JOIN results r ON d.driverid = r.driverid JOIN races rc ON r.raceid = rc.raceid WHERE rc.year IN (SELECT year FROM seasons WHERE year >= 1979 AND year <= 1954) AND r.positionorder IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(r.points) > '0' ORDER BY total_points DESC LIMIT 20;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) AS races_entered, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(res.positionorder) AS avg_finish_position FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 2019 AND r.year <= 2021 AND res.points > '0' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) >= 23 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) AS races_participated, SUM(r.points) AS total_points, AVG(r.positionorder) AS avg_finish_position FROM drivers d JOIN results r ON d.driverid = r.driverid JOIN races rc ON r.raceid = rc.raceid WHERE rc.year = 1951 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM constructorstandings cs WHERE cs.constructorid = r.constructorid AND cs.raceid = r.raceid AND cs.position <= 1 ) GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(r.points) > '0' ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) AS races_participated, SUM(res.points) AS total_points FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM laptimes lt WHERE lt.driverid = d.driverid AND lt.raceid = r.raceid AND lt.milliseconds < 83816 ) AND r.year >= 2017 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(res.points) > '50' ORDER BY total_points DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) AS races_participated, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid WHERE r.year >= 2003 AND res.points > '0' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(res.points) > '10' ORDER BY total_points DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) AS total_races, SUM(r.points) AS total_points, (SELECT AVG(points) FROM results WHERE driverid = d.driverid AND points > 17.57) AS avg_points_above_threshold FROM drivers d JOIN results r ON d.driverid = r.driverid JOIN races rc ON r.raceid = rc.raceid JOIN circuits c ON rc.circuitid = c.circuitid WHERE rc.year >= 2001 AND rc.year <= 2015 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(r.points) > 118.79 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) AS total_races, SUM(r.points) AS total_points, (SELECT AVG(points) FROM results WHERE driverid = d.driverid AND points > 17.74) AS avg_points_above_threshold FROM drivers d JOIN results r ON d.driverid = r.driverid JOIN races rc ON r.raceid = rc.raceid JOIN circuits c ON rc.circuitid = c.circuitid WHERE rc.year >= 2021 AND rc.year <= 2017 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(r.points) > 329.01 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(r.resultid) AS race_count, SUM(r.points) AS total_points, AVG(r.positionorder) AS avg_finish FROM drivers d JOIN results r ON d.driverid = r.driverid JOIN races rc ON r.raceid = rc.raceid WHERE rc.year >= 1984 AND rc.year <= 1967 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(r.points) > '0' ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(r.resultid) AS race_count, SUM(r.points) AS total_points, AVG(r.positionorder) AS avg_finish FROM drivers d LEFT JOIN results r ON d.driverid = r.driverid LEFT JOIN races rc ON r.raceid = rc.raceid WHERE rc.year >= 1971 AND rc.year <= 1979 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING COUNT(r.resultid) > 48 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(r.resultid) AS total_races, SUM(r.points) AS total_points, AVG(r.positionorder) AS avg_finish_position FROM drivers d JOIN results r ON d.driverid = r.driverid JOIN races rc ON r.raceid = rc.raceid WHERE rc.year >= 1993 AND rc.year <= 2002 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(r.points) > '0' ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(r.resultid) AS total_races, SUM(r.points) AS total_points, AVG(r.positionorder) AS avg_finish_position FROM drivers d JOIN results r ON d.driverid = r.driverid JOIN races rc ON r.raceid = rc.raceid WHERE rc.year >= 2007 AND rc.year <= 1996 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(r.points) > '0' ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name AS constructor_name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name AS circuit_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops, MAX(ds.wins) AS max_wins_in_season, MIN(q.position) AS best_qualifying_position FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits cir ON r.circuitid = cir.circuitid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND d.driverid = ps.driverid JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND d.driverid = ds.driverid JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND d.driverid = q.driverid AND res.constructorid = q.constructorid JOIN seasons s ON r.year = s.year WHERE r.year >= 1973 AND r.year <= 1982 AND res.points > '0' AND lt.milliseconds < 80219 AND ps.milliseconds > 54852 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '10' AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 92214 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_lap_time_ms ASC LIMIT 740;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name AS constructor_name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name AS circuit_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(res.positionorder) AS avg_finish_position, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) AS total_laps_led, MAX(ps.stop) AS max_pit_stops_in_race, MIN(q.position) AS best_qualifying FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits cir ON r.circuitid = cir.circuitid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON res.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid AND lt.position = 1 LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON res.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON res.raceid = q.raceid AND res.driverid = q.driverid WHERE r.year >= 1971 AND r.date <= '1950-01-01' AND res.grid <= 29 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND AVG(res.positionorder) < 18 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_finish_position ASC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name AS constructor_name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name AS circuit_name, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position AS lap_position, lt.milliseconds AS lap_time_ms, ps.stop AS pit_stop_number, ps.lap AS pit_stop_lap, ps.milliseconds AS pit_stop_duration_ms, q.position AS qualifying_position, ds.points AS driver_standing_points, ds.wins AS driver_standing_wins, cs.points AS constructor_standing_points, cs.wins AS constructor_standing_wins, cr.points AS constructor_result_points, t.win AS target_win, AVG(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid, r.year) AS avg_points_per_year, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year, c.constructorid ORDER BY SUM(res.points) DESC) AS constructor_rank_in_year, SUM(lt.milliseconds) OVER (PARTITION BY r.raceid, d.driverid ORDER BY lt.lap) AS cumulative_lap_time FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits cir ON r.circuitid = cir.circuitid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND d.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND d.driverid = q.driverid AND c.constructorid = q.constructorid LEFT JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND d.driverid = ds.driverid LEFT JOIN constructorstandings cs ON r.raceid = cs.raceid AND c.constructorid = cs.constructorid LEFT JOIN constructorresults cr ON r.raceid = cr.raceid AND c.constructorid = cr.constructorid LEFT JOIN target t ON r.raceid = t.raceid AND d.driverid = t.driverid WHERE r.year >= 1983 AND r.year <= 2001 AND res.points > '0' AND lt.milliseconds < 108087 AND (ps.milliseconds IS NULL OR ps.milliseconds > 56472) GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position, lt.milliseconds, ps.stop, ps.lap, ps.milliseconds, q.position, ds.points, ds.wins, cs.points, cs.wins, cr.points, t.win HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) > 3 AND AVG(res.points) < '0' ORDER BY r.year DESC, r.round DESC, constructor_rank_in_year, cumulative_lap_time;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name AS constructor_name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name AS circuit_name, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position AS lap_position, lt.milliseconds AS lap_time_ms, ps.stop, ps.lap AS pit_lap, ps.milliseconds AS pit_time_ms, q.position AS qualifying_position, ds.points AS driver_standing_points, ds.wins AS driver_wins, cs.points AS constructor_standing_points, cs.wins AS constructor_wins, cr.points AS constructor_result_points, t.win AS target_win, AVG(lt.milliseconds) OVER (PARTITION BY r.raceid, d.driverid) AS avg_lap_time_per_race, SUM(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY r.year, d.driverid ORDER BY r.date) AS cumulative_points_year, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.raceid ORDER BY res.positionorder) AS race_finish_rank FROM drivers d INNER JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid INNER JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid INNER JOIN circuits cir ON r.circuitid = cir.circuitid INNER JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND d.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND d.driverid = q.driverid AND res.constructorid = q.constructorid LEFT JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND d.driverid = ds.driverid LEFT JOIN constructorstandings cs ON r.raceid = cs.raceid AND c.constructorid = cs.constructorid LEFT JOIN constructorresults cr ON r.raceid = cr.raceid AND c.constructorid = cr.constructorid LEFT JOIN target t ON r.raceid = t.raceid AND d.driverid = t.driverid WHERE r.year >= 1971 AND r.year <= 1993 AND res.points > '0' AND lt.milliseconds < 74683 AND ps.milliseconds > 39691 AND q.position <= 19 AND ds.wins >= 4 AND cs.wins >= 12 AND cr.points > '0' AND t.win = 1 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position, lt.milliseconds, ps.stop, ps.lap, ps.milliseconds, q.position, ds.points, ds.wins, cs.points, cs.wins, cr.points, t.win HAVING SUM(res.points) > '10' AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 112767 ORDER BY cumulative_points_year DESC, race_finish_rank ASC LIMIT 399;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name AS constructor_name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name AS circuit_name, res.positionorder, res.points, ds.position AS driver_standing_position, ds.wins AS driver_wins, cs.position AS constructor_standing_position, cs.wins AS constructor_wins, lt.lap, lt.position AS lap_position, lt.milliseconds AS lap_time_ms, SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops, MAX(q.position) AS best_qualifying, SUM(cr.points) AS constructor_points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY SUM(res.points) DESC) AS driver_rank_year, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.circuitid ORDER BY AVG(lt.milliseconds)) AS lap_time_rank_circuit FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits cct ON r.circuitid = cct.circuitid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON res.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid JOIN pitstops ps ON res.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid JOIN qualifying q ON res.raceid = q.raceid AND res.driverid = q.driverid AND res.constructorid = q.constructorid JOIN constructorresults cr ON res.raceid = cr.raceid AND res.constructorid = cr.constructorid JOIN driverstandings ds ON res.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid JOIN constructorstandings cs ON res.raceid = cs.raceid AND res.constructorid = cs.constructorid JOIN status s ON res.statusid = s.statusid LEFT JOIN target t ON res.raceid = t.raceid AND res.driverid = t.driverid WHERE r.year >= 1973 AND r.date <= '1950-01-01' AND res.grid <= 20 AND lt.lap >= 87 AND ps.lap <= 64 AND q.position <= 30 AND cr.points > '0' AND ds.points >= '0' AND cs.position < 3 AND (t.win = 1 OR t.win IS NULL) GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round, r.name, r.circuitid HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 152250 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) >= 3 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_lap_time_ms ASC LIMIT 117;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops, MAX(q.position) AS best_qualifying, SUM(cs.wins) AS constructor_wins, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY SUM(res.points) DESC) AS yearly_rank FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON d.driverid = lt.driverid AND res.raceid = lt.raceid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON d.driverid = ps.driverid AND res.raceid = ps.raceid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON d.driverid = q.driverid AND res.raceid = q.raceid LEFT JOIN constructorstandings cs ON c.constructorid = cs.constructorid AND r.raceid = cs.raceid WHERE r.year >= 1951 AND r.date <= '1950-01-01' AND res.positionorder <= 14 AND lt.milliseconds > 95062 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round, r.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 115920 ORDER BY total_points DESC, yearly_rank ASC LIMIT 154;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points, SUM(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid, r.year ORDER BY r.round) AS cumulative_points, AVG(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY c.constructorid, r.year) AS avg_constructor_points_per_race FROM drivers d INNER JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid INNER JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid INNER JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON res.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON res.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid WHERE r.year = 1968 AND res.positionorder <= 18 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, c.constructorid, r.year, r.round, r.name, r.raceid, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points HAVING AVG(res.points) > '0.0' ORDER BY cumulative_points DESC, r.round ASC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points, SUM(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid, r.year ORDER BY r.round) AS cumulative_points, AVG(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid, r.year) AS avg_points_per_race FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid WHERE r.year = 2010 AND (res.grid <= 6 OR res.positionorder <= 10) AND NOT (res.points = 0 AND res.positionorder > 19) AND r.date >= '1950-01-01' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round, r.name, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY cumulative_points DESC, r.round ASC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position AS lap_position, lt.milliseconds AS lap_time_ms, ps.stop AS pit_stop_number, ps.lap AS pit_stop_lap, ps.milliseconds AS pit_stop_duration_ms, q.position AS qualifying_position, cs.points AS constructor_points, cs.wins SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, res.points, res.positionorder, ds.wins, (SELECT AVG(l.milliseconds) FROM laptimes l WHERE l.raceid = r.raceid AND l.driverid = d.driverid AND l.lap <= 54) AS avg_lap_time, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pitstops p WHERE p.raceid = r.raceid AND p.driverid = d.driverid AND p.lap <= 75) AS pitstop_count FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND d.driverid = ds.driverid JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND d.driverid = q.driverid AND c.constructorid = q.constructorid JOIN circuits ci ON r.circuitid = ci.circuitid WHERE r.year >= 2006 AND r.date <= '2000-01-01' AND res.points > '0.0' AND ds.position <= 15 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round, r.name, res.points, res.positionorder, ds.wins, r.raceid HAVING AVG(res.points) > '0.0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) >= 3 ORDER BY ds.wins DESC, res.points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, res.positionorder, res.points, SUM(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid, r.year ORDER BY r.date) AS cumulative_points_year, AVG(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY c.constructorid, r.year) AS avg_constructor_points_per_race_year, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.raceid ORDER BY res.points DESC) AS race_points_rank FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN circuits ci ON r.circuitid = ci.circuitid JOIN seasons s ON r.year = s.year LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON res.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON res.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON res.raceid = q.raceid AND res.driverid = q.driverid AND res.constructorid = q.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 2017 AND r.year <= 2017 AND res.points > '0' AND ci.alt > 355 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, c.constructorid, r.year, r.round, r.name, r.date, r.raceid, res.positionorder, res.points HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) > 1 OR COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) IS NULL ORDER BY r.year, r.round, cumulative_points_year DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position AS lap_position, ps.stop AS pit_stop_number, ps.duration AS pit_stop_duration, q.position AS qualifying_position, ds.position AS driver_standing_position, cs.position AS constructor_standing_position, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM results res2 WHERE res2.raceid = r.raceid AND res2.positionorder <= 6) AS top_finishers_in_race, AVG(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY r.year, c.constructorid) AS avg_constructor_points_per_year, SUM(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid ORDER BY r.date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_driver_points FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits ci ON r.circuitid = ci.circuitid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON res.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON res.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid JOIN qualifying q ON res.raceid = q.raceid AND res.driverid = q.driverid AND res.constructorid = q.constructorid JOIN driverstandings ds ON res.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid JOIN constructorstandings cs ON res.raceid = cs.raceid AND res.constructorid = cs.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 2000 AND r.year <= 2023 AND ci.country = 'UK' AND res.positionorder IS NOT NULL AND lt.lap = 29 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM constructorresults cr WHERE cr.raceid = r.raceid AND cr.constructorid = c.constructorid AND cr.points > '0') GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round, r.name, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position, ps.stop, ps.duration, q.position, ds.position, cs.position, r.raceid, r.date, c.constructorid HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY cumulative_driver_points DESC, r.year, r.round;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.raceid, r.name AS race_name, r.date, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(r.date, d.dob)) AS driver_age_at_race, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position AS lap_position, ps.stop AS pit_stop_number, ps.duration FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND d.driverid = ps.driverid WHERE r.date >= '2000-01-01' AND r.date <= '2000-01-01' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM r.date) = 2004 AND res.points > '0' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.raceid, r.name, r.date, d.dob, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position, ps.stop, ps.duration HAVING COUNT(lt.lap) > 39 ORDER BY r.date DESC, res.points DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.raceid, r.name AS race_name, r.date, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position AS lap_position, ps.stop AS pit_stop_number, ps.duration AS pit_stop_duration FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND d.driverid = ps.driverid WHERE r.date BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2000-01-01' AND res.positionorder <= 9 AND lt.lap >= 1 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.raceid, r.name, r.date, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position, ps.stop, ps.duration HAVING AVG(lt.position) < 16.77 ORDER BY r.date DESC, res.positionorder ASC LIMIT 817;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, res.positionorder, res.points, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM laptimes lt WHERE lt.raceid = r.raceid AND lt.driverid = d.driverid AND lt.position = 1) AS laps_led FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid WHERE r.year = 1969 AND res.positionorder <= 10 ORDER BY res.points DESC, laps_led DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position AS lap_position, ps.stop AS pit_stop_number, ps.lap AS pit_stop_lap, q.position AS qualifying_position, cs.points AS constructor_points, ds.wins AS driver_wins FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN laptimes lt ON res.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON res.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON res.raceid = q.raceid AND res.driverid = q.driverid LEFT JOIN constructorstandings cs ON res.raceid = cs.raceid AND res.constructorid = cs.constructorid LEFT JOIN driverstandings ds ON res.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid WHERE r.year = 1959 AND r.round >= 24 AND res.positionorder <= 10 AND lt.lap BETWEEN 42 AND 72 AND (ps.milliseconds IS NULL OR ps.milliseconds > 22616) GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position, ps.stop, ps.lap, q.position, cs.points, ds.wins HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY SUM(res.points) DESC, d.surname, d.forename;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) AS total_laps_led, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, SUM(res.points) AS total_points FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN laptimes lt ON d.driverid = lt.driverid AND res.raceid = lt.raceid WHERE r.year >= 1997 AND res.points > '0' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year HAVING AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 104104 AND SUM(res.points) > '10' ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_lap_time_ms ASC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) AS total_laps_led, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, SUM(res.points) AS total_points FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN laptimes lt ON d.driverid = lt.driverid AND res.raceid = lt.raceid WHERE r.year >= 2013 AND res.points > '0' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year HAVING AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 104679 AND SUM(res.points) > '10' ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_lap_time_ms ASC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN laptimes lt ON res.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid WHERE r.year = 2016 AND res.positionorder <= 3 AND lt.lap > 82 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_lap_time_ms ASC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, res.positionorder, res.points, AVG(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid ORDER BY r.date ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS avg_points_last_4_races FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid WHERE r.year = 1964 AND res.positionorder <= 17 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name, res.positionorder, res.points, r.date ORDER BY d.driverid, r.date;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, res.positionorder, res.points, AVG(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid, r.year) AS avg_points_per_season, SUM(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid ORDER BY r.date) AS cumulative_points FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 2017 AND res.points > '0' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name, res.positionorder, res.points, r.date ORDER BY d.driverid, r.year, r.round;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, res.positionorder, res.points, AVG(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY r.year, d.driverid) AS avg_points_per_season, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY SUM(res.points) DESC) AS season_rank FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 1958 AND r.year <= 1957 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name, res.positionorder, res.points HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY r.year DESC, season_rank, d.surname;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, res.positionorder, res.points, SUM(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid, r.year ORDER BY r.date) AS cumulative_points_season, AVG(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid, r.year) AS avg_points_season FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid WHERE r.year = 1981 AND res.positionorder <= 4 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name, res.positionorder, res.points, r.date ORDER BY d.driverid, r.year, r.round;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, res.positionorder, res.points, SUM(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid, r.year ORDER BY r.date) AS cumulative_points_season, AVG(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid, r.year) AS avg_points_season, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.raceid ORDER BY res.points DESC) AS race_points_rank FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid WHERE r.year = 1972 AND res.points > '0' ORDER BY d.driverid, r.date;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, c.name AS circuit_name, res.positionorder, res.points, (SELECT AVG(subq.avg_points) FROM ( SELECT rs.constructorid, AVG(rs.points) AS avg_points FROM results rs WHERE rs.raceid IN (SELECT raceid FROM races WHERE year = r.year) GROUP BY rs.constructorid HAVING AVG(rs.points) > 6.8 ) subq ) AS avg_constructor_points_above_threshold FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid WHERE r.date >= '2000-01-01' AND r.date <= '2011-01-01' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, r.name, c.name, res.positionorder, res.points HAVING SUM(res.points) > 96.42 ORDER BY r.year DESC, r.round DESC, res.positionorder ASC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, c.name AS circuit_name, res.positionorder, res.points, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM laptimes lt WHERE lt.raceid = r.raceid AND lt.driverid = d.driverid AND lt.position = 1) AS laps_led, (SELECT AVG(ps.milliseconds) FROM pitstops ps WHERE ps.raceid = r.raceid AND ps.driverid = d.driverid) AS avg_pitstop_ms FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid WHERE r.year = 1990 AND res.points > '0' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, r.name, c.name, res.positionorder, res.points, r.raceid HAVING AVG(res.positionorder) < 5 ORDER BY res.points DESC, laps_led DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, res.points, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM laptimes lt WHERE lt.raceid = r.raceid AND lt.driverid = d.driverid AND lt.position = 18) AS laps_in_position FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid WHERE r.year = 2006 AND res.points > '0' ORDER BY res.points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, res.points, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM laptimes lt WHERE lt.raceid = res.raceid AND lt.driverid = res.driverid AND lt.position = 1) AS laps_led FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid WHERE r.year = 1974 AND res.points > '0' ORDER BY res.points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, res.points, res.positionorder, ds.wins, AVG(lt.milliseconds) OVER (PARTITION BY lt.raceid, lt.driverid) AS avg_lap_ms FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN driverstandings ds ON res.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON res.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid WHERE r.year = 2000 AND res.points > '0' AND d.driverid IN ( SELECT driverid FROM results WHERE positionorder <= 2 ) ORDER BY res.points DESC, avg_lap_ms ASC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, res.positionorder, res.points, SUM(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid ORDER BY r.date) AS cumulative_points FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid WHERE r.year = 2018 AND res.positionorder <= 10 ORDER BY d.driverid, r.date;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position AS lap_position, lt.milliseconds AS lap_time_ms FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid WHERE r.year = 2019 AND res.positionorder <= 8 AND lt.lap = ( SELECT MAX(lap) FROM laptimes WHERE raceid = r.raceid AND driverid = d.driverid ) ORDER BY r.round, res.positionorder, lt.lap;

SELECT d1.driverid AS driver1_id, d1.forename AS driver1_forename, d1.surname AS driver1_surname, d2.driverid AS driver2_id, d2.forename AS driver2_forename, d2.surname AS driver2_surname, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, AVG(lt1.milliseconds - lt2.milliseconds) AS avg_time_diff_ms, SUM(CASE WHEN res1.positionorder < res2.positionorder THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS driver1_wins_against_driver2, SUM(cr1.points) AS driver1_constructor_points, SUM(cr2.points) AS driver2_constructor_points, COUNT(DISTINCT lt1.lap) AS total_laps_compared, CORR(lt1.position, lt2.position) AS lap_position_correlation FROM laptimes lt1 JOIN laptimes lt2 ON lt1.raceid = lt2.raceid AND lt1.lap = lt2.lap AND lt1.driverid < lt2.driverid JOIN drivers d1 ON lt1.driverid = d1.driverid JOIN drivers d2 ON lt2.driverid = d2.driverid JOIN races r ON lt1.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid LEFT JOIN results res1 ON lt1.raceid = res1.raceid AND lt1.driverid = res1.driverid LEFT JOIN results res2 ON lt2.raceid = res2.raceid AND lt2.driverid = res2.driverid LEFT JOIN constructorresults cr1 ON res1.raceid = cr1.raceid AND res1.constructorid = cr1.constructorid LEFT JOIN constructorresults cr2 ON res2.raceid = cr2.raceid AND res2.constructorid = cr2.constructorid WHERE r.year BETWEEN 1997 AND 1986 AND lt1.milliseconds IS NOT NULL AND lt2.milliseconds IS NOT NULL AND c.alt > 445 GROUP BY d1.driverid, d1.forename, d1.surname, d2.driverid, d2.forename, d2.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name HAVING COUNT(lt1.lap) > 92 AND AVG(lt1.milliseconds - lt2.milliseconds) > 8136 ORDER BY avg_time_diff_ms DESC, driver1_wins_against_driver2 DESC LIMIT 977;

SELECT d1.driverid AS driver1_id, d1.forename AS driver1_forename, d1.surname AS driver1_surname, d2.driverid AS driver2_id, d2.forename AS driver2_forename, d2.surname AS driver2_surname, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, AVG(lt1.milliseconds - lt2.milliseconds) AS avg_time_diff_ms, SUM(CASE WHEN res1.positionorder < res2.positionorder THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS driver1_wins_against_driver2, SUM(cr1.points) AS driver1_constructor_points, SUM(cr2.points) AS driver2_constructor_points, COUNT(DISTINCT lt1.lap) AS total_laps_compared, CORR(lt1.position, lt2.position) AS lap_position_correlation FROM laptimes lt1 JOIN laptimes lt2 ON lt1.raceid = lt2.raceid AND lt1.lap = lt2.lap AND lt1.driverid < lt2.driverid JOIN races r ON lt1.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN drivers d1 ON lt1.driverid = d1.driverid JOIN drivers d2 ON lt2.driverid = d2.driverid LEFT JOIN results res1 ON lt1.raceid = res1.raceid AND lt1.driverid = res1.driverid LEFT JOIN results res2 ON lt2.raceid = res2.raceid AND lt2.driverid = res2.driverid LEFT JOIN constructorresults cr1 ON res1.raceid = cr1.raceid AND res1.constructorid = cr1.constructorid LEFT JOIN constructorresults cr2 ON res2.raceid = cr2.raceid AND res2.constructorid = cr2.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 2019 AND r.date <= '1950-01-01' AND lt1.milliseconds IS NOT NULL AND lt2.milliseconds IS NOT NULL AND c.circuitid IN (62, 74, 64) GROUP BY d1.driverid, d1.forename, d1.surname, d2.driverid, d2.forename, d2.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name HAVING AVG(lt1.milliseconds - lt2.milliseconds) > 1497 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lt1.lap) >= 72 ORDER BY avg_time_diff_ms DESC, driver1_wins_against_driver2 DESC LIMIT 574;

SELECT r.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(*) AS race_count FROM results r JOIN drivers d ON r.driverid = d.driverid WHERE r.positionorder <= 6 GROUP BY r.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING COUNT(*) >= 36 INTERSECT SELECT ds.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(*) AS race_count FROM driverstandings ds JOIN drivers d ON ds.driverid = d.driverid WHERE ds.position <= 9 GROUP BY ds.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10 ORDER BY race_count DESC;

SELECT r.raceid, r.name AS race_name, r.date, c.name AS circuit_name, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, res.positionorder, res.points, cs.points AS constructor_points FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid JOIN constructorstandings cs ON r.raceid = cs.raceid AND con.constructorid = cs.constructorid WHERE r.year = 2000 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM laptimes lt WHERE lt.raceid = r.raceid AND lt.driverid = d.driverid AND lt.milliseconds < 119731 ) AND res.points > '0' ORDER BY r.date, res.positionorder;

SELECT r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.driverid) AS distinct_drivers, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) AS distinct_laps, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS distinct_pitstops, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND lt.driverid = ps.driverid WHERE r.year >= 2023 AND r.date <= '2010-03-01' GROUP BY r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lt.driverid) > 27 AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 195592 ORDER BY r.year DESC, r.round ASC;

SELECT r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, d.driverid, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, con.name AS constructor_name, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position AS lap_position, lt.milliseconds AS lap_time_ms, ps.stop AS pit_stop_number, ps.lap AS pit_stop_lap, ps.milliseconds AS pit_stop_duration_ms, q.position AS qualifying_position, ds.points AS driver_standing_points, ds.wins AS driver_standing_wins, cs.points AS constructor_standing_points, cs.wins AS constructor_standing_wins, cr.points AS constructor_result_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) OVER ( PARTITION BY r.raceid, d.driverid ORDER BY lt.lap ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_lap_time_ms, SUM(res.points) OVER ( PARTITION BY r.year, d.driverid ORDER BY r.date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS cumulative_driver_points_season, RANK() OVER ( PARTITION BY r.raceid ORDER BY res.positionorder ) AS race_finish_rank FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND res.driverid = q.driverid AND res.constructorid = q.constructorid LEFT JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid LEFT JOIN constructorstandings cs ON r.raceid = cs.raceid AND res.constructorid = cs.constructorid LEFT JOIN constructorresults cr ON r.raceid = cr.raceid AND res.constructorid = cr.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 2017 AND r.year <= 1989 AND res.positionorder IS NOT NULL AND res.positionorder <= 10 AND lt.milliseconds > 111558 AND (ps.milliseconds IS NULL OR ps.milliseconds < 49477) GROUP BY r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name, d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, con.name, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position, lt.milliseconds, ps.stop, ps.lap, ps.milliseconds, q.position, ds.points, ds.wins, cs.points, cs.wins, cr.points, r.date HAVING AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 139747 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) >= 29 ORDER BY r.year DESC, r.round DESC, cumulative_driver_points_season DESC;

SELECT r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, d.driverid, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, res.positionorder, res.points, AVG(res.points) OVER ( PARTITION BY r.circuitid, d.driverid ORDER BY r.date ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS avg_points_last_3_races FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid WHERE r.year >= 2021 AND r.year <= 2021 AND res.positionorder <= 4 AND r.date >= '2000-03-01' GROUP BY r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name, d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, res.positionorder, res.points, r.circuitid, r.date HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0.0' ORDER BY r.year, r.round, avg_points_last_3_races DESC;

SELECT r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, d.driverid, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, res.positionorder, res.points, AVG(res.points) OVER ( PARTITION BY r.year, d.driverid ORDER BY r.date ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_points_last_3_races FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid WHERE r.year >= 2008 AND r.year <= 2020 AND res.positionorder <= 6 AND r.date >= '1950-01-01' GROUP BY r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name, d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, res.positionorder, res.points, r.date HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY r.year, r.round, moving_avg_points_last_3_races DESC;

SELECT r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, con.name AS constructor_name, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points, ds.wins AS driver_season_wins, cs.wins AS constructor_season_wins, AVG(lt.milliseconds) OVER (PARTITION BY r.raceid, d.driverid) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(ps.stop) OVER (PARTITION BY r.raceid, d.driverid) AS pit_stop_count FROM races r INNER JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid INNER JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid INNER JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid INNER JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid LEFT JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND d.driverid = ds.driverid LEFT JOIN constructorstandings cs ON r.raceid = cs.raceid AND con.constructorid = cs.constructorid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND d.driverid = ps.driverid WHERE r.year >= 1985 AND r.year <= 1959 AND res.points > '0' GROUP BY r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name, d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, con.constructorid, con.name, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points, ds.wins, cs.wins, ps.stop, lt.milliseconds HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT res.positionorder) > 0 ORDER BY r.year DESC, r.round DESC, res.points DESC LIMIT 369;

SELECT r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, con.name AS constructor_name, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points, ds.wins AS driver_wins, cs.wins AS constructor_wins, AVG(lt.milliseconds) OVER (PARTITION BY r.raceid, d.driverid) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(p.stop) OVER (PARTITION BY r.raceid, d.driverid) AS pit_stop_count FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid LEFT JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND d.driverid = ds.driverid LEFT JOIN constructorstandings cs ON r.raceid = cs.raceid AND con.constructorid = cs.constructorid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops p ON r.raceid = p.raceid AND d.driverid = p.driverid WHERE r.year >= 1996 AND r.year <= 2005 AND res.points > '0' GROUP BY r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name, d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, con.constructorid, con.name, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points, ds.wins, cs.wins, p.stop, lt.milliseconds HAVING COUNT(p.stop) >= 0 ORDER BY r.year DESC, r.round DESC, res.positionorder ASC LIMIT 1000;

SELECT r.year, c.country, con.nationality, d.driverref, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) AS total_laps_analyzed, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, SUM(cr.points) AS total_constructor_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pit_stops, MIN(q.position) AS best_qualifying, AVG(res.grid) AS avg_grid_position, SUM(CASE WHEN res.positionorder = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wins, SUM(ds.wins) AS driver_season_wins, SUM(cs.wins) AS constructor_season_wins FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND res.driverid = q.driverid AND res.constructorid = q.constructorid LEFT JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid LEFT JOIN constructorstandings cs ON r.raceid = cs.raceid AND res.constructorid = cs.constructorid LEFT JOIN constructorresults cr ON r.raceid = cr.raceid AND res.constructorid = cr.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 2013 AND r.year <= 1981 AND res.points > '0' AND lt.milliseconds > 79683 AND (q.position IS NULL OR q.position < 14) GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (r.year, c.country, con.nationality, d.driverref), (r.year, c.country, con.nationality), (r.year, c.country), (r.year), () ) HAVING SUM(res.points) > '10' AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 114141 ORDER BY r.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT r.year, c.country, con.nationality, d.driverref, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) AS total_laps_analyzed, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, MIN(ps.milliseconds) AS min_pitstop_ms, MAX(q.position) AS worst_qualifying, SUM(cr.points) AS constructor_points, SUM(cs.wins) AS constructor_wins, SUM(ds.wins) AS driver_wins, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND res.driverid = q.driverid AND res.constructorid = q.constructorid LEFT JOIN constructorresults cr ON r.raceid = cr.raceid AND res.constructorid = cr.constructorid LEFT JOIN constructorstandings cs ON r.raceid = cs.raceid AND res.constructorid = cs.constructorid LEFT JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid WHERE r.year >= 1967 AND r.year <= 1966 AND res.grid <= 23 AND lt.milliseconds > 233628 AND (ps.milliseconds IS NULL OR ps.milliseconds < 24293) GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (r.year, c.country, con.nationality, d.driverref), (r.year, c.country, con.nationality), (r.year, c.country), (r.year), () ) HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) >= 12 ORDER BY r.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT r.year, c.name AS circuit_name, con.name AS constructor_name, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid WHERE r.year >= 2014 AND r.year <= 2005 AND res.positionorder <= 7 AND d.dob >= '1950-01-01' GROUP BY r.year, c.circuitid, con.constructorid, d.driverid HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 177946 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_lap_time_ms ASC;

SELECT r.year, c.name AS constructor_name, COUNT(DISTINCT res.raceid) AS races_entered, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(res.positionorder) AS avg_finish_position, MAX(ds.wins) AS max_wins_in_season FROM results res JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN driverstandings ds ON res.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid WHERE r.year >= 2003 AND r.year <= 2010 GROUP BY r.year, c.constructorid, c.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND AVG(res.positionorder) <= 18 ORDER BY r.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT r.year, c.name AS constructor_name, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) AS distinct_laps_raced, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS distinct_pit_stops, COUNT(DISTINCT q.position) AS distinct_qualifying_positions, AVG(res.points) AS avg_points, SUM(ds.wins) AS total_wins FROM races r JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND res.driverid = q.driverid LEFT JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid WHERE r.year >= 2021 AND r.year <= 2012 AND res.positionorder <= 9 GROUP BY r.year, c.constructorid, c.name, d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING AVG(res.points) > '0.0' ORDER BY r.year DESC, total_wins DESC, avg_points DESC;

SELECT r.year, c.name AS constructor_name, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY SUM(res.points) DESC) AS yearly_rank FROM races r JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid WHERE r.year >= 1965 AND r.year <= 1964 GROUP BY r.year, c.constructorid, c.name, d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY r.year DESC, yearly_rank ASC;

SELECT r.year, c.name AS constructor_name, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, SUM(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY r.year, c.constructorid ORDER BY r.date) AS cumulative_points, AVG(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY r.year, c.constructorid) AS avg_points_per_race, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY SUM(res.points) DESC) AS yearly_rank FROM results res JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid WHERE r.year >= 1951 AND r.year <= 2002 GROUP BY r.year, r.date, c.constructorid, c.name, d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, res.points HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY r.year, cumulative_points DESC;

SELECT c.circuitid, c.name AS circuit_name, c.country, r.year, r.round, d.driverid, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, con.constructorid, con.name AS constructor_name, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) AS distinct_laps_driven, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS distinct_pit_stops, COUNT(DISTINCT q.position) AS distinct_qualifying_positions, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, MAX(ds.wins) AS max_wins_in_season, SUM(cr.points) AS total_constructor_points FROM circuits c JOIN races r ON c.circuitid = r.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND d.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND d.driverid = q.driverid LEFT JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND d.driverid = ds.driverid LEFT JOIN constructorresults cr ON r.raceid = cr.raceid AND con.constructorid = cr.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 1954 AND r.year <= 1981 AND res.positionorder <= 12 AND lt.milliseconds > 132370 AND d.dob >= '1950-01-01' GROUP BY c.circuitid, c.name, c.country, r.year, r.round, d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, con.constructorid, con.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) >= 56 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) <= 0 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_lap_time_ms ASC, distinct_laps_driven DESC LIMIT 523;

SELECT c.circuitid, c.name AS circuit_name, c.country, r.year, r.round, r.date, d.driverid, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, con.name AS constructor_name, res.positionorder, res.points, ds.wins AS driver_wins, cs.wins AS constructor_wins, lt.lap, lt.position AS lap_position, lt.milliseconds AS lap_time_ms, ps.stop AS pit_stop_number, ps.lap AS pit_stop_lap, ps.milliseconds AS pit_stop_duration_ms, q.position AS qualifying_position, AVG(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY r.raceid, con.constructorid) AS avg_constructor_points_per_race, SUM(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY r.year, d.driverid ORDER BY r.date) AS cumulative_driver_points_year, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY r.circuitid, r.year) AS races_per_circuit_year, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.raceid ORDER BY res.positionorder) AS race_finish_rank FROM circuits c JOIN races r ON c.circuitid = r.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND d.driverid = ds.driverid JOIN constructorstandings cs ON r.raceid = cs.raceid AND con.constructorid =
