SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, res.points, res.positionorder, ds.wins, (SELECT AVG(l.milliseconds) FROM laptimes l WHERE l.raceid = r.raceid AND l.driverid = d.driverid AND l.lap <= 15) AS avg_lap_time, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pitstops p WHERE p.raceid = r.raceid AND p.driverid = d.driverid AND p.lap <= 41) AS pitstop_count FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND d.driverid = ds.driverid JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND d.driverid = q.driverid AND c.constructorid = q.constructorid JOIN circuits ci ON r.circuitid = ci.circuitid WHERE r.year >= 2009 AND r.date <= '2000-01-01' AND res.points > '0.0' AND ds.position <= 4 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round, r.name, res.points, res.positionorder, ds.wins, r.raceid HAVING AVG(res.points) > '0.0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) >= 16 ORDER BY ds.wins DESC, res.points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, rs.points AS race_points, ds.position AS driver_position, cs.position AS constructor_position, lt.lap, lt.position AS lap_position, ps.stop AS pit_stop_number, ps.lap AS pit_stop_lap, q.position AS qualifying_position, t.win, AVG(rs.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid, r.year) AS avg_points_per_season, SUM(rs.points) OVER (PARTITION BY c.constructorid, r.year ORDER BY r.date) AS cumulative_constructor_points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.raceid ORDER BY rs.points DESC) AS points_rank_in_race, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM laptimes lt2 WHERE lt2.driverid = d.driverid AND lt2.position = 1 AND lt2.raceid IN (SELECT raceid FROM races WHERE year = r.year)) AS season_fastest_laps FROM drivers d JOIN results rs ON d.driverid = rs.driverid JOIN races r ON rs.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON rs.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN circuits ci ON r.circuitid = ci.circuitid JOIN driverstandings ds ON d.driverid = ds.driverid AND r.raceid = ds.raceid JOIN constructorstandings cs ON c.constructorid = cs.constructorid AND r.raceid = cs.raceid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON d.driverid = lt.driverid AND r.raceid = lt.raceid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON d.driverid = ps.driverid AND r.raceid = ps.raceid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON d.driverid = q.driverid AND r.raceid = q.raceid LEFT JOIN target t ON d.driverid = t.driverid AND r.raceid = t.raceid WHERE r.year >= 1982 AND r.year <= 1971 AND rs.points > '0' AND ds.position <= 10 AND cs.position <= 8 AND ci.alt > 233 AND (SELECT AVG(points) FROM results rs2 WHERE rs2.constructorid = c.constructorid AND rs2.raceid IN (SELECT raceid FROM races WHERE year = r.year)) > '0' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round, r.name, rs.points, ds.position, cs.position, lt.lap, lt.position, ps.stop, ps.lap, q.position, t.win, c.constructorid, r.date, r.raceid HAVING SUM(rs.points) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) >= 63 ORDER BY cumulative_constructor_points DESC, avg_points_per_season DESC LIMIT 989;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) AS races_participated, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(res.positionorder) AS avg_finish_position FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid WHERE r.year >= 2008 AND c.country = 'Monaco' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year HAVING SUM(res.points) > '10' ORDER BY total_points DESC, r.year, d.surname;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY SUM(res.points) DESC) AS yearly_rank FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid WHERE r.year >= 1998 AND r.year <= 2004 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY r.year, yearly_rank, r.round;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, res.positionorder, res.points, SUM(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid ORDER BY r.date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_points, AVG(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid, r.year) AS avg_points_per_season, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.raceid ORDER BY res.positionorder) AS race_finish_rank FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 2010 AND r.year <= 2013 AND res.points > '0' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name, res.positionorder, res.points, r.date, r.raceid ORDER BY d.driverid, r.date;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, res.positionorder, res.points, SUM(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid, r.year ORDER BY r.date) AS cumulative_points_season, AVG(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid, r.year) AS avg_points_season FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid WHERE r.year = 2008 AND res.positionorder <= 2 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name, res.positionorder, res.points, r.date ORDER BY d.driverid, r.year, r.round;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, res.positionorder, res.points, SUM(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid, r.year ORDER BY r.round) AS cumulative_points FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid WHERE r.year = 1999 AND res.positionorder <= 7 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name, res.positionorder, res.points ORDER BY d.driverid, r.year, r.round;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, res.positionorder, res.points, SUM(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid, r.year ORDER BY r.round) AS cumulative_points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.raceid ORDER BY res.positionorder) AS race_finish_rank FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid WHERE r.year = 1971 AND res.positionorder <= 19 ORDER BY d.driverid, r.round;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid WHERE r.year = 1994 AND res.positionorder <= 2 AND res.raceid IN ( SELECT raceid FROM races WHERE circuitid = 71 ) GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, r.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, c.name AS circuit_name, res.positionorder, res.points, (SELECT AVG(subq.avg_points) FROM ( SELECT rs.constructorid, AVG(rs.points) AS avg_points FROM results rs WHERE rs.raceid IN (SELECT raceid FROM races WHERE year = r.year) GROUP BY rs.constructorid HAVING AVG(rs.points) > 9.12 ) subq ) AS avg_constructor_points_above_threshold FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid WHERE r.date >= '2000-01-01' AND r.date <= '2011-01-01' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, r.name, c.name, res.positionorder, res.points HAVING SUM(res.points) > 42.84 ORDER BY r.year DESC, r.round DESC, res.positionorder ASC;

SELECT d1.driverid AS driver1_id, d1.forename AS driver1_forename, d1.surname AS driver1_surname, d2.driverid AS driver2_id, d2.forename AS driver2_forename, d2.surname AS driver2_surname, r.year, r.name AS race_name, AVG(lt1.milliseconds - lt2.milliseconds) AS avg_time_diff_ms FROM laptimes lt1 JOIN laptimes lt2 ON lt1.raceid = lt2.raceid AND lt1.lap = lt2.lap JOIN drivers d1 ON lt1.driverid = d1.driverid JOIN drivers d2 ON lt2.driverid = d2.driverid JOIN races r ON lt1.raceid = r.raceid WHERE lt1.driverid < lt2.driverid AND r.year = 2014 AND lt1.lap BETWEEN 3 AND 16 GROUP BY d1.driverid, d1.forename, d1.surname, d2.driverid, d2.forename, d2.surname, r.year, r.name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 11 ORDER BY avg_time_diff_ms DESC;

SELECT d1.driverid AS driver1_id, d1.forename AS driver1_forename, d1.surname AS driver1_surname, d2.driverid AS driver2_id, d2.forename AS driver2_forename, d2.surname AS driver2_surname, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, AVG(lt1.milliseconds - lt2.milliseconds) AS avg_time_diff_ms, SUM(CASE WHEN res1.positionorder < res2.positionorder THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS driver1_wins_against_driver2, SUM(cr1.points) AS driver1_constructor_points, SUM(cr2.points) AS driver2_constructor_points, COUNT(DISTINCT lt1.lap) AS laps_compared, CORR(lt1.position, lt2.position) AS lap_position_correlation FROM laptimes lt1 JOIN laptimes lt2 ON lt1.raceid = lt2.raceid AND lt1.lap = lt2.lap AND lt1.driverid < lt2.driverid JOIN drivers d1 ON lt1.driverid = d1.driverid JOIN drivers d2 ON lt2.driverid = d2.driverid JOIN races r ON lt1.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid LEFT JOIN results res1 ON lt1.raceid = res1.raceid AND lt1.driverid = res1.driverid LEFT JOIN results res2 ON lt2.raceid = res2.raceid AND lt2.driverid = res2.driverid LEFT JOIN constructorresults cr1 ON res1.raceid = cr1.raceid AND res1.constructorid = cr1.constructorid LEFT JOIN constructorresults cr2 ON res2.raceid = cr2.raceid AND res2.constructorid = cr2.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 1984 AND r.date <= '1950-01-01' AND lt1.milliseconds IS NOT NULL AND lt2.milliseconds IS NOT NULL AND c.alt > 866 GROUP BY d1.driverid, d1.forename, d1.surname, d2.driverid, d2.forename, d2.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lt1.lap) > 77 AND AVG(lt1.milliseconds - lt2.milliseconds) BETWEEN -9071 AND 4165 ORDER BY avg_time_diff_ms DESC, driver1_wins_against_driver2 DESC LIMIT 127;

SELECT d1.driverid AS driver1_id, d1.forename AS driver1_forename, d1.surname AS driver1_surname, d2.driverid AS driver2_id, d2.forename AS driver2_forename, d2.surname AS driver2_surname, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, AVG(lt1.milliseconds - lt2.milliseconds) AS avg_time_diff_ms, SUM(CASE WHEN res1.positionorder < res2.positionorder THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS driver1_wins_against_driver2, SUM(cr1.points) AS driver1_constructor_points, SUM(cr2.points) AS driver2_constructor_points, COUNT(DISTINCT lt1.lap) AS total_laps_compared, CORR(lt1.position, lt2.position) AS lap_position_correlation FROM laptimes lt1 JOIN laptimes lt2 ON lt1.raceid = lt2.raceid AND lt1.lap = lt2.lap AND lt1.driverid < lt2.driverid JOIN drivers d1 ON lt1.driverid = d1.driverid JOIN drivers d2 ON lt2.driverid = d2.driverid JOIN races r ON lt1.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid LEFT JOIN results res1 ON lt1.raceid = res1.raceid AND lt1.driverid = res1.driverid LEFT JOIN results res2 ON lt2.raceid = res2.raceid AND lt2.driverid = res2.driverid LEFT JOIN constructorresults cr1 ON res1.raceid = cr1.raceid AND res1.constructorid = cr1.constructorid LEFT JOIN constructorresults cr2 ON res2.raceid = cr2.raceid AND res2.constructorid = cr2.constructorid WHERE r.year BETWEEN 1994 AND 1994 AND lt1.milliseconds IS NOT NULL AND lt2.milliseconds IS NOT NULL AND c.alt > 56 GROUP BY d1.driverid, d1.forename, d1.surname, d2.driverid, d2.forename, d2.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name HAVING COUNT(lt1.lap) > 81 AND AVG(lt1.milliseconds - lt2.milliseconds) > 7147 ORDER BY avg_time_diff_ms DESC, driver1_wins_against_driver2 DESC LIMIT 153;

SELECT r.raceid, r.name AS race_name, r.date, c.name AS circuit_name, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, con.name AS constructor_name, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position AS lap_position, ps.stop AS pit_stop_number, ps.lap AS pit_stop_lap, q.position AS qualifying_position FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND res.driverid = q.driverid AND res.constructorid = q.constructorid WHERE r.year = 1950 AND res.points > '0' AND (lt.milliseconds IS NULL OR lt.milliseconds < 107310) AND (ps.milliseconds IS NULL OR ps.milliseconds > 26518) AND r.date >= '1950-01-01' GROUP BY r.raceid, r.name, r.date, c.name, d.forename, d.surname, con.name, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position, ps.stop, ps.lap, q.position HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) >= 5 AND AVG(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY r.date, res.positionorder LIMIT 100;

SELECT r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, d.driverid, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, con.name AS constructor_name, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position AS lap_position, lt.milliseconds AS lap_time_ms, ps.stop AS pit_stop_number, ps.lap AS pit_stop_lap, ps.milliseconds AS pit_stop_duration_ms, q.position AS qualifying_position, ds.points AS driver_standing_points, ds.wins AS driver_standing_wins, cs.points AS constructor_standing_points, cs.wins AS constructor_standing_wins, AVG(lt.milliseconds) OVER ( PARTITION BY r.raceid, d.driverid ORDER BY lt.lap ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_lap_time, SUM(res.points) OVER ( PARTITION BY r.year, d.driverid ORDER BY r.date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS cumulative_points_season FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND res.driverid = q.driverid AND res.constructorid = q.constructorid LEFT JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid LEFT JOIN constructorstandings cs ON r.raceid = cs.raceid AND res.constructorid = cs.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 1992 AND r.year <= 2023 AND res.points > '0' AND lt.milliseconds < 93484 AND (ps.milliseconds IS NULL OR ps.milliseconds > 47094) GROUP BY r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name, d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, con.name, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position, lt.milliseconds, ps.stop, ps.lap, ps.milliseconds, q.position, ds.points, ds.wins, cs.points, cs.wins, r.date HAVING COUNT(lt.lap) > 21 ORDER BY r.year DESC, r.round DESC, cumulative_points_season DESC;

SELECT r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, d.driverid, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, res.positionorder, res.points, AVG(res.points) OVER ( PARTITION BY r.circuitid, d.driverid ORDER BY r.date ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS avg_points_last_3_races FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid WHERE r.year >= 2018 AND r.year <= 2012 AND res.positionorder <= 3 AND r.date >= '2000-03-01' GROUP BY r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name, d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, res.positionorder, res.points, r.circuitid, r.date HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0.0' ORDER BY r.year, r.round, avg_points_last_3_races DESC;

SELECT r.year, c.country, d.nationality, COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) AS race_count, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(ps.stop) AS total_pitstops FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid WHERE r.year >= 1981 AND r.year <= 1970 AND res.points > '0' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (r.year, c.country, d.nationality), (r.year, c.country), (r.year), () ) ORDER BY r.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT r.year, c.name AS circuit_name, con.name AS constructor_name, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid WHERE r.year >= 1970 AND r.year <= 1986 AND res.positionorder <= 8 GROUP BY r.year, c.circuitid, con.constructorid, d.driverid HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY r.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT r.year, c.name AS circuit_name, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, con.name AS constructor_name, res.positionorder, res.points, CASE WHEN res.positionorder = 1 THEN 'Winner' WHEN res.positionorder BETWEEN 2 AND 3 THEN 'Podium' WHEN res.positionorder BETWEEN 4 AND 10 THEN 'Points' ELSE 'No Points' END AS finish_category, AVG(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY r.year, c.circuitid) AS avg_points_per_circuit_year, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY r.year, con.constructorid) AS races_per_constructor_year FROM results res JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid WHERE r.year = 1990 AND res.points > '0' GROUP BY r.year, c.circuitid, c.name, d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, con.constructorid, con.name, res.positionorder, res.points HAVING COUNT(*) > 3 ORDER BY r.year, c.name, res.positionorder;

SELECT r.year, c.name AS constructor_name, COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) AS races_entered, COUNT(DISTINCT res.driverid) AS distinct_drivers, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(res.positionorder) AS avg_finish FROM races r JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN circuits ci ON r.circuitid = ci.circuitid WHERE r.year >= 2002 AND r.year <= 2002 AND res.grid <= 10 GROUP BY r.year, c.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT c.circuitid, c.name AS circuit_name, c.country, r.year, r.round, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.driverid) AS unique_drivers, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) AS unique_laps, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS unique_pitstops, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, MAX(ds.wins) AS max_wins_in_race, SUM(crs.points) AS total_constructor_points FROM circuits c JOIN races r ON c.circuitid = r.circuitid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND lt.driverid = ps.driverid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid AND lt.driverid = res.driverid JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND lt.driverid = ds.driverid JOIN constructorresults crs ON r.raceid = crs.raceid AND res.constructorid = crs.constructorid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid JOIN drivers d ON lt.driverid = d.driverid WHERE r.year >= 2001 AND r.date <= '1950-01-01' AND lt.milliseconds > 347998 AND res.points > '0' AND ds.position <= 11 GROUP BY c.circuitid, c.name, c.country, r.year, r.round HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lt.driverid) > 7 AND SUM(res.points) >= '10' ORDER BY r.year DESC, r.round ASC, total_points DESC;

SELECT c.circuitid, c.name AS circuit_name, c.country, r.year, r.round, d.driverid, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, con.name AS constructor_name, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position AS lap_position, lt.milliseconds AS lap_time_ms, ps.stop AS pit_stop_number, ps.lap AS pit_stop_lap, ps.milliseconds AS pit_stop_duration_ms, q.position AS qualifying_position, ds.points AS driver_standing_points, ds.wins AS driver_wins, cs.points AS constructor_standing_points, cs.wins AS constructor_wins, cr.points AS constructor_result_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) OVER (PARTITION BY r.raceid, d.driverid) AS avg_lap_time_per_race_driver, SUM(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY r.year, d.driverid ORDER BY r.date) AS cumulative_points_driver_season, COUNT(ps.stop) OVER (PARTITION BY r.raceid, d.driverid) AS total_pit_stops_per_race_driver FROM circuits c JOIN races r ON c.circuitid = r.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND d.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND d.driverid = q.driverid AND res.constructorid = q.constructorid LEFT JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND d.driverid = SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops, MAX(q.position) AS best_qualifying, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM driverstandings ds2 WHERE ds2.driverid = d.driverid AND ds2.position = 1) AS career_wins, (SELECT AVG(sub.avg_points) FROM (SELECT raceid, AVG(points) AS avg_points FROM results GROUP BY raceid) sub WHERE sub.raceid IN (SELECT raceid FROM races WHERE circuitid = cir.circuitid)) AS avg_points_on_circuit FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits cir ON r.circuitid = cir.circuitid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON d.driverid = lt.driverid AND r.raceid = lt.raceid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON d.driverid = ps.driverid AND r.raceid = ps.raceid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON d.driverid = q.driverid AND r.raceid = q.raceid JOIN seasons s ON r.year = s.year WHERE r.year >= 2007 AND r.year <= 2009 AND cir.alt > 834 AND res.grid <= 24 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round, r.name, cir.circuitid HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 79959 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_lap_time_ms ASC LIMIT 35;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops, MAX(q.position) AS best_qualifying, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM target t WHERE t.driverid = d.driverid AND t.raceid = r.raceid AND t.win = 1) AS target_wins, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY SUM(res.points) DESC) AS yearly_rank FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND d.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND d.driverid = q.driverid WHERE r.year >= 2022 AND r.date <= '1950-01-01' AND res.positionorder <= 11 AND lt.milliseconds IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM constructorstandings cs WHERE cs.raceid = r.raceid AND cs.constructorid = c.constructorid AND cs.points > '0' ) GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round, r.name, r.raceid HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 171578 ORDER BY total_points DESC, yearly_rank ASC LIMIT 936;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops, MAX(q.position) AS best_qualifying, CASE WHEN SUM(res.points) >= 170.25 THEN 'High Scorer' WHEN SUM(res.points) >= 57.11 THEN 'Medium Scorer' ELSE 'Low Scorer' END AS performance_category, CASE WHEN AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 82988 THEN 'Fast Laps' WHEN AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 97491 THEN 'Average Laps' ELSE 'Slow Laps' END AS lap_time_category FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND d.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND d.driverid = q.driverid JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND d.driverid = ds.driverid JOIN seasons s ON r.year = s.year WHERE r.year >= 2022 AND r.year <= 2020 AND r.date >= '2000-01-01' AND r.date <= '2000-01-01' AND ds.position <= 4 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round, r.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > 19.11 AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 177635 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_lap_time_ms ASC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops, MAX(q.position) AS best_qualifying, SUM(cs.wins) AS constructor_wins, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY SUM(res.points) DESC) AS yearly_rank FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON d.driverid = lt.driverid AND res.raceid = lt.raceid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON d.driverid = ps.driverid AND res.raceid = ps.raceid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON d.driverid = q.driverid AND res.raceid = q.raceid LEFT JOIN constructorstandings cs ON c.constructorid = cs.constructorid AND r.raceid = cs.raceid WHERE r.year >= 2001 AND r.date <= '1950-01-01' AND res.positionorder <= 16 AND lt.milliseconds > 165830 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round, r.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 112431 ORDER BY total_points DESC, yearly_rank ASC LIMIT 586;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points, SUM(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid, r.year ORDER BY r.round) AS cumulative_points, AVG(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid, r.year) AS avg_points_per_race FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid WHERE r.year = 2002 AND (res.grid <= 5 OR res.positionorder <= 4) AND NOT (res.points = 0 AND res.positionorder > 15) AND r.date >= '1950-01-01' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round, r.name, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY cumulative_points DESC, r.round ASC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position AS lap_position, ps.stop AS pit_stop_number, ps.duration AS pit_stop_duration, q.position AS qualifying_position, ds.position AS driver_standing_position, cs.position AS constructor_standing_position, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM results res2 WHERE res2.raceid = r.raceid AND res2.positionorder <= 2) AS top_finishers_in_race, AVG(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY r.year, c.constructorid) AS avg_constructor_points_per_year, SUM(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid ORDER BY r.date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_driver_points FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits ci ON r.circuitid = ci.circuitid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON res.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON res.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid JOIN qualifying q ON res.raceid = q.raceid AND res.driverid = q.driverid AND res.constructorid = q.constructorid JOIN driverstandings ds ON res.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid JOIN constructorstandings cs ON res.raceid = cs.raceid AND res.constructorid = cs.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 2005 AND r.year <= 2016 AND ci.country = 'UK' AND res.positionorder IS NOT NULL AND lt.lap = 2 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM constructorresults cr WHERE cr.raceid = r.raceid AND cr.constructorid = c.constructorid AND cr.points > '0') GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round, r.name, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position, ps.stop, ps.duration, q.position, ds.position, cs.position, r.raceid, r.date, c.constructorid HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY cumulative_driver_points DESC, r.year, r.round;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, res.positionorder, res.points, SUM(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid ORDER BY r.date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_total_points, AVG(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid, r.year) AS avg_points_per_season FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 2011 AND res.positionorder <= 12 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name, res.positionorder, res.points, r.date ORDER BY d.driverid, r.date;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, res.positionorder, res.points, SUM(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid, r.year ORDER BY r.date) AS cumulative_points, AVG(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid, r.year) AS avg_points_per_race, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid, r.year) AS races_entered FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid WHERE r.year = 1989 AND res.positionorder <= 12 AND res.points > '0.0' AND d.dob >= '1950-01-01' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name, res.positionorder, res.points, r.date HAVING SUM(res.points) > '1.0' ORDER BY cumulative_points DESC, r.round ASC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position AS lap_position, ps.stop AS pit_stop_number, ps.duration AS pit_stop_duration, SUM(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid, r.year ORDER BY r.date) AS cumulative_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid, r.raceid) AS avg_lap_time_ms FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN laptimes lt ON res.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON res.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid WHERE r.year = 2004 AND r.round BETWEEN 11 AND 19 AND res.positionorder <= 16 AND lt.lap >= 60 AND lt.milliseconds > 102659 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position, ps.stop, ps.duration, r.date, lt.milliseconds, r.raceid HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY cumulative_points DESC, r.round, res.positionorder;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN laptimes lt ON d.driverid = lt.driverid AND res.raceid = lt.raceid WHERE r.year = 1952 AND res.points > '0' AND lt.lap IN (SELECT lap FROM laptimes WHERE milliseconds < 112182) GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, r.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '10' ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_lap_time_ms ASC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN laptimes lt ON d.driverid = lt.driverid AND res.raceid = lt.raceid WHERE r.year = 2000 AND res.positionorder <= 3 AND lt.lap BETWEEN 64 AND 13 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, r.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid WHERE r.year = 1996 AND res.positionorder <= 20 AND lt.lap BETWEEN 5 AND 39 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, r.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_lap_time_ms ASC;

SELECT d1.driverid AS driver1_id, d1.forename AS driver1_forename, d1.surname AS driver1_surname, d2.driverid AS driver2_id, d2.forename AS driver2_forename, d2.surname AS driver2_surname, r.year, r.name AS race_name, AVG(lt1.milliseconds - lt2.milliseconds) AS avg_time_diff_ms FROM laptimes lt1 JOIN laptimes lt2 ON lt1.raceid = lt2.raceid AND lt1.lap = lt2.lap JOIN drivers d1 ON lt1.driverid = d1.driverid JOIN drivers d2 ON lt2.driverid = d2.driverid JOIN races r ON lt1.raceid = r.raceid WHERE lt1.driverid < lt2.driverid AND lt1.milliseconds IS NOT NULL AND lt2.milliseconds IS NOT NULL AND r.year >= 2023 AND lt1.lap <= 75 GROUP BY d1.driverid, d1.forename, d1.surname, d2.driverid, d2.forename, d2.surname, r.year, r.name HAVING COUNT(*) > 44 ORDER BY avg_time_diff_ms DESC;

SELECT d1.driverid AS driver1_id, d1.forename AS driver1_forename, d1.surname AS driver1_surname, d2.driverid AS driver2_id, d2.forename AS driver2_forename, d2.surname AS driver2_surname, r.year, r.name AS race_name, AVG(lt1.milliseconds - lt2.milliseconds) AS avg_time_diff_ms FROM laptimes lt1 JOIN laptimes lt2 ON lt1.raceid = lt2.raceid AND lt1.lap = lt2.lap JOIN drivers d1 ON lt1.driverid = d1.driverid JOIN drivers d2 ON lt2.driverid = d2.driverid JOIN races r ON lt1.raceid = r.raceid WHERE lt1.driverid < lt2.driverid AND r.year = 2015 AND lt1.lap BETWEEN 8 AND 28 GROUP BY d1.driverid, d1.forename, d1.surname, d2.driverid, d2.forename, d2.surname, r.year, r.name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 7 ORDER BY avg_time_diff_ms DESC;

SELECT ds.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, SUM(ds.points) AS total_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ds.raceid) AS races_count FROM driverstandings ds JOIN drivers d ON ds.driverid = d.driverid JOIN races r ON ds.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid WHERE r.year >= 2001 AND c.alt >= 139 GROUP BY ds.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(ds.points) > '10' INTERSECT SELECT ds.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, SUM(ds.points) AS total_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ds.raceid) AS races_count FROM driverstandings ds JOIN drivers d ON ds.driverid = d.driverid JOIN races r ON ds.raceid = r.raceid JOIN results res ON ds.raceid = res.raceid AND ds.driverid = res.driverid WHERE res.grid <= 1 AND res.positionorder <= 3 GROUP BY ds.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ds.raceid) >= 25 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT r.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(*) AS race_count, SUM(r.points) AS total_points FROM results r JOIN drivers d ON r.driverid = d.driverid JOIN races rc ON r.raceid = rc.raceid WHERE r.points > '0' AND rc.year >= 2002 GROUP BY r.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(r.points) > '10' INTERSECT SELECT r.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(*) AS race_count, SUM(r.points) AS total_points FROM results r JOIN drivers d ON r.driverid = d.driverid JOIN races rc ON r.raceid = rc.raceid WHERE r.grid <= 8 AND rc.year <= 2023 GROUP BY r.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING COUNT(*) > 24 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT r.raceid, r.name AS race_name, r.date, c.name AS circuit_name, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, con.name AS constructor_name, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position AS lap_position, ps.stop AS pit_stop_number, ps.lap AS pit_stop_lap, q.position AS qualifying_position FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND res.driverid = q.driverid AND res.constructorid = q.constructorid WHERE r.year = 1967 AND res.points > '0' AND (lt.milliseconds IS NULL OR lt.milliseconds < 95861) AND (ps.milliseconds IS NULL OR ps.milliseconds > 58204) AND r.date >= '1950-01-01' GROUP BY r.raceid, r.name, r.date, c.name, d.forename, d.surname, con.name, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position, ps.stop, ps.lap, q.position HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) >= 9 AND AVG(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY r.date, res.positionorder LIMIT 100;

SELECT r.raceid, r.name AS race_name, r.date, c.name AS circuit_name, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, con.name AS constructor_name, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position AS lap_position, ps.stop AS pit_stop_number, ps.lap AS pit_stop_lap, q.position AS qualifying_position FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND res.driverid = q.driverid AND res.constructorid = q.constructorid WHERE r.year = 1998 AND res.points > '0' AND (lt.milliseconds IS NULL OR lt.milliseconds < 87445) AND (ps.milliseconds IS NULL OR ps.milliseconds > 37724) AND r.date >= '1950-01-01' GROUP BY r.raceid, r.name, r.date, c.name, d.forename, d.surname, con.name, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position, ps.stop, ps.lap, q.position HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) >= 10 AND AVG(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY r.date, res.positionorder LIMIT 100;

SELECT r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, d.driverid, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, res.positionorder, res.points, AVG(res.points) OVER ( PARTITION BY r.year, d.driverid ORDER BY r.date ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_points_last_3_races FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid WHERE r.year >= 2019 AND r.year <= 1971 AND res.positionorder <= 9 AND r.date >= '1950-01-01' GROUP BY r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name, d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, res.positionorder, res.points, r.date HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY r.year, r.round, moving_avg_points_last_3_races DESC;

SELECT r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, con.name AS constructor_name, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points, CASE WHEN res.positionorder = 1 THEN 'Winner' WHEN res.positionorder BETWEEN 2 AND 3 THEN 'Podium' WHEN res.positionorder BETWEEN 4 AND 10 THEN 'Points' ELSE 'No Points' END AS finish_category, AVG(l.milliseconds) OVER (PARTITION BY r.raceid, d.driverid) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(p.stop) OVER (PARTITION BY r.raceid, d.driverid) AS pit_stop_count FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid LEFT JOIN laptimes l ON r.raceid = l.raceid AND res.driverid = l.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops p ON r.raceid = p.raceid AND res.driverid = p.driverid WHERE r.year = 1994 AND res.points > '0' GROUP BY r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name, d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, con.name, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points, l.milliseconds, p.stop ORDER BY r.round, res.positionorder LIMIT 100;

SELECT r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, con.name AS constructor_name, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points, CASE WHEN res.positionorder = 1 THEN 'Winner' WHEN res.positionorder BETWEEN 2 AND 3 THEN 'Podium' WHEN res.positionorder BETWEEN 4 AND 10 THEN 'Points' ELSE 'No Points' END AS finish_category, AVG(l.milliseconds) OVER (PARTITION BY r.raceid, d.driverid) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(p.stop) OVER (PARTITION BY r.raceid, d.driverid) AS pit_stop_count FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid LEFT JOIN laptimes l ON r.raceid = l.raceid AND res.driverid = l.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops p ON r.raceid = p.raceid AND res.driverid = p.driverid WHERE r.year = 2001 AND res.points > '0' GROUP BY r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name, d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, con.name, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points, l.milliseconds, p.stop ORDER BY r.round, res.positionorder LIMIT 100;

SELECT r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, con.name AS constructor_name, res.points, res.positionorder, ds.wins AS driver_wins, cs.wins AS constructor_wins FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid JOIN constructorstandings cs ON r.raceid = cs.raceid AND res.constructorid = cs.constructorid WHERE r.year = 1973 AND res.points >= '0' INTERSECT SELECT r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, con.name AS constructor_name, res.points, res.positionorder, ds.wins AS driver_wins, cs.wins AS constructor_wins FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid JOIN constructorstandings cs ON r.raceid = cs.raceid AND res.constructorid = cs.constructorid WHERE r.round <= 17 AND res.positionorder <= 16 ORDER BY raceid, driver_name;

SELECT r.year, c.country, con.nationality, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, COUNT(DISTINCT res.driverid) AS unique_drivers, AVG(res.positionorder) AS avg_finish_pos FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 1966 AND r.year <= 1963 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (r.year, c.country, con.nationality), (r.year, c.country), (r.year, con.nationality), (r.year), () ) HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY r.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT r.year, c.country, d.nationality, COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) AS race_count, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid WHERE r.year >= 1960 AND r.year <= 1962 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (r.year, c.country, d.nationality), (r.year, c.country), (r.year), () ) ORDER BY r.year, c.country, d.nationality;

SELECT r.year, c.name AS circuit_name, con.name AS constructor_name, COUNT(DISTINCT d.driverid) AS unique_drivers, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) AS unique_laps_raced, SUM(res.points) AS total_points FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid WHERE r.year >= 2010 AND r.year <= 2008 GROUP BY r.year, c.name, con.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY r.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT r.year, c.name AS circuit_name, con.name AS constructor_name, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.driverid) AS distinct_drivers, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) AS distinct_laps_led, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid AND lt.driverid = res.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 2003 AND lt.milliseconds <= 85681 GROUP BY r.year, c.name, con.name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lt.driverid) > 3 ORDER BY r.year DESC, distinct_drivers DESC;

SELECT r.year, c.name AS circuit_name, con.name AS constructor_name, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops FROM races r INNER JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid INNER JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid INNER JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid INNER JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid WHERE r.year >= 2021 AND r.year <= 2005 AND res.positionorder <= 1 GROUP BY r.year, c.circuitid, con.constructorid, d.driverid HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY r.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT r.year, c.name AS circuit_name, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, con.name AS constructor_name, res.positionorder, res.points, CASE WHEN res.positionorder = 1 THEN 'Winner' WHEN res.positionorder BETWEEN 2 AND 3 THEN 'Podium' WHEN res.positionorder BETWEEN 4 AND 10 THEN 'Points' ELSE 'No Points' END AS finish_category, AVG(l.milliseconds) OVER (PARTITION BY r.raceid, d.driverid) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(p.stop) OVER (PARTITION BY r.raceid, d.driverid) AS total_pitstops FROM races r JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid LEFT JOIN laptimes l ON r.raceid = l.raceid AND res.driverid = l.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops p ON r.raceid = p.raceid AND res.driverid = p.driverid WHERE r.year >= 2004 AND r.year <= 2011 AND res.points > '0' GROUP BY r.year, c.name, d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, con.name, res.positionorder, res.points, r.raceid, l.milliseconds, p.stop ORDER BY r.year DESC, res.positionorder ASC;

SELECT r.year, c.name AS constructor_name, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.driverid) AS distinct_drivers, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) AS distinct_laps, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms FROM laptimes lt JOIN races r ON lt.raceid = r.raceid JOIN results res ON lt.raceid = res.raceid AND lt.driverid = res.driverid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 2016 AND lt.milliseconds <= 120263 GROUP BY r.year, c.name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lt.driverid) > 3 ORDER BY r.year DESC, avg_lap_time_ms ASC;

SELECT r.year, c.name AS constructor_name, COUNT(DISTINCT res.driverid) AS unique_drivers, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(res.positionorder) AS avg_finish FROM results res JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 2019 AND res.points > '0' GROUP BY r.year, c.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '50' ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT r.year, c.name AS constructor_name, COUNT(DISTINCT res.raceid) AS races_entered, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(res.positionorder) AS avg_finish_position, MAX(ds.wins) AS max_wins_in_season FROM constructors c JOIN results res ON c.constructorid = res.constructorid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN driverstandings ds ON res.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid WHERE r.year >= 2000 AND res.points > '0' GROUP BY r.year, c.constructorid, c.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '100' AND AVG(res.positionorder) < 12 ORDER BY total_points DESC, r.year ASC;

SELECT r.year, c.name AS constructor_name, COUNT(DISTINCT res.raceid) AS races_entered, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(res.positionorder) AS avg_finish_position, MAX(ds.wins) AS max_wins_in_season FROM constructors c JOIN results res ON c.constructorid = res.constructorid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN driverstandings ds ON res.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid WHERE r.year >= 2014 AND res.points > '0' GROUP BY r.year, c.constructorid, c.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '10' ORDER BY total_points DESC, r.year ASC;

SELECT r.year, c.name AS constructor_name, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY SUM(res.points) DESC) AS yearly_rank FROM races r JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid WHERE r.year >= 1960 AND r.year <= 1985 GROUP BY r.year, c.constructorid, c.name, d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY r.year DESC, yearly_rank ASC;

SELECT r.year, c.name AS constructor_name, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY SUM(res.points) DESC) AS yearly_rank FROM races r JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid WHERE r.year >= 1963 AND r.year <= 2010 GROUP BY r.year, c.constructorid, c.name, d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY r.year DESC, yearly_rank ASC;

SELECT c.circuitid, c.name AS circuit_name, c.country, r.year, r.round, d.driverid, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, con.constructorid, con.name AS constructor_name, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) AS distinct_laps_driven, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS distinct_pit_stops, COUNT(DISTINCT q.position) AS distinct_qualifying_positions, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, MAX(ds.wins) AS max_wins_in_season, SUM(cr.points) AS total_constructor_points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year, c.circuitid ORDER BY SUM(res.points) DESC) AS driver_rank_per_circuit_year FROM circuits c JOIN races r ON c.circuitid = r.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND res.driverid = q.driverid AND res.constructorid = q.constructorid JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid JOIN constructorresults cr ON r.raceid = cr.raceid AND res.constructorid = cr.constructorid JOIN constructorstandings cs ON r.raceid = cs.raceid AND res.constructorid = cs.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 1962 AND r.year <= 1984 AND res.grid > 12 AND lt.position <= 14 AND ds.position <= 25 AND cs.position <= 5 GROUP BY c.circuitid, c.name, c.country, r.year, r.round, d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, con.constructorid, con.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 97025 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) >= 70 ORDER BY r.year DESC, r.round, total_points DESC, driver_rank_per_circuit_year;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, 'race_points' AS source_type, SUM(r.points) AS total_points FROM drivers d JOIN results r ON d.driverid = r.driverid JOIN races rc ON r.raceid = rc.raceid WHERE rc.year = 2013 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname UNION ALL SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, 'standings_points' AS source_type, SUM(ds.points) AS total_points FROM drivers d JOIN driverstandings ds ON d.driverid = ds.driverid JOIN races rc ON ds.raceid = rc.raceid WHERE rc.year = 1963 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) AS races_entered, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(res.positionorder) AS avg_finish_position, MAX(ds.wins) AS max_wins_in_season FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN driverstandings ds ON d.driverid = ds.driverid AND r.raceid = ds.raceid JOIN seasons s ON r.year = s.year WHERE r.year >= 2006 AND r.year <= 2009 AND res.points > '0' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(res.points) > '50' AND COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) >= 61 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_finish_position ASC LIMIT 50;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name AS constructor_name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name AS circuit_name, cir.country, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(res.positionorder) AS avg_finish_position, COUNT(DISTINCT res.raceid) AS races_entered, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN res.positionorder = 1 THEN res.raceid END) AS wins, SUM(lt.milliseconds) / 1000.0 AS total_race_seconds, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops, AVG(ps.milliseconds) AS avg_pitstop_ms, MIN(q.position) AS best_qualifying, AVG(q.position) AS avg_qualifying, SUM(cr.points) AS constructor_points, MAX(cs.wins) AS constructor_wins, SUM(ds.wins) AS driver_season_wins, COUNT(t.win) AS target_wins FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits cir ON r.circuitid = cir.circuitid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON res.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON res.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON res.raceid = q.raceid AND res.driverid = q.driverid AND res.constructorid = q.constructorid LEFT JOIN constructorresults cr ON res.raceid = cr.raceid AND res.constructorid = cr.constructorid LEFT JOIN constructorstandings cs ON res.raceid = cs.raceid AND res.constructorid = cs.constructorid LEFT JOIN driverstandings ds ON res.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid LEFT JOIN target t ON res.raceid = t.raceid AND res.driverid = t.driverid WHERE r.year >= 1990 AND r.year <= 2007 AND res.points > '0' AND lt.milliseconds > 116604 AND cir.alt > 437 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name, cir.country HAVING SUM(res.points) > '10' AND COUNT(DISTINCT res.raceid) >= 49 AND AVG(res.positionorder) < 13 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_finish_position ASC LIMIT 53;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name AS constructor_name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name AS circuit_name, cir.country, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points, res.laps, res.milliseconds AS race_time_ms, lt.lap, lt.position AS lap_position, lt.milliseconds AS lap_time_ms, ps.stop, ps.lap AS pit_lap, ps.milliseconds AS pit_time_ms, q.position AS ON res.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON res.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON res.raceid = q.raceid AND res.driverid = q.driverid AND res.constructorid = q.constructorid LEFT JOIN driverstandings ds ON res.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid LEFT JOIN constructorstandings cs ON res.raceid = cs.raceid AND res.constructorid = cs.constructorid LEFT JOIN constructorresults cr ON res.raceid = cr.raceid AND res.constructorid = cr.constructorid LEFT JOIN status s ON res.statusid = s.statusid LEFT JOIN target t ON res.raceid = t.raceid AND res.driverid = t.driverid WHERE r.year >= 2023 AND r.year <= 1976 AND res.points >= '0' AND res.grid <= 17 AND cir.lat >= '-90' AND cir.lat <= '-90' AND cir.lng >= '-180' AND cir.lng <= '-180' AND d.dob >= '1950-01-01' AND (lt.milliseconds IS NULL OR lt.milliseconds <= 61316) AND (ps.milliseconds IS NULL OR ps.milliseconds >= 40260) GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name, cir.country, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points, res.laps, res.milliseconds, lt.lap, lt.position, lt.lap) >= 30 AND AVG(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY r.year DESC, r.round DESC, res.positionorder ASC, lt.lap ASC, ps.stop ASC LIMIT 201 OFFSET 3867;

lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON res.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON res.raceid = q.raceid AND res.driverid = q.driverid AND res.constructorid = q.constructorid LEFT JOIN driverstandings ds ON res.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid LEFT JOIN constructorstandings cs ON res.raceid = cs.raceid AND res.constructorid = cs.constructorid LEFT JOIN constructorresults cr ON res.raceid = cr.raceid AND res.constructorid = cr.constructorid LEFT JOIN status s ON res.statusid = s.statusid LEFT JOIN target t ON res.raceid = t.raceid AND res.driverid = t.driverid LEFT JOIN seasons se ON r.year = se.year WHERE r.year >= 1963 AND r.year <= 1992 AND res.positionorder IS NOT NULL AND res.points > '0' AND lt.milliseconds > 73817 AND ps.milliseconds > 48248 AND ds.points >= '0' AND cs.points >= '0' AND cr.points >= '0' AND t.win = 0 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name, res.positionorder, res.points, res.grid, res.laps, lt.lap, lt.position, lt.milliseconds, ps.stop, ps.lap, ps.milliseconds, q.position, ds.points, ds.position, ds.wins, cs.points, SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name AS constructor_name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name AS circuit_name, res.positionorder, res.points, res.grid, res.laps, res.fastestlap, ds.position, ds.wins, cs.position, cs.wins, lt.total_laps, lt.avg_position, ps.total_stops, ps.total_pit_milliseconds, q.avg_qualifying_position HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND
