SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) AS total_laps_raced, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, SUM(CASE WHEN res.positionorder = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wins, MIN(ps.milliseconds) AS fastest_pitstop_ms FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON d.driverid = lt.driverid AND res.raceid = lt.raceid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON d.driverid = ps.driverid AND res.raceid = ps.raceid JOIN qualifying q ON d.driverid = q.driverid AND res.raceid = q.raceid JOIN driverstandings ds ON d.driverid = ds.driverid AND res.raceid = ds.raceid WHERE r.year >= 2002 AND r.date <= '2000-01-01' AND res.grid <= 15 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round, r.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 107532 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_lap_time_ms ASC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops, MAX(ds.wins) AS max_wins_in_season, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY SUM(res.points) DESC) AS yearly_rank FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON d.driverid = lt.driverid AND res.raceid = lt.raceid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON d.driverid = ps.driverid AND res.raceid = ps.raceid JOIN driverstandings ds ON d.driverid = ds.driverid AND res.raceid = ds.raceid WHERE r.year >= 1969 AND r.date <= '1950-01-01' AND res.grid <= 20 AND lt.milliseconds > 180026 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM qualifying q WHERE q.raceid = r.raceid AND q.driverid = d.driverid AND q.position <= 20 ) GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round, r.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) >= 0 ORDER BY total_points DESC, yearly_rank LIMIT 305;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops, MAX(q.position) AS best_qualifying, CASE WHEN SUM(res.points) >= 432.8 THEN 'High Scorer' WHEN SUM(res.points) >= 90.68 THEN 'Medium Scorer' ELSE 'Low Scorer' END AS performance_category, CASE WHEN AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 86911 THEN 'Fast Laps' WHEN AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 113912 THEN 'Average Laps' ELSE 'Slow Laps' END AS lap_time_category FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND d.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND d.driverid = q.driverid JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND d.driverid = ds.driverid JOIN constructorresults cr ON r.raceid = cr.raceid AND c.constructorid = cr.constructorid JOIN constructorstandings cs ON r.raceid = cs.raceid AND c.constructorid = cs.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 2021 AND r.year <= 2022 AND r.date >= '2000-01-01' AND r.date <= '2000-01-01' AND ds.position <= 5 AND cs.position <= 3 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round, r.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > 76.07 AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 146985 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) >= 2 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_lap_time_ms ASC LIMIT 24;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops, MAX(q.position) AS best_qualifying, SUM(CASE WHEN res.positionorder = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wins FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON d.driverid = lt.driverid AND r.raceid = lt.raceid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON d.driverid = ps.driverid AND r.raceid = ps.raceid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON d.driverid = q.driverid AND r.raceid = q.raceid WHERE r.year >= 1996 AND r.date <= '1950-01-01' AND res.points > '0' AND lt.milliseconds < 87115 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round, r.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '10' AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 67147 UNION ALL SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, SUM(cs.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops, MAX(q.position) AS best_qualifying, SUM(cs.wins) AS wins FROM drivers d JOIN constructorstandings cs ON d.driverid = cs.constructorid JOIN races r ON cs.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON cs.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON d.driverid = lt.driverid AND r.raceid = lt.raceid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON d.driverid = ps.driverid AND r.raceid = ps.raceid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON d.driverid = q.driverid AND r.raceid = q.raceid WHERE r.year >= 1984 AND r.date <= '1950-01-01' AND cs.points > '0' AND lt.milliseconds < 84277 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round, r.name HAVING SUM(cs.points) > '10' AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 70480 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_lap_time_ms ASC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position AS lap_position, lt.milliseconds AS lap_time_ms, ps.stop AS pit_stop_number, ps.lap AS pit_stop_lap, ps.milliseconds AS pit_stop_duration_ms, q.position AS qualifying_position, cs.points AS constructor_points, cs.wins AS constructor_wins, ds.points AS driver_standing_points, ds.wins AS driver_wins, AVG(lt.milliseconds) OVER (PARTITION BY lt.raceid, lt.driverid) AS avg_lap_time_per_race, SUM(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY res.driverid ORDER BY r.date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_driver_points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.raceid ORDER BY res.positionorder) AS race_finish_rank FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits ci ON r.circuitid = ci.circuitid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON res.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON res.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON res.raceid = q.raceid AND res.driverid = q.driverid AND res.constructorid = q.constructorid JOIN constructorstandings cs ON res.raceid = cs.raceid AND res.constructorid = cs.constructorid JOIN driverstandings ds ON res.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid JOIN seasons s ON r.year = s.year WHERE r.year >= 2007 AND r.year <= 1951 AND res.points > '0' AND lt.milliseconds < 98618 AND ci.alt > 629 AND r.date >= '1950-01-01' AND r.date <= '1950-01-01' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round, r.name, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position, lt.milliseconds, ps.stop, ps.lap, ps.milliseconds, q.position, cs.points, cs.wins, ds.points, ds.wins, r.date, r.raceid, lt.raceid, lt.driverid, res.driverid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) > 13 AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 81965 ORDER BY cumulative_driver_points DESC, race_finish_rank;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position AS lap_position, lt.milliseconds AS lap_time_ms, ps.stop, ps.duration AS pitstop_duration, ps.milliseconds AS pitstop_ms, q.position AS qualifying_position, cs.points AS constructor_points, cs.wins AS constructor_wins, ds.points AS driver_points, ds.wins AS driver_wins, AVG(lt.milliseconds) OVER (PARTITION BY lt.raceid, lt.driverid) AS avg_lap_time_per_race_driver, SUM(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY res.constructorid ORDER BY r.date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_constructor_points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.raceid ORDER BY res.positionorder) AS race_finish_rank FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits ci ON r.circuitid = ci.circuitid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON res.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON res.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON res.raceid = q.raceid AND res.driverid = q.driverid AND res.constructorid = q.constructorid JOIN constructorstandings cs ON res.raceid = cs.raceid AND res.constructorid = cs.constructorid JOIN driverstandings ds ON res.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid JOIN seasons s ON r.year = s.year WHERE r.year >= 1990 AND r.year <= 2015 AND res.points > '0' AND lt.milliseconds < 103613 AND cs.points >= '0' AND ds.points >= '0' AND ci.alt > 529 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round, r.name, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position, lt.milliseconds, ps.stop, ps.duration, ps.milliseconds, q.position, cs.points, cs.wins, ds.points, ds.wins, r.date, r.raceid, res.constructorid, lt.raceid, lt.driverid HAVING COUNT(lt.lap) > 46 AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 79757 ORDER BY r.year DESC, r.round DESC, cumulative_constructor_points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.raceid, r.name AS race_name, r.date, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(r.date, d.dob)) AS driver_age_at_race, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position AS lap_position, ps.stop AS pit_stop_number, ps.duration AS pit_stop_duration FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND d.driverid = ps.driverid WHERE r.date >= '2000-01-01' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM r.date) = 2007 AND res.points > '0' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.raceid, r.name, r.date, d.dob, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position, ps.stop, ps.duration HAVING COUNT(lt.lap) > 3 ORDER BY r.date DESC, res.points DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position AS lap_position, ps.stop AS pit_stop_number, ps.lap AS pit_stop_lap, q.position AS qualifying_position FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN laptimes lt ON res.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON res.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON res.raceid = q.raceid AND res.driverid = q.driverid WHERE r.year = 2020 AND r.round BETWEEN 1 AND 20 AND res.positionorder <= 16 AND lt.lap >= 74 AND lt.position <= 24 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position, ps.stop, ps.lap, q.position HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) >= 10 ORDER BY SUM(res.points) DESC, d.surname, d.forename;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, COUNT(*) AS races_entered FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid WHERE r.year = 2015 AND res.positionorder <= 1 AND d.driverid IN ( SELECT driverid FROM results WHERE points > '0' GROUP BY driverid HAVING COUNT(*) >= 4 ) GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY total_points DESC, races_entered DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, res.positionorder, res.points, SUM(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid ORDER BY r.date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_points, AVG(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid, r.year) AS avg_points_per_season, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.raceid ORDER BY res.positionorder) AS race_finish_rank FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 2014 AND r.year <= 2004 AND res.points > '0' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name, res.positionorder, res.points, r.date, r.raceid ORDER BY d.driverid, r.date;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, res.points, res.positionorder, ds.wins, AVG(lt.milliseconds) OVER (PARTITION BY lt.raceid, lt.driverid) AS avg_lap_ms FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN driverstandings ds ON res.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON res.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid WHERE r.year = 2000 AND res.points > '0' AND d.driverid IN ( SELECT driverid FROM results WHERE positionorder <= 4 ) ORDER BY res.points DESC, avg_lap_ms ASC;

SELECT r.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(*) AS race_count, SUM(r.points) AS total_points FROM results r JOIN drivers d ON r.driverid = d.driverid JOIN races rc ON r.raceid = rc.raceid WHERE r.points > '0' AND rc.year >= 2011 GROUP BY r.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(r.points) > '10' INTERSECT SELECT r.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(*) AS race_count, SUM(r.points) AS total_points FROM results r JOIN drivers d ON r.driverid = d.driverid JOIN races rc ON r.raceid = rc.raceid WHERE r.grid <= 5 AND rc.year <= 2008 GROUP BY r.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING COUNT(*) > 48 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT r.year, c.country, con.nationality, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, COUNT(DISTINCT res.driverid) AS unique_drivers, AVG(res.positionorder) AS avg_finish FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 1985 AND r.date <= '1950-01-01' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (r.year, c.country, con.nationality), (r.year, c.country), (r.year), () ) ORDER BY r.year, c.country, con.nationality;

SELECT r.year, c.country, d.nationality, COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) AS race_count, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_ms FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid WHERE r.year >= 2018 AND r.year <= 1974 AND res.points > '0' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (r.year, c.country, d.nationality), (r.year, c.country), (r.year), () ) ORDER BY r.year, c.country, d.nationality;

SELECT r.year, c.name AS circuit_name, con.name AS constructor_name, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) AS distinct_laps_driven, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS distinct_pit_stops, COUNT(DISTINCT q.position) AS distinct_qualifying_positions, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, MAX(ds.wins) AS max_wins_in_season, SUM(cr.points) AS total_constructor_points FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND res.driverid = q.driverid AND res.constructorid = q.constructorid JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid JOIN constructorresults cr ON r.raceid = cr.raceid AND res.constructorid = cr.constructorid JOIN constructorstandings cs ON r.raceid = cs.raceid AND res.constructorid = cs.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 1978 AND r.year <= 1959 AND res.grid <= 16 AND d.dob >= '1950-01-01' AND lt.milliseconds > 280581 GROUP BY r.year, c.circuitid, con.constructorid, d.driverid HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) >= 17 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) <= 2 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_lap_time_ms ASC LIMIT 100;

SELECT r.year, c.name AS circuit_name, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, con.name AS constructor_name, res.positionorder, res.points, CASE WHEN res.positionorder = 1 THEN 'Winner' WHEN res.positionorder BETWEEN 2 AND 3 THEN 'Podium' WHEN res.positionorder BETWEEN 4 AND 10 THEN 'Points' ELSE 'No Points' END AS finish_category, AVG(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY r.year, c.circuitid) AS avg_points_per_circuit_year, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY r.year, con.constructorid) AS races_per_constructor_year FROM results res JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid WHERE r.year = 2003 AND res.points > '0' GROUP BY r.year, c.circuitid, c.name, d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, con.constructorid, con.name, res.positionorder, res.points HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY r.year, c.name, res.positionorder;

SELECT r.year, c.name AS constructor_name, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY SUM(res.points) DESC) AS yearly_rank FROM races r JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid WHERE r.year >= 1982 AND r.year <= 2010 GROUP BY r.year, c.constructorid, c.name, d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY r.year DESC, yearly_rank ASC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) AS races_entered, SUM(r.points) AS total_points, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM results r2 WHERE r2.driverid = d.driverid AND r2.position = 1) AS career_wins FROM drivers d JOIN results r ON d.driverid = r.driverid JOIN races rc ON r.raceid = rc.raceid JOIN circuits c ON rc.circuitid = c.circuitid WHERE rc.year >= 1962 AND rc.year <= 2021 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(r.points) > '0' ORDER BY total_points DESC LIMIT 20;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) AS races_entered, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(res.positionorder) AS avg_finish_position FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 2010 AND r.year <= 2016 AND res.points > '0' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) >= 35 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(r.resultid) AS race_count, COALESCE(SUM(r.points), 0) AS total_points FROM drivers d LEFT JOIN results r ON d.driverid = r.driverid LEFT JOIN races rc ON r.raceid = rc.raceid WHERE rc.year >= 2015 OR rc.year IS NULL GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING COALESCE(SUM(r.points), 0) > '0' ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(r.resultid) AS race_count, SUM(r.points) AS total_points, AVG(r.positionorder) AS avg_finish FROM drivers d JOIN results r ON d.driverid = r.driverid JOIN races rc ON r.raceid = rc.raceid WHERE rc.year >= 1992 AND r.points > '0' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING COUNT(r.resultid) >= 26 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name AS constructor_name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name AS circuit_name, AVG(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY res.driverid, res.constructorid) AS avg_points_per_entry, SUM(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY res.driverid ORDER BY r.date) AS cumulative_points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.raceid ORDER BY res.points DESC) AS race_rank, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM laptimes lt WHERE lt.raceid = r.raceid AND lt.driverid = d.driverid AND lt.position = 1) AS laps_led, (SELECT AVG(ps.milliseconds) FROM pitstops ps WHERE ps.raceid = r.raceid AND ps.driverid = d.driverid) AS avg_pitstop_ms, (SELECT SUM(cr.points) FROM constructorresults cr WHERE cr.raceid = r.raceid AND cr.constructorid = c.constructorid) AS constructor_race_points, (SELECT MAX(ds.wins) FROM driverstandings ds WHERE ds.raceid = r.raceid AND ds.driverid IN (SELECT driverid FROM results WHERE constructorid = c.constructorid AND raceid = r.raceid)) AS max_wins_by_constructor_driver FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits cir ON r.circuitid = cir.circuitid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND d.driverid = q.driverid AND c.constructorid = q.constructorid LEFT JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND d.driverid = ds.driverid LEFT JOIN constructorstandings cs ON r.raceid = cs.raceid AND c.constructorid = cs.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 1950 AND r.year <= 1963 AND res.grid <= 3 AND res.positionorder <= 21 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM laptimes lt2 WHERE lt2.raceid = r.raceid AND lt2.driverid = d.driverid) >= 35 AND (SELECT AVG(lt3.milliseconds) FROM laptimes lt3 WHERE lt3.raceid = r.raceid AND lt3.driverid = d.driverid) <= 73772 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name, res.points, r.date, SELECT r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, con.name AS constructor_name, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points, ds.wins AS driver_season_wins, cs.wins AS constructor_season_wins, AVG(lt.milliseconds) OVER (PARTITION BY r.raceid, d.driverid) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(ps.stop) OVER (PARTITION BY r.raceid, d.driverid) AS pit_stop_count FROM races r INNER JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid INNER JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid INNER JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid INNER JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid LEFT JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND d.driverid = ds.driverid LEFT JOIN constructorstandings cs ON r.raceid = cs.raceid AND con.constructorid = cs.constructorid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND d.driverid = ps.driverid WHERE r.year >= 2020 AND r.year <= 1952 AND res.points > '0' GROUP BY r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name, d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, con.constructorid, con.name, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points, ds.wins, cs.wins, ps.stop, lt.milliseconds HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT res.positionorder) > 0 ORDER BY r.year DESC, r.round DESC, res.points DESC LIMIT 469;

SELECT r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, con.name AS constructor_name, res.points, res.positionorder, ds.wins AS driver_wins, cs.wins AS constructor_wins FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid LEFT JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid LEFT JOIN constructorstandings cs ON r.raceid = cs.raceid AND res.constructorid = cs.constructorid WHERE r.year = 1993 AND res.points > '0' INTERSECT SELECT r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, con.name AS constructor_name, res.points, res.positionorder, ds.wins AS driver_wins, cs.wins AS constructor_wins FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid LEFT JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid LEFT JOIN constructorstandings cs ON r.raceid = cs.raceid AND res.constructorid = cs.constructorid WHERE r.year = 1989 AND res.positionorder <= 10 ORDER BY raceid, driver_name;

SELECT r.year, c.country, con.nationality, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, COUNT(DISTINCT res.driverid) AS unique_drivers, AVG(res.positionorder) AS avg_finish FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 1970 AND r.year <= 2021 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (r.year, c.country, con.nationality), (r.year, c.country), (r.year, con.nationality), (r.year), () ) HAVING SUM(res.points) > 65.15 ORDER BY r.year, total_points DESC;

SELECT r.year, c.country, d.nationality, COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) AS race_count, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid WHERE r.year >= 1999 AND r.year <= 1956 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (r.year, c.country, d.nationality), (r.year, c.country), (r.year), () ) ORDER BY r.year, c.country, d.nationality;

SELECT r.year, c.country, d.nationality, COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) AS race_count, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(ps.stop) AS total_pitstops FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid WHERE r.year >= 1999 AND r.year <= 2010 AND res.points > '0' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (r.year, c.country, d.nationality), (r.year, c.country), (r.year), () ) ORDER BY r.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT r.year, c.name AS circuit_name, con.name AS constructor_name, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.driverid) AS distinct_drivers, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) AS distinct_laps_led, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid AND lt.driverid = res.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 2019 AND lt.milliseconds <= 80205 GROUP BY r.year, c.name, con.name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lt.driverid) > 5 ORDER BY r.year DESC, distinct_drivers DESC;

SELECT r.year, c.name AS constructor_name, COUNT(DISTINCT res.driverid) AS unique_drivers, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(res.positionorder) AS avg_finish FROM results res JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 2007 AND res.points > '0' GROUP BY r.year, c.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '10' ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT r.year, c.name AS constructor_name, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) AS distinct_laps_raced, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS distinct_pit_stops, COUNT(DISTINCT q.position) AS distinct_qualifying_positions, AVG(res.points) AS avg_points, SUM(ds.wins) AS total_wins FROM races r JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND res.driverid = q.driverid LEFT JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid WHERE r.year >= 2015 AND r.year <= 2008 AND res.positionorder <= 1 GROUP BY r.year, c.constructorid, c.name, d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING AVG(res.points) > '0.0' ORDER BY r.year DESC, total_wins DESC, avg_points DESC;

SELECT c.circuitid, c.name AS circuit_name, c.country, r.year, r.round, d.driverid, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, con.constructorid, con.name AS constructor_name, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) AS distinct_laps_driven, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS distinct_pit_stops, COUNT(DISTINCT q.position) AS distinct_qualifying_positions, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, MAX(ds.wins) AS max_wins_in_season, SUM(cr.points) AS total_constructor_points FROM circuits c JOIN races r ON c.circuitid = r.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND d.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND d.driverid = q.driverid LEFT JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND d.driverid = ds.driverid LEFT JOIN constructorresults cr ON r.raceid = cr.raceid AND con.constructorid = cr.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 1961 AND r.year <= 2000 AND res.positionorder <= 16 AND lt.milliseconds > 170658 AND d.dob >= '1950-01-01' GROUP BY c.circuitid, c.name, c.country, r.year, r.round, d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, con.constructorid, con.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) >= 52 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) <= 2 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_lap_time_ms ASC, distinct_laps_driven DESC LIMIT 972;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, COUNT(*) AS races_entered FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid WHERE r.year = 1998 AND res.grid <= 18 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' UNION ALL SELECT d.driverid, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) AS laps_analyzed FROM drivers d JOIN laptimes lt ON d.driverid = lt.driverid JOIN races r ON lt.raceid = r.raceid JOIN results res ON lt.raceid = res.raceid AND lt.driverid = res.driverid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid WHERE r.year = 1991 AND lt.position <= 20 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round HAVING AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 61208 ORDER BY year, round, driver_name;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, COUNT(*) AS races_entered FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid WHERE r.year = 2007 AND res.grid <= 18 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' UNION ALL SELECT d.driverid, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) AS laps_analyzed FROM drivers d JOIN laptimes lt ON d.driverid = lt.driverid JOIN races r ON lt.raceid = r.raceid JOIN results res ON lt.raceid = res.raceid AND lt.driverid = res.driverid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid WHERE r.year = 2001 AND lt.position <= 19 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round HAVING AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 113665 ORDER BY year, round, driver_name;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) AS races_entered, SUM(r.points) AS total_points, (SELECT AVG(l.milliseconds) FROM laptimes l WHERE l.driverid = d.driverid AND l.lap = 20) AS avg_lap_time_ms FROM drivers d JOIN results r ON d.driverid = r.driverid JOIN races rc ON r.raceid = rc.raceid WHERE rc.year >= 2008 AND rc.year <= 2011 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(r.points) > '0' ORDER BY total_points DESC LIMIT 66;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) AS races_entered, SUM(r.points) AS total_points, (SELECT AVG(lt.milliseconds) FROM laptimes lt WHERE lt.driverid = d.driverid AND lt.raceid IN (SELECT raceid FROM races WHERE year = 2013)) AS avg_lap_time_ms FROM drivers d JOIN results r ON d.driverid = r.driverid JOIN races rc ON r.raceid = rc.raceid JOIN circuits c ON rc.circuitid = c.circuitid WHERE rc.year >= 2007 AND rc.year <= 2008 AND c.country = 'UK' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(r.points) > '10' ORDER BY total_points DESC LIMIT 20;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) AS races_entered, SUM(r.points) AS total_points, AVG(r.positionorder) AS avg_finish_position FROM drivers d JOIN results r ON d.driverid = r.driverid JOIN races rc ON r.raceid = rc.raceid WHERE rc.year IN (SELECT year FROM seasons WHERE year >= 2013 AND year <= 2017) AND r.positionorder <= 11 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(r.points) > '0' ORDER BY total_points DESC LIMIT 59;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) AS races_entered, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(res.positionorder) AS avg_finish_position, MAX(ds.wins) AS max_wins_in_season FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN driverstandings ds ON d.driverid = ds.driverid AND r.raceid = ds.raceid JOIN seasons s ON r.year = s.year WHERE r.year >= 2010 AND res.points > '0' AND d.dob <= '1950-01-01' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(res.points) > '10' ORDER BY total_points DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) AS races_participated, SUM(res.points) AS total_points FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid WHERE r.year = 1963 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM constructorstandings cs WHERE cs.constructorid = res.constructorid AND cs.raceid = r.raceid AND cs.position <= 8 ) GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) AS races_participated, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid WHERE r.year >= 2009 AND res.points > '0' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(res.points) > '10' ORDER BY total_points DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, SUM(r.points) AS total_points, COUNT(r.resultid) AS races_finished FROM drivers d JOIN results r ON d.driverid = r.driverid WHERE r.positionorder <= 10 AND r.laps >= 20 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(r.points) > '5' UNION ALL SELECT c.constructorid, NULL AS forename, c.name AS surname, SUM(cs.points) AS total_points, COUNT(cs.constructorstandingsid) AS races_counted FROM constructors c JOIN constructorstandings cs ON c.constructorid = cs.constructorid WHERE cs.position <= 4 AND cs.wins >= 3 GROUP BY c.constructorid, c.name HAVING SUM(cs.points) > '10' ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, SUM(r.points) AS total_points, COUNT(r.resultid) AS races_finished FROM drivers d JOIN results r ON d.driverid = r.driverid WHERE r.positionorder <= 10 AND r.points > '0.0' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING COUNT(r.resultid) >= 15 UNION ALL SELECT c.constructorid, c.name, NULL AS surname, SUM(cs.points) AS total_points, COUNT(cs.constructorstandingsid) AS races_count FROM constructors c JOIN constructorstandings cs ON c.constructorid = cs.constructorid WHERE cs.position <= 8 AND cs.points > '0.0' GROUP BY c.constructorid, c.name HAVING COUNT(cs.constructorstandingsid) >= 11 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, res.positionorder, res.points, CASE WHEN res.positionorder = 1 THEN 'Winner' WHEN res.positionorder BETWEEN 2 AND 3 THEN 'Podium' WHEN res.positionorder BETWEEN 4 AND 10 THEN 'Points' ELSE 'No Points' END AS finish_category, SUM(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid, r.year ORDER BY r.date) AS cumulative_points_season, AVG(res.positionorder) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid, r.year) AS avg_position_season FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid WHERE r.year = 1990 AND res.positionorder <= 13 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name, res.positionorder, res.points, r.date ORDER BY r.year, r.round, res.positionorder;

SELECT d1.driverid AS driver1_id, d1.forename AS driver1_forename, d1.surname AS driver1_surname, d2.driverid AS driver2_id, d2.forename AS driver2_forename, d2.surname AS driver2_surname, r.year, r.name AS race_name, c.name AS circuit_name, AVG(lt1.milliseconds - lt2.milliseconds) AS avg_time_diff_ms, COUNT(*) AS lap_count FROM laptimes lt1 JOIN laptimes lt2 ON lt1.raceid = lt2.raceid AND lt1.lap = lt2.lap JOIN drivers d1 ON lt1.driverid = d1.driverid JOIN drivers d2 ON lt2.driverid = d2.driverid JOIN races r ON lt1.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res1 ON lt1.raceid = res1.raceid AND lt1.driverid = res1.driverid JOIN results res2 ON lt2.raceid = res2.raceid AND lt2.driverid = res2.driverid WHERE lt1.position IS NOT NULL AND lt2.position IS NOT NULL AND lt1.milliseconds IS NOT NULL AND lt2.milliseconds IS NOT NULL AND lt1.driverid < lt2.driverid AND r.year >= 2006 AND c.circuitid = 13 AND res1.grid <= 4 AND res2.grid <= 4 GROUP BY d1.driverid, d1.forename, d1.surname, d2.driverid, d2.forename, d2.surname, r.year, r.name, c.name HAVING COUNT(*) > 42 AND AVG(lt1.milliseconds - lt2.milliseconds) > 4786 ORDER BY avg_time_diff_ms DESC, lap_count DESC;

SELECT r.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(*) AS race_count FROM results r JOIN drivers d ON r.driverid = d.driverid WHERE r.positionorder <= 2 GROUP BY r.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING COUNT(*) >= 25 INTERSECT SELECT ds.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(*) AS race_count FROM driverstandings ds JOIN drivers d ON ds.driverid = d.driverid WHERE ds.position <= 8 GROUP BY ds.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING COUNT(*) >= 9 ORDER BY race_count DESC;

SELECT r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.driverid) AS distinct_drivers, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) AS distinct_laps, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS distinct_pitstops, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND lt.driverid = ps.driverid WHERE r.year >= 2018 AND r.date <= '2010-03-01' GROUP BY r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lt.driverid) > 13 AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 110537 ORDER BY r.year DESC, r.round ASC;

SELECT r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.driverid) AS distinct_drivers, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) AS distinct_laps, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS distinct_pitstops, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, SUM(res.points) AS total_points FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND lt.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid AND lt.driverid = res.driverid WHERE r.year >= 2002 AND r.date <= '2000-03-01' GROUP BY r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lt.driverid) > 10 AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 127908 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.driverid) AS drivers_with_laptimes, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_ms FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid WHERE r.year = 1951 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM results res WHERE res.raceid = r.raceid AND res.positionorder <= 8 ) GROUP BY r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name HAVING AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 99385 ORDER BY r.round;

SELECT r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, c.country, d.driverid, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, con.name AS constructor_name, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points, res.laps, res.milliseconds AS result_ms, lt.lap, lt.position AS lap_position, lt.milliseconds AS lap_ms, ps.stop, ps.lap AS pit_lap, ps.milliseconds AS pit_ms, q.position AS qualify_position, ds.points AS driver_standing_points, ds.wins AS driver_standing_wins, cs.points AS constructor_standing_points, cs.wins AS constructor_standing_wins, AVG(lt.milliseconds) OVER ( PARTITION BY r.raceid, d.driverid ORDER BY lt.lap ROWS BETWEEN 9 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_lap_ms, SUM(res.points) OVER ( PARTITION BY r.year, d.driverid ORDER BY r.date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS cumulative_points_season FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND d.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND d.driverid = q.driverid AND res.constructorid = q.constructorid LEFT JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND d.driverid = ds.driverid LEFT JOIN constructorstandings cs ON r.raceid = cs.raceid AND con.constructorid = cs.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 2003 AND r.year <= 2014 AND res.positionorder <= 10 AND (lt.milliseconds IS NULL OR lt.milliseconds > 77102) AND (ps.milliseconds IS NULL OR ps.milliseconds < 51172) GROUP BY r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name, c.country, d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, con.name, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points, res.laps, res.milliseconds, lt.lap, lt.position, lt.milliseconds, ps.stop, ps.lap, ps.milliseconds, q.position, ds.points, ds.wins, cs.points, cs.wins, r.date HAVING AVG(res.points) > '0.0' OR COUNT(lt.lap) >= 11 ORDER BY r.year DESC, r.round DESC, cumulative_points_season DESC;

SELECT r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, d.driverid, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, res.positionorder, res.points, AVG(res.points) OVER ( PARTITION BY r.circuitid, d.driverid ORDER BY r.date ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS avg_points_last_3_races FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 2017 AND r.year <= 2013 AND res.positionorder <= 8 AND d.dob >= '1970-01-01' GROUP BY r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name, d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, res.positionorder, res.points, r.circuitid, r.date HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY r.year, r.round, avg_points_last_3_races DESC;

SELECT r.year, c.country, d.nationality, COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) AS race_count, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid WHERE r.year >= 1999 AND r.year <= 2015 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (r.year, c.country, d.nationality), (r.year, c.country), (r.year), () ) ORDER BY r.year, c.country, d.nationality;

SELECT r.year, c.country, d.nationality, COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) AS race_count, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid WHERE r.year >= 2008 AND r.year <= 1968 AND res.points > '0' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (r.year, c.country, d.nationality), (r.year, c.country), (r.year), () ) ORDER BY r.year, c.country, d.nationality;

SELECT r.year, c.name AS circuit_name, con.name AS constructor_name, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid WHERE r.year >= 1991 AND r.year <= 1975 AND res.positionorder <= 18 GROUP BY r.year, c.circuitid, con.constructorid, d.driverid HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY r.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT r.year, c.name AS constructor_name, COUNT(DISTINCT res.raceid) AS races_entered, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(res.positionorder) AS avg_finish_position, COUNT(CASE WHEN res.positionorder = 1 THEN 1 END) AS wins FROM results res JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid WHERE r.year >= 2023 AND d.dob >= '1970-01-01' GROUP BY r.year, c.constructorid, c.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '50' AND AVG(res.positionorder) <= 5 ORDER BY r.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT r.year, c.name AS constructor_name, COUNT(DISTINCT res.raceid) AS races_entered, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(res.positionorder) AS avg_finish_position, MAX(ds.wins) AS max_wins_in_season FROM results res JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN driverstandings ds ON res.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid WHERE r.year >= 1993 AND res.points > '0.0' GROUP BY r.year, c.constructorid, c.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '50.0' AND AVG(res.positionorder) < 19 ORDER BY r.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT r.year, c.name AS constructor_name, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) AS distinct_laps_raced, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS distinct_pit_stops, COUNT(DISTINCT q.position) AS distinct_qualifying_positions, AVG(res.points) AS avg_points, SUM(ds.wins) AS total_wins FROM races r JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND res.driverid = q.driverid LEFT JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid WHERE r.year >= 2018 AND r.year <= 2013 AND res.positionorder <= 17 GROUP BY r.year, c.constructorid, c.name, d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING AVG(res.points) > '0.0' ORDER BY r.year DESC, total_wins DESC, avg_points DESC;

SELECT c.circuitid, c.name AS circuit_name, c.country, r.year, r.round, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.driverid) AS unique_drivers_lapped, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.driverid) AS unique_drivers_pitted, COUNT(DISTINCT q.driverid) AS unique_drivers_qualified, COUNT(DISTINCT res.driverid) AS unique_drivers_finished, COUNT(DISTINCT ds.driverid) AS unique_drivers_standing, COUNT(DISTINCT cs.constructorid) AS unique_constructors_standing, SUM(res.points) AS total_points_awarded, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, SUM(ps.milliseconds) AS total_pitstop_ms, MAX(ds.wins) AS max_driver_wins, MAX(cs.wins) AS max_constructor_wins FROM circuits c JOIN races r ON c.circuitid = r.circuitid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND lt.driverid = ps.driverid AND lt.lap = ps.lap LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid LEFT JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid AND q.driverid = res.driverid AND q.constructorid = res.constructorid LEFT JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid LEFT JOIN constructorstandings cs ON r.raceid = cs.raceid AND res.constructorid = cs.constructorid LEFT JOIN constructorresults cr ON r.raceid = cr.raceid AND cs.constructorid = cr.constructorid LEFT JOIN drivers d ON lt.driverid = d.driverid LEFT JOIN constructors con ON q.constructorid = con.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 1976 AND r.date <= '1950-01-01' AND c.alt >= 1503 GROUP BY c.circuitid, c.name, c.country, r.year, r.round HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lt.driverid) > 36 AND SUM(res.points) >= '0' ORDER BY r.year DESC, r.round ASC, total_points_awarded DESC;

SELECT c.circuitid, c.name AS circuit_name, c.country, r.year, r.round, d.driverid, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, con.name AS constructor_name, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) AS distinct_laps_driven, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS distinct_pit_stops, COUNT(DISTINCT q.position) AS distinct_qualifying_positions, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, MAX(ds.wins) AS max_wins_in_season, SUM(cr.points) AS total_constructor_points FROM circuits c JOIN races r ON c.circuitid = r.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND d.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND d.driverid = q.driverid AND res.constructorid = q.constructorid JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND d.driverid = ds.driverid JOIN constructorresults cr ON r.raceid = cr.raceid AND con.constructorid = cr.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 1957 AND r.date <= '1950-01-01' AND res.grid <= 30 AND lt.position <= 20 AND ds.position <= 20 GROUP BY c.circuitid, c.name, c.country, r.year, r.round, d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, con.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 53158 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_lap_time_ms ASC LIMIT 791;

SELECT c.circuitid, c.name AS circuit_name, c.country, r.year, r.round, d.driverid, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, con.name AS constructor_name, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position AS lap_position, lt.milliseconds AS lap_time_ms, ps.stop AS pit_stop_number, ps.lap AS pit_stop_lap, ps.milliseconds AS pit_stop_duration_ms, q.position AS qualifying_position, ds.points AS driver_standing_points, ds.wins AS driver_wins, cs.points AS constructor_standing_points, cs.wins AS constructor_wins, cr.points AS constructor_result_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) OVER (PARTITION BY r.raceid, d.driverid) AS avg_lap_time_per_race_driver, SUM(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY r.year, d.driverid ORDER BY r.date) AS cumulative_points_driver_season, COUNT(ps.stop) OVER (PARTITION BY r.raceid, d.driverid) AS total_pit_stops_per_race_driver FROM circuits c JOIN races r ON c.circuitid = r.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND d.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND d.driverid = q.driverid AND res.constructorid = q.constructorid LEFT JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND d.driverid = ds.driverid LEFT JOIN constructorstandings cs ON r.raceid = cs.raceid AND con.constructorid = cs.constructorid LEFT JOIN constructorresults cr ON r.raceid = cr.raceid AND con.constructorid = cr.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 1988 AND r.year <= 1983 AND c.country = 'UK' AND res.positionorder <= 11 AND lt.milliseconds > 113660 GROUP BY c.circuitid, c.name, c.country, r.year, r.round, d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, con.name, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position, lt.milliseconds, ps.stop, ps.lap, ps.milliseconds, q.position, ds.points, ds.wins, cs.points, cs.wins, cr.points, r.raceid, r.date HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 137305 AND COUNT(ps.stop) >= 5 ORDER BY r.year DESC, r.round DESC, res.positionorder ASC, lt.lap ASC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) AS races_entered, SUM(r.points) AS total_points, (SELECT AVG(lt.milliseconds) FROM laptimes lt WHERE lt.driverid = d.driverid AND lt.lap = 46) AS avg_lap_time_ms FROM drivers d JOIN results r ON d.driverid = r.driverid JOIN races rc ON r.raceid = rc.raceid WHERE rc.year >= 1998 AND rc.year <= 1970 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(r.points) > '0' ORDER BY total_points DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) AS races_entered, SUM(r.points) AS total_points, AVG(r.positionorder) AS avg_finish_position FROM drivers d JOIN results r ON d.driverid = r.driverid JOIN races rc ON r.raceid = rc.raceid WHERE r.points > 2.79 AND rc.date >= '2000-01-01' AND d.driverid IN ( SELECT driverid FROM results WHERE positionorder <= 3 GROUP BY driverid HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10 ) GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(r.points) > 19.63 ORDER BY total_points DESC LIMIT 25;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) AS races_entered, SUM(r.points) AS total_points, AVG(r.positionorder) AS avg_finish_position FROM drivers d JOIN results r ON d.driverid = r.driverid JOIN races rc ON r.raceid = rc.raceid WHERE rc.year IN (SELECT year FROM seasons WHERE year >= 1953 AND year <= 1992) AND r.positionorder <= 5 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(r.points) > '0' ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) AS races_entered, SUM(r.points) AS total_points, AVG(r.positionorder) AS avg_finish_position FROM drivers d JOIN results r ON d.driverid = r.driverid JOIN races rc ON r.raceid = rc.raceid WHERE rc.year IN (SELECT year FROM seasons WHERE year >= 1968 AND year <= 2018) AND r.positionorder <= 17 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(r.points) > '0' ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) AS races_entered, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(res.positionorder) AS avg_finish_position FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid WHERE r.year >= 2007 AND c.country = 'Monaco' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(res.points) > '50' ORDER BY total_points DESC LIMIT 20;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) AS races_entered, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(res.positionorder) AS avg_finish_position FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid WHERE r.year >= 1999 AND res.points > '0' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(res.points) > '10' ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) AS races_participated, SUM(r.points) AS total_points FROM drivers d JOIN results r ON d.driverid = r.driverid JOIN races rc ON r.raceid = rc.raceid WHERE rc.year IN (SELECT year FROM seasons WHERE year >= 2021 AND year <= 2002) AND r.positionorder <= 4 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(r.points) > '0' ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(r.resultid) AS race_count, COALESCE(SUM(r.points), 0) AS total_points FROM drivers d LEFT JOIN results r ON d.driverid = r.driverid LEFT JOIN races rc ON r.raceid = rc.raceid WHERE rc.year >= 1980 AND rc.year <= 1991 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING COALESCE(SUM(r.points), 0) > '0' ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(r.resultid) AS race_count, COALESCE(SUM(r.points), 0) AS total_points FROM drivers d LEFT JOIN results r ON d.driverid = r.driverid LEFT JOIN races rc ON r.raceid = rc.raceid WHERE rc.year >= 1999 OR rc.year IS NULL GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING COALESCE(SUM(r.points), 0) > '0' ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(r.resultid) AS race_count, SUM(r.points) AS total_points FROM drivers d JOIN results r ON d.driverid = r.driverid JOIN races rc ON r.raceid = rc.raceid WHERE rc.year IN (SELECT year FROM seasons WHERE year >= 2003 AND year <= 2009) GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(r.points) > '0' ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(r.resultid) AS total_results, COALESCE(SUM(r.points), 0) AS total_points FROM drivers d LEFT JOIN results r ON d.driverid = r.driverid LEFT JOIN races rc ON r.raceid = rc.raceid WHERE rc.year >= 2000 OR rc.year IS NULL GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING COALESCE(SUM(r.points), 0) > '0' ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, SUM(r.points) AS total_points, COUNT(r.raceid) AS races_finished FROM drivers d JOIN results r ON d.driverid = r.driverid WHERE r.positionorder <= 1 AND r.points > '0' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(r.points) > '50' UNION ALL SELECT c.constructorid, c.name AS forename, NULL AS surname, SUM(cs.points) AS total_points, COUNT(cs.raceid) AS races_finished FROM constructors c JOIN constructorstandings cs ON c.constructorid = cs.constructorid WHERE cs.position <= 6 AND cs.points > '0' GROUP BY c.constructorid, c.name HAVING SUM(cs.points) > '50' ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, SUM(r.points) AS total_points, COUNT(r.resultid) AS races_finished FROM drivers d JOIN results r ON d.driverid = r.driverid WHERE r.positionorder <= 8 AND r.points > '0.0' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING COUNT(r.resultid) >= 38 UNION ALL SELECT c.constructorid, c.name AS constructor_name, NULL AS surname, SUM(cs.points) AS total_points, COUNT(cs.constructorstandingsid) AS standings_count FROM constructors c JOIN constructorstandings cs ON c.constructorid = cs.constructorid WHERE cs.position <= 4 AND cs.points > '0.0' GROUP BY c.constructorid, c.name HAVING COUNT(cs.constructorstandingsid) >= 9 ORDER BY total_points DESC;
