res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position, lt.milliseconds, ps.stop, ps.lap, ps.milliseconds, q.position, cs.points, cs.wins, ds.points, ds.wins, r.date, r.raceid, lt.raceid, lt.driverid, res.driverid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) > 26 AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 62026 ORDER BY cumulative_driver_points DESC, race_finish_rank;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position AS lap_position, ps.stop AS pit_stop_number, ps.lap AS pit_stop_lap, ds.position AS championship_position, ds.wins AS season_wins FROM drivers d INNER JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid INNER JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid INNER JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON res.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON res.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN driverstandings ds ON res.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid WHERE r.year = 2020 AND res.points >= '0' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round, r.name, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position, ps.stop, ps.lap, ds.position, ds.wins HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) > 7 ORDER BY res.points DESC, ds.position ASC LIMIT 100;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position AS lap_position, ps.stop AS pit_stop_number, ps.duration AS pit_stop_duration, q.position AS qualifying_position, ds.position AS driver_standing_position, cs.position AS constructor_standing_position, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM results res2 WHERE res2.raceid = r.raceid AND res2.positionorder <= 4) AS top_finishers_in_race, (SELECT AVG(lt2.milliseconds) FROM laptimes lt2 WHERE lt2.raceid = r.raceid AND lt2.lap = lt.lap AND lt2.milliseconds > 197499) AS avg_lap_time_excluding_slow FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND d.driverid = ps.driverid AND lt.lap = ps.lap LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND d.driverid = q.driverid LEFT JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND d.driverid = ds.driverid LEFT JOIN constructorstandings cs ON r.raceid = cs.raceid AND c.constructorid = cs.constructorid WHERE r.date >= '2000-01-01' AND r.date <= '2000-01-01' AND res.points > '0.0' AND lt.milliseconds < 93940 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM constructorresults cr WHERE cr.raceid = r.raceid AND cr.constructorid = c.constructorid AND cr.points >= '0.0') > 0 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round, r.name, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position, ps.stop, ps.duration, q.position, ds.position, cs.position, r.raceid, lt.milliseconds HAVING AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 134546 AND COUNT(ps.stop) >= 5 ORDER BY r.year DESC, r.round DESC, res.positionorder ASC, lt.lap ASC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.raceid, r.name AS race_name, r.date, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(r.date, d.dob)) AS driver_age_at_race, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) AS laps_analyzed FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid WHERE r.date >= '2000-01-01'::date AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM r.date) = 2003 AND d.dob <= r.date - INTERVAL '42 years' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.raceid, r.name, r.date HAVING AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 141705.17 ORDER BY avg_lap_time_ms ASC LIMIT 100;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN laptimes lt ON d.driverid = lt.driverid AND res.raceid = lt.raceid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON d.driverid = ps.driverid AND res.raceid = ps.raceid WHERE r.year >= 2018 AND r.date <= '2000-03-01' AND res.positionorder <= 9 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0.5' ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_lap_time_ms ASC LIMIT 100;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, res.positionorder, res.points, CASE WHEN res.positionorder = 1 THEN 'Winner' WHEN res.positionorder BETWEEN 2 AND 3 THEN 'Podium' WHEN res.positionorder BETWEEN 4 AND 10 THEN 'Points' ELSE 'No Points' END AS finish_category, SUM(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid, r.year ORDER BY r.date) AS cumulative_points_season, AVG(res.positionorder) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid, r.year) AS avg_position_season FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid WHERE r.year = 1963 AND res.points > '0' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name, res.positionorder, res.points, r.date ORDER BY r.year, r.round, res.positionorder;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, res.positionorder, res.points, SUM(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid, r.year ORDER BY r.date) AS cumulative_points_season, AVG(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid, r.year) AS avg_points_season FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid WHERE r.year = 1978 AND res.positionorder <= 18 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name, res.positionorder, res.points, r.date ORDER BY d.driverid, r.year, r.round;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, res.positionorder, res.points, SUM(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid, r.year ORDER BY r.round) AS cumulative_points FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid WHERE r.year = 2020 AND res.positionorder <= 20 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name, res.positionorder, res.points ORDER BY d.driverid, r.year, r.round;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position AS lap_position, ps.stop AS pit_stop_number, ps.duration AS pit_stop_duration, SUM(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid, r.year ORDER BY r.date) AS cumulative_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid, r.raceid) AS avg_lap_time_ms FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN laptimes lt ON res.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON res.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid WHERE r.year = 2020 AND r.round BETWEEN 9 AND 15 AND res.positionorder <= 15 AND lt.lap >= 24 AND lt.milliseconds > 69891 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position, ps.stop, ps.duration, r.date, lt.milliseconds, r.raceid HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY cumulative_points DESC, r.round, res.positionorder;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position AS lap_position, ps.stop AS pit_stop_number, ps.lap AS pit_stop_lap, q.position AS qualifying_position FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN laptimes lt ON res.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON res.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON res.raceid = q.raceid AND res.driverid = q.driverid WHERE r.year = 1961 AND r.round >= 7 AND res.positionorder <= 8 AND lt.lap BETWEEN 80 AND 59 AND (ps.milliseconds IS NULL OR ps.milliseconds > 27312) GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position, ps.stop, ps.lap, q.position HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY SUM(res.points) DESC, d.surname, r.round;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN laptimes lt ON d.driverid = lt.driverid AND res.raceid = lt.raceid WHERE r.year = 1971 AND res.positionorder <= 14 AND lt.lap BETWEEN 48 AND 72 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, r.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN laptimes lt ON d.driverid = lt.driverid AND res.raceid = lt.raceid WHERE r.year = 2007 AND res.points > '0' AND lt.lap IN (SELECT lap FROM laptimes WHERE milliseconds < 97238) GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, r.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '10' ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_lap_time_ms ASC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(res.positionorder) AS avg_finish_position FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid WHERE r.year IN ( SELECT year FROM seasons WHERE year BETWEEN 2020 AND 1967 ) AND res.positionorder <= 16 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, r.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_finish_position ASC;

SELECT d1.driverid AS driver1_id, d1.forename AS driver1_forename, d1.surname AS driver1_surname, d2.driverid AS driver2_id, d2.forename AS driver2_forename, d2.surname AS driver2_surname, r.year, r.name AS race_name, AVG(lt1.milliseconds - lt2.milliseconds) AS avg_time_diff_ms FROM laptimes lt1 JOIN laptimes lt2 ON lt1.raceid = lt2.raceid AND lt1.lap = lt2.lap JOIN drivers d1 ON lt1.driverid = d1.driverid JOIN drivers d2 ON lt2.driverid = d2.driverid JOIN races r ON lt1.raceid = r.raceid WHERE lt1.driverid < lt2.driverid AND lt1.milliseconds > lt2.milliseconds AND r.year = 1958 AND lt1.lap BETWEEN 42 AND 52 GROUP BY d1.driverid, d1.forename, d1.surname, d2.driverid, d2.forename, d2.surname, r.year, r.name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 4 ORDER BY avg_time_diff_ms DESC;

SELECT d1.driverid AS driver1_id, d1.forename AS driver1_forename, d1.surname AS driver1_surname, d2.driverid AS driver2_id, d2.forename AS driver2_forename, d2.surname AS driver2_surname, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, con1.name AS constructor1_name, con2.name AS constructor2_name, AVG(lt1.milliseconds - lt2.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_diff_ms, SUM(res1.points) AS driver1_total_points, SUM(res2.points) AS driver2_total_points, COUNT(DISTINCT lt1.lap) AS laps_compared, CORR(lt1.position, lt2.position) AS position_correlation FROM laptimes lt1 JOIN laptimes lt2 ON lt1.raceid = lt2.raceid AND lt1.lap = lt2.lap AND lt1.driverid < lt2.driverid JOIN drivers d1 ON lt1.driverid = d1.driverid JOIN drivers d2 ON lt2.driverid = d2.driverid JOIN races r ON lt1.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res1 ON lt1.raceid = res1.raceid AND lt1.driverid = res1.driverid JOIN results res2 ON lt2.raceid = res2.raceid AND lt2.driverid = res2.driverid JOIN constructors con1 ON res1.constructorid = con1.constructorid JOIN constructors con2 ON res2.constructorid = con2.constructorid JOIN qualifying q1 ON lt1.raceid = q1.raceid AND lt1.driverid = q1.driverid JOIN qualifying q2 ON lt2.raceid = q2.raceid AND lt2.driverid = q2.driverid JOIN pitstops ps1 ON lt1.raceid = ps1.raceid AND lt1.driverid = ps1.driverid JOIN pitstops ps2 ON lt2.raceid = ps2.raceid AND lt2.driverid = ps2.driverid JOIN driverstandings ds1 ON lt1.raceid = ds1.raceid AND lt1.driverid = ds1.driverid JOIN driverstandings ds2 ON lt2.raceid = ds2.raceid AND lt2.driverid = ds2.driverid WHERE r.year >= 1988 AND r.year <= 1953 AND lt1.milliseconds > 135972 AND lt2.milliseconds > 296763 AND res1.points >= '0' AND res2.points >= '0' AND c.alt > 891 GROUP BY d1.driverid, d1.forename, d1.surname, d2.driverid, d2.forename, d2.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name, con1.name, con2.name HAVING AVG(lt1.milliseconds - lt2.milliseconds) > '-5000' AND COUNT(DISTINCT lt1.lap) > 65 AND SUM(res1.points) + SUM(res2.points) > '0' ORDER BY avg_lap_time_diff_ms DESC, driver1_total_points DESC, driver2_total_points DESC LIMIT 1000;
SELECT r.raceid, COUNT(l.driverid) AS total_laps FROM races r JOIN laptimes l ON r.raceid = l.raceid WHERE r.year = 1965 AND l.milliseconds < 109649 GROUP BY r.raceid ORDER BY total_laps DESC;

SELECT r.raceid, r.name AS race_name, r.date, c.name AS circuit_name, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, con.name AS constructor_name, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position AS lap_position, ps.stop AS pit_stop_number, ps.lap AS pit_stop_lap, q.position AS qualifying_position FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND res.driverid = q.driverid AND res.constructorid = q.constructorid WHERE r.year = 1962 AND res.grid BETWEEN 20 AND 18 AND res.points > '0' AND r.date >= '1950-01-01' AND (lt.milliseconds < 106047 OR lt.milliseconds IS NULL) GROUP BY r.raceid, r.name, r.date, c.name, d.forename, d.surname, con.name, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position, ps.stop, ps.lap, q.position HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) > 5 ORDER BY r.date, res.positionorder LIMIT 94;

SELECT r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, c.country, d.driverid, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, con.name AS constructor_name, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points, res.laps, res.milliseconds, lt.lap, lt.position AS lap_position, lt.milliseconds AS lap_time_ms, ps.stop, ps.lap AS pit_lap, ps.milliseconds AS pit_stop_ms, q.position AS qualifying_position, ds.points AS driver_standing_points, ds.wins AS driver_wins, cs.points AS constructor_standing_points, cs.wins AS constructor_wins, cr.points AS constructor_result_points, t.win AS target_win, s.status, AVG(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY r.year, con.constructorid) AS avg_constructor_points_per_year, SUM(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY r.year, d.driverid ORDER BY r.date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_driver_points, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY r.circuitid) AS races_at_circuit FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND res.driverid = q.driverid AND res.constructorid = q.constructorid LEFT JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid LEFT JOIN constructorstandings cs ON r.raceid = cs.raceid AND res.constructorid = cs.constructorid LEFT JOIN constructorresults cr ON r.raceid = cr.raceid AND res.constructorid = cr.constructorid LEFT JOIN target t ON r.raceid = t.raceid AND res.driverid = t.driverid LEFT JOIN status s ON res.statusid = s.statusid WHERE r.year >= 1982 AND r.date <= '1950-01-01' AND res.points > '0' AND (lt.milliseconds IS NULL OR lt.milliseconds < 117691) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM driverstandings ds2 WHERE ds2.driverid = d.driverid AND ds2.points >= '0' AND ds2.raceid IN (SELECT raceid FROM races WHERE year = r.year) ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM constructorstandings cs2 WHERE cs2.constructorid = con.constructorid AND cs2.wins >= 18 AND cs2.raceid IN (SELECT raceid FROM races WHERE year = r.year AND round <= r.round) ) GROUP BY r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name, c.country, d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, con.name, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points, res.laps, res.milliseconds, lt.lap, lt.position, lt.milliseconds, ps.stop, ps.lap, ps.milliseconds, q.position, ds.points, ds.wins, cs.points, cs.wins, cr.points, t.win, s.status, c.circuitid, con.constructorid, d.driverid, r.date HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) > 58 AND AVG(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY r.year DESC, r.round DESC, res.positionorder ASC, lt.lap ASC;

SELECT r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, con.name AS constructor_name, res.points, res.positionorder, ds.wins AS driver_wins, cs.wins AS constructor_wins FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid JOIN constructorstandings cs ON r.raceid = cs.raceid AND res.constructorid = cs.constructorid WHERE r.year = 1960 AND res.points >= '0' INTERSECT SELECT r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, con.name AS constructor_name, res.points, res.positionorder, ds.wins AS driver_wins, cs.wins AS constructor_wins FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid JOIN constructorstandings cs ON r.raceid = cs.raceid AND res.constructorid = cs.constructorid WHERE r.round <= 9 AND res.positionorder <= 15 ORDER BY raceid, driver_name;

SELECT r.year, c.country, con.nationality, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, COUNT(DISTINCT res.driverid) AS unique_drivers, AVG(res.positionorder) AS avg_finish FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 1964 AND r.year <= 1967 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (r.year, c.country, con.nationality), (r.year, c.country), (r.year, con.nationality), (r.year), () ) HAVING SUM(res.points) > 38.75 ORDER BY r.year, total_points DESC;

SELECT r.year, c.name AS circuit_name, con.name AS constructor_name, COUNT(DISTINCT d.driverid) AS unique_drivers, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) AS unique_laps_raced, SUM(res.points) AS total_points FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid WHERE r.year >= 1994 AND r.year <= 1985 GROUP BY r.year, c.circuitid, c.name, con.constructorid, con.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY r.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT r.year, c.name AS circuit_name, con.name AS constructor_name, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops FROM races r INNER JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid INNER JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid INNER JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid INNER JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid WHERE r.year >= 2008 AND r.year <= 2011 AND res.positionorder <= 1 GROUP BY r.year, c.circuitid, con.constructorid, d.driverid HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY r.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT r.year, c.name AS circuit_name, con.name AS constructor_name, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid WHERE r.year >= 2000 AND r.year <= 2022 GROUP BY r.year, c.circuitid, con.constructorid, d.driverid HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY r.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT r.year, c.name AS constructor_name, COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) AS races_entered, COUNT(DISTINCT res.driverid) AS distinct_drivers, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(res.positionorder) AS avg_finish FROM constructors c JOIN results res ON c.constructorid = res.constructorid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid WHERE r.year >= 2020 AND res.points > '0' GROUP BY r.year, c.name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) > 7 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT r.year, c.name AS constructor_name, COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) AS races_entered, COUNT(DISTINCT res.driverid) AS distinct_drivers, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(res.positionorder) AS avg_finish FROM races r JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN circuits ci ON r.circuitid = ci.circuitid WHERE r.year >= 2020 AND r.year <= 1999 AND res.grid <= 15 GROUP BY r.year, c.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT r.year, c.name AS constructor_name, COUNT(DISTINCT res.driverid) AS unique_drivers, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(res.positionorder) AS avg_finish FROM results res JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 1991 AND res.points > '0' GROUP BY r.year, c.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '10' ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT r.year, c.name AS constructor_name, COUNT(DISTINCT res.driverid) AS unique_drivers, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(res.positionorder) AS avg_finish FROM results res JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 2002 AND res.points > '0' GROUP BY r.year, c.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '10' ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT r.year, c.name AS constructor_name, COUNT(DISTINCT res.driverid) AS unique_drivers, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(res.positionorder) AS avg_finish FROM results res JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 2023 AND res.points > '0' GROUP BY r.year, c.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '50' ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT r.year, c.name AS constructor_name, COUNT(DISTINCT res.raceid) AS races_entered, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(res.positionorder) AS avg_finish_position, MAX(ds.wins) AS max_wins_in_season FROM results res JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN driverstandings ds ON res.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid JOIN circuits ci ON r.circuitid = ci.circuitid WHERE r.year >= 1996 AND ci.country = 'Australia' AND res.positionorder IS NOT NULL GROUP BY r.year, c.constructorid, c.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '50' AND AVG(res.positionorder) <= 2 ORDER BY r.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT r.year, c.name AS constructor_name, SUM(cs.points) AS total_points, AVG(cs.wins) AS avg_wins FROM races r JOIN constructorstandings cs ON r.raceid = cs.raceid JOIN constructors c ON cs.constructorid = c.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 2014 AND cs.points > '0' GROUP BY r.year, c.name HAVING SUM(cs.points) > '100' ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT c.circuitid, c.name AS circuit_name, c.country, r.year, r.round, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.driverid) AS unique_drivers, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) AS unique_laps, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS unique_pitstops, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, MAX(ds.wins) AS max_wins_in_race, SUM(crs.points) AS total_constructor_points FROM circuits c JOIN races r ON c.circuitid = r.circuitid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND lt.driverid = ps.driverid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid AND lt.driverid = res.driverid JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND lt.driverid = ds.driverid JOIN constructorresults crs ON r.raceid = crs.raceid AND res.constructorid = crs.constructorid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid JOIN drivers d ON lt.driverid = d.driverid WHERE r.year >= 1975 AND r.date <= '1950-01-01' AND lt.milliseconds > 341040 AND res.points > '0' AND ds.position <= 6 GROUP BY c.circuitid, c.name, c.country, r.year, r.round HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lt.driverid) > 28 AND SUM(res.points) >= '10' ORDER BY r.year DESC, r.round ASC, total_points DESC;

SELECT c.circuitid, c.name AS circuit_name, c.country, r.year, r.round, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.driverid) AS unique_drivers_lapped, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.driverid) AS unique_drivers_pitted, COUNT(DISTINCT q.driverid) AS unique_drivers_qualified, COUNT(DISTINCT res.driverid) AS unique_drivers_finished, COUNT(DISTINCT ds.driverid) AS unique_drivers_standing, COUNT(DISTINCT cs.constructorid) AS unique_constructors_standing, SUM(res.points) AS total_points_awarded, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, SUM(ps.milliseconds) AS total_pitstop_ms, MAX(ds.wins) AS max_driver_wins, MAX(cs.wins) AS max_constructor_wins FROM circuits c JOIN races r ON c.circuitid = r.circuitid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND lt.driverid = ps.driverid AND lt.lap = ps.lap LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid LEFT JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid AND q.driverid = res.driverid AND q.constructorid = res.constructorid LEFT JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid LEFT JOIN constructorstandings cs ON r.raceid = cs.raceid AND res.constructorid = cs.constructorid LEFT JOIN constructorresults cr ON r.raceid = cr.raceid AND cs.constructorid = cr.constructorid LEFT JOIN drivers d ON lt.driverid = d.driverid LEFT JOIN constructors con ON q.constructorid = con.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 1986 AND r.date <= '1950-01-01' AND c.alt >= 1737 GROUP BY c.circuitid, c.name, c.country, r.year, r.round HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lt.driverid) > 1 AND SUM(res.points) >= '0' ORDER BY r.year DESC, r.round ASC, total_points_awarded DESC;

SELECT c.circuitid, c.name AS circuit_name, c.country, r.year, r.round, d.driverid, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, con.constructorid, con.name AS constructor_name, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) AS distinct_laps_driven, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS distinct_pit_stops, COUNT(DISTINCT q.position) AS distinct_qualifying_positions, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, MAX(ds.wins) AS max_wins_in_season, SUM(cr.points) AS total_constructor_points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year, c.circuitid ORDER BY SUM(res.points) DESC) AS driver_rank_per_circuit_year FROM circuits c JOIN races r ON c.circuitid = r.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND res.driverid = q.driverid AND res.constructorid = q.constructorid JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid JOIN constructorresults cr ON r.raceid = cr.raceid AND res.constructorid = cr.constructorid JOIN constructorstandings cs ON r.raceid = cs.raceid AND res.constructorid = cs.constructorid JOIN seasons s ON r.year = s.year WHERE r.year >= 1951 AND r.year <= 1989 AND res.grid <= 17 AND lt.milliseconds > 168270 AND d.dob >= '1950-01-01' GROUP BY c.circuitid, c.name, c.country, r.year, r.round, d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, con.constructorid, con.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) >= 4 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) <= 10 ORDER BY r.year DESC, r.round, total_points DESC, driver_rank_per_circuit_year;

SELECT c.circuitid, c.name AS circuit_name, c.country, r.year, r.round, d.driverid, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, con.constructorid, con.name AS constructor_name, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) AS distinct_laps_driven, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS distinct_pit_stops, COUNT(DISTINCT q.position) AS distinct_qualifying_positions, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, MAX(ds.wins) AS max_wins_in_season, SUM(cr.points) AS total_constructor_points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year, c.circuitid ORDER BY SUM(res.points) DESC) AS driver_rank_per_circuit_year FROM circuits c JOIN races r ON c.circuitid = r.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND res.driverid = q.driverid AND res.constructorid = q.constructorid JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid JOIN constructorresults cr ON r.raceid = cr.raceid AND res.constructorid = cr.constructorid JOIN constructorstandings cs ON r.raceid = cs.raceid AND res.constructorid = cs.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 1978 AND r.year <= 1950 AND res.grid > 20 AND lt.position <= 8 AND ds.position <= 17 AND cs.position <= 2 GROUP BY c.circuitid, c.name, c.country, r.year, r.round, d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, con.constructorid, con.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 178232 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) >= 68 ORDER BY r.year DESC, r.round, total_points DESC, driver_rank_per_circuit_year;

SELECT c.circuitid, c.name AS circuit_name, c.country, r.year, r.round, d.driverid, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, con.name AS constructor_name, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) AS distinct_laps_driven, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS distinct_pit_stops, COUNT(DISTINCT q.position) AS distinct_qualifying_positions, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, MAX(ds.wins) AS max_wins_in_season, SUM(cr.points) AS total_constructor_points FROM circuits c JOIN races r ON c.circuitid = r.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND d.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND d.driverid = q.driverid AND res.constructorid = q.constructorid JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND d.driverid = ds.driverid JOIN constructorresults cr ON r.raceid = cr.raceid AND con.constructorid = cr.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 2017 AND r.date <= '1950-01-01' AND res.grid <= 12 AND lt.position <= 25 AND ds.position <= 14 GROUP BY c.circuitid, c.name, c.country, r.year, r.round, d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, con.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 165074 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_lap_time_ms ASC LIMIT 577;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) AS races_entered, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(res.positionorder) AS avg_finish_position, MAX(ds.wins) AS max_wins_in_season FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN driverstandings ds ON d.driverid = ds.driverid AND r.raceid = ds.raceid JOIN seasons s ON r.year = s.year WHERE r.year >= 1973 AND r.year <= 2021 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) >= 63 ORDER BY total_points DESC LIMIT 50;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) AS races_participated, SUM(r.points) AS total_points, AVG(r.positionorder) AS avg_finish_position FROM drivers d JOIN results r ON d.driverid = r.driverid JOIN races rc ON r.raceid = rc.raceid WHERE rc.year = 1980 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM constructorstandings cs WHERE cs.constructorid = r.constructorid AND cs.raceid = r.raceid AND cs.position <= 7 ) GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(r.points) > '0' ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(r.resultid) AS race_count, SUM(r.points) AS total_points FROM drivers d JOIN results r ON d.driverid = r.driverid JOIN races rc ON r.raceid = rc.raceid WHERE rc.year IN (SELECT year FROM seasons WHERE year >= 1981 AND year <= 2005) GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(r.points) > '0' ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, SUM(r.points) AS total_points, COUNT(r.raceid) AS races_finished FROM drivers d JOIN results r ON d.driverid = r.driverid WHERE r.positionorder <= 7 AND r.points > '0' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(r.points) > '50' UNION ALL SELECT c.constructorid, c.name AS forename, NULL AS surname, SUM(cs.points) AS total_points, COUNT(cs.raceid) AS races_finished FROM constructors c JOIN constructorstandings cs ON c.constructorid = cs.constructorid WHERE cs.position <= 6 AND cs.points > '0' GROUP BY c.constructorid, c.name HAVING SUM(cs.points) > '50' ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, SUM(r.points) AS total_points, COUNT(r.resultid) AS races_finished FROM drivers d JOIN results r ON d.driverid = r.driverid WHERE r.positionorder <= 10 AND r.laps >= 67 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(r.points) > '5' UNION ALL SELECT c.constructorid, NULL AS forename, c.name AS surname, SUM(cs.points) AS total_points, COUNT(cs.constructorstandingsid) AS races_counted FROM constructors c JOIN constructorstandings cs ON c.constructorid = cs.constructorid WHERE cs.position <= 8 AND cs.wins >= 1 GROUP BY c.constructorid, c.name HAVING SUM(cs.points) > '10' ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, SUM(r.points) AS total_points, COUNT(r.resultid) AS races_finished FROM drivers d JOIN results r ON d.driverid = r.driverid WHERE r.positionorder <= 10 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(r.points) > '50' UNION ALL SELECT c.constructorid, c.name, NULL AS surname, SUM(cs.points) AS total_points, COUNT(cs.constructorstandingsid) AS races_counted FROM constructors c JOIN constructorstandings cs ON c.constructorid = cs.constructorid WHERE cs.position <= 8 GROUP BY c.constructorid, c.name HAVING SUM(cs.points) > '100' ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name AS constructor_name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops, MAX(ds.wins) AS max_wins_in_season, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY SUM(res.points) DESC) AS yearly_rank FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND d.driverid = ps.driverid JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND d.driverid = ds.driverid JOIN seasons s ON r.year = s.year WHERE r.year >= 1958 AND r.year <= 1973 AND res.grid <= 14 AND lt.milliseconds > 118670 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) >= 1 INTERSECT SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name AS constructor_name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops, MAX(ds.wins) AS max_wins_in_season, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY SUM(res.points) DESC) AS yearly_rank FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND d.driverid = ps.driverid JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND d.driverid = ds.driverid JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND d.driverid = q.driverid WHERE r.year >= 1990 AND r.year <= 1950 AND q.position <= 10 AND lt.milliseconds < 114630 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round HAVING SUM(res.points) < '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) <= 5 ORDER BY yearly_rank, total_points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name AS constructor_name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name AS circuit_name, AVG(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY res.driverid, res.constructorid) AS avg_points_per_entry, SUM(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY res.driverid ORDER BY r.date) AS cumulative_points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.raceid ORDER BY res.points DESC) AS race_rank, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM laptimes lt WHERE lt.raceid = r.raceid AND lt.driverid = d.driverid AND lt.position = 1) AS laps_led, (SELECT AVG(ps.milliseconds) FROM pitstops ps WHERE ps.raceid = r.raceid AND ps.driverid = d.driverid) AS avg_pitstop_ms, (SELECT SUM(cr.points) FROM constructorresults cr WHERE cr.raceid = r.raceid AND cr.constructorid = c.constructorid) AS constructor_race_points, (SELECT MAX(ds.wins) FROM driverstandings ds WHERE ds.raceid = r.raceid AND ds.driverid IN (SELECT driverid FROM results WHERE constructorid = c.constructorid AND raceid = r.raceid)) AS max_wins_by_constructor_driver FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits cir ON r.circuitid = cir.circuitid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND d.driverid = q.driverid AND c.constructorid = q.constructorid LEFT JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND d.driverid = ds.driverid LEFT JOIN constructorstandings cs ON r.raceid = cs.raceid AND c.constructorid = cs.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 1985 AND r.year <= 2007 AND res.grid <= 27 AND res.positionorder <= 6 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM laptimes lt2 WHERE lt2.raceid = r.raceid AND lt2.driverid = d.driverid) >= 70 AND (SELECT AVG(lt3.milliseconds) FROM laptimes lt3 WHERE lt3.raceid = r.raceid AND lt3.driverid = d.driverid) <= 103634 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name, res.points, r.date, res.driverid, res.constructorid HAVING AVG(res.points) > '0.0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) >= 13 ORDER BY cumulative_points DESC, race_rank ASC LIMIT 333;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name AS constructor_name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name AS circuit_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops, MAX(ds.wins) AS max_wins_in_season, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY SUM(res.points) DESC) AS yearly_rank FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits cir ON r.circuitid = cir.circuitid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND d.driverid = ps.driverid JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND d.driverid = ds.driverid JOIN seasons s ON r.year = s.year WHERE r.year IN (SELECT year FROM races WHERE date >= '1950-01-01' AND date <= '1950-01-01' GROUP BY year HAVING COUNT(raceid) > 27) AND cir.country = 'UK' AND c.nationality IN (SELECT nationality FROM constructors WHERE constructorid IN (SELECT constructorid FROM constructorstandings WHERE points > '0')) AND res.positionorder <= 2 AND lt.lap BETWEEN 18 AND 31 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 77512 ORDER BY total_points DESC, yearly_rank LIMIT 577;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name AS constructor_name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name AS circuit_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops, MAX(ds.wins) AS max_wins_in_season, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY SUM(res.points) DESC) AS yearly_rank FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits cir ON r.circuitid = cir.circuitid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND d.driverid = ps.driverid JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND d.driverid = ds.driverid JOIN seasons s ON r.year = s.year WHERE r.year IN (SELECT year FROM seasons WHERE year >= 2019 AND year <= 2011) AND res.positionorder <= 13 AND lt.milliseconds > 111618 AND cir.alt > 438 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) >= 0 ORDER BY total_points DESC, yearly_rank, r.year, r.round LIMIT 426;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name AS constructor_name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name AS circuit_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops, MAX(q.position) AS best_qualifying, COUNT(DISTINCT ds.wins) AS total_wins, SUM(cr.points) AS constructor_points, AVG(lt2.position) AS avg_race_position FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits cir ON r.circuitid = cir.circuitid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND d.driverid = ps.driverid JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND d.driverid = q.driverid JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND d.driverid = ds.driverid JOIN constructorresults cr ON r.raceid = cr.raceid AND c.constructorid = cr.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt2 ON r.raceid = lt2.raceid AND d.driverid = lt2.driverid WHERE r.year >= 2013 AND r.year <= 1985 AND res.points > '0' AND lt.milliseconds < 174060 AND ps.lap > 5 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '10' AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 159642 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_lap_time_ms ASC LIMIT 406;
