SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops, MAX(q.position) AS best_qualifying, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM driverstandings ds2 WHERE ds2.driverid = d.driverid AND ds2.position = 1) AS career_wins, (SELECT AVG(sub.avg_points) FROM (SELECT raceid, AVG(points) AS avg_points FROM results GROUP BY raceid) sub WHERE sub.raceid IN (SELECT raceid FROM races WHERE circuitid = cir.circuitid)) AS avg_points_on_circuit FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits cir ON r.circuitid = cir.circuitid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON d.driverid = lt.driverid AND r.raceid = lt.raceid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON d.driverid = ps.driverid AND r.raceid = ps.raceid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON d.driverid = q.driverid AND r.raceid = q.raceid JOIN seasons s ON r.year = s.year WHERE r.year >= 1965 AND r.year <= 1994 AND cir.alt > 819 AND res.grid <= 23 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round, r.name, cir.circuitid HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 72371 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_lap_time_ms ASC LIMIT 87;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, rs.points AS race_points, ds.position AS driver_position, cs.position AS constructor_position, lt.lap, lt.position AS lap_position, ps.stop AS pit_stop_number, ps.lap AS pit_stop_lap, q.position AS qualifying_position, t.win, AVG(rs.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid, r.year) AS avg_points_per_season, SUM(rs.points) OVER (PARTITION BY c.constructorid, r.year ORDER BY r.date) AS cumulative_constructor_points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.raceid ORDER BY rs.points DESC) AS points_rank_in_race, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM laptimes lt2 WHERE lt2.driverid = d.driverid AND lt2.position = 1 AND lt2.raceid IN (SELECT raceid FROM races WHERE year = r.year)) AS season_fastest_laps FROM drivers d JOIN results rs ON d.driverid = rs.driverid JOIN races r ON rs.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON rs.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN circuits ci ON r.circuitid = ci.circuitid JOIN driverstandings ds ON d.driverid = ds.driverid AND r.raceid = ds.raceid JOIN constructorstandings cs ON c.constructorid = cs.constructorid AND r.raceid = cs.raceid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON d.driverid = lt.driverid AND r.raceid = lt.raceid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON d.driverid = ps.driverid AND r.raceid = ps.raceid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON d.driverid = q.driverid AND r.raceid = q.raceid LEFT JOIN target t ON d.driverid = t.driverid AND r.raceid = t.raceid WHERE r.year >= 1996 AND r.year <= 2007 AND rs.points > '0' AND ds.position <= 5 AND cs.position <= 4 AND ci.alt > 131 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round, r.name, rs.points, ds.position, cs.position, lt.lap, lt.position, ps.stop, ps.lap, q.position, t.win, c.constructorid, r.raceid, r.date HAVING SUM(rs.points) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) >= 39 ORDER BY r.year DESC, r.round DESC, rs.points DESC LIMIT 206;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, rs.points AS race_points, ds.position AS driver_position, cs.position AS constructor_position, lt.lap, lt.position AS lap_position, ps.stop AS pit_stop_number, ps.lap AS pit_stop_lap, q.position AS qualifying_position, t.win, AVG(rs.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid, r.year) AS avg_points_per_season, SUM(rs.points) OVER (PARTITION BY c.constructorid, r.year ORDER BY r.date) AS cumulative_constructor_points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.raceid ORDER BY rs.points DESC) AS points_rank_in_race, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM laptimes lt2 WHERE lt2.driverid = d.driverid AND lt2.position = 1 AND lt2.raceid IN (SELECT raceid FROM races WHERE year = r.year)) AS season_fastest_laps FROM drivers d JOIN results rs ON d.driverid = rs.driverid JOIN races r ON rs.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON rs.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN circuits ci ON r.circuitid = ci.circuitid JOIN driverstandings ds ON d.driverid = ds.driverid AND r.raceid = ds.raceid JOIN constructorstandings cs ON c.constructorid = cs.constructorid AND r.raceid = cs.raceid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON d.driverid = lt.driverid AND r.raceid = lt.raceid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON d.driverid = ps.driverid AND r.raceid = ps.raceid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON d.driverid = q.driverid AND r.raceid = q.raceid LEFT JOIN target t ON d.driverid = t.driverid AND r.raceid = t.raceid WHERE r.year >= 2018 AND r.year <= 1968 AND rs.points > '0' AND ds.position <= 10 AND cs.position <= 5 AND ci.alt > 196 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round, r.name, rs.points, ds.position, cs.position, lt.lap, lt.position, ps.stop, ps.lap, q.position, t.win, c.constructorid, r.raceid, r.date HAVING SUM(rs.points) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) >= 47 ORDER BY r.year DESC, r.round DESC, rs.points DESC LIMIT 139;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.raceid, r.date, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) AS laps_led, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid WHERE lt.position = 1 AND r.date >= '2000-01-01' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM r.date) = 2006 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.raceid, r.date HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) > 2 ORDER BY laps_led DESC, avg_lap_time_ms ASC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.raceid, r.date, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) AS laps_led, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid WHERE lt.position = 1 AND r.date >= '2000-01-01' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM r.date) = 2019 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.raceid, r.date HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) > 3 ORDER BY laps_led DESC, avg_lap_time_ms ASC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.raceid, r.name AS race_name, r.date, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(r.date, d.dob)) AS age_at_race, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position AS lap_position, ps.stop AS pit_stop_number, ps.duration FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND d.driverid = ps.driverid WHERE r.date >= '2000-01-01' AND r.date <= '2000-01-01' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(r.date, d.dob)) >= 21 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.raceid, r.name, r.date, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position, ps.stop, ps.duration HAVING AVG(res.points) > 6.78 ORDER BY r.date DESC, d.surname, d.forename;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position AS lap_position, ps.stop AS pit_stop_number, ps.lap AS pit_stop_lap, q.position AS qualifying_position FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN laptimes lt ON res.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON res.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON res.raceid = q.raceid AND res.driverid = q.driverid WHERE r.year = 1953 AND r.round BETWEEN 1 AND 10 AND res.positionorder <= 13 AND lt.lap >= 36 AND lt.position <= 20 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position, ps.stop, ps.lap, q.position HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) >= 8 ORDER BY SUM(res.points) DESC, d.surname, d.forename;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops FROM drivers d INNER JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid INNER JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid INNER JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND d.driverid = ps.driverid WHERE r.year = 2022 AND res.grid <= 19 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_lap_time_ms ASC LIMIT 100;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, res.positionorder, res.points, AVG(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid, r.year) AS avg_points_per_season, SUM(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid ORDER BY r.date) AS running_total_points FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid WHERE r.year >= 2016 AND r.year <= 2021 AND res.points > '0' ORDER BY d.driverid, r.date;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, res.positionorder, res.points, AVG(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY r.year, d.driverid) AS avg_points_per_season, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY SUM(res.points) DESC) AS season_rank FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 2009 AND r.year <= 2008 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name, res.positionorder, res.points HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY r.year, season_rank, d.surname;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, res.positionorder, res.points, CASE WHEN res.positionorder = 1 THEN 'Winner' WHEN res.positionorder BETWEEN 2 AND 3 THEN 'Podium' WHEN res.positionorder BETWEEN 4 AND 10 THEN 'Points' ELSE 'No Points' END AS finish_category, SUM(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid, r.year ORDER BY r.date) AS cumulative_points_season, AVG(res.positionorder) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid, r.year) AS avg_position_season FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid WHERE r.year = 2014 AND res.points > '0' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name, res.positionorder, res.points, r.date ORDER BY r.year, r.round, res.positionorder;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, res.positionorder, res.points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY SUM(res.points) DESC) AS yearly_rank FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid WHERE r.year >= 1973 AND r.year <= 1957 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name, res.positionorder, res.points HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY r.year, yearly_rank, r.round;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, res.positionorder, res.points, SUM(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid ORDER BY r.date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_total_points, AVG(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid, r.circuitid) AS avg_points_per_circuit FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 1969 AND res.positionorder <= 15 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name, res.positionorder, res.points, r.date, r.circuitid ORDER BY d.driverid, r.date;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, res.positionorder, res.points, SUM(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid, r.year ORDER BY r.date) AS cumulative_points, AVG(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid, r.year) AS avg_points_per_race, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid, r.year) AS races_entered FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid WHERE r.year = 1967 AND res.positionorder <= 15 AND res.points > '0.0' AND d.dob >= '1950-01-01' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name, res.positionorder, res.points, r.date HAVING SUM(res.points) > '1.0' ORDER BY cumulative_points DESC, r.round ASC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, res.positionorder, res.points, SUM(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid, r.year ORDER BY r.round) AS cumulative_points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.raceid ORDER BY res.positionorder) AS race_finish_rank FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid WHERE r.year = 1970 AND res.positionorder <= 17 ORDER BY d.driverid, r.round;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position AS lap_position, ps.stop AS pit_stop_number, ps.lap AS pit_stop_lap, q.position AS qualifying_position FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN laptimes lt ON res.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON res.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON res.raceid = q.raceid AND res.driverid = q.driverid WHERE r.year = 2016 AND r.round >= 16 AND res.positionorder <= 6 AND lt.lap BETWEEN 67 AND 71 AND (ps.milliseconds IS NULL OR ps.milliseconds > 29464) GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position, ps.stop, ps.lap, q.position HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY SUM(res.points) DESC, d.surname, r.round;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN laptimes lt ON d.driverid = lt.driverid AND res.raceid = lt.raceid WHERE r.year = 2021 AND res.points > '0' AND lt.lap IN (SELECT lap FROM laptimes WHERE milliseconds < 85071) GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, r.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '10' ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_lap_time_ms ASC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, c.name AS circuit_name, res.positionorder, res.points, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM laptimes lt WHERE lt.raceid = r.raceid AND lt.driverid = d.driverid AND lt.position = 1) AS laps_led, (SELECT AVG(sub.avg_points) FROM (SELECT rs.driverid, AVG(rs.points) AS avg_points FROM results rs WHERE rs.raceid IN (SELECT raceid FROM races WHERE year = r.year) GROUP BY rs.driverid) sub WHERE sub.driverid = d.driverid) AS avg_points_in_season FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid WHERE r.year = 1951 AND res.positionorder <= 6 AND con.nationality = 'British' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, r.name, c.name, res.positionorder, res.points, r.raceid HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY SUM(res.points) DESC, d.surname;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, res.points, res.positionorder, ds.wins, AVG(lt.milliseconds) OVER (PARTITION BY lt.raceid, lt.driverid) AS avg_lap_ms FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN driverstandings ds ON res.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON res.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid WHERE r.year = 2022 AND res.points > '0' AND d.driverid IN ( SELECT driverid FROM results WHERE positionorder <= 1 ) ORDER BY res.points DESC, avg_lap_ms ASC;

SELECT d1.driverid AS driver1_id, d1.forename AS driver1_forename, d1.surname AS driver1_surname, d2.driverid AS driver2_id, d2.forename AS driver2_forename, d2.surname AS driver2_surname, r.year, r.name AS race_name, AVG(lt1.milliseconds - lt2.milliseconds) AS avg_time_diff_ms FROM laptimes lt1 JOIN laptimes lt2 ON lt1.raceid = lt2.raceid AND lt1.lap = lt2.lap JOIN drivers d1 ON lt1.driverid = d1.driverid JOIN drivers d2 ON lt2.driverid = d2.driverid JOIN races r ON lt1.raceid = r.raceid WHERE lt1.driverid < lt2.driverid AND r.year = 2003 AND lt1.lap BETWEEN 7 AND 27 GROUP BY d1.driverid, d1.forename, d1.surname, d2.driverid, d2.forename, d2.surname, r.year, r.name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 6 ORDER BY avg_time_diff_ms DESC;

SELECT d1.driverid AS driver1_id, d1.forename AS driver1_forename, d1.surname AS driver1_surname, d2.driverid AS driver2_id, d2.forename AS driver2_forename, d2.surname AS driver2_surname, r.year, r.name AS race_name, AVG(lt1.milliseconds - lt2.milliseconds) AS avg_time_diff_ms FROM laptimes lt1 JOIN laptimes lt2 ON lt1.raceid = lt2.raceid AND lt1.lap = lt2.lap JOIN drivers d1 ON lt1.driverid = d1.driverid JOIN drivers d2 ON lt2.driverid = d2.driverid JOIN races r ON lt1.raceid = r.raceid WHERE lt1.driverid < lt2.driverid AND r.year = 2018 AND lt1.lap BETWEEN 1 AND 18 GROUP BY d1.driverid, d1.forename, d1.surname, d2.driverid, d2.forename, d2.surname, r.year, r.name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 14 ORDER BY avg_time_diff_ms DESC;

SELECT d1.driverid AS driver1_id, d1.forename AS driver1_forename, d1.surname AS driver1_surname, d2.driverid AS driver2_id, d2.forename AS driver2_forename, d2.surname AS driver2_surname, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, AVG(lt1.milliseconds - lt2.milliseconds) AS avg_time_diff_ms, SUM(CASE WHEN res1.positionorder < res2.positionorder THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS driver1_wins_against_driver2, SUM(cr1.points) AS driver1_constructor_points, SUM(cr2.points) AS driver2_constructor_points, COUNT(DISTINCT lt1.lap) AS laps_compared, CORR(lt1.position, lt2.position) AS lap_position_correlation FROM laptimes lt1 JOIN laptimes lt2 ON lt1.raceid = lt2.raceid AND lt1.lap = lt2.lap AND lt1.driverid < lt2.driverid JOIN drivers d1 ON lt1.driverid = d1.driverid JOIN drivers d2 ON lt2.driverid = d2.driverid JOIN races r ON lt1.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid LEFT JOIN results res1 ON lt1.raceid = res1.raceid AND lt1.driverid = res1.driverid LEFT JOIN results res2 ON lt2.raceid = res2.raceid AND lt2.driverid = res2.driverid LEFT JOIN constructorresults cr1 ON res1.raceid = cr1.raceid AND res1.constructorid = cr1.constructorid LEFT JOIN constructorresults cr2 ON res2.raceid = cr2.raceid AND res2.constructorid = cr2.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 1992 AND r.date <= '1950-01-01' AND lt1.milliseconds IS NOT NULL AND lt2.milliseconds IS NOT NULL AND c.alt > 106 GROUP BY d1.driverid, d1.forename, d1.surname, d2.driverid, d2.forename, d2.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lt1.lap) > 100 AND AVG(lt1.milliseconds - lt2.milliseconds) BETWEEN -6369 AND 2163 ORDER BY avg_time_diff_ms DESC, driver1_wins_against_driver2 DESC LIMIT 42;

SELECT d1.driverid AS driver1_id, d1.forename AS driver1_forename, d1.surname AS driver1_surname, d2.driverid AS driver2_id, d2.forename AS driver2_forename, d2.surname AS driver2_surname, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, AVG(lt1.milliseconds - lt2.milliseconds) AS avg_time_diff_ms, SUM(res1.points) AS driver1_total_points, SUM(res2.points) AS driver2_total_points, COUNT(DISTINCT lt1.raceid) AS races_compared, SUM(CASE WHEN res1.positionorder < res2.positionorder THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS driver1_wins_over_driver2 FROM laptimes lt1 JOIN laptimes lt2 ON lt1.raceid = lt2.raceid AND lt1.lap = lt2.lap AND lt1.driverid < lt2.driverid JOIN drivers d1 ON lt1.driverid = d1.driverid JOIN drivers d2 ON lt2.driverid = d2.driverid JOIN races r ON lt1.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res1 ON lt1.raceid = res1.raceid AND lt1.driverid = res1.driverid JOIN results res2 ON lt2.raceid = res2.raceid AND lt2.driverid = res2.driverid LEFT JOIN constructorstandings cs1 ON res1.raceid = cs1.raceid AND res1.constructorid = cs1.constructorid LEFT JOIN constructorstandings cs2 ON res2.raceid = cs2.raceid AND res2.constructorid = cs2.constructorid LEFT JOIN qualifying q1 ON lt1.raceid = q1.raceid AND lt1.driverid = q1.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q2 ON lt2.raceid = q2.raceid AND lt2.driverid = q2.driverid WHERE r.year >= 1992 AND r.date <= '1950-01-01' AND lt1.milliseconds > 333039 AND lt2.milliseconds > 320187 AND c.circuitid IN (14, 52, 61) GROUP BY d1.driverid, d1.forename, d1.surname, d2.driverid, d2.forename, d2.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name HAVING AVG(lt1.milliseconds - lt2.milliseconds) > 1301 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lt1.raceid) >= 4 ORDER BY avg_time_diff_ms DESC, races_compared DESC LIMIT 44;

SELECT d1.driverid AS driver1_id, d1.forename AS driver1_forename, d1.surname AS driver1_surname, d2.driverid AS driver2_id, d2.forename AS driver2_forename, d2.surname AS driver2_surname, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, con1.name AS constructor1_name, con2.name AS constructor2_name, AVG(lt1.milliseconds - lt2.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_diff_ms, SUM(res1.points) AS driver1_total_points, SUM(res2.points) AS driver2_total_points, COUNT(DISTINCT lt1.lap) AS laps_compared, CORR(lt1.position, lt2.position) AS position_correlation FROM laptimes lt1 JOIN laptimes lt2 ON lt1.raceid = lt2.raceid AND lt1.lap = lt2.lap AND lt1.driverid < lt2.driverid JOIN drivers d1 ON lt1.driverid = d1.driverid JOIN drivers d2 ON lt2.driverid = d2.driverid JOIN races r ON lt1.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res1 ON lt1.raceid = res1.raceid AND lt1.driverid = res1.driverid JOIN results res2 ON lt2.raceid = res2.raceid AND lt2.driverid = res2.driverid JOIN constructors con1 ON res1.constructorid = con1.constructorid JOIN constructors con2 ON res2.constructorid = con2.constructorid JOIN qualifying q1 ON lt1.raceid = q1.raceid AND lt1.driverid = q1.driverid JOIN qualifying q2 ON lt2.raceid = q2.raceid AND lt2.driverid = q2.driverid JOIN pitstops ps1 ON lt1.raceid = ps1.raceid AND lt1.driverid = ps1.driverid JOIN pitstops ps2 ON lt2.raceid = ps2.raceid AND lt2.driverid = ps2.driverid JOIN driverstandings ds1 ON lt1.raceid = ds1.raceid AND lt1.driverid = ds1.driverid JOIN driverstandings ds2 ON lt2.raceid = ds2.raceid AND lt2.driverid = ds2.driverid WHERE r.year >= 1979 AND r.year <= 2015 AND lt1.milliseconds > 69066 AND lt2.milliseconds > 328278 AND res1.points >= '0' AND res2.points >= '0' AND c.alt > 452 GROUP BY d1.driverid, d1.forename, d1.surname, d2.driverid, d2.forename, d2.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name, con1.name, con2.name HAVING AVG(lt1.milliseconds - lt2.milliseconds) > '-5000' AND COUNT(DISTINCT lt1.lap) > 20 AND SUM(res1.points) + SUM(res2.points) > '0' ORDER BY avg_lap_time_diff_ms DESC, driver1_total_points DESC, driver2_total_points DESC LIMIT 1000;

SELECT r.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(*) AS race_count, SUM(r.points) AS total_points FROM results r JOIN drivers d ON r.driverid = d.driverid JOIN races rc ON r.raceid = rc.raceid WHERE r.points > '0' AND rc.year = 2011 GROUP BY r.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(r.points) > '10' INTERSECT SELECT r.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(*) AS race_count, SUM(r.points) AS total_points FROM results r JOIN drivers d ON r.driverid = d.driverid JOIN races rc ON r.raceid = rc.raceid WHERE r.grid <= 8 AND rc.year BETWEEN 2015 AND 2022 GROUP BY r.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING COUNT(*) >= 40 ORDER BY total_points DESC;
SELECT r.raceid, COUNT(l.driverid) AS lap_count FROM races r JOIN laptimes l ON r.raceid = l.raceid WHERE r.year = 1981 AND l.lap > 92 GROUP BY r.raceid ORDER BY lap_count DESC;
SELECT r.raceid, COUNT(l.driverid) AS lap_count FROM races r JOIN laptimes l ON r.raceid = l.raceid WHERE r.year = 2003 AND l.lap > 89 GROUP BY r.raceid ORDER BY lap_count DESC;
SELECT r.raceid, COUNT(l.driverid) AS total_laps FROM races r JOIN laptimes l ON r.raceid = l.raceid WHERE r.year = 1974 AND l.milliseconds < 105488 GROUP BY r.raceid ORDER BY total_laps DESC;

SELECT r.raceid, r.name AS race_name, r.date, c.name AS circuit_name, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, con.name AS constructor_name, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position AS lap_position, ps.stop AS pit_stop_number, ps.lap AS pit_stop_lap, q.position AS qualifying_position FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND res.driverid = q.driverid AND res.constructorid = q.constructorid WHERE r.year = 1952 AND res.grid BETWEEN 1 AND 1 AND res.points > '0' AND r.date >= '1950-01-01' AND (lt.milliseconds < 65724 OR lt.milliseconds IS NULL) GROUP BY r.raceid, r.name, r.date, c.name, d.forename, d.surname, con.name, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position, ps.stop, ps.lap, q.position HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) > 9 ORDER BY r.date, res.positionorder LIMIT 96;

SELECT r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, d.driverid, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, con.name AS constructor_name, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position AS lap_position, lt.milliseconds AS lap_time_ms, ps.stop AS pit_stop_number, ps.lap AS pit_stop_lap, ps.milliseconds AS pit_stop_duration_ms, q.position AS qualifying_position, ds.points AS driver_standing_points, ds.wins AS driver_standing_wins, cs.points AS constructor_standing_points, cs.wins AS constructor_standing_wins, AVG(lt.milliseconds) OVER ( PARTITION BY r.raceid, d.driverid ORDER BY lt.lap ROWS BETWEEN 4 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_lap_time, SUM(res.points) OVER ( PARTITION BY r.year, con.constructorid ORDER BY r.date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS cumulative_constructor_points, RANK() OVER ( PARTITION BY r.raceid ORDER BY res.positionorder ) AS race_finish_rank FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND res.driverid = q.driverid AND res.constructorid = q.constructorid LEFT JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid LEFT JOIN constructorstandings cs ON r.raceid = cs.raceid AND res.constructorid = cs.constructorid LEFT JOIN constructorresults cr ON r.raceid = cr.raceid AND res.constructorid = cr.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 1990 AND r.year <= 2022 AND res.positionorder <= 11 AND lt.milliseconds > 70502 AND (ps.milliseconds IS NULL OR ps.milliseconds < 59484) GROUP BY r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name, d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, con.name, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position, lt.milliseconds, ps.stop, ps.lap, ps.milliseconds, q.position, ds.points, ds.wins, cs.points, cs.wins, r.date, con.constructorid HAVING AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 125580 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) > 42 ORDER BY r.year DESC, r.round DESC, cumulative_constructor_points DESC;

SELECT r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, d.driverid, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, res.positionorder, res.points, AVG(res.points) OVER ( PARTITION BY r.year, d.driverid ORDER BY r.date ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_points_last_3_races FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 2006 AND r.year <= 2021 AND res.positionorder <= 5 AND d.dob >= '1970-01-01' GROUP BY r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name, d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, res.positionorder, res.points, r.date HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY r.year, r.round, moving_avg_points_last_3_races DESC;

SELECT r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, d.driverid, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, res.positionorder, res.points, AVG(res.points) OVER ( PARTITION BY r.year, d.driverid ORDER BY r.date ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_points_last_3_races FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 2018 AND r.date >= '2000-03-01' AND res.positionorder <= 3 GROUP BY r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name, d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, res.positionorder, res.points, r.date HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0.0' ORDER BY r.year, r.round, moving_avg_points_last_3_races DESC;

SELECT r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, d.driverid, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, res.positionorder, res.points, AVG(res.points) OVER ( PARTITION BY r.year, d.driverid ORDER BY r.date ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_points_last_3_races FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid WHERE r.year >= 2008 AND r.year <= 2002 AND res.positionorder <= 7 GROUP BY r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name, d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, res.positionorder, res.points, r.date HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY r.year, r.round, moving_avg_points_last_3_races DESC;

SELECT r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, d.driverref, d.nationality AS driver_nationality, con.name AS constructor_name, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points, AVG(res.points) OVER ( PARTITION BY r.circuitid, d.driverid ORDER BY r.date ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS avg_points_last_3_races FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 2006 AND r.year <= 2006 AND res.positionorder <= 5 AND res.grid <= 3 GROUP BY r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name, d.driverref, d.nationality, con.name, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points, r.circuitid, d.driverid, r.date HAVING AVG(res.points) > '0.0' ORDER BY r.year, r.round, avg_points_last_3_races DESC;

SELECT r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, d.driverref, lt.lap, lt.position AS lap_position, lt.milliseconds, AVG(lt.milliseconds) OVER ( PARTITION BY lt.raceid, lt.driverid ORDER BY lt.lap ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_ms FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid JOIN drivers d ON lt.driverid = d.driverid WHERE r.year = 2002 AND lt.milliseconds > 61236 ORDER BY r.raceid, lt.driverid, lt.lap;

SELECT r.year, c.country, con.nationality, d.driverref, COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) AS race_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) AS total_laps_analyzed, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, SUM(CASE WHEN res.positionorder = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wins, SUM(ps.stop) AS total_pit_stops, AVG(q.position) AS avg_qualifying_position FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND res.driverid = q.driverid AND res.constructorid = q.constructorid LEFT JOIN constructorresults cr ON r.raceid = cr.raceid AND res.constructorid = cr.constructorid LEFT JOIN constructorstandings cs ON r.raceid = cs.raceid AND res.constructorid = cs.constructorid LEFT JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid WHERE r.year >= 2002 AND r.year <= 1994 AND res.points > '0' AND (lt.milliseconds IS NULL OR lt.milliseconds > 65980) AND d.dob >= '1950-01-01' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (r.year, c.country, con.nationality, d.driverref), (r.year, c.country, con.nationality), (r.year, c.country), (r.year), () ) HAVING SUM(res.points) > '10' AND COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) >= 13 ORDER BY r.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT r.year, c.name AS circuit_name, con.name AS constructor_name, COUNT(DISTINCT res.driverid) AS unique_drivers, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(res.positionorder) AS avg_finish_position FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 2009 AND r.year <= 2023 GROUP BY r.year, c.name, con.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY r.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT r.year, c.name AS circuit_name, con.name AS constructor_name, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid WHERE r.year >= 1974 AND r.year <= 1980 AND res.positionorder <= 12 GROUP BY r.year, c.circuitid, con.constructorid, d.driverid HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY r.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT r.year, c.name AS circuit_name, con.name AS constructor_name, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid WHERE r.year >= 2005 AND r.year <= 1996 GROUP BY r.year, c.circuitid, con.constructorid, d.driverid HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_lap_time_ms ASC LIMIT 100;

SELECT r.year, c.name AS circuit_name, con.name AS constructor_name, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid WHERE r.year >= 2005 AND r.year <= 2002 GROUP BY r.year, c.circuitid, c.name, con.constructorid, con.name, d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY r.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT r.year, c.name AS circuit_name, con.name AS constructor_name, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, res.positionorder, res.points, ds.wins, lt.lap, lt.position AS lap_position, ps.duration AS pitstop_duration, q.position AS qualifying_position FROM races r INNER JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid INNER JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid INNER JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid INNER JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid LEFT JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid AND lt.lap = ps.lap LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND res.driverid = q.driverid AND res.constructorid = q.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 2005 AND r.year <= 2016 AND res.points > '0' GROUP BY r.year, c.circuitid, con.constructorid, d.driverid, res.positionorder, res.points, ds.wins, lt.lap, lt.position, ps.duration, q.position HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY r.year DESC, SUM(res.points) DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT r.year, c.name AS constructor_name, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.driverid) AS distinct_drivers, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) AS distinct_laps, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms FROM laptimes lt JOIN races r ON lt.raceid = r.raceid JOIN results res ON lt.raceid = res.raceid AND lt.driverid = res.driverid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 1992 AND lt.milliseconds <= 91597 GROUP BY r.year, c.name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lt.driverid) > 6 ORDER BY r.year DESC, avg_lap_time_ms ASC;

SELECT r.year, c.name AS constructor_name, COUNT(DISTINCT res.raceid) AS races_entered, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(res.positionorder) AS avg_finish_position, MAX(ds.wins) AS max_wins_in_season FROM results res JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN driverstandings ds ON res.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid WHERE r.year >= 2012 AND res.points > '0.0' GROUP BY r.year, c.constructorid, c.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '50.0' AND AVG(res.positionorder) < 6 ORDER BY r.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT c.circuitid, c.name AS circuit_name, c.country, r.year, r.round, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.driverid) AS unique_drivers, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) AS unique_laps, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS unique_pitstops, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, MAX(ds.wins) AS max_wins_in_race, SUM(crs.points) AS total_constructor_points FROM circuits c JOIN races r ON c.circuitid = r.circuitid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND lt.driverid = ps.driverid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid AND lt.driverid = res.driverid JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND lt.driverid = ds.driverid JOIN constructorresults crs ON r.raceid = crs.raceid AND res.constructorid = crs.constructorid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid JOIN drivers d ON lt.driverid = d.driverid WHERE r.year >= 1986 AND r.date <= '1950-01-01' AND lt.milliseconds > 92462 AND res.points > '0' AND ds.position <= 12 GROUP BY c.circuitid, c.name, c.country, r.year, r.round HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lt.driverid) > 7 AND SUM(res.points) >= '10' ORDER BY r.year DESC, r.round ASC, total_points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) AS races_participated, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid WHERE r.year = 2000 AND d.driverid IN ( SELECT driverid FROM results WHERE points > '0' GROUP BY driverid HAVING COUNT(raceid) >= 14 ) GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, res.positionorder, res.points, SUM(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid, r.year ORDER BY r.round) AS cumulative_points FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid WHERE r.year = 1955 AND res.positionorder <= 15 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name, res.positionorder, res.points ORDER BY d.driverid, r.year, r.round;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, res.positionorder, res.points, SUM(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid, r.year ORDER BY r.round) AS cumulative_points FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid WHERE r.year = 1959 AND res.positionorder <= 8 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name, res.positionorder, res.points ORDER BY d.driverid, r.year, r.round;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) AS laps_analyzed FROM drivers d JOIN laptimes lt ON d.driverid = lt.driverid JOIN races r ON lt.raceid = r.raceid WHERE r.year = 1991 AND lt.milliseconds IS NOT NULL AND lt.lap IN ( SELECT lap FROM laptimes WHERE raceid IN ( SELECT raceid FROM races WHERE circuitid = 67 ) GROUP BY lap HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT driverid) > 28 ) GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, r.name HAVING AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 89121 ORDER BY avg_lap_time_ms ASC LIMIT 20;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN laptimes lt ON d.driverid = lt.driverid AND res.raceid = lt.raceid WHERE r.year = 1987 AND res.positionorder <= 20 AND lt.lap BETWEEN 29 AND 66 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, r.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN laptimes lt ON d.driverid = lt.driverid AND res.raceid = lt.raceid WHERE r.year = 2005 AND res.points > '0' AND lt.lap IN (SELECT lap FROM laptimes WHERE milliseconds < 87391) GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, r.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '10' ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_lap_time_ms ASC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid WHERE r.year = 2003 AND res.positionorder <= 11 AND lt.lap BETWEEN 2 AND 51 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, r.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_lap_time_ms ASC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, c.name AS circuit_name, res.positionorder, res.points, (SELECT AVG(sub.points) FROM (SELECT r2.year, res2.driverid, SUM(res2.points) AS points FROM results res2 JOIN races r2 ON res2.raceid = r2.raceid WHERE r2.year = r.year GROUP BY r2.year, res2.driverid) sub WHERE sub.driverid = d.driverid) AS avg_yearly_points FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 2009 AND res.positionorder <= 2 AND c.country = 'UK' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, r.name, c.name, res.positionorder, res.points HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY r.year DESC, r.round ASC, res.positionorder ASC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, c.name AS circuit_name, res.positionorder, res.points, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM laptimes lt WHERE lt.raceid = r.raceid AND lt.driverid = d.driverid AND lt.position = 1) AS laps_led FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid WHERE r.year = 1993 AND res.points > '0' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, r.name, c.name, res.positionorder, res.points, r.raceid HAVING COUNT(res.resultid) > 2 ORDER BY res.points DESC, laps_led DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, c.name AS circuit_name, res.positionorder, res.points, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM laptimes lt WHERE lt.raceid = r.raceid AND lt.driverid = d.driverid AND lt.position = 1) AS laps_led, (SELECT AVG(ps.milliseconds) FROM pitstops ps WHERE ps.raceid = r.raceid AND ps.driverid = d.driverid) AS avg_pitstop_ms FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid WHERE r.year = 1966 AND res.points > '0' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, r.name, c.name, res.positionorder, res.points, r.raceid HAVING AVG(res.positionorder) < 6 ORDER BY res.points DESC, laps_led DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position AS lap_position, lt.milliseconds AS lap_time_ms FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid WHERE r.year = 1957 AND res.positionorder <= 7 AND lt.lap = ( SELECT MAX(lap) FROM laptimes WHERE raceid = r.raceid AND driverid = d.driverid ) ORDER BY r.round, res.positionorder, lt.lap;

SELECT d1.driverid AS driver1_id, d1.forename AS driver1_forename, d1.surname AS driver1_surname, d2.driverid AS driver2_id, d2.forename AS driver2_forename, d2.surname AS driver2_surname, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, AVG(lt1.milliseconds - lt2.milliseconds) AS avg_time_diff_ms, SUM(CASE WHEN res1.positionorder < res2.positionorder THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS driver1_wins_against_driver2, SUM(cr1.points) AS driver1_constructor_points, SUM(cr2.points) AS driver2_constructor_points, COUNT(DISTINCT lt1.lap) AS total_laps_compared, CORR(lt1.position, lt2.position) AS lap_position_correlation FROM laptimes lt1 JOIN laptimes lt2 ON lt1.raceid = lt2.raceid AND lt1.lap = lt2.lap AND lt1.driverid < lt2.driverid JOIN drivers d1 ON lt1.driverid = d1.driverid JOIN drivers d2 ON lt2.driverid = d2.driverid JOIN races r ON lt1.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid LEFT JOIN results res1 ON lt1.raceid = res1.raceid AND lt1.driverid = res1.driverid LEFT JOIN results res2 ON lt2.raceid = res2.raceid AND lt2.driverid = res2.driverid LEFT JOIN constructorresults cr1 ON res1.raceid = cr1.raceid AND res1.constructorid = cr1.constructorid LEFT JOIN constructorresults cr2 ON res2.raceid = cr2.raceid AND res2.constructorid = cr2.constructorid WHERE r.year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2008 AND lt1.milliseconds IS NOT NULL AND lt2.milliseconds IS NOT NULL AND c.alt > 564 GROUP BY d1.driverid, d1.forename, d1.surname, d2.driverid, d2.forename, d2.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name HAVING COUNT(lt1.lap) > 42 AND AVG(lt1.milliseconds - lt2.milliseconds) > 7453 ORDER BY avg_time_diff_ms DESC, driver1_wins_against_driver2 DESC LIMIT 885;

SELECT d1.driverid AS driver1_id, d1.forename AS driver1_forename, d1.surname AS driver1_surname, d2.driverid AS driver2_id, d2.forename AS driver2_forename, d2.surname AS driver2_surname, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, con1.name AS constructor1_name, con2.name AS constructor2_name, AVG(lt1.milliseconds - lt2.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_diff_ms, SUM(res1.points) AS driver1_total_points, SUM(res2.points) AS driver2_total_points, COUNT(DISTINCT lt1.lap) AS laps_compared, CORR(lt1.position, lt2.position) AS position_correlation FROM laptimes lt1 JOIN laptimes lt2 ON lt1.raceid = lt2.raceid AND lt1.lap = lt2.lap AND lt1.driverid < lt2.driverid JOIN drivers d1 ON lt1.driverid = d1.driverid JOIN drivers d2 ON lt2.driverid = d2.driverid JOIN races r ON lt1.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res1 ON lt1.raceid = res1.raceid AND lt1.driverid = res1.driverid JOIN results res2 ON lt2.raceid = res2.raceid AND lt2.driverid = res2.driverid JOIN constructors con1 ON res1.constructorid = con1.constructorid JOIN constructors con2 ON res2.constructorid = con2.constructorid JOIN qualifying q1 ON lt1.raceid = q1.raceid AND lt1.driverid = q1.driverid JOIN qualifying q2 ON lt2.raceid = q2.raceid AND lt2.driverid = q2.driverid JOIN pitstops ps1 ON lt1.raceid = ps1.raceid AND lt1.driverid = ps1.driverid JOIN pitstops ps2 ON lt2.raceid = ps2.raceid AND lt2.driverid = ps2.driverid JOIN driverstandings ds1 ON lt1.raceid = ds1.raceid AND lt1.driverid = ds1.driverid JOIN driverstandings ds2 ON lt2.raceid = ds2.raceid AND lt2.driverid = ds2.driverid WHERE r.year >= 2017 AND r.year <= 2001 AND lt1.milliseconds > 119250 AND lt2.milliseconds > 106029 AND res1.points >= '0' AND res2.points >= '0' AND c.alt > 767 GROUP BY d1.driverid, d1.forename, d1.surname, d2.driverid, d2.forename, d2.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name, con1.name, con2.name HAVING AVG(lt1.milliseconds - lt2.milliseconds) > '-5000' AND COUNT(DISTINCT lt1.lap) > 64 AND SUM(res1.points) + SUM(res2.points) > '0' ORDER BY avg_lap_time_diff_ms DESC, driver1_total_points DESC, driver2_total_points DESC LIMIT 1000;

SELECT r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.driverid) AS drivers_with_laptimes, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_ms FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid WHERE r.year = 1986 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM results res WHERE res.raceid = r.raceid AND res.positionorder <= 2 ) GROUP BY r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name HAVING AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 114119 ORDER BY r.round;

SELECT r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, c.country, d.driverid, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, con.name AS constructor_name, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points, res.laps, res.milliseconds, lt.lap, lt.position AS lap_position, lt.milliseconds AS lap_time_ms, ps.stop, ps.lap AS pit_lap, ps.milliseconds AS pit_stop_ms, q.position AS qualifying_position, ds.points AS driver_standing_points, ds.wins AS driver_wins, cs.points AS constructor_standing_points, cs.wins AS constructor_wins, cr.points AS constructor_result_points, t.win AS target_win, s.status, AVG(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY r.year, con.constructorid) AS avg_constructor_points_per_year, SUM(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY r.year, d.driverid ORDER BY r.date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_driver_points, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY r.circuitid) AS races_at_circuit FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND res.driverid = q.driverid AND res.constructorid = q.constructorid LEFT JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid LEFT JOIN constructorstandings cs ON r.raceid = cs.raceid AND res.constructorid = cs.constructorid LEFT JOIN constructorresults cr ON r.raceid = cr.raceid AND res.constructorid = cr.constructorid LEFT JOIN target t ON r.raceid = t.raceid AND res.driverid = t.driverid LEFT JOIN status s ON res.statusid = s.statusid WHERE r.year >= 1974 AND r.date <= '1950-01-01' AND res.points > '0' AND (lt.milliseconds IS NULL OR lt.milliseconds < 115996) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM driverstandings ds2 WHERE ds2.driverid = d.driverid AND ds2.points >= '0' AND ds2.raceid IN (SELECT raceid FROM races WHERE year = r.year) ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM constructorstandings cs2 WHERE cs2.constructorid = con.constructorid AND cs2.wins >= 17 AND cs2.raceid IN (SELECT raceid FROM races WHERE year = r.year AND round <= r.round) ) GROUP BY r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name, c.country, d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, con.name, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points, res.laps, res.milliseconds, lt.lap, lt.position, lt.milliseconds, ps.stop, ps.lap, ps.milliseconds, q.position, ds.points, ds.wins, cs.points, cs.wins, cr.points, t.win, s.status, c.circuitid, con.constructorid, d.driverid, r.date HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) > 19 AND AVG(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY r.year DESC, r.round DESC, res.positionorder ASC, lt.lap ASC;

SELECT r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, d.driverid, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, con.name AS constructor_name, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position AS lap_position, lt.milliseconds AS lap_time_ms, ps.stop AS pit_stop_number, ps.lap AS pit_stop_lap, ps.milliseconds AS pit_stop_duration_ms, q.position AS qualifying_position, ds.points AS driver_standing_points, ds.wins AS driver_standing_wins, cs.points AS constructor_standing_points, cs.wins AS constructor_standing_wins, AVG(lt.milliseconds) OVER ( PARTITION BY r.raceid, d.driverid ORDER BY lt.lap ROWS BETWEEN 9 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_lap_time, SUM(res.points) OVER ( PARTITION BY r.year, d.driverid ORDER BY r.date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS cumulative_points_season FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND res.driverid = q.driverid AND res.constructorid = q.constructorid LEFT JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid LEFT JOIN constructorstandings cs ON r.raceid = cs.raceid AND res.constructorid = cs.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 2001 AND r.year <= 1957 AND res.points > '0' AND lt.milliseconds < 93206 AND (ps.milliseconds IS NULL OR ps.milliseconds > 39622) GROUP BY r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name, d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, con.name, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position, lt.milliseconds, ps.stop, ps.lap, ps.milliseconds, q.position, ds.points, ds.wins, cs.points, cs.wins, r.date HAVING COUNT(lt.lap) > 15 ORDER BY r.year DESC, r.round DESC, cumulative_points_season DESC;

SELECT r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, d.driverid, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, res.positionorder, res.points, AVG(res.points) OVER ( PARTITION BY r.year, d.driverid ORDER BY r.date ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_points_last_3_races FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 2007 AND r.date >= '2000-03-01' AND res.positionorder <= 2 GROUP BY r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name, d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, res.positionorder, res.points, r.date HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0.0' ORDER BY r.year, r.round, moving_avg_points_last_3_races DESC;

SELECT r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, d.driverid, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, res.positionorder, res.points, AVG(res.points) OVER ( PARTITION BY r.year, d.driverid ORDER BY r.date ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_points_last_3_races FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 2016 AND r.date >= '2000-03-01' AND res.positionorder <= 1 GROUP BY r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name, d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, res.positionorder, res.points, r.date HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0.0' ORDER BY r.year, r.round, moving_avg_points_last_3_races DESC;

SELECT r.year, c.country, con.name AS constructor_name, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) AS races_entered, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, SUM(ps.milliseconds) AS total_pitstop_time_ms, COUNT(ps.stop) AS total_pitstops, MAX(ds.wins) AS max_wins_in_season FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid WHERE r.year >= 2004 AND r.year <= 1994 AND res.points > '0' AND d.dob >= '1960-01-01' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (r.year, c.country, con.name, d.forename, d.surname), (r.year, c.country, con.name), (r.year, c.country), (r.year), () ) HAVING SUM(res.points) > '10' ORDER BY r.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT r.year, c.name AS circuit_name, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, con.name AS constructor_name, res.positionorder, res.points, CASE WHEN res.positionorder = 1 THEN 'Winner' WHEN res.positionorder BETWEEN 2 AND 3 THEN 'Podium' WHEN res.positionorder BETWEEN 4 AND 10 THEN 'Points' ELSE 'No Points' END AS finish_category, AVG(l.milliseconds) OVER (PARTITION BY r.raceid, d.driverid) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(p.stop) OVER (PARTITION BY r.raceid, d.driverid) AS total_pitstops FROM races r JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid LEFT JOIN laptimes l ON r.raceid = l.raceid AND res.driverid = l.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops p ON r.raceid = p.raceid AND res.driverid = p.driverid WHERE r.year >= 2023 AND r.year <= 2019 AND res.points > '0' GROUP BY r.year, c.name, d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, con.name, res.positionorder, res.points, r.raceid, l.milliseconds, p.stop ORDER BY r.year DESC, res.positionorder ASC;

SELECT r.year, c.name AS constructor_name, COUNT(DISTINCT res.raceid) AS races_entered, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(res.positionorder) AS avg_finish_position, MAX(ds.wins) AS max_wins_in_season FROM constructors c JOIN results res ON c.constructorid = res.constructorid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN driverstandings ds ON res.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid WHERE r.year >= 2017 AND res.points > '0' GROUP BY r.year, c.constructorid, c.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '100' AND AVG(res.positionorder) < 10 ORDER BY total_points DESC, r.year ASC;

SELECT r.year, c.name AS constructor_name, COUNT(DISTINCT res.raceid) AS races_entered, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(res.positionorder) AS avg_finish_position, MAX(ds.wins) AS max_wins_in_season FROM results res JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN driverstandings ds ON res.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid WHERE r.year >= 2019 AND res.points > '0.0' GROUP BY r.year, c.constructorid, c.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '50.0' AND AVG(res.positionorder) < 19 ORDER BY r.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT r.year, c.name AS constructor_name, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY SUM(res.points) DESC) AS yearly_rank FROM races r JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid WHERE r.year >= 2014 AND r.year <= 1968 GROUP BY r.year, c.constructorid, c.name, d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY r.year DESC, yearly_rank ASC;

SELECT r.year, c.name AS constructor_name, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, SUM(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY r.year, c.constructorid ORDER BY r.date) AS cumulative_points, AVG(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY r.year, c.constructorid) AS avg_points_per_race, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY SUM(res.points) DESC) AS yearly_rank FROM results res JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid WHERE r.year >= 1979 AND r.year <= 1960 GROUP BY r.year, r.date, c.constructorid, c.name, d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, res.points HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY r.year, cumulative_points DESC;

SELECT c.circuitid, c.name AS circuit_name, c.country, r.year, r.round, d.driverid, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, con.name AS constructor_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops, MAX(ds.wins) AS max_wins_in_season, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY SUM(res.points) DESC) AS yearly_points_rank FROM circuits c JOIN races r ON c.circuitid = r.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid LEFT JOIN constructorresults cr ON r.raceid = cr.raceid AND res.constructorid = cr.constructorid LEFT JOIN constructorstandings cs ON r.raceid = cs.raceid AND res.constructorid = cs.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 1975 AND r.date <= '1950-01-01' AND res.grid <= 9 AND (lt.milliseconds IS NULL OR lt.milliseconds > 102454) AND (ps.milliseconds IS NULL OR ps.milliseconds < 59725) GROUP BY c.circuitid, c.name, c.country, r.year, r.round, d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, con.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) >= 16 AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 139436 ORDER BY r.year DESC, r.round, total_points DESC, avg_lap_time_ms;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) AS races_entered, SUM(r.points) AS total_points, (SELECT AVG(lt.milliseconds) FROM laptimes lt WHERE lt.driverid = d.driverid AND lt.lap = 9) AS avg_lap_time_ms FROM drivers d JOIN results r ON d.driverid = r.driverid JOIN races rc ON r.raceid = rc.raceid WHERE rc.year >= 2006 AND rc.year <= 2004 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(r.points) > '0' ORDER BY total_points DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) AS races_entered, SUM(r.points) AS total_points, AVG(r.positionorder) AS avg_finish_position FROM drivers d JOIN results r ON d.driverid = r.driverid JOIN races rc ON r.raceid = rc.raceid WHERE rc.year IN (SELECT year FROM seasons WHERE year >= 2011 AND year <= 1961) AND r.positionorder <= 5 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(r.points) > '0' ORDER BY total_points DESC LIMIT 20;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON d.driverid = lt.driverid AND r.raceid = lt.raceid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON d.driverid = ps.driverid AND r.raceid = ps.raceid WHERE r.year >= 1985 AND r.year <= 2015 AND res.positionorder <= 20 AND lt.milliseconds > 76263 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name, r.year, r.round HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 106005 INTERSECT SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON d.driverid = lt.driverid AND r.raceid = lt.raceid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON d.driverid = ps.driverid AND r.raceid = ps.raceid JOIN qualifying q ON d.driverid = q.driverid AND r.raceid = q.raceid WHERE r.year >= 2000 AND r.year <= 1969 AND q.position <= 21 AND res.grid <= 17 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name, r.year, r.round HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT q.qualifyid) > 59 AND SUM(res.points) < '0' ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_lap_time_ms ASC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops, MAX(ds.wins) AS max_wins_in_season, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY SUM(res.points) DESC) AS yearly_rank FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND d.driverid = ps.driverid JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND d.driverid = ds.driverid JOIN seasons s ON r.year = s.year JOIN circuits ci ON r.circuitid = ci.circuitid JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND d.driverid = q.driverid AND c.constructorid = q.constructorid LEFT JOIN constructorresults cr ON r.raceid = cr.raceid AND c.constructorid = cr.constructorid LEFT JOIN constructorstandings cs ON r.raceid = cs.raceid AND c.constructorid = cs.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 1964 AND r.year <= 1990 AND res.points > '0' AND lt.milliseconds < 72856 AND ci.alt > 500 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name, r.year, r.round HAVING SUM(res.points) > '10' AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 117443 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) >= 2 ORDER BY r.year DESC, total_points DESC, avg_lap_time_ms ASC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, cir.name AS circuit_name, COUNT(DISTINCT res.raceid) AS races_entered, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(res.positionorder) AS avg_finish_position, MAX(ds.wins) AS max_wins_in_season, SUM(CASE WHEN res.positionorder = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wins, SUM(lt.milliseconds) / 1000.0 AS total_racing_seconds, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops, AVG(q.position) AS avg_qualifying_position FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits cir ON r.circuitid = cir.circuitid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN driverstandings ds ON d.driverid = ds.driverid AND r.raceid = ds.raceid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON d.driverid = lt.driverid AND r.raceid = lt.raceid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON d.driverid = ps.driverid AND r.raceid = ps.raceid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON d.driverid = q.driverid AND r.raceid = q.raceid WHERE r.year >= 1968 AND r.year <= 1975 AND cir.country = 'UK' AND res.points > '0' AND d.dob >= '1950-01-01' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name, r.year, r.round, cir.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '50' AND COUNT(DISTINCT res.raceid) >= 25 AND AVG(res.positionorder) <= 19 ORDER BY total_points DESC, wins DESC, avg_finish_position ASC LIMIT 55;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) AS races_entered, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) AS total_laps_raced, SUM(r.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, MAX(ds.wins) AS max_wins_in_season FROM drivers d JOIN results r ON d.driverid = r.driverid JOIN races rc ON r.raceid = rc.raceid JOIN constructors c ON r.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND r.driverid = lt.driverid JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND r.driverid = ds.driverid JOIN seasons s ON rc.year = s.year WHERE rc.year >= 1998 AND rc.date <= '1990-01-01' AND r.grid <= 2 AND lt.position <= 12 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name HAVING SUM(r.points) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) >= 52 ORDER BY total_points DESC, races_entered DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) AS races_entered, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(res.positionorder) AS avg_finish_position, MAX(ds.wins) AS max_wins_in_season FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN driverstandings ds ON d.driverid = ds.driverid AND r.raceid = ds.raceid WHERE r.year >= 2001 AND res.points > '0.0' AND d.dob <= '1970-01-01' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '10.0' ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_finish_position ASC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops, MAX(ds.wins) AS max_wins_in_season, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY SUM(res.points) DESC) AS yearly_rank FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON d.driverid = lt.driverid AND res.raceid = lt.raceid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON d.driverid = ps.driverid AND res.raceid = ps.raceid JOIN driverstandings ds ON d.driverid = ds.driverid AND res.raceid = ds.raceid WHERE r.year >= 1963 AND r.year <= 1987 AND res.grid <= 28 AND lt.milliseconds > 139250 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 175892 UNION ALL SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, SUM(cr.points) AS total_points, AVG(q.position) AS avg_qualifying_position, COUNT(DISTINCT cs.wins) AS total_constructor_wins, MAX(cs.position) AS best_constructor_standing, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY SUM(cr.points) DESC) AS yearly_rank FROM drivers d JOIN qualifying q ON d.driverid = q.driverid JOIN races r ON q.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON q.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN constructorresults cr ON c.constructorid = cr.constructorid AND r.raceid = cr.raceid JOIN constructorstandings cs ON c.constructorid = cs.constructorid AND r.raceid = cs.raceid JOIN circuits ci ON r.circuitid = ci.circuitid WHERE r.year >= 1970 AND r.year <= 1982 AND q.position <= 24 AND ci.alt > 1194 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round HAVING SUM(cr.points) > '0' AND AVG(q.position) < 20 ORDER BY yearly_rank, total_points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops, MAX(q.position) AS best_qualifying FROM drivers d INNER JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid INNER JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid INNER JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND d.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND d.driverid = q.driverid WHERE r.year >= 2002 AND r.year <= 2017 AND res.positionorder <= 2 AND (lt.milliseconds IS NULL OR lt.milliseconds > 97252) GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round, r.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) >= 5 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_lap_time_ms ASC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, res.positionorder, res.points, AVG(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid, r.year) AS avg_points_per_season, SUM(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid ORDER BY r.date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.raceid ORDER BY res.points DESC) AS race_points_rank, lt.total_laps, ps.total_pitstops, q.avg_qualifying_position FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN ( SELECT raceid, driverid, COUNT(DISTINCT lap) AS total_laps FROM laptimes GROUP BY raceid, driverid ) lt ON res.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN ( SELECT raceid, driverid, COUNT(stop) AS total_pitstops FROM pitstops GROUP BY raceid, driverid ) ps ON res.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN ( SELECT raceid, driverid, AVG(position) AS avg_qualifying_position FROM qualifying GROUP BY raceid, driverid ) q ON res.raceid = q.raceid AND res.driverid = q.driverid JOIN seasons s ON r.year = s.year JOIN circuits ci ON r.circuitid = ci.circuitid JOIN driverstandings ds ON res.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid JOIN constructorstandings cs ON res.raceid = cs.raceid AND res.constructorid = cs.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 1998 AND r.year <= 1969 AND res.points > '0' AND ci.alt > 42 AND ds.position <= 13 AND cs.position <= 9 AND d.dob >= '1950-01-01' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round, r.name, res.positionorder, res.points, r.date, r.raceid, lt.total_laps, ps.total_pitstops, q.avg_qualifying_position HAVING SUM(res.points) > '10' ORDER BY cumulative_points DESC, race_points_rank ASC LIMIT 306;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, res.positionorder, res.points, SUM(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid, r.year ORDER BY r.date) AS cumulative_points_year, AVG(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY c.constructorid, r.year) AS avg_constructor_points_per_race_year, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.raceid ORDER BY res.points DESC) AS race_points_rank FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN circuits ci ON r.circuitid = ci.circuitid JOIN seasons s ON r.year = s.year LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON res.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON res.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON res.raceid = q.raceid AND res.driverid = q.driverid AND res.constructorid = q.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 2014 AND r.year <= 2019 AND res.points > '0' AND ci.alt > 773 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, c.constructorid, r.year, r.round, r.name, r.date, r.raceid, res.positionorder, res.points HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) > 15 OR COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) IS NULL ORDER BY r.year, r.round, cumulative_points_year DESC;

constructor_position, lt.lap, lt.position AS lap_position, ps.stop AS pit_stop_number, ps.lap AS pit_stop_lap, q.position AS qualifying_position, t.win, AVG(rs.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid, r.year) AS avg_points_per_season, SUM(rs.points) OVER (PARTITION BY c.constructorid, r.year ORDER BY r.date) AS cumulative_constructor_points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.raceid ORDER BY rs.points JOIN laptimes lt ON d.driverid = lt.driverid AND r.raceid = lt.raceid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON d.driverid = ps.driverid AND r.raceid = ps.raceid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON d.driverid = q.driverid AND r.raceid = q.raceid LEFT JOIN target t ON d.driverid = t.driverid AND r.raceid = t.raceid WHERE r.year >= 1958 AND r.year <= 2021 AND rs.points > '0' AND ds.position <= 20 AND cs.position <= 5 AND ci.alt > 714 AND (SELECT AVG(points) FROM results rs2 WHERE rs2.constructorid = c.constructorid AND rs2.raceid IN (SELECT raceid FROM races WHERE year = r.year)) > '0' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename,
