AND COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) >= 84 ORDER BY cumulative_constructor_points DESC, avg_points_per_season DESC LIMIT 170;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, COUNT(*) AS races_entered FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid WHERE r.year = 1961 AND res.positionorder <= 3 AND d.driverid IN ( SELECT driverid FROM results WHERE points > '0' GROUP BY driverid HAVING COUNT(*) >= 25 ) GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY total_points DESC, races_entered DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND d.driverid = ps.driverid WHERE r.year = 1995 AND res.grid <= 3 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_lap_time_ms ASC LIMIT 50;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, res.positionorder, res.points, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM laptimes lt WHERE lt.raceid = r.raceid AND lt.driverid = d.driverid AND lt.position = 1) AS laps_led FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid WHERE r.year = 1991 AND res.points > '0' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name, res.positionorder, res.points, r.raceid HAVING SUM(res.points) > '10' ORDER BY SUM(res.points) DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, res.positionorder, res.points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY SUM(res.points) DESC) AS yearly_rank FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid WHERE r.year >= 1981 AND r.year <= 2017 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name, res.positionorder, res.points HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY r.year, yearly_rank, r.round;

SELECT d1.driverid AS driver1_id, d1.forename AS driver1_forename, d1.surname AS driver1_surname, d2.driverid AS driver2_id, d2.forename AS driver2_forename, d2.surname AS driver2_surname, r.year, r.name AS race_name, AVG(lt1.milliseconds - lt2.milliseconds) AS avg_time_diff_ms FROM laptimes lt1 JOIN laptimes lt2 ON lt1.raceid = lt2.raceid AND lt1.lap = lt2.lap JOIN drivers d1 ON lt1.driverid = d1.driverid JOIN drivers d2 ON lt2.driverid = d2.driverid JOIN races r ON lt1.raceid = r.raceid WHERE lt1.driverid < lt2.driverid AND lt1.milliseconds IS NOT NULL AND lt2.milliseconds IS NOT NULL AND r.year >= 2021 AND lt1.lap <= 70 GROUP BY d1.driverid, d1.forename, d1.surname, d2.driverid, d2.forename, d2.surname, r.year, r.name HAVING COUNT(*) > 41 ORDER BY avg_time_diff_ms DESC;

SELECT ds.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, SUM(ds.points) AS total_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ds.raceid) AS races_count FROM driverstandings ds JOIN drivers d ON ds.driverid = d.driverid JOIN races r ON ds.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid WHERE r.year >= 2018 AND c.alt >= 462 GROUP BY ds.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(ds.points) > '10' INTERSECT SELECT ds.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, SUM(ds.points) AS total_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ds.raceid) AS races_count FROM driverstandings ds JOIN drivers d ON ds.driverid = d.driverid JOIN races r ON ds.raceid = r.raceid JOIN results res ON ds.raceid = res.raceid AND ds.driverid = res.driverid WHERE res.grid <= 10 AND res.positionorder <= 2 GROUP BY ds.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ds.raceid) >= 50 ORDER BY total_points DESC;
SELECT r.raceid, COUNT(l.driverid) AS total_laps FROM races r JOIN laptimes l ON r.raceid = l.raceid WHERE r.year = 1996 AND l.milliseconds < 102699 GROUP BY r.raceid ORDER BY total_laps DESC;

SELECT r.raceid, r.name AS race_name, r.date, c.name AS circuit_name, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, res.positionorder, res.points, cs.points AS constructor_points FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid JOIN constructorstandings cs ON r.raceid = cs.raceid AND con.constructorid = cs.constructorid WHERE r.year = 2016 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM laptimes lt WHERE lt.raceid = r.raceid AND lt.driverid = d.driverid AND lt.milliseconds < 111633 ) AND res.points > '0' ORDER BY r.date, res.positionorder;

SELECT r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, d.driverid, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, lt.lap, lt.position AS lap_position, lt.milliseconds, AVG(lt.milliseconds) OVER ( PARTITION BY lt.raceid, lt.driverid ORDER BY lt.lap ROWS BETWEEN 7 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_milliseconds FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid JOIN drivers d ON lt.driverid = d.driverid WHERE r.year = 2009 AND r.round = 2 ORDER BY r.raceid, d.driverid, lt.lap;

SELECT r.year, c.country, con.nationality, COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) AS race_count, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid WHERE r.year >= 1986 AND r.year <= 1957 AND res.points > '0' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (r.year, c.country, con.nationality), (r.year, c.country), (r.year, con.nationality), (r.year), () ) ORDER BY r.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT r.year, c.country, d.nationality, COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) AS race_count, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid WHERE r.year >= 2009 AND r.year <= 2021 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (r.year, c.country, d.nationality), (r.year, c.country), (r.year), () ) ORDER BY r.year, c.country, d.nationality;

SELECT r.year, c.name AS circuit_name, con.name AS constructor_name, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.driverid) AS distinct_drivers, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) AS distinct_laps_led, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid AND lt.driverid = res.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 2003 AND lt.milliseconds <= 100110 GROUP BY r.year, c.name, con.name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lt.driverid) > 1 ORDER BY r.year DESC, distinct_drivers DESC;

SELECT r.year, c.name AS constructor_name, COUNT(DISTINCT res.driverid) AS unique_drivers, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(res.positionorder) AS avg_finish FROM results res JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid WHERE r.year = 1964 AND res.points > '0' GROUP BY r.year, c.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '10' ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT r.year, c.name AS constructor_name, COUNT(DISTINCT res.driverid) AS unique_drivers, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(res.positionorder) AS avg_finish FROM results res JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 2020 AND res.points > '0' GROUP BY r.year, c.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '10' ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT r.year, c.name AS constructor_name, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY SUM(res.points) DESC) AS yearly_rank FROM races r JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid WHERE r.year >= 1950 AND r.year <= 2003 GROUP BY r.year, c.constructorid, c.name, d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY r.year DESC, yearly_rank ASC;

SELECT r.year, r.name AS race_name, c.name AS circuit_name, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, con.name AS constructor_name, res.positionorder, res.points, AVG(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY r.year, con.constructorid) AS avg_constructor_points_per_year, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY res.points DESC) AS yearly_points_rank FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 2018 AND r.year <= 2016 AND res.positionorder <= 1 GROUP BY r.year, r.name, c.name, d.driverid, con.constructorid, res.positionorder, res.points HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY r.year DESC, yearly_points_rank ASC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) AS races_entered, SUM(r.points) AS total_points, (SELECT AVG(lt.milliseconds) FROM laptimes lt WHERE lt.driverid = d.driverid AND lt.raceid IN (SELECT raceid FROM races WHERE year = 2005)) AS avg_lap_time_ms FROM drivers d JOIN results r ON d.driverid = r.driverid JOIN races rc ON r.raceid = rc.raceid JOIN circuits c ON rc.circuitid = c.circuitid WHERE rc.year >= 2009 AND rc.year <= 2014 AND c.country = 'UK' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(r.points) > '10' ORDER BY total_points DESC LIMIT 20;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) AS races_entered, SUM(r.points) AS total_points, AVG(r.positionorder) AS avg_finish_position FROM drivers d JOIN results r ON d.driverid = r.driverid JOIN races rc ON r.raceid = rc.raceid WHERE rc.year IN (SELECT year FROM seasons WHERE year >= 2018 AND year <= 1976) AND r.positionorder <= 11 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(r.points) > '0' ORDER BY total_points DESC LIMIT 20;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) AS races_entered, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(res.positionorder) AS avg_finish_position, MAX(ds.wins) AS max_wins_in_season FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN driverstandings ds ON d.driverid = ds.driverid AND r.raceid = ds.raceid JOIN seasons s ON r.year = s.year WHERE r.year >= 1993 AND r.year <= 1991 AND res.points > '0' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(res.points) > '50' AND COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) >= 94 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_finish_position ASC LIMIT 50;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) AS races_participated, SUM(res.points) AS total_points FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM laptimes lt WHERE lt.driverid = d.driverid AND lt.raceid = r.raceid AND lt.milliseconds < 87854 ) AND r.year >= 2010 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(res.points) > '50' ORDER BY total_points DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(r.resultid) AS race_count, COALESCE(SUM(r.points), 0) AS total_points FROM drivers d LEFT JOIN results r ON d.driverid = r.driverid LEFT JOIN races rc ON r.raceid = rc.raceid WHERE rc.year >= 2019 OR rc.year IS NULL GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING COALESCE(SUM(r.points), 0) > '0' ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(r.resultid) AS race_count, SUM(r.points) AS total_points, AVG(r.positionorder) AS avg_finish FROM drivers d JOIN results r ON d.driverid = r.driverid JOIN races rc ON r.raceid = rc.raceid WHERE rc.year >= 2018 AND r.points > '0' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING COUNT(r.resultid) >= 39 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(r.resultid) AS total_races, SUM(r.points) AS total_points, AVG(r.positionorder) AS avg_finish_position FROM drivers d JOIN results r ON d.driverid = r.driverid JOIN races rc ON r.raceid = rc.raceid WHERE rc.year >= 2019 AND rc.year <= 1993 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(r.points) > '0' ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, SUM(r.points) AS total_points, COUNT(r.resultid) AS races_finished FROM drivers d JOIN results r ON d.driverid = r.driverid WHERE r.positionorder <= 2 AND r.points > '0.0' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING COUNT(r.resultid) >= 39 UNION ALL SELECT c.constructorid, c.name AS constructor_name, NULL AS surname, SUM(cs.points) AS total_points, COUNT(cs.constructorstandingsid) AS standings_count FROM constructors c JOIN constructorstandings cs ON c.constructorid = cs.constructorid WHERE cs.position <= 10 AND cs.points > '0.0' GROUP BY c.constructorid, c.name HAVING COUNT(cs.constructorstandingsid) >= 26 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name AS constructor_name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name AS circuit_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops, MAX(q.position) AS best_qualifying, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY SUM(res.points) DESC) AS yearly_rank FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits cir ON r.circuitid = cir.circuitid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND d.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND d.driverid = q.driverid WHERE r.year >= 2015 AND r.date <= '1950-01-01' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM driverstandings ds WHERE ds.driverid = d.driverid AND ds.raceid = r.raceid AND ds.position <= 11 ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM constructorstandings cs WHERE cs.constructorid = c.constructorid AND cs.raceid = r.raceid AND cs.wins >= 14 ) GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) >= 88 ORDER BY total_points DESC, yearly_rank LIMIT 97;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name AS constructor_name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name AS circuit_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(res.positionorder) AS avg_finish_position, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) AS total_laps_raced, SUM(ps.milliseconds) / 1000.0 AS total_pitstop_time_seconds, MAX(ds.wins) AS max_wins_in_season, AVG(q.position) AS avg_qualifying_position FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits cir ON r.circuitid = cir.circuitid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON res.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON res.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid JOIN driverstandings ds ON res.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid JOIN qualifying q ON res.raceid = q.raceid AND res.driverid = q.driverid AND res.constructorid = q.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 1966 AND r.year <= 1962 AND res.positionorder <= 11 AND cir.alt >= 749 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND AVG(res.positionorder) < 3 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_finish_position ASC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) AS races_entered, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(res.positionorder) AS avg_finish_position, MAX(ds.wins) AS max_wins_in_season FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN driverstandings ds ON d.driverid = ds.driverid AND r.raceid = ds.raceid WHERE r.year >= 2000 AND res.points > '0.0' AND d.dob <= '1970-01-01' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '10.0' ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_finish_position ASC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON d.driverid = lt.driverid AND res.raceid = lt.raceid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON d.driverid = ps.driverid AND res.raceid = ps.raceid WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM constructorstandings cs WHERE cs.constructorid = c.constructorid AND cs.raceid = r.raceid AND cs.points > 29.92 ) AND r.date >= '2000-01-01' AND r.date <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round, r.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > 54.12 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_lap_time_ms ASC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops, CASE WHEN SUM(res.points) >= 380.54 THEN 'High Scorer' WHEN SUM(res.points) >= 139.71 THEN 'Medium Scorer' ELSE 'Low Scorer' END AS performance_category, CASE WHEN AVG(lt.milliseconds) <= 82852 THEN 'Fast Lap' WHEN AVG(lt.milliseconds) <= 93726 THEN 'Average Lap' ELSE 'Slow Lap' END AS lap_time_category, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY SUM(res.points) DESC) AS yearly_rank FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON d.driverid = lt.driverid AND res.raceid = lt.raceid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON d.driverid = ps.driverid AND res.raceid = ps.raceid JOIN qualifying q ON d.driverid = q.driverid AND res.raceid = q.raceid JOIN driverstandings ds ON d.driverid = ds.driverid AND res.raceid = ds.raceid WHERE r.year >= 2018 AND r.year <= 2016 AND res.grid <= 5 AND lt.lap >= 3 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round, r.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > 94.68 AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 138283 ORDER BY r.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops, MAX(ds.wins) AS max_wins_in_season, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY SUM(res.points) DESC) AS yearly_rank FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON d.driverid = lt.driverid AND r.raceid = lt.raceid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON d.driverid = ps.driverid AND r.raceid = ps.raceid JOIN driverstandings ds ON d.driverid = ds.driverid AND r.raceid = ds.raceid WHERE r.year IN ( SELECT year FROM seasons WHERE year > 2020 ) AND r.date >= ( SELECT MIN(date) FROM races WHERE circuitid IN ( SELECT circuitid FROM circuits WHERE alt > 18 ) ) AND res.positionorder <= ( SELECT AVG(positionorder) FROM results WHERE raceid IN ( SELECT raceid FROM races WHERE year = r.year ) AND points > '0.0' ) GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round, r.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '10.0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) > 59 ORDER BY total_points DESC, yearly_rank LIMIT 290;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops, MAX(q.position) AS best_qualifying, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM target t WHERE t.driverid = d.driverid AND t.raceid = r.raceid AND t.win = 1) AS target_wins FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND d.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND d.driverid = q.driverid WHERE r.year >= 1965 AND r.date <= '1950-01-01' AND res.points > '0' AND lt.milliseconds < 103606 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round, r.name, r.raceid HAVING SUM(res.points) > '10' AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 81859 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_lap_time_ms ASC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position AS lap_position, ps.stop AS pit_stop_number, ps.duration AS pit_stop_duration, q.position AS qualifying_position, ds.position AS driver_standing_position, cs.position AS constructor_standing_position, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM laptimes lt2 WHERE lt2.raceid = r.raceid AND lt2.driverid = d.driverid AND lt2.milliseconds < 91112) AS laps_faster_than_threshold, (SELECT AVG(points) FROM results res2 WHERE res2.raceid = r.raceid AND res2.driverid = d.driverid AND res2.points > '0.0') AS avg_points_above_threshold FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits cct ON r.circuitid = cct.circuitid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND d.driverid = ps.driverid JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND d.driverid = q.driverid JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND d.driverid = ds.driverid JOIN constructorstandings cs ON r.raceid = cs.raceid AND c.constructorid = cs.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 2017 AND r.year <= 2009 AND cct.country = 'UK' AND res.positionorder <= 6 AND lt.lap BETWEEN 10 AND 62 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round, r.name, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position, ps.stop, ps.duration, q.position, ds.position, cs.position, r.raceid HAVING SUM(res.points) > '5.0' AND AVG(lt.position) < 2 ORDER BY r.year DESC, r.round DESC, SUM(res.points) DESC, AVG(lt.position) ASC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.raceid, r.name AS race_name, r.date, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(r.date, d.dob)) AS age_at_race, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position AS lap_position, ps.stop AS pit_stop_number, ps.duration AS pit_stop_duration FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND d.driverid = ps.driverid WHERE r.date >= '2000-01-01' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM r.date) = 2020 AND res.points > '0' AND lt.lap = 18 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.raceid, r.name, r.date, d.dob, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position, ps.stop, ps.duration HAVING COUNT(ps.stop) >= 2 ORDER BY r.date DESC, res.positionorder ASC LIMIT 100;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.raceid, r.name AS race_name, r.date, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(r.date, d.dob)) AS age_at_race, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position AS lap_position, ps.stop AS pit_stop_number, ps.duration FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND d.driverid = ps.driverid WHERE r.date >= '2000-01-01' AND r.date <= '2000-01-01' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(r.date, d.dob)) >= 42 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.raceid, r.name, r.date, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position, ps.stop, ps.duration HAVING AVG(res.points) > 6.18 ORDER BY r.date DESC, d.surname, d.forename;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.raceid, r.name AS race_name, r.date, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(r.date, d.dob)) AS driver_age_at_race, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) AS laps_analyzed FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid WHERE r.date >= '2000-01-01'::date AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM r.date) = 2011 AND d.dob <= r.date - INTERVAL '24 years' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.raceid, r.name, r.date HAVING AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 143315.41 ORDER BY avg_lap_time_ms ASC LIMIT 100;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops FROM drivers d INNER JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid INNER JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid INNER JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND d.driverid = ps.driverid WHERE r.year = 1983 AND res.grid <= 17 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_lap_time_ms ASC LIMIT 100;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, res.positionorder, res.points, AVG(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY r.year, d.driverid) AS avg_points_per_season, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY SUM(res.points) DESC) AS season_rank FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 1974 AND r.year <= 2007 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name, res.positionorder, res.points HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY r.year, season_rank, d.surname;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, res.positionorder, res.points, SUM(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid, r.year ORDER BY r.date) AS cumulative_points, AVG(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid, r.year) AS avg_points_per_race, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid, r.year) AS races_entered FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid WHERE r.year = 1984 AND res.positionorder <= 14 AND res.points > '0.0' AND d.dob >= '1950-01-01' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name, res.positionorder, res.points, r.date HAVING SUM(res.points) > '1.0' ORDER BY cumulative_points DESC, r.round ASC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, c.name AS circuit_name, res.positionorder, res.points, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM laptimes lt WHERE lt.raceid = r.raceid AND lt.driverid = d.driverid AND lt.position = 1) AS laps_led FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid WHERE r.year = 2018 AND res.points > '0' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, r.name, c.name, res.positionorder, res.points, r.raceid HAVING SUM(res.points) > '10' ORDER BY SUM(res.points) DESC, laps_led DESC;

SELECT r.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(r.resultid) AS race_count, SUM(r.points) AS total_points FROM results r JOIN drivers d ON r.driverid = d.driverid JOIN races rc ON r.raceid = rc.raceid WHERE rc.year = 1997 AND r.positionorder <= 8 GROUP BY r.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(r.points) > '0' INTERSECT SELECT r.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(r.resultid) AS race_count, SUM(r.points) AS total_points FROM results r JOIN drivers d ON r.driverid = d.driverid JOIN races rc ON r.raceid = rc.raceid WHERE rc.year = 2012 AND r.positionorder <= 4 GROUP BY r.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(r.points) > '0' ORDER BY total_points DESC;
SELECT r.raceid, COUNT(l.driverid) AS lap_count FROM races r JOIN laptimes l ON r.raceid = l.raceid WHERE r.year = 1995 AND l.lap > 2 GROUP BY r.raceid ORDER BY lap_count DESC;

SELECT r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, c.country AS circuit_country, d.driverid, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, con.name AS constructor_name, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points, res.laps, res.milliseconds AS result_ms, lt.lap, lt.position AS lap_position, lt.milliseconds AS lap_ms, ps.stop, ps.lap AS pit_lap, ps.milliseconds AS pit_ms, q.position AS qualifying_position, ds.points AS driver_standing_points, ds.wins AS driver_standing_wins, cs.points AS constructor_standing_points, cs.wins AS constructor_standing_wins, AVG(lt.milliseconds) OVER ( PARTITION BY r.raceid, d.driverid ORDER BY lt.lap ROWS BETWEEN 4 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_lap_ms, SUM(res.points) OVER ( PARTITION BY r.year, d.driverid ORDER BY r.date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS cumulative_points_season FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND res.driverid = q.driverid AND res.constructorid = q.constructorid LEFT JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid LEFT JOIN constructorstandings cs ON r.raceid = cs.raceid AND res.constructorid = cs.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 1995 AND r.year <= 1988 AND res.points > '0' AND (lt.milliseconds IS NULL OR lt.milliseconds < 111566) AND (ps.milliseconds IS NULL OR ps.milliseconds > 41298) AND (q.position IS NULL OR q.position <= 18) AND (ds.position IS NULL OR ds.position < 18) AND (cs.position IS NULL OR cs.position < 8) GROUP BY r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name, c.country, d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, con.name, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points, res.laps, res.milliseconds, lt.lap, lt.position, lt.milliseconds, ps.stop, ps.lap, ps.milliseconds, q.position, ds.points, ds.wins, cs.points, cs.wins HAVING COUNT(lt.lap) > 10 AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 89871 ORDER BY r.year DESC, r.round DESC, cumulative_points_season DESC;

SELECT r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, d.driverid, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, con.name AS constructor_name, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position AS lap_position, lt.milliseconds AS lap_time_ms, ps.stop AS pit_stop_number, ps.lap AS pit_stop_lap, ps.milliseconds AS pit_stop_duration_ms, q.position AS qualifying_position, ds.points AS driver_standing_points, ds.wins AS driver_standing_wins, cs.points AS constructor_standing_points, cs.wins AS constructor_standing_wins, cr.points AS constructor_result_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) OVER ( PARTITION BY r.raceid, d.driverid ORDER BY lt.lap ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_lap_time_ms, SUM(res.points) OVER ( PARTITION BY r.year, d.driverid ORDER BY r.date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS cumulative_driver_points_season, RANK() OVER ( PARTITION BY r.raceid ORDER BY res.positionorder ) AS race_finish_rank FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND res.driverid = q.driverid AND res.constructorid = q.constructorid LEFT JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid LEFT JOIN constructorstandings cs ON r.raceid = cs.raceid AND res.constructorid = cs.constructorid LEFT JOIN constructorresults cr ON r.raceid = cr.raceid AND res.constructorid = cr.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 1992 AND r.year <= 1989 AND res.positionorder IS NOT NULL AND res.positionorder <= 8 AND lt.milliseconds > 75145 AND (ps.milliseconds IS NULL OR ps.milliseconds < 24190) GROUP BY r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name, d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, con.name, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position, lt.milliseconds, ps.stop, ps.lap, ps.milliseconds, q.position, ds.points, ds.wins, cs.points, cs.wins, cr.points, r.date HAVING AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 102258 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) >= 10 ORDER BY r.year DESC, r.round DESC, cumulative_driver_points_season DESC;

SELECT r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, d.driverid, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, res.positionorder, res.points, AVG(res.points) OVER ( PARTITION BY r.year, d.driverid ORDER BY r.date ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_points_last_3_races FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 2009 AND r.date >= '2000-03-01' AND res.positionorder <= 1 GROUP BY r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name, d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, res.positionorder, res.points, r.date HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0.0' ORDER BY r.year, r.round, moving_avg_points_last_3_races DESC;

SELECT r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, con.name AS constructor_name, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points, ds.wins AS driver_wins, cs.wins AS constructor_wins, AVG(lt.milliseconds) OVER (PARTITION BY r.raceid, d.driverid) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(p.stop) OVER (PARTITION BY r.raceid, d.driverid) AS pitstop_count FROM races r INNER JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid INNER JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid INNER JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid INNER JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid LEFT JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND d.driverid = ds.driverid LEFT JOIN constructorstandings cs ON r.raceid = cs.raceid AND con.constructorid = cs.constructorid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops p ON r.raceid = p.raceid AND d.driverid = p.driverid WHERE r.year >= 2013 AND r.year <= 2018 AND res.points > '0' GROUP BY r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name, d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, con.constructorid, con.name, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points, ds.wins, cs.wins, p.stop, lt.milliseconds HAVING COUNT(p.stop) < 6 ORDER BY r.year DESC, r.round DESC, res.points DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT r.year, c.country, con.name AS constructor_name, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) AS races_entered, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, SUM(ps.milliseconds) AS total_pitstop_time_ms, COUNT(ps.stop) AS total_pitstops, MAX(ds.wins) AS max_wins_in_season FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid WHERE r.year >= 2023 AND r.year <= 2002 AND res.points > '0' AND d.dob >= '1960-01-01' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (r.year, c.country, con.name, d.forename, d.surname), (r.year, c.country, con.name), (r.year, c.country), (r.year), () ) HAVING SUM(res.points) > '10' ORDER BY r.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT r.year, c.country, con.nationality, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, COUNT(DISTINCT res.driverid) AS unique_drivers, AVG(res.positionorder) AS avg_finish FROM races r JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 1986 AND r.year <= 1994 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (r.year, c.country, con.nationality), (r.year, c.country), (r.year, con.nationality), (c.country, con.nationality), (r.year), (c.country), (con.nationality), () ) HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY r.year, c.country, con.nationality;

SELECT r.year, c.name AS circuit_name, con.name AS constructor_name, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid WHERE r.year >= 1969 AND r.year <= 1983 AND res.positionorder <= 20 GROUP BY r.year, c.circuitid, con.constructorid, d.driverid HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_lap_time_ms ASC LIMIT 100;

SELECT r.year, c.name AS constructor_name, COUNT(DISTINCT res.driverid) AS unique_drivers, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(res.positionorder) AS avg_finish FROM results res JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN driverstandings ds ON res.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid WHERE r.year >= 2019 AND res.points > '0' GROUP BY r.year, c.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '10' ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) AS races_entered, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(res.positionorder) AS avg_finish_position FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid WHERE r.year >= 2023 AND c.country = 'Monaco' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(res.points) > '50' ORDER BY total_points DESC LIMIT 20;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) AS races_participated, SUM(r.points) AS total_points FROM drivers d JOIN results r ON d.driverid = r.driverid WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM races rc WHERE rc.raceid = r.raceid AND rc.year >= 2002 AND rc.year <= 2019 ) GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(r.points) > '0' ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name AS constructor_name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name AS circuit_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops, MAX(ds.wins) AS max_wins_in_season, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY SUM(res.points) DESC) AS yearly_rank FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits cir ON r.circuitid = cir.circuitid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND d.driverid = ps.driverid JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND d.driverid = ds.driverid WHERE r.year IN (SELECT year FROM seasons WHERE year >= 1988 AND year <= 1985) AND cir.lat BETWEEN '-90.0' AND '-90.0' AND res.grid <= 13 AND res.positionorder IS NOT NULL AND lt.milliseconds > 329332 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0.0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) >= 6 ORDER BY total_points DESC, yearly_rank, r.year, r.round LIMIT 831;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name AS constructor_name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name AS circuit_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops, MAX(q.position) AS best_qualifying, SUM(CASE WHEN res.positionorder = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wins, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(res.points) DESC) AS driver_rank FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits cir ON r.circuitid = cir.circuitid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND d.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND d.driverid = q.driverid JOIN seasons s ON r.year = s.year JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND d.driverid = ds.driverid JOIN constructorstandings cs ON r.raceid = cs.raceid AND c.constructorid = cs.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 1951 AND r.year <= 2022 AND cir.country = 'UK' AND res.grid <= 11 AND res.laps >= 43 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 167433 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) >= 3 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_lap_time_ms ASC LIMIT 97;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) AS total_laps, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, MAX(ds.wins) AS max_wins_in_season, COUNT(ps.stop) AS total_pitstops, AVG(ps.milliseconds) AS avg_pitstop_ms, MIN(q.position) AS best_qualifying, SUM(cr.points) AS constructor_points, AVG(cs.position) AS avg_constructor_position FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON d.driverid = lt.driverid AND res.raceid = lt.raceid JOIN pitstops ps ON d.driverid = ps.driverid AND res.raceid = ps.raceid JOIN qualifying q ON d.driverid = q.driverid AND res.raceid = q.raceid JOIN constructorresults cr ON res.raceid = cr.raceid AND res.constructorid = cr.constructorid JOIN constructorstandings cs ON res.raceid = cs.raceid AND res.constructorid = cs.constructorid JOIN driverstandings ds ON res.raceid = ds.raceid AND d.driverid = ds.driverid WHERE r.year >= 1991 AND r.date <= '1950-01-01' AND res.points > '0' AND lt.milliseconds < 78419 AND ps.milliseconds > 41730 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round, r.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '10' AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 78643 AND COUNT(ps.stop) >= 6 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_lap_time_ms ASC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON res.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON res.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid WHERE r.year = 2018 AND res.grid <= 20 AND res.positionorder IS NOT NULL AND res.positionorder <= 14 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round, r.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 176424 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_lap_time_ms ASC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops, MAX(ds.wins) AS max_wins_in_season, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY SUM(res.points) DESC) AS yearly_rank FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON d.driverid = lt.driverid AND res.raceid = lt.raceid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON d.driverid = ps.driverid AND res.raceid = ps.raceid JOIN driverstandings ds ON d.driverid = ds.driverid AND res.raceid = ds.raceid JOIN seasons s ON r.year = s.year WHERE r.year >= 2006 AND r.year <= 2003 AND res.grid <= 19 AND lt.milliseconds > 110497 AND ds.position <= 4 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round, r.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 82630 ORDER BY r.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops, MAX(ds.wins) AS max_wins_in_season, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY SUM(res.points) DESC) AS yearly_rank FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON d.driverid = lt.driverid AND res.raceid = lt.raceid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON d.driverid = ps.driverid AND res.raceid = ps.raceid JOIN driverstandings ds ON d.driverid = ds.driverid AND res.raceid = ds.raceid WHERE r.year IN ( SELECT year FROM seasons WHERE year >= 1982 AND year <= 1980 ) AND res.positionorder <= ( SELECT AVG(positionorder) FROM results WHERE raceid IN ( SELECT raceid FROM races WHERE year = r.year ) ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM qualifying q WHERE q.driverid = d.driverid AND q.raceid = r.raceid AND q.position < 7 ) GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round, r.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) >= 36 ORDER BY r.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points, AVG(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY r.year, c.constructorid) AS avg_constructor_points_per_year, SUM(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY r.year, d.driverid ORDER BY r.date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_driver_points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year, r.raceid ORDER BY res.positionorder) AS race_finish_rank FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN circuits ci ON r.circuitid = ci.circuitid JOIN laptimes lt ON res.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid JOIN qualifying q ON res.raceid = q.raceid AND res.driverid = q.driverid AND res.constructorid = q.constructorid JOIN driverstandings ds ON res.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid WHERE r.year >= 2013 AND r.year <= 2022 AND res.points > '0' AND lt.milliseconds < 80026 AND ci.alt > 537 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round, r.name, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points, r.date, r.raceid, c.constructorid HAVING AVG(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY r.year, r.round, cumulative_driver_points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position AS lap_position, ps.stop AS pit_stop_number, ps.lap AS pit_stop_lap, ds.position AS championship_position, ds.wins AS season_wins FROM drivers d INNER JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid INNER JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid INNER JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON res.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON res.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN driverstandings ds ON res.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid WHERE r.year = 2004 AND res.points >= '0' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round, r.name, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position, ps.stop, ps.lap, ds.position, ds.wins HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) > 1 ORDER BY res.points DESC, ds.position ASC LIMIT 100;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, res.points, res.positionorder, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM laptimes lt WHERE lt.raceid = r.raceid AND lt.driverid = d.driverid AND lt.position = 1) AS laps_led, (SELECT AVG(ps.milliseconds) FROM pitstops ps WHERE ps.raceid = r.raceid AND ps.driverid = d.driverid) AS avg_pitstop_ms, SUM(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY r.year, c.constructorid ORDER BY r.date) AS cumulative_points FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN circuits ci ON r.circuitid = ci.circuitid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND d.driverid = ps.driverid WHERE r.year >= 2021 AND r.year <= 2018 AND res.points > '0' AND ci.alt > 406 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, c.constructorid, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, r.name, r.date, res.points, res.positionorder HAVING AVG(lt.position) < 14 OR AVG(lt.position) IS NULL ORDER BY r.year, r.round, cumulative_points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position AS lap_position, ps.stop, ps.duration, q.position AS qualifying_position, ds.position AS driver_standing_position, cs.position AS constructor_standing_position, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM laptimes lt2 WHERE lt2.raceid = r.raceid AND lt2.driverid = d.driverid AND lt2.milliseconds < 80305) AS laps_faster_than_threshold, (SELECT AVG(points) FROM results res2 WHERE res2.raceid IN (SELECT raceid FROM races WHERE year = r.year) AND res2.driverid = d.driverid) AS avg_points_per_season, (SELECT SUM(wins) FROM driverstandings ds2 WHERE ds2.raceid = r.raceid AND ds2.driverid = d.driverid) AS total_wins_up_to_race FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits cct ON r.circuitid = cct.circuitid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND d.driverid = ps.driverid JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND d.driverid = q.driverid JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND d.driverid = ds.driverid JOIN constructorstandings cs ON r.raceid = cs.raceid AND c.constructorid = cs.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 2012 AND r.year <= 2010 AND cct.country = 'UK' AND res.points > '0' AND lt.milliseconds IS NOT NULL AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM results res3 WHERE res3.raceid = r.raceid AND res3.positionorder <= 10) > 19 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round, r.name, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position, ps.stop, ps.duration, q.position, ds.position, cs.position, r.raceid HAVING SUM(res.points) > '50' AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 164746 ORDER BY total_wins_up_to_race DESC, avg_points_per_season DESC LIMIT 721;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.raceid, r.name AS race_name, r.date, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position AS lap_position, ps.stop AS pit_stop_number, ps.duration AS pit_stop_duration FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND d.driverid = ps.driverid WHERE r.date BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2000-01-01' AND res.positionorder <= 2 AND lt.lap >= 19 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.raceid, r.name, r.date, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position, ps.stop, ps.duration HAVING AVG(lt.position) < 3.41 ORDER BY r.date DESC, res.positionorder ASC LIMIT 196;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, res.positionorder, res.points, AVG(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY r.year, d.driverid) AS avg_points_per_season, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY SUM(res.points) DESC) AS season_rank FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid WHERE r.year >= 2017 AND r.year <= 1998 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name, res.positionorder, res.points HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY r.year DESC, season_rank, d.surname;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, res.points, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM laptimes lt WHERE lt.raceid = res.raceid AND lt.driverid = res.driverid AND lt.position = 1) AS laps_led FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid WHERE r.year = 2023 AND res.points > '0' ORDER BY res.points DESC;

SELECT d1.driverid AS driver1_id, d1.forename AS driver1_forename, d1.surname AS driver1_surname, d2.driverid AS driver2_id, d2.forename AS driver2_forename, d2.surname AS driver2_surname, r.year, r.name AS race_name, AVG(lt1.milliseconds - lt2.milliseconds) AS avg_time_diff_ms FROM laptimes lt1 JOIN laptimes lt2 ON lt1.raceid = lt2.raceid AND lt1.lap = lt2.lap JOIN drivers d1 ON lt1.driverid = d1.driverid JOIN drivers d2 ON lt2.driverid = d2.driverid JOIN races r ON lt1.raceid = r.raceid WHERE lt1.driverid < lt2.driverid AND r.year = 2011 AND lt1.lap BETWEEN 6 AND 22 GROUP BY d1.driverid, d1.forename, d1.surname, d2.driverid, d2.forename, d2.surname, r.year, r.name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10 ORDER BY avg_time_diff_ms DESC;

SELECT d1.driverid AS driver1_id, d1.forename AS driver1_forename, d1.surname AS driver1_surname, d2.driverid AS driver2_id, d2.forename AS driver2_forename, d2.surname AS driver2_surname, r.year, r.name AS race_name, c.name AS circuit_name, AVG(lt1.milliseconds - lt2.milliseconds) AS avg_time_diff_ms, COUNT(*) AS lap_count FROM laptimes lt1 JOIN laptimes lt2 ON lt1.raceid = lt2.raceid AND lt1.lap = lt2.lap JOIN drivers d1 ON lt1.driverid = d1.driverid JOIN drivers d2 ON lt2.driverid = d2.driverid JOIN races r ON lt1.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res1 ON lt1.raceid = res1.raceid AND lt1.driverid = res1.driverid JOIN results res2 ON lt2.raceid = res2.raceid AND lt2.driverid = res2.driverid WHERE lt1.position IS NOT NULL AND lt2.position IS NOT NULL AND lt1.milliseconds IS NOT NULL AND lt2.milliseconds IS NOT NULL AND lt1.driverid < lt2.driverid AND r.year >= 2016 AND c.circuitid = 37 AND res1.grid <= 10 AND res2.grid <= 2 GROUP BY d1.driverid, d1.forename, d1.surname, d2.driverid, d2.forename, d2.surname, r.year, r.name, c.name HAVING COUNT(*) > 6 AND AVG(lt1.milliseconds - lt2.milliseconds) > 1141 ORDER BY avg_time_diff_ms DESC, lap_count DESC;

SELECT r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, c.country, d.driverid, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, con.name AS constructor_name, res.positionorder, res.points, ds.position AS driver_championship_position, ds.wins AS driver_wins, cs.position AS constructor_championship_position, cs.wins AS constructor_wins, AVG(l.milliseconds) OVER (PARTITION BY r.raceid, d.driverid) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(p.stop) OVER (PARTITION BY r.raceid, d.driverid) AS total_pitstops, q.position AS qualifying_position, SUM(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY r.year, d.driverid ORDER BY r.date) AS cumulative_driver_points, SUM(cr.points) OVER (PARTITION BY r.year, con.constructorid ORDER BY r.date) AS cumulative_constructor_points FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid LEFT JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND d.driverid = ds.driverid LEFT JOIN constructorstandings cs ON r.raceid = cs.raceid AND con.constructorid = cs.constructorid LEFT JOIN laptimes l ON r.raceid = l.raceid AND d.driverid = l.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops p ON r.raceid = p.raceid AND d.driverid = p.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND d.driverid = q.driverid AND con.constructorid = q.constructorid LEFT JOIN constructorresults cr ON r.raceid = cr.raceid AND con.constructorid = cr.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 1959 AND r.date <= '1950-01-01' AND res.positionorder <= 14 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM target t WHERE t.raceid = r.raceid AND t.driverid = d.driverid AND t.win = 1 ) AND d.dob <= '1920-01-01' AND con.constructorid IN (SELECT constructorid FROM constructors WHERE nationality = 'British') GROUP BY r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name, c.country, d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, con.name, res.positionorder, res.points, ds.position, ds.wins, cs.position, cs.wins, q.position, cr.points, l.milliseconds, p.stop, r.date, con.constructorid HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY r.year DESC, r.round DESC, cumulative_driver_points DESC;

SELECT r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, d.driverid, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, con.name AS constructor_name, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position AS lap_position, lt.milliseconds AS lap_time_ms, ps.stop AS pit_stop_number, ps.lap AS pit_stop_lap, ps.milliseconds AS pit_stop_duration_ms, q.position AS qualifying_position, ds.points AS driver_standing_points, ds.wins AS driver_standing_wins, cs.points AS constructor_standing_points, cs.wins AS constructor_standing_wins, AVG(lt.milliseconds) OVER ( PARTITION BY r.raceid, d.driverid ORDER BY lt.lap ROWS BETWEEN 9 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_lap_time, SUM(res.points) OVER ( PARTITION BY r.year, con.constructorid ORDER BY r.date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS cumulative_constructor_points, RANK() OVER ( PARTITION BY r.raceid ORDER BY res.positionorder ) AS race_finish_rank FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND res.driverid = q.driverid AND res.constructorid = q.constructorid LEFT JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid LEFT JOIN constructorstandings cs ON r.raceid = cs.raceid AND res.constructorid = cs.constructorid LEFT JOIN constructorresults cr ON r.raceid = cr.raceid AND res.constructorid = cr.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 2012 AND r.year <= 1969 AND res.positionorder <= 2 AND lt.milliseconds > 66460 AND (ps.milliseconds IS NULL OR ps.milliseconds < 53593) GROUP BY r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name, d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, con.name, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position, lt.milliseconds, ps.stop, ps.lap, ps.milliseconds, q.position, ds.points, ds.wins, cs.points, cs.wins, r.date, con.constructorid HAVING AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 136730 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) > 9 ORDER BY r.year DESC, r.round DESC, cumulative_constructor_points DESC;

SELECT r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, d.driverid, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, res.positionorder, res.points, AVG(res.points) OVER ( PARTITION BY r.circuitid, d.driverid ORDER BY r.date ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS avg_points_last_3_races FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 2014 AND r.year <= 2014 AND res.positionorder <= 9 AND d.dob >= '1970-01-01' GROUP BY r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name, d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, res.positionorder, res.points, r.circuitid, r.date HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY r.year, r.round, avg_points_last_3_races DESC;

SELECT r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, d.driverref, d.nationality AS driver_nationality, con.name AS constructor_name, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points, AVG(res.points) OVER ( PARTITION BY r.circuitid, d.driverid ORDER BY r.date ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS avg_points_last_3_races FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 2013 AND r.year <= 2007 AND res.positionorder <= 5 AND res.grid <= 6 GROUP BY r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name, d.driverref, d.nationality, con.name, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points, r.circuitid, d.driverid, r.date HAVING AVG(res.points) > '0.0' ORDER BY r.year, r.round, avg_points_last_3_races DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) AS races_entered, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lp.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(ps.stop) AS total_pitstops FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lp ON r.raceid = lp.raceid AND d.driverid = lp.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND d.driverid = ps.driverid WHERE r.year IN (SELECT year FROM seasons WHERE year >= 1959 AND year <= 2016) AND res.positionorder <= 5 AND r.date >= '1950-01-01' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) >= 47 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_lap_time_ms ASC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops, MAX(q.position) AS best_qualifying FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON d.driverid = lt.driverid AND res.raceid = lt.raceid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON d.driverid = ps.driverid AND res.raceid = ps.raceid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON d.driverid = q.driverid AND res.raceid = q.raceid WHERE r.year >= 1978 AND r.date <= '1950-01-01' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round, r.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 154500 UNION ALL SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, SUM(cr.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops, MAX(q.position) AS best_qualifying FROM drivers d JOIN constructorresults cr ON d.driverid = 755 JOIN races r ON cr.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON cr.constructorid = c.constructorid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON d.driverid = lt.driverid AND cr.raceid = lt.raceid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON d.driverid = ps.driverid AND cr.raceid = ps.raceid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON d.driverid = q.driverid AND cr.raceid = q.raceid WHERE r.year >= 2003 AND r.date <= '1950-01-01' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round, r.name HAVING SUM(cr.points) > '0' AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 157119 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_lap_time_ms ASC;

BY res.constructorid ORDER BY r.date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_constructor_points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.raceid ORDER BY res.positionorder) AS SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position AS lap_position, ps.stop AS pit_stop_number, ps.duration AS pit_stop_duration, q.position AS qualifying_position, ds.position AS driver_standing_position, cs.position AS constructor_standing_position, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM results res2 WHERE res2.raceid = r.raceid AND res2.positionorder <= 3) AS top_finishers_in_race, (SELECT AVG(lt2.milliseconds) FROM laptimes lt2 WHERE lt2.raceid = r.raceid AND lt2.lap = lt.lap AND lt2.milliseconds > 107492) AS avg_lap_time_excluding_slow FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND d.driverid = ps.driverid AND lt.lap = ps.lap LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND d.driverid = q.driverid LEFT JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND d.driverid = ds.driverid LEFT JOIN constructorstandings cs ON r.raceid = cs.raceid AND c.constructorid = cs.constructorid WHERE r.date >= '2000-01-01' AND r.date <= '2000-01-01' AND res.points > '0.0' AND lt.milliseconds < 173978 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM constructorresults cr WHERE cr.raceid = r.raceid AND cr.constructorid = c.constructorid AND cr.points >= '0.0') > 0 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round, r.name, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position, ps.stop, ps.duration, q.position, ds.position, cs.position, r.raceid, lt.milliseconds HAVING AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 149448 AND COUNT(ps.stop) >= 4 ORDER BY r.year DESC, r.round DESC, res.positionorder ASC, lt.lap ASC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, CASE WHEN SUM(res.points) >= 69.18 THEN 'High Performer' WHEN SUM(res.points) >= 16.92 THEN 'Medium Performer' ELSE 'Low Performer' END AS performance_category FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid WHERE r.year = 2016 AND r.round >= 6 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > 5.8 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY SUM(res.points) DESC) AS yearly_rank FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid WHERE r.year >= 1979 AND r.year <= 1978 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY r.year, yearly_rank, r.round;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, res.positionorder, res.points, AVG(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid ORDER BY r.date ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS avg_points_last_4_races FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid WHERE r.year = 1971 AND res.positionorder <= 8 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name, res.positionorder, res.points, r.date ORDER BY d.driverid, r.date;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, res.positionorder, res.points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY SUM(res.points) DESC) AS yearly_rank FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid WHERE r.year >= 1989 AND r.year <= 2019 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name, res.positionorder, res.points HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY r.year, yearly_rank, r.round;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, COUNT(*) AS races_entered, AVG(res.positionorder) AS avg_finish_position FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid WHERE r.year = 1957 AND res.positionorder <= 8 AND d.driverid IN ( SELECT driverid FROM results WHERE points > '0' GROUP BY driverid HAVING COUNT(*) >= 8 ) GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, r.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_finish_position ASC;

SELECT d1.driverid AS driver1_id, d1.forename AS driver1_forename, d1.surname AS driver1_surname, d2.driverid AS driver2_id, d2.forename AS driver2_forename, d2.surname AS driver2_surname, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, AVG(lt1.milliseconds - lt2.milliseconds) AS avg_time_diff_ms, SUM(CASE WHEN lt1.position < lt2.position THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS driver1_ahead_count, SUM(CASE WHEN lt2.position < lt1.position THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS driver2_ahead_count, COUNT(*) AS total_laps_compared FROM laptimes lt1 JOIN laptimes lt2 ON lt1.raceid = lt2.raceid AND lt1.lap = lt2.lap AND lt1.driverid < lt2.driverid JOIN races r ON lt1.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN drivers d1 ON lt1.driverid = d1.driverid JOIN drivers d2 ON lt2.driverid = d2.driverid JOIN results res1 ON lt1.raceid = res1.raceid AND lt1.driverid = res1.driverid JOIN results res2 ON lt2.raceid = res2.raceid AND lt2.driverid = res2.driverid JOIN constructorresults cr1 ON res1.raceid = cr1.raceid AND res1.constructorid = cr1.constructorid JOIN constructorresults cr2 ON res2.raceid = cr2.raceid AND res2.constructorid = cr2.constructorid JOIN qualifying q1 ON lt1.raceid = q1.raceid AND lt1.driverid = q1.driverid JOIN qualifying q2 ON lt2.raceid = q2.raceid AND lt2.driverid = q2.driverid WHERE r.year >= 1959 AND r.year <= 1982 AND lt1.milliseconds > 75453 AND lt2.milliseconds > 306970 AND res1.points >= '0' AND res2.points >= '0' GROUP BY d1.driverid, d1.forename, d1.surname, d2.driverid, d2.forename, d2.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name HAVING COUNT(*) > 26 AND AVG(lt1.milliseconds - lt2.milliseconds) BETWEEN -6506 AND 5101 ORDER BY avg_time_diff_ms DESC, total_laps_compared DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT r.year, c.name AS circuit_name, con.name AS constructor_name, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid WHERE r.year >= 1995 AND r.year <= 1967 AND res.positionorder <= 14 GROUP BY r.year, c.circuitid, con.constructorid, d.driverid HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY r.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT r.year, c.name AS constructor_name, COUNT(DISTINCT res.driverid) AS unique_drivers, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(res.positionorder) AS avg_finish FROM results res JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN driverstandings ds ON res.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid WHERE r.year >= 2011 AND res.points > '0' GROUP BY r.year, c.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '10' ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT r.year, c.name AS constructor_name, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, SUM(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY r.year, c.constructorid ORDER BY r.date) AS cumulative_points, AVG(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY r.year, c.constructorid) AS avg_points_per_race FROM results res JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid WHERE r.year >= 2005 AND res.points > '0' ORDER BY r.year, c.constructorid, r.date;

SELECT c.circuitid, c.name AS circuit_name, c.country, r.year, r.round, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.driverid) AS unique_drivers, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) AS unique_laps, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS unique_pitstops, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, MAX(ds.wins) AS max_wins_in_race, SUM(crs.points) AS total_constructor_points FROM circuits c JOIN races r ON c.circuitid = r.circuitid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND lt.driverid = ps.driverid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid AND lt.driverid = res.driverid JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND lt.driverid = ds.driverid JOIN constructorresults crs ON r.raceid = crs.raceid AND res.constructorid = crs.constructorid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid JOIN drivers d ON lt.driverid = d.driverid WHERE r.year >= 1975 AND r.date <= '1950-01-01' AND lt.milliseconds > 108903 AND res.points > '0' AND ds.position <= 2 GROUP BY c.circuitid, c.name, c.country, r.year, r.round HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lt.driverid) > 49 AND SUM(res.points) >= '10' ORDER BY r.year DESC, r.round ASC, total_points DESC;

SELECT c.circuitid, c.name AS circuit_name, c.country, r.year, r.round, d.driverid, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, con.name AS constructor_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops, MAX(ds.wins) AS max_wins_in_season, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY SUM(res.points) DESC) AS yearly_points_rank FROM circuits c JOIN races r ON c.circuitid = r.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND d.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND d.driverid = ds.driverid LEFT JOIN constructorresults cr ON r.raceid = cr.raceid AND con.constructorid = cr.constructorid LEFT JOIN constructorstandings cs ON r.raceid = cs.raceid AND con.constructorid = cs.constructorid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND d.driverid = q.driverid AND con.constructorid = q.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 2021 AND r.year <= 2021 AND res.grid <= 9 AND d.dob >= '1950-01-01' AND c.alt >= 194 GROUP BY c.circuitid, c.name, c.country, r.year, r.round, d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, con.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 143308 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) >= 8 ORDER BY r.year DESC, r.round, total_points DESC;
