SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY SUM(res.points) DESC) AS yearly_rank FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON d.driverid = lt.driverid AND res.raceid = lt.raceid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON d.driverid = ps.driverid AND res.raceid = ps.raceid WHERE r.year IN ( SELECT DISTINCT year FROM races WHERE circuitid IN ( SELECT circuitid FROM circuits WHERE lat > '-90' AND alt > 2930 ) ) AND res.positionorder <= ( SELECT AVG(positionorder) + 9 FROM results WHERE raceid IN ( SELECT raceid FROM races WHERE date BETWEEN '1950-01-01' AND '1950-01-01' ) ) GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round, r.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 170936 ORDER BY r.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lap.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT pit.stop) AS total_pitstops, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM results res2 WHERE res2.driverid = d.driverid AND res2.position = 1) AS career_wins, (SELECT AVG(pos.position) FROM driverstandings pos WHERE pos.driverid = d.driverid AND pos.raceid IN (SELECT raceid FROM races WHERE year >= 2020)) AS avg_position_since_year, MAX(qual.position) AS best_qualifying, MIN(res.grid) AS worst_grid_start FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lap ON res.raceid = lap.raceid AND res.driverid = lap.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops pit ON res.raceid = pit.raceid AND res.driverid = pit.driverid JOIN qualifying qual ON res.raceid = qual.raceid AND res.driverid = qual.driverid JOIN constructorresults cr ON res.raceid = cr.raceid AND res.constructorid = cr.constructorid JOIN constructorstandings cs ON res.raceid = cs.raceid AND res.constructorid = cs.constructorid JOIN driverstandings ds ON res.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid WHERE r.date >= '1950-01-01' AND r.year <= 2019 AND res.points > '0' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round, r.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND AVG(lap.milliseconds) < 149607 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_lap_time_ms ASC LIMIT 201;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops, MAX(ds.wins) AS max_wins_in_season, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY SUM(res.points) DESC) AS yearly_rank FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON d.driverid = lt.driverid AND r.raceid = lt.raceid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON d.driverid = ps.driverid AND r.raceid = ps.raceid JOIN driverstandings ds ON d.driverid = ds.driverid AND r.raceid = ds.raceid WHERE r.year >= 1985 AND r.date <= '1950-01-01' AND res.grid <= 22 AND lt.position <= 2 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM qualifying q WHERE q.raceid = r.raceid AND q.driverid = d.driverid AND q.position <= 30 ) GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round, r.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 63233 ORDER BY total_points DESC, yearly_rank ASC LIMIT 911;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, res.points, res.positionorder, ds.wins, (SELECT AVG(l.milliseconds) FROM laptimes l WHERE l.raceid = r.raceid AND l.driverid = d.driverid AND l.lap <= 2) AS avg_lap_time, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pitstops p WHERE p.raceid = r.raceid AND p.driverid = d.driverid AND p.lap <= 17) AS pitstop_count FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND d.driverid = ds.driverid JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND d.driverid = q.driverid AND c.constructorid = q.constructorid JOIN circuits ci ON r.circuitid = ci.circuitid WHERE r.year >= 2001 AND r.date <= '2000-01-01' AND res.points > '0.0' AND ds.position <= 5 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round, r.name, res.points, res.positionorder, ds.wins, r.raceid HAVING AVG(res.points) > '0.0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) >= 2 ORDER BY ds.wins DESC, res.points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, res.positionorder, res.points, SUM(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid, r.year ORDER BY r.date) AS cumulative_points_year, AVG(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY c.constructorid, r.year) AS avg_constructor_points_per_race_year, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.raceid ORDER BY res.points DESC) AS race_points_rank FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN circuits ci ON r.circuitid = ci.circuitid JOIN seasons s ON r.year = s.year LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON res.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON res.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON res.raceid = q.raceid AND res.driverid = q.driverid AND res.constructorid = q.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 2017 AND r.year <= 1995 AND res.points > '0' AND ci.alt > 920 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, c.constructorid, r.year, r.round, r.name, r.date, r.raceid, res.positionorder, res.points HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) > 22 OR COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) IS NULL ORDER BY r.year, r.round, cumulative_points_year DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position AS lap_position, ps.stop AS pit_stop_number, ps.duration AS pit_stop_duration, q.position AS qualifying_position, ds.position AS driver_standing_position, cs.position AS constructor_standing_position, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM results res2 WHERE res2.raceid = r.raceid AND res2.positionorder <= 3) AS top_finishers_in_race, AVG(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY r.year, c.constructorid) AS avg_constructor_points_per_year, SUM(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid ORDER BY r.date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_driver_points FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits ci ON r.circuitid = ci.circuitid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON res.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON res.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid JOIN qualifying q ON res.raceid = q.raceid AND res.driverid = q.driverid AND res.constructorid = q.constructorid JOIN driverstandings ds ON res.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid JOIN constructorstandings cs ON res.raceid = cs.raceid AND res.constructorid = cs.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 2014 AND r.year <= 2015 AND ci.country = 'UK' AND res.positionorder IS NOT NULL AND lt.lap = 27 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM constructorresults cr WHERE cr.raceid = r.raceid AND cr.constructorid = c.constructorid AND cr.points > '0') GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round, r.name, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position, ps.stop, ps.duration, q.position, ds.position, cs.position, r.raceid, r.date, c.constructorid HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY cumulative_driver_points DESC, r.year, r.round;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY SUM(res.points) DESC) AS yearly_rank FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid WHERE r.year >= 2018 AND r.year <= 1967 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY r.year, yearly_rank, r.round;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position AS lap_position, ps.stop AS pit_stop_number, ps.lap AS pit_stop_lap FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN laptimes lt ON res.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON res.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid WHERE r.year = 1950 AND res.positionorder <= 20 AND lt.lap = ( SELECT MAX(lap) FROM laptimes WHERE raceid = lt.raceid AND driverid = lt.driverid ) GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position, ps.stop, ps.lap HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY r.year, r.round, res.positionorder;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(res.positionorder) AS avg_finish_position FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid WHERE r.year IN ( SELECT year FROM seasons WHERE year BETWEEN 1971 AND 2014 ) AND res.positionorder <= 11 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, r.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_finish_position ASC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, res.points, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM laptimes lt WHERE lt.raceid = r.raceid AND lt.driverid = d.driverid AND lt.position = 4) AS laps_in_position FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid WHERE r.year = 1957 AND res.points > '0' ORDER BY res.points DESC;

SELECT d1.driverid AS driver1_id, d1.forename AS driver1_forename, d1.surname AS driver1_surname, d2.driverid AS driver2_id, d2.forename AS driver2_forename, d2.surname AS driver2_surname, r.year, r.name AS race_name, AVG(lt1.milliseconds - lt2.milliseconds) AS avg_time_diff_ms FROM laptimes lt1 JOIN laptimes lt2 ON lt1.raceid = lt2.raceid AND lt1.lap = lt2.lap JOIN drivers d1 ON lt1.driverid = d1.driverid JOIN drivers d2 ON lt2.driverid = d2.driverid JOIN races r ON lt1.raceid = r.raceid WHERE lt1.driverid < lt2.driverid AND lt1.milliseconds IS NOT NULL AND lt2.milliseconds IS NOT NULL AND r.year >= 2007 AND lt1.lap <= 41 GROUP BY d1.driverid, d1.forename, d1.surname, d2.driverid, d2.forename, d2.surname, r.year, r.name HAVING COUNT(*) > 16 ORDER BY avg_time_diff_ms DESC;

SELECT d1.driverid AS driver1_id, d1.forename AS driver1_forename, d1.surname AS driver1_surname, d2.driverid AS driver2_id, d2.forename AS driver2_forename, d2.surname AS driver2_surname, r.year, r.name AS race_name, AVG(lt1.milliseconds - lt2.milliseconds) AS avg_time_diff_ms FROM laptimes lt1 JOIN laptimes lt2 ON lt1.raceid = lt2.raceid AND lt1.lap = lt2.lap JOIN drivers d1 ON lt1.driverid = d1.driverid JOIN drivers d2 ON lt2.driverid = d2.driverid JOIN races r ON lt1.raceid = r.raceid WHERE lt1.driverid < lt2.driverid AND lt1.milliseconds IS NOT NULL AND lt2.milliseconds IS NOT NULL AND r.year >= 2022 AND lt1.lap <= 9 GROUP BY d1.driverid, d1.forename, d1.surname, d2.driverid, d2.forename, d2.surname, r.year, r.name HAVING COUNT(*) > 43 ORDER BY avg_time_diff_ms DESC;

SELECT d1.driverid AS driver1_id, d1.forename AS driver1_forename, d1.surname AS driver1_surname, d2.driverid AS driver2_id, d2.forename AS driver2_forename, d2.surname AS driver2_surname, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, AVG(lt1.milliseconds - lt2.milliseconds) AS avg_time_diff_ms, SUM(CASE WHEN res1.positionorder < res2.positionorder THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS driver1_wins_against_driver2, SUM(cr1.points) AS driver1_constructor_points, SUM(cr2.points) AS driver2_constructor_points, COUNT(DISTINCT lt1.lap) AS total_laps_compared, CORR(lt1.position, lt2.position) AS lap_position_correlation FROM laptimes lt1 JOIN laptimes lt2 ON lt1.raceid = lt2.raceid AND lt1.lap = lt2.lap AND lt1.driverid < lt2.driverid JOIN races r ON lt1.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN drivers d1 ON lt1.driverid = d1.driverid JOIN drivers d2 ON lt2.driverid = d2.driverid LEFT JOIN results res1 ON lt1.raceid = res1.raceid AND lt1.driverid = res1.driverid LEFT JOIN results res2 ON lt2.raceid = res2.raceid AND lt2.driverid = res2.driverid LEFT JOIN constructorresults cr1 ON res1.raceid = cr1.raceid AND res1.constructorid = cr1.constructorid LEFT JOIN constructorresults cr2 ON res2.raceid = cr2.raceid AND res2.constructorid = cr2.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 1990 AND r.date <= '1950-01-01' AND lt1.milliseconds IS NOT NULL AND lt2.milliseconds IS NOT NULL AND c.circuitid IN (33, 74, 73) GROUP BY d1.driverid, d1.forename, d1.surname, d2.driverid, d2.forename, d2.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name HAVING AVG(lt1.milliseconds - lt2.milliseconds) > 6203 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lt1.lap) >= 87 ORDER BY avg_time_diff_ms DESC, driver1_wins_against_driver2 DESC LIMIT 739;

SELECT r.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(*) AS race_count, SUM(r.points) AS total_points FROM results r JOIN drivers d ON r.driverid = d.driverid JOIN races rc ON r.raceid = rc.raceid WHERE r.points > '0' AND rc.year = 2014 GROUP BY r.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(r.points) > '10' INTERSECT SELECT r.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(*) AS race_count, SUM(r.points) AS total_points FROM results r JOIN drivers d ON r.driverid = d.driverid JOIN races rc ON r.raceid = rc.raceid WHERE r.grid <= 1 AND rc.year BETWEEN 2015 AND 2017 GROUP BY r.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING COUNT(*) >= 26 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.driverid) AS distinct_drivers, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) AS distinct_laps, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS distinct_pitstops, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, SUM(res.points) AS total_points FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND lt.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid AND lt.driverid = res.driverid WHERE r.year >= 2001 AND r.date <= '2000-03-01' GROUP BY r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lt.driverid) > 29 AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 146747 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.driverid) AS distinct_drivers, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) AS distinct_laps, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS distinct_pitstops, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, SUM(res.points) AS total_points FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND lt.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid AND lt.driverid = res.driverid WHERE r.year >= 2022 AND r.date <= '2000-03-01' GROUP BY r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lt.driverid) > 22 AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 175396 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, con.name AS constructor_name, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points, ds.wins AS driver_wins, cs.wins AS constructor_wins, AVG(lt.milliseconds) OVER (PARTITION BY r.raceid, d.driverid) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(p.stop) OVER (PARTITION BY r.raceid, d.driverid) AS pitstop_count FROM races r INNER JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid INNER JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid INNER JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid INNER JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid LEFT JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND d.driverid = ds.driverid LEFT JOIN constructorstandings cs ON r.raceid = cs.raceid AND con.constructorid = cs.constructorid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops p ON r.raceid = p.raceid AND d.driverid = p.driverid WHERE r.year >= 2008 AND r.year <= 2002 AND res.points > '0' GROUP BY r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name, d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, con.constructorid, con.name, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points, ds.wins, cs.wins, p.stop, lt.milliseconds HAVING COUNT(p.stop) < 5 ORDER BY r.year DESC, r.round DESC, res.points DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT r.year, c.country, con.nationality, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, COUNT(DISTINCT res.driverid) AS unique_drivers, AVG(res.positionorder) AS avg_finish FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 1957 AND r.date <= '1950-01-01' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (r.year, c.country, con.nationality), (r.year, c.country), (r.year), () ) ORDER BY r.year, c.country, con.nationality;

SELECT r.year, c.country, con.nationality, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, COUNT(DISTINCT res.driverid) AS unique_drivers, AVG(res.positionorder) AS avg_finish FROM races r JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 2002 AND r.year <= 2001 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (r.year, c.country, con.nationality), (r.year, c.country), (r.year, con.nationality), (c.country, con.nationality), (r.year), (c.country), (con.nationality), () ) HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY r.year, c.country, con.nationality;

SELECT r.year, c.name AS circuit_name, con.name AS constructor_name, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops FROM races r INNER JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid INNER JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid INNER JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid INNER JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid WHERE r.year >= 2006 AND r.year <= 2007 AND res.positionorder <= 2 GROUP BY r.year, c.circuitid, con.constructorid, d.driverid HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY r.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT r.year, c.name AS circuit_name, con.name AS constructor_name, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops FROM races r INNER JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid INNER JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid INNER JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid INNER JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid WHERE r.year >= 2022 AND r.year <= 2013 AND res.positionorder <= 6 GROUP BY r.year, c.circuitid, con.constructorid, d.driverid HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY r.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT r.year, c.name AS circuit_name, con.name AS constructor_name, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, res.positionorder, res.points, ds.wins, lt.lap, lt.position AS lap_position, ps.duration AS pitstop_duration, q.position AS qualifying_position FROM races r INNER JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid INNER JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid INNER JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid INNER JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid LEFT JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid AND lt.lap = ps.lap LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND res.driverid = q.driverid AND res.constructorid = q.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 2000 AND r.year <= 1997 AND res.points > '0' GROUP BY r.year, c.circuitid, con.constructorid, d.driverid, res.positionorder, res.points, ds.wins, lt.lap, lt.position, ps.duration, q.position HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY r.year DESC, SUM(res.points) DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name AS constructor_name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, rs.points AS race_points, ds.points AS driver_standings_points, cs.points AS constructor_standings_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops, SUM(q.position) AS total_qualifying_position, SUM(CASE WHEN t.win = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_wins FROM drivers d JOIN results rs ON d.driverid = rs.driverid JOIN races r ON rs.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits ci ON r.circuitid = ci.circuitid JOIN constructors c ON rs.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN driverstandings ds ON d.driverid = ds.driverid AND r.raceid = ds.raceid JOIN constructorstandings cs ON c.constructorid = cs.constructorid AND r.raceid = cs.raceid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON d.driverid = lt.driverid AND r.raceid = lt.raceid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON d.driverid = ps.driverid AND r.raceid = ps.raceid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON d.driverid = q.driverid AND r.raceid = q.raceid LEFT JOIN target t ON d.driverid = t.driverid AND r.raceid = t.raceid WHERE r.year >= 1979 AND r.year <= 2008 AND rs.points > '0' AND ci.alt >= 281 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, rs.points, ds.points, cs.points HAVING AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 109696 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) >= 0 ORDER BY total_wins DESC, avg_lap_time_ms ASC LIMIT 31;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops, MAX(q.position) AS best_qualifying, MIN(ds.position) AS best_race_position, COUNT(DISTINCT res.raceid) AS races_participated FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON res.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON res.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON res.raceid = q.raceid AND res.driverid = q.driverid LEFT JOIN driverstandings ds ON res.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid JOIN circuits ci ON r.circuitid = ci.circuitid JOIN seasons s ON r.year = s.year WHERE r.date >= '2000-01-01' AND r.date <= '2000-01-01' AND ci.alt > 244 AND res.grid <= 8 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name, r.year, r.round HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 108958 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) >= 3 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_lap_time_ms ASC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, cir.name AS circuit_name, COUNT(DISTINCT res.raceid) AS races_participated, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(res.positionorder) AS avg_finish_position, MAX(lt.lap) AS max_laps_in_race, SUM(ps.milliseconds) / 1000.0 AS total_pitstop_time_seconds, COUNT(DISTINCT q.position) AS unique_qualifying_positions, SUM(CASE WHEN res.positionorder = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wins, SUM(ds.wins) AS season_wins, SUM(cs.wins) AS constructor_season_wins, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits cir ON r.circuitid = cir.circuitid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON res.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid JOIN pitstops ps ON res.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid JOIN qualifying q ON res.raceid = q.raceid AND res.driverid = q.driverid AND res.constructorid = q.constructorid JOIN driverstandings ds ON res.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid JOIN constructorstandings cs ON res.raceid = cs.raceid AND res.constructorid = cs.constructorid JOIN constructorresults cr ON res.raceid = cr.raceid AND res.constructorid = cr.constructorid JOIN seasons s ON r.year = s.year WHERE r.date >= '1950-01-01' AND r.date <= '1950-01-01' AND cir.lat >= '-90' AND cir.lat <= '-90' AND d.dob <= '1920-01-01' AND res.grid <= 11 AND res.laps >= 67 AND lt.position <= 22 AND ps.milliseconds >= 36741 AND q.position <= 26 AND ds.points >= '0' AND cs.points >= '0' AND cr.points >= '0' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name, r.year, r.round, cir.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND AVG(res.positionorder) < 13 AND COUNT(DISTINCT res.raceid) >= 625 AND SUM(CASE WHEN res.positionorder = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 6 AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) <= 133790 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) >= 4 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_finish_position ASC, wins DESC LIMIT 80;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, COUNT(r.resultid) AS total_races, SUM(r.points) AS total_points, AVG(r.positionorder) AS avg_finish_position FROM drivers d JOIN results r ON d.driverid = r.driverid JOIN constructors c ON r.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN races rc ON r.raceid = rc.raceid WHERE rc.year >= 2015 AND r.points > '0' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name HAVING SUM(r.points) > '50' ORDER BY total_points DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) AS total_laps_led, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, MIN(ps.milliseconds) AS fastest_pitstop_ms FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits cct ON r.circuitid = cct.circuitid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON d.driverid = lt.driverid AND res.raceid = lt.raceid AND lt.position = 1 LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON d.driverid = ps.driverid AND res.raceid = ps.raceid JOIN driverstandings ds ON d.driverid = ds.driverid AND res.raceid = ds.raceid WHERE r.year >= 2001 AND r.date <= '2000-03-01' AND res.grid <= 6 AND cct.alt >= 500 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) >= 3 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_lap_time_ms ASC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON res.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON res.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid WHERE r.year = 1979 AND res.grid <= 5 AND res.positionorder IS NOT NULL AND res.positionorder <= 7 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round, r.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 68238 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_lap_time_ms ASC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops, MAX(ds.wins) AS max_wins_in_season, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY SUM(res.points) DESC) AS yearly_rank FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON d.driverid = lt.driverid AND res.raceid = lt.raceid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON d.driverid = ps.driverid AND res.raceid = ps.raceid JOIN driverstandings ds ON d.driverid = ds.driverid AND res.raceid = ds.raceid JOIN seasons s ON r.year = s.year WHERE r.year >= 2014 AND r.year <= 2013 AND res.points > '0' AND lt.milliseconds < 107118 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round, r.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '10' AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 85856 ORDER BY r.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops, MAX(ds.wins) AS max_wins_in_season, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY SUM(res.points) DESC) AS yearly_rank FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON d.driverid = lt.driverid AND res.raceid = lt.raceid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON d.driverid = ps.driverid AND res.raceid = ps.raceid JOIN driverstandings ds ON d.driverid = ds.driverid AND res.raceid = ds.raceid WHERE r.year >= 2007 AND r.date <= '1950-01-01' AND res.grid <= 20 AND lt.position <= 29 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM qualifying q WHERE q.raceid = r.raceid AND q.driverid = d.driverid AND q.position <= 9 ) GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round, r.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 103828 ORDER BY total_points DESC, yearly_rank LIMIT 926;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, res.points, res.positionorder, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM laptimes lt WHERE lt.raceid = r.raceid AND lt.driverid = d.driverid AND lt.position = 1) AS laps_led, (SELECT AVG(ps.milliseconds) FROM pitstops ps WHERE ps.raceid = r.raceid AND ps.driverid = d.driverid) AS avg_pitstop_ms, SUM(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY r.year, c.constructorid ORDER BY r.date) AS cumulative_points FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN circuits ci ON r.circuitid = ci.circuitid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND d.driverid = ps.driverid WHERE r.year >= 2003 AND r.year <= 2013 AND res.points > '0' AND ci.alt > 26 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, c.constructorid, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, r.name, r.date, res.points, res.positionorder HAVING AVG(lt.position) < 13 OR AVG(lt.position) IS NULL ORDER BY r.year, r.round, cumulative_points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position AS lap_position, ps.stop AS pit_stop_number, ps.duration AS pit_stop_duration, q.position AS qualifying_position, ds.position AS driver_standing_position, cs.position AS constructor_standing_position, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM laptimes lt2 WHERE lt2.raceid = r.raceid AND lt2.driverid = d.driverid AND lt2.milliseconds < 93301) AS laps_faster_than_threshold, (SELECT AVG(points) FROM results res2 WHERE res2.raceid = r.raceid AND res2.driverid = d.driverid AND res2.points > '0.0') AS avg_points_above_threshold FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits cct ON r.circuitid = cct.circuitid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND d.driverid = ps.driverid JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND d.driverid = q.driverid JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND d.driverid = ds.driverid JOIN constructorstandings cs ON r.raceid = cs.raceid AND c.constructorid = cs.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 2000 AND r.year <= 2016 AND cct.country = 'UK' AND res.positionorder <= 9 AND lt.lap BETWEEN 10 AND 55 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round, r.name, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position, ps.stop, ps.duration, q.position, ds.position, cs.position, r.raceid HAVING SUM(res.points) > '5.0' AND AVG(lt.position) < 4 ORDER BY r.year DESC, r.round DESC, SUM(res.points) DESC, AVG(lt.position) ASC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN laptimes lt ON res.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid WHERE r.year = 2012 AND res.positionorder <= 11 AND lt.lap > 32 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_lap_time_ms ASC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, res.positionorder, res.points, AVG(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY r.year, d.driverid ORDER BY r.round) AS avg_points_running, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY SUM(res.points) DESC) AS yearly_rank FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid WHERE r.year >= 1988 AND r.year <= 1955 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name, res.positionorder, res.points HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY r.year, r.round, yearly_rank;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, res.positionorder, res.points, CASE WHEN res.positionorder = 1 THEN 'Winner' WHEN res.positionorder BETWEEN 2 AND 3 THEN 'Podium' WHEN res.positionorder BETWEEN 4 AND 10 THEN 'Points Finish' ELSE 'Outside Points' END AS finish_category, AVG(l.milliseconds) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid, r.year) AS avg_lap_time_ms, SUM(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid ORDER BY r.date) AS cumulative_points FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid LEFT JOIN laptimes l ON res.raceid = l.raceid AND res.driverid = l.driverid WHERE r.year = 2009 AND res.grid <= 17 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name, res.positionorder, res.points, r.date, l.milliseconds HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY cumulative_points DESC, r.round ASC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, res.positionorder, res.points, SUM(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid, r.year ORDER BY r.date) AS cumulative_points_season, AVG(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid, r.year) AS avg_points_season FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid WHERE r.year = 2003 AND res.positionorder <= 3 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name, res.positionorder, res.points, r.date ORDER BY d.driverid, r.year, r.round;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) AS laps_analyzed FROM drivers d JOIN laptimes lt ON d.driverid = lt.driverid JOIN races r ON lt.raceid = r.raceid WHERE r.year = 1966 AND lt.milliseconds IS NOT NULL AND lt.lap IN ( SELECT lap FROM laptimes WHERE raceid IN ( SELECT raceid FROM races WHERE circuitid = 39 ) GROUP BY lap HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT driverid) > 6 ) GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, r.name HAVING AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 116703 ORDER BY avg_lap_time_ms ASC LIMIT 20;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, c.name AS circuit_name, res.positionorder, res.points, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM laptimes lt WHERE lt.raceid = r.raceid AND lt.driverid = d.driverid AND lt.position = 1) AS laps_led, (SELECT AVG(sub.avg_points) FROM (SELECT rs.driverid, AVG(rs.points) AS avg_points FROM results rs WHERE rs.raceid IN (SELECT raceid FROM races WHERE year = r.year) GROUP BY rs.driverid) sub WHERE sub.driverid = d.driverid) AS avg_points_in_season FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid WHERE r.year = 1986 AND res.positionorder <= 9 AND con.nationality = 'British' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, r.name, c.name, res.positionorder, res.points, r.raceid HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY SUM(res.points) DESC, d.surname;

SELECT d1.driverid AS driver1_id, d1.forename AS driver1_forename, d1.surname AS driver1_surname, d2.driverid AS driver2_id, d2.forename AS driver2_forename, d2.surname AS driver2_surname, r.year, r.name AS race_name, AVG(lt1.milliseconds - lt2.milliseconds) AS avg_time_diff_ms FROM laptimes lt1 JOIN laptimes lt2 ON lt1.raceid = lt2.raceid AND lt1.lap = lt2.lap JOIN drivers d1 ON lt1.driverid = d1.driverid JOIN drivers d2 ON lt2.driverid = d2.driverid JOIN races r ON lt1.raceid = r.raceid WHERE lt1.driverid < lt2.driverid AND lt1.milliseconds > lt2.milliseconds AND r.year = 1952 AND lt1.lap BETWEEN 59 AND 55 GROUP BY d1.driverid, d1.forename, d1.surname, d2.driverid, d2.forename, d2.surname, r.year, r.name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1 ORDER BY avg_time_diff_ms DESC;

SELECT d1.driverid AS driver1_id, d1.forename AS driver1_forename, d1.surname AS driver1_surname, d2.driverid AS driver2_id, d2.forename AS driver2_forename, d2.surname AS driver2_surname, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, AVG(lt1.milliseconds - lt2.milliseconds) AS avg_time_diff_ms, SUM(res1.points) AS driver1_total_points, SUM(res2.points) AS driver2_total_points, COUNT(DISTINCT lt1.raceid) AS races_compared, SUM(CASE WHEN res1.positionorder < res2.positionorder THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS driver1_wins_over_driver2 FROM laptimes lt1 JOIN laptimes lt2 ON lt1.raceid = lt2.raceid AND lt1.lap = lt2.lap AND lt1.driverid < lt2.driverid JOIN drivers d1 ON lt1.driverid = d1.driverid JOIN drivers d2 ON lt2.driverid = d2.driverid JOIN races r ON lt1.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res1 ON lt1.raceid = res1.raceid AND lt1.driverid = res1.driverid JOIN results res2 ON lt2.raceid = res2.raceid AND lt2.driverid = res2.driverid LEFT JOIN constructorstandings cs1 ON res1.raceid = cs1.raceid AND res1.constructorid = cs1.constructorid LEFT JOIN constructorstandings cs2 ON res2.raceid = cs2.raceid AND res2.constructorid = cs2.constructorid LEFT JOIN qualifying q1 ON lt1.raceid = q1.raceid AND lt1.driverid = q1.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q2 ON lt2.raceid = q2.raceid AND lt2.driverid = q2.driverid WHERE r.year >= 1967 AND r.date <= '1950-01-01' AND lt1.milliseconds > 75245 AND lt2.milliseconds > 131109 AND c.circuitid IN (48, 33, 45) GROUP BY d1.driverid, d1.forename, d1.surname, d2.driverid, d2.forename, d2.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name HAVING AVG(lt1.milliseconds - lt2.milliseconds) > 2449 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lt1.raceid) >= 39 ORDER BY avg_time_diff_ms DESC, races_compared DESC LIMIT 607;

SELECT ds.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, SUM(ds.points) AS total_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ds.raceid) AS races_count FROM driverstandings ds JOIN drivers d ON ds.driverid = d.driverid JOIN races r ON ds.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid WHERE r.year >= 2007 AND c.alt >= 264 GROUP BY ds.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(ds.points) > '10' INTERSECT SELECT ds.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, SUM(ds.points) AS total_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ds.raceid) AS races_count FROM driverstandings ds JOIN drivers d ON ds.driverid = d.driverid JOIN races r ON ds.raceid = r.raceid JOIN results res ON ds.raceid = res.raceid AND ds.driverid = res.driverid WHERE res.grid <= 4 AND res.positionorder <= 5 GROUP BY ds.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ds.raceid) >= 23 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT r.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(*) AS race_count, SUM(r.points) AS total_points FROM results r JOIN drivers d ON r.driverid = d.driverid JOIN races rc ON r.raceid = rc.raceid WHERE r.points > 8.62 AND rc.year >= 2017 GROUP BY r.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(r.points) > 144.87 INTERSECT SELECT ds.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(DISTINCT ds.raceid) AS race_count, SUM(ds.points) AS total_points FROM driverstandings ds JOIN drivers d ON ds.driverid = d.driverid JOIN races rc ON ds.raceid = rc.raceid WHERE ds.points > 10.76 AND rc.year >= 2020 GROUP BY ds.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(ds.points) > 483.75 ORDER BY total_points DESC;
SELECT r.raceid, COUNT(l.driverid) AS total_laps FROM races r JOIN laptimes l ON r.raceid = l.raceid WHERE r.year = 2010 AND l.milliseconds < 79788 GROUP BY r.raceid ORDER BY total_laps DESC;

SELECT r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, d.driverid, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, res.positionorder, res.points, AVG(res.points) OVER ( PARTITION BY r.year, d.driverid ORDER BY r.date ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_points_last_3_races FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid WHERE r.year >= 2001 AND r.year <= 2014 AND res.positionorder <= 7 GROUP BY r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name, d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, res.positionorder, res.points, r.date HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0.0' ORDER BY r.year, r.round, moving_avg_points_last_3_races DESC;

SELECT r.year, c.country, con.nationality, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, COUNT(DISTINCT res.driverid) AS unique_drivers, AVG(res.positionorder) AS avg_finish FROM races r JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 1964 AND r.year <= 1990 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (r.year, c.country, con.nationality), (r.year, c.country), (r.year, con.nationality), (c.country, con.nationality), (r.year), (c.country), (con.nationality), () ) HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY r.year, c.country, con.nationality;

SELECT r.year, c.name AS constructor_name, COUNT(DISTINCT res.driverid) AS unique_drivers, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(res.positionorder) AS avg_finish FROM results res JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 2021 AND res.points > '0' GROUP BY r.year, c.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '10' ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT r.year, c.name AS constructor_name, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY SUM(res.points) DESC) AS yearly_rank FROM races r JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid WHERE r.year >= 2017 AND r.year <= 2005 GROUP BY r.year, c.constructorid, c.name, d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY r.year DESC, yearly_rank ASC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops, MAX(q.position) AS best_qualifying, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM target t WHERE t.driverid = d.driverid AND t.raceid = r.raceid AND t.win = 1) AS target_wins, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY SUM(res.points) DESC) AS yearly_rank FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND d.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND d.driverid = q.driverid WHERE r.year >= 1963 AND r.date <= '1950-01-01' AND res.positionorder <= 10 AND lt.milliseconds IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM constructorstandings cs WHERE cs.raceid = r.raceid AND cs.constructorid = c.constructorid AND cs.points > '0' ) GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round, r.name, r.raceid HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 145603 ORDER BY total_points DESC, yearly_rank ASC LIMIT 126;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points, SUM(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid, r.year ORDER BY r.round) AS cumulative_points, AVG(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid, r.year) AS avg_points_per_race FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid WHERE r.year = 1993 AND (res.grid <= 1 OR res.positionorder <= 10) AND NOT (res.points = 0 AND res.positionorder > 25) AND r.date >= '1950-01-01' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round, r.name, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY cumulative_points DESC, r.round ASC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points, SUM(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid, r.year ORDER BY r.round) AS cumulative_points, AVG(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid, r.year) AS avg_points_per_race, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid, r.year) AS races_entered FROM drivers d INNER JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid INNER JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid INNER JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON res.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON res.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid WHERE r.year = 2011 AND res.points >= '0' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round, r.name, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points HAVING COUNT(lt.lap) > 38 OR COUNT(ps.stop) > 1 ORDER BY cumulative_points DESC, avg_points_per_race DESC LIMIT 84;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position AS lap_position, ps.stop AS pit_stop_number, ps.lap AS pit_stop_lap, ds.position AS championship_position, ds.wins AS season_wins FROM drivers d INNER JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid INNER JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid INNER JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON res.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON res.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN driverstandings ds ON res.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid WHERE r.year = 2019 AND res.points >= '0' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round, r.name, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position, ps.stop, ps.lap, ds.position, ds.wins HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) > 7 ORDER BY res.points DESC, ds.position ASC LIMIT 100;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position AS lap_position, ps.stop, ps.duration, q.position AS qualifying_position, ds.position AS driver_standing_position, cs.position AS constructor_standing_position, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM laptimes lt2 WHERE lt2.raceid = r.raceid AND lt2.driverid = d.driverid AND lt2.milliseconds < 86254) AS laps_faster_than_threshold, (SELECT AVG(points) FROM results res2 WHERE res2.raceid IN (SELECT raceid FROM races WHERE year = r.year) AND res2.driverid = d.driverid) AS avg_points_per_season, (SELECT SUM(wins) FROM driverstandings ds2 WHERE ds2.raceid = r.raceid AND ds2.driverid = d.driverid) AS total_wins_up_to_race FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits cct ON r.circuitid = cct.circuitid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND d.driverid = ps.driverid JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND d.driverid = q.driverid JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND d.driverid = ds.driverid JOIN constructorstandings cs ON r.raceid = cs.raceid AND c.constructorid = cs.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 2017 AND r.year <= 2016 AND cct.country = 'UK' AND res.points > '0' AND lt.milliseconds IS NOT NULL AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM results res3 WHERE res3.raceid = r.raceid AND res3.positionorder <= 9) > 8 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round, r.name, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position, ps.stop, ps.duration, q.position, ds.position, cs.position, r.raceid HAVING SUM(res.points) > '50' AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 128087 ORDER BY total_wins_up_to_race DESC, avg_points_per_season DESC LIMIT 830;

SELECT r.year, c.name AS constructor_name, COUNT(DISTINCT res.raceid) AS races_entered, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(res.positionorder) AS avg_finish_position, MAX(ds.wins) AS max_wins_in_season FROM results res JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN driverstandings ds ON res.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid WHERE r.year >= 2022 AND res.points > '0.0' GROUP BY r.year, c.constructorid, c.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '50.0' AND AVG(res.positionorder) < 15 ORDER BY r.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT c.circuitid, c.name AS circuit_name, c.country, r.year, r.round, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.driverid) AS unique_drivers_lapped, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.driverid) AS unique_drivers_pitted, COUNT(DISTINCT q.driverid) AS unique_drivers_qualified, COUNT(DISTINCT res.driverid) AS unique_drivers_finished, SUM(cr.points) AS total_constructor_points, AVG(ds.points) AS avg_driver_points, SUM(lt.milliseconds) / 1000.0 AS total_lap_time_seconds, SUM(ps.milliseconds) / 1000.0 AS total_pitstop_time_seconds FROM circuits c JOIN races r ON c.circuitid = r.circuitid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND lt.driverid = ps.driverid AND lt.lap = ps.lap JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND lt.driverid = q.driverid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid AND lt.driverid = res.driverid JOIN constructorresults cr ON r.raceid = cr.raceid JOIN constructors con ON cr.constructorid = con.constructorid AND res.constructorid = con.constructorid JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND lt.driverid = ds.driverid JOIN drivers d ON lt.driverid = d.driverid JOIN status s ON res.statusid = s.statusid WHERE r.year >= 1999 AND r.year <= 1950 AND r.date >= '1950-01-01' AND r.date <= '1950-01-01' AND lt.milliseconds > 190308 AND ps.milliseconds > 53061 AND cr.points > '0.0' AND ds.points > '0.0' GROUP BY c.circuitid, c.name, c.country, r.year, r.round HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lt.driverid) > 42 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ps.driverid) > 5 AND COUNT(DISTINCT q.driverid) > 49 AND COUNT(DISTINCT res.driverid) > 14 AND SUM(cr.points) > '10.0' AND AVG(ds.points) > '1.0' ORDER BY r.year DESC, r.round DESC, total_constructor_points DESC;

SELECT c.circuitid, c.name AS circuit_name, c.country, r.year, r.round, d.driverid, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, con.name AS constructor_name, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, MIN(lt.milliseconds) AS fastest_lap_ms, MAX(lt.milliseconds) AS slowest_lap_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) AS total_laps_analyzed, SUM(res.points) AS total_points_scored, AVG(res.grid) AS avg_starting_grid, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pit_stops, SUM(ps.milliseconds) AS total_pit_time_ms, AVG(q.position) AS avg_qualifying_position, SUM(cr.points) AS constructor_points, SUM(cs.wins) AS constructor_wins, SUM(ds.wins) AS driver_wins, COUNT(DISTINCT res.statusid) AS distinct_statuses FROM circuits c JOIN races r ON c.circuitid = r.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND res.driverid = q.driverid AND res.constructorid = q.constructorid LEFT JOIN constructorresults cr ON r.raceid = cr.raceid AND res.constructorid = cr.constructorid LEFT JOIN constructorstandings cs ON r.raceid = cs.raceid AND res.constructorid = cs.constructorid LEFT JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid LEFT JOIN status s ON res.statusid = s.statusid WHERE r.year >= 1962 AND r.year <= 1998 AND c.lat >= '-90.0' AND c.lat <= '-90.0' AND c.lng >= '-180.0' AND c.lng <= '-180.0' AND d.dob >= '1900-01-01' AND d.dob <= '1900-01-01' AND res.grid >= 26 AND res.grid <= 26 AND lt.milliseconds >= 284236 AND lt.milliseconds <= 84581 GROUP BY c.circuitid, c.name, c.country, r.year, r.round, d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, con.name HAVING AVG(lt.milliseconds) <= 297932 AND SUM(res.points) >= '0.0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) >= 65 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) <= 8 ORDER BY r.year DESC, r.round DESC, total_points_scored DESC, avg_lap_time_ms ASC;

SELECT c.circuitid, c.name AS circuit_name, r.year, r.round, d.driverid, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, con.constructorid, con.name AS constructor_name, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, MIN(lt.milliseconds) AS fastest_lap_ms, MAX(lt.milliseconds) AS slowest_lap_ms, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) AS laps_analyzed, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops, AVG(ps.milliseconds) AS avg_pitstop_ms, SUM(cs.wins) AS constructor_wins, SUM(ds.wins) AS driver_wins, AVG(q.position) AS avg_qualifying_position, MIN(q.position) AS best_qualifying_position FROM circuits c JOIN races r ON c.circuitid = r.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN constructorstandings cs ON r.raceid = cs.raceid AND con.constructorid = cs.constructorid LEFT JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND d.driverid = ds.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND res.driverid = q.driverid AND res.constructorid = q.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 1965 AND r.year <= 2009 AND res.points > '0' AND lt.milliseconds > 234132 AND cs.wins >= 9 GROUP BY c.circuitid, c.name, r.year, r.round, d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, con.constructorid, con.name HAVING AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 176618 AND SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_lap_time_ms ASC LIMIT 100;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) AS races_entered, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(res.positionorder) AS avg_finish_position FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 2011 AND r.year <= 2002 AND res.points > '0' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) >= 11 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(r.resultid) AS race_count, COALESCE(SUM(r.points), 0) AS total_points FROM drivers d LEFT JOIN results r ON d.driverid = r.driverid LEFT JOIN races rc ON r.raceid = rc.raceid WHERE rc.year >= 1954 OR rc.year IS NULL GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING COALESCE(SUM(r.points), 0) > '0' ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name AS constructor_name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name AS circuit_name, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position AS lap_position, lt.milliseconds AS lap_time_ms, ps.stop AS pit_stop_number, ps.lap AS pit_stop_lap, ps.milliseconds AS pit_stop_duration_ms, q.position AS qualifying_position, ds.points AS driver_standing_points, ds.position AS driver_standing_position, cs.points AS constructor_standing_points, cs.position AS constructor_standing_position, cr.points AS constructor_result_points, t.win, AVG(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid, r.year) AS avg_points_per_year, SUM(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY c.constructorid ORDER BY r.date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_constructor_points, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY r.circuitid) AS races_at_circuit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY res.points DESC) AS yearly_points_rank FROM drivers d INNER JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid INNER JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid INNER JOIN circuits cir ON r.circuitid = cir.circuitid INNER JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON res.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON res.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON res.raceid = q.raceid AND res.driverid = q.driverid AND res.constructorid = q.constructorid LEFT JOIN driverstandings ds ON res.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid LEFT JOIN constructorstandings cs ON res.raceid = cs.raceid AND res.constructorid = cs.constructorid LEFT JOIN constructorresults cr ON res.raceid = cr.raceid AND res.constructorid = cr.constructorid LEFT JOIN target t ON res.raceid = t.raceid AND res.driverid = t.driverid WHERE r.year >= 1981 AND r.year <= 1958 AND res.points > '0' AND (lt.milliseconds > 65131 OR lt.milliseconds IS NULL) AND (ps.milliseconds > 27185 OR ps.milliseconds IS NULL) AND cir.alt > 926 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position, lt.milliseconds, ps.stop, ps.lap, ps.milliseconds, q.position, ds.points, ds.position, cs.points, cs.position, cr.points, t.win, r.date, r.circuitid HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) >= 39 ORDER BY yearly_points_rank, running_constructor_points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) AS total_laps_led, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, MIN(ps.milliseconds) AS min_pitstop_ms, MAX(q.position) AS worst_qualifying, SUM(CASE WHEN res.positionorder = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wins, SUM(cr.points) AS constructor_points, SUM(cs.wins) AS constructor_wins FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits ci ON r.circuitid = ci.circuitid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON res.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON res.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON res.raceid = q.raceid AND res.driverid = q.driverid LEFT JOIN constructorresults cr ON res.raceid = cr.raceid AND res.constructorid = cr.constructorid LEFT JOIN constructorstandings cs ON res.raceid = cs.raceid AND res.constructorid = cs.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 2015 AND r.year <= 1979 AND ci.country = 'UK' AND res.grid <= 18 AND lt.position = 1 AND d.dob <= '1950-01-01' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name, r.year, r.round HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) >= 29 AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 90596 ORDER BY total_points DESC, wins DESC, total_laps_led DESC LIMIT 86;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) AS total_laps, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, MAX(ds.wins) AS max_wins_in_season, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops, AVG(ps.milliseconds) AS avg_pitstop_ms, MIN(q.position) AS best_qualifying, SUM(cr.points) AS constructor_points, AVG(cs.position) AS avg_constructor_position FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON d.driverid = lt.driverid AND res.raceid = lt.raceid JOIN pitstops ps ON d.driverid = ps.driverid AND res.raceid = ps.raceid JOIN qualifying q ON d.driverid = q.driverid AND res.raceid = q.raceid JOIN driverstandings ds ON d.driverid = ds.driverid AND res.raceid = ds.raceid JOIN constructorresults cr ON c.constructorid = cr.constructorid AND res.raceid = cr.raceid JOIN constructorstandings cs ON c.constructorid = cs.constructorid AND res.raceid = cs.raceid WHERE r.year >= 1984 AND r.date <= '1950-01-01' AND res.points > '0' AND lt.milliseconds < 93928 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round, r.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '10' AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 79318 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_lap_time_ms ASC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops, MAX(q.position) AS best_qualifying FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND d.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND d.driverid = q.driverid WHERE r.year >= 2015 AND r.date <= '1950-01-01' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round, r.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 159391 INTERSECT SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops, MAX(q.position) AS best_qualifying FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND d.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND d.driverid = q.driverid JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND d.driverid = ds.driverid WHERE r.circuitid IN (SELECT circuitid FROM circuits WHERE alt > 1097) GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round, r.name HAVING MAX(ds.wins) >= 13 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) <= 7 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_lap_time_ms ASC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN laptimes lt ON d.driverid = lt.driverid AND res.raceid = lt.raceid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON d.driverid = ps.driverid AND res.raceid = ps.raceid WHERE r.year >= 2002 AND r.date <= '2000-03-01' AND res.positionorder <= 2 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0.5' ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_lap_time_ms ASC LIMIT 100;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, CASE WHEN SUM(res.points) >= 185.14 THEN 'High Performer' WHEN SUM(res.points) >= 25.85 THEN 'Medium Performer' ELSE 'Low Performer' END AS performance_category FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid WHERE r.year = 2007 AND r.round >= 20 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > 2.64 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, res.positionorder, res.points, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM laptimes lt WHERE lt.raceid = r.raceid AND lt.driverid = d.driverid AND lt.position = 1) AS laps_led FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid WHERE r.year = 2012 AND res.points > '0' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name, res.positionorder, res.points, r.raceid HAVING SUM(res.points) > '10' ORDER BY SUM(res.points) DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, res.positionorder, res.points, SUM(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid, r.year ORDER BY r.round) AS cumulative_points FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid WHERE r.year = 2004 AND res.positionorder <= 16 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name, res.positionorder, res.points ORDER BY d.driverid, r.year, r.round;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM laptimes lt WHERE lt.raceid = r.raceid AND lt.driverid = d.driverid AND lt.position = 4) AS laps_in_position, SUM(res.points) AS total_points FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid WHERE r.year = 2023 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, r.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT r.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(*) AS race_count, SUM(r.points) AS total_points FROM results r JOIN drivers d ON r.driverid = d.driverid JOIN races rc ON r.raceid = rc.raceid WHERE r.points > 1.63 AND rc.year = 2009 GROUP BY r.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(r.points) > 347.27 INTERSECT SELECT r.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(*) AS race_count, SUM(r.points) AS total_points FROM results r JOIN drivers d ON r.driverid = d.driverid JOIN races rc ON r.raceid = rc.raceid WHERE r.grid <= 5 AND rc.year = 2015 GROUP BY r.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING COUNT(*) >= 21 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT r.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(*) AS race_count, SUM(r.points) AS total_points FROM results r JOIN drivers d ON r.driverid = d.driverid JOIN races rc ON r.raceid = rc.raceid WHERE r.points > 19.35 AND rc.year >= 2006 GROUP BY r.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(r.points) > 72.34 INTERSECT SELECT ds.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(DISTINCT ds.raceid) AS race_count, SUM(ds.points) AS total_points FROM driverstandings ds JOIN drivers d ON ds.driverid = d.driverid JOIN races rc ON ds.raceid = rc.raceid WHERE ds.points > 6.55 AND rc.year >= 2000 GROUP BY ds.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(ds.points) > 64.82 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, d.driverref, lt.lap, lt.position AS lap_position, lt.milliseconds, AVG(lt.milliseconds) OVER ( PARTITION BY lt.raceid, lt.driverid ORDER BY lt.lap ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_ms FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid JOIN drivers d ON lt.driverid = d.driverid WHERE r.year = 2006 AND lt.milliseconds > 79479 ORDER BY r.raceid, lt.driverid, lt.lap;

SELECT r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, con.name AS constructor_name, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points, AVG(res.points) OVER ( PARTITION BY res.driverid ORDER BY r.date ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS avg_points_moving, SUM(res.points) OVER ( PARTITION BY res.constructorid ORDER BY r.date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS cumulative_constructor_points, lt.lap, lt.position AS lap_position, ps.stop AS pit_stop_number, ps.duration AS pit_stop_duration, q.position AS qualifying_position FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND res.driverid = q.driverid AND res.constructorid = q.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 2007 AND r.date <= '2000-01-01' AND res.points > '0' AND (lt.milliseconds IS NULL OR lt.milliseconds < 81083) GROUP BY r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name, d.forename, d.surname, con.name, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position, ps.stop, ps.duration, q.position, r.date, res.driverid, res.constructorid HAVING AVG(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY r.date, res.positionorder;

SELECT r.year, c.country, con.nationality, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, COUNT(DISTINCT res.driverid) AS unique_drivers, AVG(res.positionorder) AS avg_finish_position FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 1978 AND r.year <= 2015 AND res.positionorder <= 10 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (r.year, c.country, con.nationality), (r.year, c.country), (r.year, con.nationality), (c.country, con.nationality), (r.year), (c.country), (con.nationality), () ) HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY r.year, c.country, con.nationality;

SELECT r.year, c.name AS constructor_name, AVG(res.points) AS avg_points_per_race, SUM(res.points) AS total_points FROM results res JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid WHERE r.year IN (SELECT year FROM seasons WHERE year > 2021) AND res.points > '0' GROUP BY r.year, c.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '50' ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT r.year, c.name AS constructor_name, COUNT(DISTINCT res.raceid) AS races_entered, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(res.positionorder) AS avg_finish_position, MAX(ds.wins) AS max_wins_in_season FROM constructors c JOIN results res ON c.constructorid = res.constructorid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN driverstandings ds ON res.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid WHERE r.year >= 2010 AND res.points > '0' GROUP BY r.year, c.constructorid, c.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '100' AND AVG(res.positionorder) < 5 ORDER BY total_points DESC, r.year ASC;

SELECT c.circuitid, c.name AS circuit_name, c.country, r.year, r.round, d.driverid, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, con.constructorid, con.name AS constructor_name, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) AS distinct_laps_driven, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS distinct_pit_stops, COUNT(DISTINCT q.position) AS distinct_qualifying_positions, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, MAX(ds.wins) AS max_wins_in_season, SUM(cr.points) AS total_constructor_points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year, c.circuitid ORDER BY SUM(res.points) DESC) AS driver_rank_per_circuit_year FROM circuits c JOIN races r ON c.circuitid = r.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND res.driverid = q.driverid AND res.constructorid = q.constructorid JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid JOIN constructorresults cr ON r.raceid = cr.raceid AND res.constructorid = cr.constructorid JOIN constructorstandings cs ON r.raceid = cs.raceid AND res.constructorid = cs.constructorid JOIN seasons s ON r.year = s.year WHERE r.year >= 2011 AND r.year <= 1978 AND res.grid <= 14 AND lt.milliseconds > 175088 AND d.dob >= '1950-01-01' GROUP BY c.circuitid, c.name, c.country, r.year, r.round, d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, con.constructorid, con.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) >= 1 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) <= 10 ORDER BY r.year DESC, r.round, total_points DESC, driver_rank_per_circuit_year;

SELECT c.circuitid, c.name AS circuit_name, r.year, r.round, d.driverid, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, con.constructorid, con.name AS constructor_name, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, MIN(lt.milliseconds) AS fastest_lap_ms, MAX(lt.milliseconds) AS slowest_lap_ms, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) AS laps_analyzed, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops, AVG(ps.milliseconds) AS avg_pitstop_ms, SUM(cs.wins) AS constructor_wins, SUM(ds.wins) AS driver_wins, AVG(q.position) AS avg_qualifying_position, MIN(q.position) AS best_qualifying_position FROM circuits c JOIN races r ON c.circuitid = r.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN constructorstandings cs ON r.raceid = cs.raceid AND con.constructorid = cs.constructorid LEFT JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND d.driverid = ds.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND res.driverid = q.driverid AND res.constructorid = q.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 2011 AND r.year <= 2022 AND res.points > '0' AND lt.milliseconds > 195748 AND cs.wins >= 4 GROUP BY c.circuitid, c.name, r.year, r.round, d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, con.constructorid, con.name HAVING AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 169886 AND SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_lap_time_ms ASC LIMIT 100;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name AS constructor_name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name AS circuit_name, COUNT(DISTINCT res.resultid) AS total_results, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(res.positionorder) AS avg_finish_position, MAX(ds.wins) AS max_wins_in_season, SUM(lt.milliseconds) / 1000.0 AS total_race_seconds, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops, AVG(q.position) AS avg_qualifying_position FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits cir ON r.circuitid = cir.circuitid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN driverstandings ds ON d.driverid = ds.driverid AND r.raceid = ds.raceid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON d.driverid = lt.driverid AND r.raceid = lt.raceid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON d.driverid = ps.driverid AND r.raceid = ps.raceid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON d.driverid = q.driverid AND r.raceid = q.raceid WHERE r.year >= 2019 AND r.year <= 1969 AND res.points > '0' AND cir.alt > 614 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '10' AND COUNT(DISTINCT res.resultid) >= 17 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_finish_position ASC LIMIT 505;
