SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name AS constructor_name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name AS circuit_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(res.positionorder) AS avg_finish_position, COUNT(DISTINCT res.raceid) AS races_entered, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN res.positionorder = 1 THEN res.raceid END) AS wins, SUM(lt.milliseconds) / 1000.0 AS total_race_seconds, AVG(ps.milliseconds) AS avg_pitstop_ms, MIN(q.position) AS best_qualifying, MAX(ds.wins) AS max_season_wins, SUM(cr.points) AS total_constructor_points FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits cir ON r.circuitid = cir.circuitid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON res.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON res.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON res.raceid = q.raceid AND res.driverid = q.driverid JOIN driverstandings ds ON res.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid JOIN constructorresults cr ON res.raceid = cr.raceid AND res.constructorid = cr.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 2004 AND r.year <= 2005 AND cir.country = 'UK' AND res.grid <= 14 AND res.points > '0' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '10' AND COUNT(DISTINCT res.raceid) >= 4 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_finish_position ASC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name AS constructor_name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name AS circuit_name, cir.country, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(res.positionorder) AS avg_finish_position, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) AS total_laps_led, MIN(ps.milliseconds) AS fastest_pitstop_ms, MAX(q.position) AS worst_qualifying, SUM(ds.wins) AS total_wins, SUM(cs.wins) AS constructor_wins, COUNT(DISTINCT res.resultid) AS races_finished, CORR(res.grid, res.positionorder) AS grid_finish_correlation FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits cir ON r.circuitid = cir.circuitid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON res.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid AND lt.position = 1 JOIN pitstops ps ON res.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid JOIN qualifying q ON res.raceid = q.raceid AND res.driverid = q.driverid JOIN driverstandings ds ON res.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid JOIN constructorstandings cs ON res.raceid = cs.raceid AND res.constructorid = cs.constructorid JOIN seasons s ON r.year = s.year WHERE r.year >= 1982 AND r.year <= 1988 AND res.positionorder IS NOT NULL AND res.positionorder <= 17 AND cir.alt >= 1521 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name, cir.country HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT res.resultid) >= 94 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_finish_position ASC LIMIT 342;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name AS constructor_name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name AS circuit_name, cir.country, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(res.positionorder) AS avg_finish_position, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) AS total_laps_raced, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops, MIN(lt.milliseconds) AS fastest_lap_ms, MAX(q.position) AS worst_qualifying, SUM(cr.points) AS constructor_points, SUM(ds.wins) AS driver_wins, SUM(cs.wins) AS constructor_wins, COUNT(DISTINCT res.resultid) AS races_finished, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY SUM(res.points) DESC) AS yearly_rank FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits cir ON r.circuitid = cir.circuitid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND d.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND d.driverid = q.driverid AND c.constructorid = q.constructorid LEFT JOIN constructorresults cr ON r.raceid = cr.raceid AND c.constructorid = cr.constructorid LEFT JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND d.driverid = ds.driverid LEFT JOIN constructorstandings cs ON r.raceid = cs.raceid AND c.constructorid = cs.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 1955 AND r.year <= 1986 AND cir.lat >= '-90.0' AND cir.lat <= '-90.0' AND res.points > '0.0' AND res.positionorder <= 17 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name, cir.country HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0.0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) > 47 AND AVG(res.positionorder) < 20 ORDER BY total_points DESC, yearly_rank, r.year, r.round LIMIT 238;

qualifying_position, ds.points AS driver_standing_points, ds.position AS driver_standing_position, ds.wins AS driver_wins, cs.points AS constructor_standing_points, cs.position AS constructor_standing_position, cs.wins AS constructor_wins, cr.points AS constructor_result_points, s.status, t.win, AVG(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid, r.year) AS avg_driver_points_per_year, SUM(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY c.constructorid, r.year ORDER BY r.date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_constructor_points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.raceid ORDER BY res.positionorder) AS race_finish_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY ds.points DESC) AS driver_championship_rank, LAG(res.positionorder, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid ORDER BY r.date) AS prev_race_position, LEAD(res.positionorder, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid ORDER BY r.date) AS next_race_position FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits cir ON r.circuitid = cir.circuitid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON res.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid JOIN pitstops ps ON res.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid JOIN qualifying q ON res.raceid = q.raceid AND res.driverid = q.driverid AND res.constructorid = q.constructorid JOIN driverstandings ds ON res.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid JOIN constructorstandings cs ON res.raceid = cs.raceid AND res.constructorid = cs.constructorid JOIN constructorresults cr ON res.raceid = cr.raceid AND res.constructorid = cr.constructorid JOIN status s ON res.statusid = s.statusid LEFT JOIN target t ON res.raceid = t.raceid AND res.driverid = t.driverid WHERE r.year >= 1981 AND r.year <= 2010 AND res.positionorder <= 4 AND res.grid <= 17 AND res.laps >= 189 AND res.milliseconds >= 74239852 AND lt.position <= 23 AND lt.milliseconds >= 179296 AND ps.milliseconds >= 13208 AND q.position <= 29 AND ds.points >= '0' AND cs.points >= '0' AND cr.points >= '0' AND cir.alt >= 1583 AND d.dob >= '1950-01-01' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name, res.positionorder, res.points, res.grid, res.laps, res.milliseconds, lt.lap, lt.position, lt.milliseconds, ps.stop, ps.lap, ps.milliseconds, q.position, ds.points, ds.position, ds.wins, cs.points, cs.position, cs.wins, cr.points, s.status, t.win, r.date HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 177533 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) >= 2 ORDER BY r.year DESC, r.round DESC, res.positionorder ASC, lt.lap ASC, ps.stop ASC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name AS constructor_name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name AS circuit_name, rs.points AS race_points, ds.points AS driver_standing_points, cs.points AS constructor_standing_points, cr.points AS constructor_result_points, (SELECT AVG(lt.milliseconds) FROM laptimes lt WHERE lt.raceid = r.raceid AND lt.driverid = d.driverid) AS avg_lap_time_ms, (SELECT COUNT(ps.stop) FROM pitstops ps WHERE ps.raceid = r.raceid AND ps.driverid = d.driverid) AS pitstop_count, (SELECT MIN(q.position) FROM qualifying q WHERE q.raceid = r.raceid AND q.driverid = d.driverid) AS best_qualifying_position, SUM(rs.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid, r.year ORDER BY r.round) AS cumulative_points_driver_year, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.raceid ORDER BY rs.points DESC) AS race_points_rank FROM drivers d JOIN results rs ON d.driverid = rs.driverid JOIN races r ON rs.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits cir ON r.circuitid = cir.circuitid JOIN constructors c ON rs.constructorid = c.constructorid LEFT JOIN driverstandings ds ON rs.raceid = ds.raceid AND rs.driverid = ds.driverid LEFT JOIN constructorstandings cs ON rs.raceid = cs.raceid AND rs.constructorid = cs.constructorid LEFT JOIN constructorresults cr ON rs.raceid = cr.raceid AND rs.constructorid = cr.constructorid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON rs.raceid = lt.raceid AND rs.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON rs.raceid = ps.raceid AND rs.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON rs.raceid = q.raceid AND rs.driverid = q.driverid WHERE r.year >= 1961 AND r.year <= 2008 AND rs.points > '0' AND cir.alt > 605 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name, rs.points, ds.points, cs.points, cr.points HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) > 26 AND AVG(ps.milliseconds) < 167148 ORDER BY r.year DESC, r.round DESC, race_points_rank;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, rc.name AS race_name, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) AS total_laps_raced, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, MIN(ps.milliseconds) AS min_pitstop_ms, MAX(q.position) AS worst_qualifying, SUM(cs.wins) AS constructor_wins, SUM(ds.wins) AS driver_wins, COUNT(DISTINCT t.win) AS target_wins FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits rc ON r.circuitid = rc.circuitid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON d.driverid = lt.driverid AND res.raceid = lt.raceid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON d.driverid = ps.driverid AND res.raceid = ps.raceid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON d.driverid = q.driverid AND res.raceid = q.raceid LEFT JOIN constructorstandings cs ON c.constructorid = cs.constructorid AND res.raceid = cs.raceid LEFT JOIN driverstandings ds ON d.driverid = ds.driverid AND res.raceid = ds.raceid LEFT JOIN target t ON d.driverid = t.driverid AND res.raceid = t.raceid WHERE r.year >= 2001 AND r.year <= 2001 AND res.points > '0' AND lt.milliseconds < 96105 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name, r.year, r.round, rc.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '10' AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 62291 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_lap_time_ms ASC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) AS races_entered, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lp.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(ps.stop) AS total_pitstops FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lp ON r.raceid = lp.raceid AND d.driverid = lp.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND d.driverid = ps.driverid WHERE r.year IN (SELECT year FROM seasons WHERE year >= 1984 AND year <= 2019) AND res.positionorder <= 12 AND r.date >= '1950-01-01' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) >= 11 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_lap_time_ms ASC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON d.driverid = lt.driverid AND res.raceid = lt.raceid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON d.driverid = ps.driverid AND res.raceid = ps.raceid WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM constructorstandings cs WHERE cs.constructorid = c.constructorid AND cs.raceid = r.raceid AND cs.points > 36.78 ) AND r.date >= '2000-01-01' AND r.date <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round, r.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > 65.62 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_lap_time_ms ASC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops, MAX(ds.wins) AS max_wins_in_season, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY SUM(res.points) DESC) AS yearly_rank FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON d.driverid = lt.driverid AND res.raceid = lt.raceid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON d.driverid = ps.driverid AND res.raceid = ps.raceid JOIN driverstandings ds ON d.driverid = ds.driverid AND res.raceid = ds.raceid WHERE r.year >= 1991 AND r.date <= '1950-01-01' AND res.grid <= 8 AND lt.milliseconds < 96238 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM qualifying q WHERE q.raceid = r.raceid AND q.driverid = d.driverid AND q.position <= 10 ) GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round, r.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) >= 9 ORDER BY total_points DESC, yearly_rank LIMIT 881;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops, MAX(ds.wins) AS max_wins_in_season, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY SUM(res.points) DESC) AS yearly_rank FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON d.driverid = lt.driverid AND res.raceid = lt.raceid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON d.driverid = ps.driverid AND res.raceid = ps.raceid JOIN driverstandings ds ON d.driverid = ds.driverid AND res.raceid = ds.raceid WHERE r.year >= 2003 AND r.date <= '1950-01-01' AND res.grid <= 9 AND lt.position <= 23 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM qualifying q WHERE q.driverid = d.driverid AND q.raceid = r.raceid AND q.position <= 13 ) GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round, r.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 136785 ORDER BY total_points DESC, yearly_rank ASC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops, MAX(q.position) AS best_qualifying FROM drivers d INNER JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid INNER JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid INNER JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND d.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND d.driverid = q.driverid WHERE r.year >= 2018 AND r.year <= 2003 AND res.positionorder <= 6 AND (lt.milliseconds IS NULL OR lt.milliseconds > 74667) GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round, r.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) >= 2 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_lap_time_ms ASC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) AS races_participated, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(res.positionorder) AS avg_finish_position FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid WHERE r.year >= 1996 AND c.country = 'Monaco' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year HAVING SUM(res.points) > '10' ORDER BY total_points DESC, r.year, d.surname;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND d.driverid = ps.driverid WHERE r.year = 1965 AND res.grid <= 23 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_lap_time_ms ASC LIMIT 50;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, res.positionorder, res.points, AVG(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY r.year, d.driverid) AS avg_points_per_season, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY SUM(res.points) DESC) AS season_rank FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 1964 AND r.year <= 1971 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name, res.positionorder, res.points HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY r.year, season_rank, d.surname;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, res.positionorder, res.points, SUM(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid ORDER BY r.date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_points, AVG(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid, r.year) AS avg_points_per_season, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.raceid ORDER BY res.positionorder) AS race_finish_rank FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 1994 AND r.year <= 2022 AND res.points > '0' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name, res.positionorder, res.points, r.date, r.raceid ORDER BY d.driverid, r.date;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, res.positionorder, res.points, SUM(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid ORDER BY r.date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_total_points, AVG(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid, r.year) AS avg_points_per_season FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 1980 AND res.positionorder <= 4 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name, res.positionorder, res.points, r.date ORDER BY d.driverid, r.date;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN laptimes lt ON d.driverid = lt.driverid AND res.raceid = lt.raceid WHERE r.year = 2000 AND res.points > '0' AND lt.lap IN (SELECT lap FROM laptimes WHERE milliseconds < 104184) GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, r.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '10' ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_lap_time_ms ASC;

SELECT d1.driverid AS driver1_id, d1.forename AS driver1_forename, d1.surname AS driver1_surname, d2.driverid AS driver2_id, d2.forename AS driver2_forename, d2.surname AS driver2_surname, r.year, r.name AS race_name, AVG(lt1.milliseconds - lt2.milliseconds) AS avg_time_diff_ms FROM laptimes lt1 JOIN laptimes lt2 ON lt1.raceid = lt2.raceid AND lt1.lap = lt2.lap JOIN drivers d1 ON lt1.driverid = d1.driverid JOIN drivers d2 ON lt2.driverid = d2.driverid JOIN races r ON lt1.raceid = r.raceid WHERE lt1.driverid < lt2.driverid AND lt1.milliseconds > lt2.milliseconds AND r.year = 1982 AND lt1.lap BETWEEN 16 AND 15 GROUP BY d1.driverid, d1.forename, d1.surname, d2.driverid, d2.forename, d2.surname, r.year, r.name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 7 ORDER BY avg_time_diff_ms DESC;

SELECT d1.driverid AS driver1_id, d1.forename AS driver1_forename, d1.surname AS driver1_surname, d2.driverid AS driver2_id, d2.forename AS driver2_forename, d2.surname AS driver2_surname, r.year, r.name AS race_name, AVG(lt1.milliseconds - lt2.milliseconds) AS avg_time_diff_ms FROM laptimes lt1 JOIN laptimes lt2 ON lt1.raceid = lt2.raceid AND lt1.lap = lt2.lap JOIN drivers d1 ON lt1.driverid = d1.driverid JOIN drivers d2 ON lt2.driverid = d2.driverid JOIN races r ON lt1.raceid = r.raceid WHERE lt1.driverid < lt2.driverid AND r.year = 2012 AND lt1.lap BETWEEN 3 AND 17 GROUP BY d1.driverid, d1.forename, d1.surname, d2.driverid, d2.forename, d2.surname, r.year, r.name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10 ORDER BY avg_time_diff_ms DESC;

SELECT d1.driverid AS driver1_id, d1.forename AS driver1_forename, d1.surname AS driver1_surname, d2.driverid AS driver2_id, d2.forename AS driver2_forename, d2.surname AS driver2_surname, r.year, r.name AS race_name, AVG(lt1.milliseconds - lt2.milliseconds) AS avg_time_diff_ms FROM laptimes lt1 JOIN laptimes lt2 ON lt1.raceid = lt2.raceid AND lt1.lap = lt2.lap JOIN drivers d1 ON lt1.driverid = d1.driverid JOIN drivers d2 ON lt2.driverid = d2.driverid JOIN races r ON lt1.raceid = r.raceid WHERE lt1.driverid < lt2.driverid AND r.year = 2019 AND lt1.lap BETWEEN 9 AND 17 GROUP BY d1.driverid, d1.forename, d1.surname, d2.driverid, d2.forename, d2.surname, r.year, r.name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 16 ORDER BY avg_time_diff_ms DESC;

SELECT d1.driverid AS driver1_id, d1.forename AS driver1_forename, d1.surname AS driver1_surname, d2.driverid AS driver2_id, d2.forename AS driver2_forename, d2.surname AS driver2_surname, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, AVG(lt1.milliseconds - lt2.milliseconds) AS avg_time_diff_ms, SUM(CASE WHEN res1.positionorder < res2.positionorder THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS driver1_wins_against_driver2, SUM(cr1.points) AS driver1_constructor_points, SUM(cr2.points) AS driver2_constructor_points, COUNT(DISTINCT lt1.lap) AS total_laps_compared, CORR(lt1.position, lt2.position) AS lap_position_correlation FROM laptimes lt1 JOIN laptimes lt2 ON lt1.raceid = lt2.raceid AND lt1.lap = lt2.lap AND lt1.driverid < lt2.driverid JOIN drivers d1 ON lt1.driverid = d1.driverid JOIN drivers d2 ON lt2.driverid = d2.driverid JOIN races r ON lt1.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid LEFT JOIN results res1 ON lt1.raceid = res1.raceid AND lt1.driverid = res1.driverid LEFT JOIN results res2 ON lt2.raceid = res2.raceid AND lt2.driverid = res2.driverid LEFT JOIN constructorresults cr1 ON res1.raceid = cr1.raceid AND res1.constructorid = cr1.constructorid LEFT JOIN constructorresults cr2 ON res2.raceid = cr2.raceid AND res2.constructorid = cr2.constructorid WHERE r.year BETWEEN 1988 AND 1990 AND lt1.milliseconds IS NOT NULL AND lt2.milliseconds IS NOT NULL AND c.alt > 695 GROUP BY d1.driverid, d1.forename, d1.surname, d2.driverid, d2.forename, d2.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name HAVING COUNT(lt1.lap) > 10 AND AVG(lt1.milliseconds - lt2.milliseconds) > 8006 ORDER BY avg_time_diff_ms DESC, driver1_wins_against_driver2 DESC LIMIT 60;

SELECT r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, c.country AS circuit_country, d.driverid, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, con.name AS constructor_name, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points, res.laps, res.milliseconds AS result_ms, lt.lap, lt.position AS lap_position, lt.milliseconds AS lap_ms, ps.stop, ps.lap AS pit_lap, ps.milliseconds AS pit_ms, q.position AS qualifying_position, ds.points AS driver_standing_points, ds.wins AS driver_standing_wins, cs.points AS constructor_standing_points, cs.wins AS constructor_standing_wins, AVG(lt.milliseconds) OVER ( PARTITION BY r.raceid, d.driverid ORDER BY lt.lap ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_lap_ms, SUM(res.points) OVER ( PARTITION BY r.year, d.driverid ORDER BY r.date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS cumulative_points_season FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND res.driverid = q.driverid AND res.constructorid = q.constructorid LEFT JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid LEFT JOIN constructorstandings cs ON r.raceid = cs.raceid AND res.constructorid = cs.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 2010 AND r.year <= 2007 AND res.points > '0' AND (lt.milliseconds IS NULL OR lt.milliseconds < 71748) AND (ps.milliseconds IS NULL OR ps.milliseconds > 37651) AND (q.position IS NULL OR q.position <= 18) AND (ds.position IS NULL OR ds.position < 12) AND (cs.position IS NULL OR cs.position < 12) GROUP BY r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name, c.country, d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, con.name, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points, res.laps, res.milliseconds, lt.lap, lt.position, lt.milliseconds, ps.stop, ps.lap, ps.milliseconds, q.position, ds.points, ds.wins, cs.points, cs.wins HAVING COUNT(lt.lap) > 26 AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 104251 ORDER BY r.year DESC, r.round DESC, cumulative_points_season DESC;

SELECT r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, d.driverid, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, con.name AS constructor_name, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position AS lap_position, lt.milliseconds AS lap_time_ms, ps.stop AS pit_stop_number, ps.lap AS pit_stop_lap, ps.milliseconds AS pit_stop_duration_ms, q.position AS qualifying_position, ds.points AS driver_standing_points, ds.wins AS driver_standing_wins, cs.points AS constructor_standing_points, cs.wins AS constructor_standing_wins, AVG(lt.milliseconds) OVER ( PARTITION BY r.raceid, d.driverid ORDER BY lt.lap ROWS BETWEEN 4 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_lap_time, SUM(res.points) OVER ( PARTITION BY r.year, con.constructorid ORDER BY r.date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS cumulative_constructor_points, RANK() OVER ( PARTITION BY r.raceid ORDER BY res.positionorder ) AS race_finish_rank FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND res.driverid = q.driverid AND res.constructorid = q.constructorid LEFT JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid LEFT JOIN constructorstandings cs ON r.raceid = cs.raceid AND res.constructorid = cs.constructorid LEFT JOIN constructorresults cr ON r.raceid = cr.raceid AND res.constructorid = cr.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 1995 AND r.year <= 1986 AND res.positionorder <= 11 AND lt.milliseconds > 85300 AND (ps.milliseconds IS NULL OR ps.milliseconds < 43460) GROUP BY r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name, d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, con.name, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position, lt.milliseconds, ps.stop, ps.lap, ps.milliseconds, q.position, ds.points, ds.wins, cs.points, cs.wins, r.date, con.constructorid HAVING AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 126448 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) > 17 ORDER BY r.year DESC, r.round DESC, cumulative_constructor_points DESC;

SELECT r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, d.driverid, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, lt.lap, lt.position AS lap_position, lt.milliseconds, AVG(lt.milliseconds) OVER ( PARTITION BY lt.raceid, lt.driverid ORDER BY lt.lap ROWS BETWEEN 8 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_milliseconds FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid JOIN drivers d ON lt.driverid = d.driverid WHERE r.year = 2015 AND r.round = 21 ORDER BY r.raceid, d.driverid, lt.lap;

SELECT r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, d.driverid, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, res.positionorder, res.points, AVG(res.points) OVER ( PARTITION BY r.year, d.driverid ORDER BY r.date ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_points_last_3_races FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 2015 AND r.year <= 2005 AND res.positionorder <= 10 AND d.dob >= '1970-01-01' GROUP BY r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name, d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, res.positionorder, res.points, r.date HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY r.year, r.round, moving_avg_points_last_3_races DESC;

SELECT r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, d.driverref, lt.lap, lt.position AS lap_position, lt.milliseconds, AVG(lt.milliseconds) OVER ( PARTITION BY lt.raceid, lt.driverid ORDER BY lt.lap ROWS BETWEEN 4 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_ms FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid JOIN drivers d ON lt.driverid = d.driverid WHERE r.year = 2023 AND lt.milliseconds > 67904 ORDER BY r.raceid, lt.driverid, lt.lap;

SELECT r.year, c.country, con.nationality, COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) AS race_count, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid WHERE r.year >= 1989 AND r.year <= 1988 AND res.points > '0' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (r.year, c.country, con.nationality), (r.year, c.country), (r.year, con.nationality), (r.year), () ) ORDER BY r.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT r.year, c.name AS circuit_name, con.name AS constructor_name, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid WHERE r.year >= 1991 AND r.year <= 2018 GROUP BY r.year, c.circuitid, c.name, con.constructorid, con.name, d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY r.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT r.year, c.name AS constructor_name, COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) AS races_entered, COUNT(DISTINCT res.driverid) AS distinct_drivers, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(res.positionorder) AS avg_finish FROM constructors c JOIN results res ON c.constructorid = res.constructorid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid WHERE r.year >= 2016 AND res.points > '0' GROUP BY r.year, c.name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) > 2 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT r.year, c.name AS constructor_name, COUNT(DISTINCT res.raceid) AS races_entered, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(res.positionorder) AS avg_finish_position, MAX(ds.wins) AS max_wins_in_season FROM results res JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN driverstandings ds ON res.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid JOIN seasons s ON r.year = s.year WHERE r.year >= 2021 AND res.points > '0' GROUP BY r.year, c.constructorid, c.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '10' ORDER BY r.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT r.year, c.name AS constructor_name, COUNT(DISTINCT res.raceid) AS races_entered, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(res.positionorder) AS avg_finish_position, MAX(ds.wins) AS max_wins_in_season FROM results res JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN driverstandings ds ON res.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid JOIN seasons s ON r.year = s.year WHERE r.year >= 2022 AND res.points > '0' GROUP BY r.year, c.constructorid, c.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '10' ORDER BY r.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT r.year, c.name AS constructor_name, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, COUNT(DISTINCT res.raceid) AS races_entered, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(ps.stop) AS total_pitstops FROM results res JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON res.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON res.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid WHERE r.year >= 2005 AND res.points > '0' AND d.dob >= '1980-01-01' GROUP BY r.year, c.constructorid, c.name, d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(res.points) > '10' ORDER BY r.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT r.year, r.name AS race_name, c.name AS circuit_name, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, con.name AS constructor_name, res.positionorder, res.points, AVG(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY r.year, con.constructorid) AS avg_constructor_points_per_year, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY res.points DESC) AS yearly_points_rank FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 2018 AND r.year <= 1993 AND res.positionorder <= 4 GROUP BY r.year, r.name, c.name, d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, con.constructorid, con.name, res.positionorder, res.points HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY r.year DESC, yearly_points_rank;

SELECT r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, con.name AS constructor_name, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position AS lap_position, ps.stop AS pit_stop_number, ps.lap AS pit_stop_lap, q.position AS qualifying_position, ds.wins AS driver_wins, cs.wins AS constructor_wins FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND res.driverid = q.driverid AND res.constructorid = q.constructorid LEFT JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid LEFT JOIN constructorstandings cs ON r.raceid = cs.raceid AND res.constructorid = cs.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 2018 AND r.year <= 2017 AND res.points > '0' AND d.dob >= '1970-01-01' GROUP BY r.year, r.round, c.name, d.forename, d.surname, con.name, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position, ps.stop, ps.lap, q.position, ds.wins, cs.wins HAVING AVG(lt.position) < 3 OR AVG(lt.position) IS NULL ORDER BY r.year DESC, r.round, res.points DESC;

SELECT c.circuitid, c.name AS circuit_name, c.country, r.year, r.round, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.driverid) AS unique_drivers_lapped, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.driverid) AS unique_drivers_pitted, COUNT(DISTINCT q.driverid) AS unique_drivers_qualified, COUNT(DISTINCT res.driverid) AS unique_drivers_finished, COUNT(DISTINCT ds.driverid) AS unique_drivers_standing, COUNT(DISTINCT cs.constructorid) AS unique_constructors_standing, SUM(res.points) AS total_points_awarded, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, SUM(ps.milliseconds) AS total_pitstop_ms, MAX(ds.wins) AS max_driver_wins, MAX(cs.wins) AS max_constructor_wins FROM circuits c JOIN races r ON c.circuitid = r.circuitid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND lt.driverid = ps.driverid AND lt.lap = ps.lap LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid LEFT JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid AND q.driverid = res.driverid AND q.constructorid = res.constructorid LEFT JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid LEFT JOIN constructorstandings cs ON r.raceid = cs.raceid AND res.constructorid = cs.constructorid LEFT JOIN constructorresults cr ON r.raceid = cr.raceid AND cs.constructorid = cr.constructorid LEFT JOIN drivers d ON lt.driverid = d.driverid LEFT JOIN constructors con ON q.constructorid = con.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 2011 AND r.date <= '1950-01-01' AND c.alt >= 435 GROUP BY c.circuitid, c.name, c.country, r.year, r.round HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lt.driverid) > 25 AND SUM(res.points) >= '0' ORDER BY r.year DESC, r.round ASC, total_points_awarded DESC;

ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND res.driverid = q.driverid AND res.constructorid = q.constructorid LEFT JOIN constructorresults SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, SUM(r.points) AS total_points, COUNT(r.resultid) AS races_finished FROM drivers d JOIN results r ON d.driverid = r.driverid WHERE r.positionorder <= 4 AND r.points > '0.0' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING COUNT(r.resultid) >= 44 UNION ALL SELECT c.constructorid, c.name, NULL AS surname, SUM(cs.points) AS total_points, COUNT(cs.constructorstandingsid) AS races_count FROM constructors c JOIN constructorstandings cs ON c.constructorid = cs.constructorid WHERE cs.position <= 6 AND cs.points > '0.0' GROUP BY c.constructorid, c.name HAVING COUNT(cs.constructorstandingsid) >= 15 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name AS constructor_name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name AS circuit_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(res.positionorder) AS avg_finish_position, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) AS total_laps_led, MAX(ps.stop) AS max_pit_stops_in_race, MIN(q.position) AS best_qualifying FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits cir ON r.circuitid = cir.circuitid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON res.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid AND lt.position = 1 LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON res.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON res.raceid = q.raceid AND res.driverid = q.driverid WHERE r.year >= 1981 AND r.date <= '1950-01-01' AND res.grid <= 3 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND AVG(res.positionorder) < 26 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_finish_position ASC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position AS lap_position, ps.stop AS pit_stop_number, ps.duration AS pit_stop_duration, q.position AS qualifying_position, ds.position AS driver_standing_position, cs.position AS constructor_standing_position, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM laptimes lt2 WHERE lt2.raceid = r.raceid AND lt2.driverid = d.driverid AND lt2.milliseconds < 83426) AS laps_faster_than_threshold, (SELECT AVG(points) FROM results res2 WHERE res2.raceid = r.raceid AND res2.driverid = d.driverid AND res2.points > '0.0') AS avg_points_above_threshold FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits cct ON r.circuitid = cct.circuitid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND d.driverid = ps.driverid JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND d.driverid = q.driverid JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND d.driverid = ds.driverid JOIN constructorstandings cs ON r.raceid = cs.raceid AND c.constructorid = cs.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 2021 AND r.year <= 2009 AND cct.country = 'UK' AND res.positionorder <= 9 AND lt.lap BETWEEN 10 AND 63 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round, r.name, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position, ps.stop, ps.duration, q.position, ds.position, cs.position, r.raceid HAVING SUM(res.points) > '5.0' AND AVG(lt.position) < 5 ORDER BY r.year DESC, r.round DESC, SUM(res.points) DESC, AVG(lt.position) ASC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.raceid, r.name AS race_name, r.date, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position AS lap_position, ps.stop AS pit_stop_number, ps.duration AS pit_stop_duration FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND d.driverid = ps.driverid WHERE r.date BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2000-01-01' AND res.positionorder <= 10 AND lt.milliseconds > 64167 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.raceid, r.name, r.date, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position, ps.stop, ps.duration HAVING SUM(res.points) > 22.99 ORDER BY r.date DESC, res.positionorder ASC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, res.positionorder, res.points, AVG(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY r.year, d.driverid ORDER BY r.round) AS avg_points_running, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY SUM(res.points) DESC) AS yearly_rank FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid WHERE r.year >= 2022 AND r.year <= 1958 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name, res.positionorder, res.points HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY r.year, r.round, yearly_rank;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, res.positionorder, res.points, SUM(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid, r.year ORDER BY r.date) AS cumulative_points_season, AVG(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid, r.year) AS avg_points_season, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.raceid ORDER BY res.points DESC) AS race_points_rank FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid WHERE r.year = 2023 AND res.points > '0' ORDER BY d.driverid, r.date;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN laptimes lt ON d.driverid = lt.driverid AND res.raceid = lt.raceid WHERE r.year = 2021 AND res.points > '0' AND lt.lap IN (SELECT lap FROM laptimes WHERE milliseconds < 109354) GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, r.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '10' ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_lap_time_ms ASC;

SELECT d1.driverid AS driver1_id, d1.forename AS driver1_forename, d1.surname AS driver1_surname, d2.driverid AS driver2_id, d2.forename AS driver2_forename, d2.surname AS driver2_surname, r.year, r.name AS race_name, AVG(lt1.milliseconds - lt2.milliseconds) AS avg_time_diff_ms FROM laptimes lt1 JOIN laptimes lt2 ON lt1.raceid = lt2.raceid AND lt1.lap = lt2.lap JOIN drivers d1 ON lt1.driverid = d1.driverid JOIN drivers d2 ON lt2.driverid = d2.driverid JOIN races r ON lt1.raceid = r.raceid WHERE lt1.driverid < lt2.driverid AND lt1.milliseconds > lt2.milliseconds AND r.year = 1955 AND lt1.lap BETWEEN 62 AND 24 GROUP BY d1.driverid, d1.forename, d1.surname, d2.driverid, d2.forename, d2.surname, r.year, r.name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 ORDER BY avg_time_diff_ms DESC;

SELECT r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, d.driverref, d.nationality AS driver_nationality, con.name AS constructor_name, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points, AVG(res.points) OVER ( PARTITION BY r.circuitid, d.driverid ORDER BY r.date ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS avg_points_last_3_races FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 2010 AND r.year <= 2021 AND res.positionorder <= 10 AND res.grid <= 11 GROUP BY r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name, d.driverref, d.nationality, con.name, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points, r.circuitid, d.driverid, r.date HAVING AVG(res.points) > '0.0' ORDER BY r.year, r.round, avg_points_last_3_races DESC;

SELECT r.year, c.country, con.nationality, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, COUNT(DISTINCT res.driverid) AS unique_drivers, AVG(res.positionorder) AS avg_finish FROM races r JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 1995 AND r.year <= 1958 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (r.year, c.country, con.nationality), (r.year, c.country), (r.year, con.nationality), (c.country, con.nationality), (r.year), (c.country), (con.nationality), () ) HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY r.year, c.country, con.nationality;

SELECT r.year, c.name AS circuit_name, con.name AS constructor_name, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, res.positionorder, res.points, ds.wins, lt.lap, lt.position AS lap_position, ps.duration AS pitstop_duration, q.position AS qualifying_position FROM races r INNER JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid INNER JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid INNER JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid INNER JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid LEFT JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid AND lt.lap = ps.lap LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND res.driverid = q.driverid AND res.constructorid = q.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 1994 AND r.year <= 1983 AND res.points > '0' GROUP BY r.year, c.circuitid, con.constructorid, d.driverid, res.positionorder, res.points, ds.wins, lt.lap, lt.position, ps.duration, q.position HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY r.year DESC, SUM(res.points) DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, con.name AS constructor_name, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position AS lap_position, ps.stop AS pit_stop_number, ps.lap AS pit_stop_lap, q.position AS qualifying_position, ds.wins AS driver_wins, cs.wins AS constructor_wins FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND res.driverid = q.driverid AND res.constructorid = q.constructorid LEFT JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid LEFT JOIN constructorstandings cs ON r.raceid = cs.raceid AND res.constructorid = cs.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 2004 AND r.year <= 2000 AND res.points > '0' AND d.dob >= '1970-01-01' GROUP BY r.year, r.round, c.name, d.forename, d.surname, con.name, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position, ps.stop, ps.lap, q.position, ds.wins, cs.wins HAVING AVG(lt.position) < 6 OR AVG(lt.position) IS NULL ORDER BY r.year DESC, r.round, res.points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) AS races_entered, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(res.positionorder) AS avg_finish_position, MAX(ds.wins) AS max_wins_in_season FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN driverstandings ds ON d.driverid = ds.driverid AND r.raceid = ds.raceid JOIN seasons s ON r.year = s.year WHERE r.year >= 2000 AND res.points > '0' AND d.dob <= '1950-01-01' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(res.points) > '10' ORDER BY total_points DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) AS races_participated, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid WHERE r.year = 2003 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM constructorstandings cs WHERE cs.constructorid = res.constructorid AND cs.raceid = r.raceid AND cs.position <= 3 ) GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY total_points DESC LIMIT 20;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(r.resultid) AS race_count, SUM(r.points) AS total_points, AVG(r.positionorder) AS avg_finish FROM drivers d JOIN results r ON d.driverid = r.driverid JOIN races rc ON r.raceid = rc.raceid WHERE rc.year >= 1954 AND rc.year <= 1958 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(r.points) > '0' ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name AS constructor_name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name AS circuit_name, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) AS distinct_laps_led, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS distinct_pit_stops, COUNT(DISTINCT q.position) AS distinct_qualifying_positions, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, MAX(ds.wins) AS max_wins_in_season, SUM(crs.points) AS constructor_points_total FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits cir ON r.circuitid = cir.circuitid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND d.driverid = ps.driverid JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND d.driverid = q.driverid AND c.constructorid = q.constructorid JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND d.driverid = ds.driverid JOIN constructorresults crs ON r.raceid = crs.raceid AND c.constructorid = crs.constructorid JOIN seasons s ON r.year = s.year WHERE r.year >= 1991 AND r.year <= 1996 AND cir.alt >= 855 AND res.grid <= 2 AND lt.position = 1 AND ps.milliseconds > 38311 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) >= 69 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) <= 3 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_lap_time_ms ASC LIMIT 100;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name AS constructor_name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name AS circuit_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops, MAX(q.position) AS best_qualifying, COUNT(DISTINCT ds.wins) AS total_wins, SUM(cr.points) AS constructor_points, AVG(lt2.position) AS avg_race_position FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits cir ON r.circuitid = cir.circuitid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND d.driverid = ps.driverid JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND d.driverid = q.driverid JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND d.driverid = ds.driverid JOIN constructorresults cr ON r.raceid = cr.raceid AND c.constructorid = cr.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt2 ON r.raceid = lt2.raceid AND d.driverid = lt2.driverid WHERE r.year >= 2018 AND r.year <= 1962 AND res.points > '0' AND lt.milliseconds < 135700 AND ps.lap > 59 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '10' AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 118002 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_lap_time_ms ASC LIMIT 1000;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name AS constructor_name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name AS circuit_name, res.positionorder, res.points, res.grid, res.laps, lt.lap, lt.position AS lap_position, lt.milliseconds AS lap_time_ms, ps.stop, ps.lap AS pit_lap, ps.milliseconds AS pit_time_ms, q.position AS qualifying_position, ds.points AS driver_standing_points, ds.wins AS driver_standing_wins, cs.points AS constructor_standing_points, cs.wins AS constructor_standing_wins, AVG(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid, r.year) AS avg_points_per_year, SUM(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY c.constructorid ORDER BY r.date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_constructor_points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.raceid ORDER BY res.positionorder) AS race_finish_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY ds.points DESC) AS yearly_driver_rank FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits cir ON r.circuitid = cir.circuitid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON res.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid JOIN pitstops ps ON res.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid JOIN qualifying q ON res.raceid = q.raceid AND res.driverid = q.driverid AND res.constructorid = q.constructorid JOIN driverstandings ds ON res.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid JOIN constructorstandings cs ON res.raceid = cs.raceid AND res.constructorid = cs.constructorid JOIN seasons s ON r.year = s.year WHERE r.year >= 2013 AND r.year <= 1996 AND res.positionorder <= 15 AND lt.lap >= 32 AND ps.stop >= 5 AND q.position <= 1 AND ds.points >= '0' AND cs.points >= '0' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name, res.positionorder, res.points, res.grid, res.laps, lt.lap, lt.position, lt.milliseconds, ps.stop, ps.lap, ps.milliseconds, q.position, ds.points, ds.wins, cs.points, cs.wins, r.date HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 160245 ORDER BY r.year DESC, r.round DESC, res.positionorder ASC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON d.driverid = lt.driverid AND res.raceid = lt.raceid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON d.driverid = ps.driverid AND res.raceid = ps.raceid JOIN qualifying q ON d.driverid = q.driverid AND res.raceid = q.raceid JOIN constructorstandings cs ON c.constructorid = cs.constructorid AND res.raceid = cs.raceid JOIN driverstandings ds ON d.driverid = ds.driverid AND res.raceid = ds.raceid WHERE r.year >= 2000 AND r.date <= '1950-01-01' AND res.grid <= 18 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 109787 INTERSECT SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON d.driverid = lt.driverid AND res.raceid = lt.raceid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON d.driverid = ps.driverid AND res.raceid = ps.raceid JOIN qualifying q ON d.driverid = q.driverid AND res.raceid = q.raceid JOIN constructorresults cr ON c.constructorid = cr.constructorid AND res.raceid = cr.raceid JOIN target t ON d.driverid = t.driverid AND res.raceid = t.raceid WHERE r.year >= 1975 AND r.date <= '1950-01-01' AND res.positionorder <= 11 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 140172 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_lap_time_ms ASC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops, CASE WHEN SUM(res.points) >= 199.38 THEN 'High Scorer' WHEN SUM(res.points) >= 96.31 THEN 'Medium Scorer' ELSE 'Low Scorer' END AS performance_category, CASE WHEN AVG(lt.milliseconds) <= 88166 THEN 'Fast Lap' WHEN AVG(lt.milliseconds) <= 100925 THEN 'Average Lap' ELSE 'Slow Lap' END AS lap_time_category, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY SUM(res.points) DESC) AS yearly_rank FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON d.driverid = lt.driverid AND res.raceid = lt.raceid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON d.driverid = ps.driverid AND res.raceid = ps.raceid JOIN qualifying q ON d.driverid = q.driverid AND res.raceid = q.raceid JOIN driverstandings ds ON d.driverid = ds.driverid AND res.raceid = ds.raceid WHERE r.year >= 2016 AND r.year <= 2020 AND res.grid <= 4 AND lt.lap >= 2 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round, r.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > 60.57 AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 179337 ORDER BY r.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops, MAX(q.position) AS best_qualifying, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM target t WHERE t.driverid = d.driverid AND t.raceid = r.raceid AND t.win = 1) AS target_wins FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND d.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND d.driverid = q.driverid WHERE r.year >= 1987 AND r.date <= '1950-01-01' AND res.points > '0' AND lt.milliseconds < 123323 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round, r.name, r.raceid HAVING SUM(res.points) > '10' AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 152129 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_lap_time_ms ASC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, COUNT(res.resultid) AS races_entered, AVG(res.positionorder) AS avg_finish, MAX(ds.wins) AS max_wins_in_season, SUM(CASE WHEN res.positionorder = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wins, SUM(CASE WHEN res.positionorder BETWEEN 1 AND 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS podiums, SUM(CASE WHEN res.positionorder > 10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS finishes_outside_top10, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM laptimes lt2 WHERE lt2.driverid = d.driverid AND lt2.position = 1) AS total_laps_led, (SELECT AVG(cs.points) FROM constructorstandings cs WHERE cs.constructorid = c.constructorid AND cs.raceid IN (SELECT raceid FROM races WHERE year = r.year)) AS avg_constructor_points_per_race FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN driverstandings ds ON d.driverid = ds.driverid AND r.raceid = ds.raceid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND d.driverid = ps.driverid JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND d.driverid = q.driverid AND c.constructorid = q.constructorid JOIN constructorresults cr ON r.raceid = cr.raceid AND c.constructorid = cr.constructorid JOIN seasons s ON r.year = s.year WHERE r.year >= 2009 AND r.year <= 1997 AND res.points > '0' AND ds.position <= 10 AND q.position <= 1 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, c.constructorid, r.year, r.round, r.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '10' AND COUNT(res.resultid) >= 4 AND AVG(res.positionorder) <= 10 ORDER BY total_points DESC, wins DESC, podiums DESC LIMIT 38;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY SUM(res.points) DESC) AS yearly_rank FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid WHERE r.year >= 1964 AND r.year <= 2008 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY r.year, yearly_rank, r.round;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, c.name AS circuit_name, res.positionorder, res.points, (SELECT AVG(sub.points) FROM (SELECT r2.year, res2.driverid, SUM(res2.points) AS points FROM results res2 JOIN races r2 ON res2.raceid = r2.raceid WHERE r2.year = r.year GROUP BY r2.year, res2.driverid) sub WHERE sub.driverid = d.driverid) AS avg_yearly_points FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 2016 AND res.positionorder <= 4 AND c.country = 'UK' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, r.name, c.name, res.positionorder, res.points HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY r.year DESC, r.round ASC, res.positionorder ASC;

SELECT r.year, c.name AS circuit_name, con.name AS constructor_name, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid WHERE r.year >= 2005 AND r.year <= 2009 GROUP BY r.year, c.circuitid, con.constructorid, d.driverid HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY r.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT r.year, c.name AS constructor_name, COUNT(DISTINCT res.raceid) AS races_entered, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(res.positionorder) AS avg_finish_position, MAX(ds.wins) AS max_wins_in_season FROM constructors c JOIN results res ON c.constructorid = res.constructorid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN driverstandings ds ON res.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid WHERE r.year >= 2007 AND res.points > '0' GROUP BY r.year, c.constructorid, c.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '10' ORDER BY total_points DESC, r.year ASC;

SELECT r.year, c.name AS constructor_name, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) AS distinct_laps_raced, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS distinct_pit_stops, COUNT(DISTINCT q.position) AS distinct_qualifying_positions, AVG(res.points) AS avg_points, SUM(ds.wins) AS total_wins FROM races r JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND res.driverid = q.driverid LEFT JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid WHERE r.year >= 2002 AND r.year <= 1998 AND res.positionorder <= 11 GROUP BY r.year, c.constructorid, c.name, d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING AVG(res.points) > '0.0' ORDER BY r.year DESC, total_wins DESC, avg_points DESC;

SELECT c.circuitid, c.name AS circuit_name, c.country, r.year, r.round, d.driverid, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, con.constructorid, con.name AS constructor_name, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) AS distinct_laps_driven, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS distinct_pit_stops, COUNT(DISTINCT q.position) AS distinct_qualifying_positions, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, MAX(ds.wins) AS max_wins_in_season, SUM(cr.points) AS total_constructor_points FROM circuits c JOIN races r ON c.circuitid = r.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND d.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND d.driverid = q.driverid LEFT JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND d.driverid = ds.driverid LEFT JOIN constructorresults cr ON r.raceid = cr.raceid AND con.constructorid = cr.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 1995 AND r.year <= 1991 AND res.positionorder <= 2 AND lt.milliseconds > 200742 AND d.dob >= '1950-01-01' GROUP BY c.circuitid, c.name, c.country, r.year, r.round, d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, con.constructorid, con.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) >= 52 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) <= 9 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_lap_time_ms ASC, distinct_laps_driven DESC LIMIT 367;
