SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY SUM(res.points) DESC) AS yearly_rank FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid WHERE r.year >= 2000 AND r.year <= 1965 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY r.year, yearly_rank, r.round;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, res.positionorder, res.points, AVG(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY r.year, d.driverid) AS avg_points_per_season, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY SUM(res.points) DESC) AS season_rank FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 1955 AND r.year <= 2012 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name, res.positionorder, res.points HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY r.year, season_rank, d.surname;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, res.positionorder, res.points, AVG(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY r.year, d.driverid) AS avg_points_per_season, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY SUM(res.points) DESC) AS season_rank FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid WHERE r.year >= 1992 AND r.year <= 1994 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name, res.positionorder, res.points HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY r.year DESC, season_rank, d.surname;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) AS laps_analyzed FROM drivers d JOIN laptimes lt ON d.driverid = lt.driverid JOIN races r ON lt.raceid = r.raceid WHERE r.year = 1994 AND lt.milliseconds IS NOT NULL AND lt.lap IN ( SELECT lap FROM laptimes WHERE raceid IN ( SELECT raceid FROM races WHERE circuitid = 68 ) GROUP BY lap HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT driverid) > 30 ) GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, r.name HAVING AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 135116 ORDER BY avg_lap_time_ms ASC LIMIT 20;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid WHERE r.year = 1982 AND res.positionorder <= 5 AND res.raceid IN ( SELECT raceid FROM races WHERE circuitid = 14 ) GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, r.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, COUNT(*) AS races_entered, AVG(res.positionorder) AS avg_finish_position FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid WHERE r.year = 2012 AND res.positionorder <= 17 AND d.driverid IN ( SELECT driverid FROM results WHERE points > '0' GROUP BY driverid HAVING COUNT(*) >= 7 ) GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, r.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_finish_position ASC;

SELECT r.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(*) AS race_count, SUM(r.points) AS total_points FROM results r JOIN drivers d ON r.driverid = d.driverid JOIN races rc ON r.raceid = rc.raceid WHERE r.points > 9.91 AND rc.year = 2014 GROUP BY r.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(r.points) > 375.23 INTERSECT SELECT r.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(*) AS race_count, SUM(r.points) AS total_points FROM results r JOIN drivers d ON r.driverid = d.driverid JOIN races rc ON r.raceid = rc.raceid WHERE r.grid <= 4 AND rc.year = 2010 GROUP BY r.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING COUNT(*) >= 23 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.driverid) AS distinct_drivers, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) AS distinct_laps, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS distinct_pitstops, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, SUM(res.points) AS total_points FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND lt.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid AND lt.driverid = res.driverid WHERE r.year >= 2019 AND r.date <= '2000-03-01' GROUP BY r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lt.driverid) > 22 AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 151136 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.driverid) AS drivers_with_laptimes, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_ms FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid WHERE r.year = 1958 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM results res WHERE res.raceid = r.raceid AND res.positionorder <= 1 ) GROUP BY r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name HAVING AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 106586 ORDER BY r.round;

SELECT r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, d.driverref, lt.lap, lt.position AS lap_position, lt.milliseconds, AVG(lt.milliseconds) OVER ( PARTITION BY lt.raceid, lt.driverid ORDER BY lt.lap ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_ms FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid JOIN drivers d ON lt.driverid = d.driverid WHERE r.year = 2010 AND lt.milliseconds > 96395 ORDER BY r.raceid, lt.driverid, lt.lap;

SELECT r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, con.name AS constructor_name, res.points, res.positionorder, ds.wins AS driver_wins, cs.wins AS constructor_wins FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid JOIN constructorstandings cs ON r.raceid = cs.raceid AND res.constructorid = cs.constructorid WHERE r.year = 1957 AND res.points >= '0' INTERSECT SELECT r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, con.name AS constructor_name, res.points, res.positionorder, ds.wins AS driver_wins, cs.wins AS constructor_wins FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid JOIN constructorstandings cs ON r.raceid = cs.raceid AND res.constructorid = cs.constructorid WHERE r.round <= 3 AND res.positionorder <= 12 ORDER BY raceid, driver_name;

SELECT r.year, c.country, con.nationality, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, COUNT(DISTINCT res.driverid) AS unique_drivers, AVG(res.positionorder) AS avg_finish FROM races r JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 1995 AND r.year <= 2016 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (r.year, c.country, con.nationality), (r.year, c.country), (r.year, con.nationality), (c.country, con.nationality), (r.year), (c.country), (con.nationality), () ) HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY r.year, c.country, con.nationality;

SELECT r.year, c.name AS circuit_name, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, con.name AS constructor_name, res.positionorder, res.points, CASE WHEN res.positionorder = 1 THEN 'Winner' WHEN res.positionorder BETWEEN 2 AND 3 THEN 'Podium' WHEN res.positionorder BETWEEN 4 AND 10 THEN 'Points' ELSE 'No Points' END AS finish_category, AVG(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY r.year, c.circuitid) AS avg_points_per_circuit_year, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY r.year, con.constructorid) AS races_per_constructor_year FROM results res JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid WHERE r.year = 2014 AND res.points > '0' GROUP BY r.year, c.circuitid, c.name, d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, con.constructorid, con.name, res.positionorder, res.points HAVING COUNT(*) > 4 ORDER BY r.year, c.name, res.positionorder;

SELECT r.year, c.name AS constructor_name, COUNT(DISTINCT res.raceid) AS races_entered, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(res.positionorder) AS avg_finish_position, COUNT(CASE WHEN res.positionorder = 1 THEN 1 END) AS wins FROM results res JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid WHERE r.year >= 1994 AND d.dob >= '1970-01-01' GROUP BY r.year, c.constructorid, c.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '50' AND AVG(res.positionorder) <= 18 ORDER BY r.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT r.year, c.name AS constructor_name, COUNT(DISTINCT res.raceid) AS races_entered, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(res.positionorder) AS avg_finish_position, MAX(ds.wins) AS max_wins_in_season FROM constructors c JOIN results res ON c.constructorid = res.constructorid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN driverstandings ds ON res.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid WHERE r.year >= 2018 AND res.points > '0' GROUP BY r.year, c.constructorid, c.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '100' AND AVG(res.positionorder) < 13 ORDER BY total_points DESC, r.year ASC;

SELECT r.year, c.name AS constructor_name, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, COUNT(DISTINCT res.raceid) AS races_entered, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, CASE WHEN SUM(res.points) >= 256.8 THEN 'High Performer' WHEN SUM(res.points) >= 93.33 THEN 'Medium Performer' ELSE 'Low Performer' END AS performance_category, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms FROM results res JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON res.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid WHERE r.year >= 2011 GROUP BY r.year, c.constructorid, c.name, d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT res.raceid) > 25 ORDER BY r.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT r.year, c.name AS constructor_name, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY SUM(res.points) DESC) AS yearly_rank FROM races r JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid WHERE r.year >= 2013 AND r.year <= 1954 GROUP BY r.year, c.constructorid, c.name, d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY r.year DESC, yearly_rank;

SELECT c.circuitid, c.name AS circuit_name, c.country, r.year, r.round, d.driverid, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, con.name AS constructor_name, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, MIN(lt.milliseconds) AS fastest_lap_ms, MAX(lt.milliseconds) AS slowest_lap_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) AS total_laps_analyzed, SUM(res.points) AS total_points_scored, AVG(res.grid) AS avg_starting_grid, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pit_stops, SUM(ps.milliseconds) AS total_pit_time_ms, AVG(q.position) AS avg_qualifying_position, SUM(cr.points) AS constructor_points, SUM(cs.wins) AS constructor_wins, SUM(ds.wins) AS driver_wins, COUNT(DISTINCT res.statusid) AS distinct_statuses FROM circuits c JOIN races r ON c.circuitid = r.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND res.driverid = q.driverid AND res.constructorid = q.constructorid LEFT JOIN constructorresults cr ON r.raceid = cr.raceid AND res.constructorid = cr.constructorid LEFT JOIN constructorstandings cs ON r.raceid = cs.raceid AND res.constructorid = cs.constructorid LEFT JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid LEFT JOIN status s ON res.statusid = s.statusid WHERE r.year >= 1984 AND r.year <= 1995 AND c.lat >= '-90.0' AND c.lat <= '-90.0' AND c.lng >= '-180.0' AND c.lng <= '-180.0' AND d.dob >= '1900-01-01' AND d.dob <= '1900-01-01' AND res.grid >= 21 AND res.grid <= 26 AND lt.milliseconds >= 271551 AND lt.milliseconds <= 64210 GROUP BY c.circuitid, c.name, c.country, r.year, r.round, d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, con.name HAVING AVG(lt.milliseconds) <= 113365 AND SUM(res.points) >= '0.0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) >= 93 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) <= 10 ORDER BY r.year DESC, r.round DESC, total_points_scored DESC, avg_lap_time_ms ASC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(r.resultid) AS race_count, SUM(r.points) AS total_points, AVG(r.positionorder) AS avg_finish FROM drivers d JOIN results r ON d.driverid = r.driverid JOIN races rc ON r.raceid = rc.raceid WHERE rc.year >= 2000 AND r.points > '0' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING COUNT(r.resultid) >= 35 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN laptimes lt ON d.driverid = lt.driverid AND res.raceid = lt.raceid WHERE r.year = 1976 AND res.points > '0' AND lt.lap IN (SELECT lap FROM laptimes WHERE milliseconds < 103710) GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, r.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '10' ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_lap_time_ms ASC;

SELECT r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, con.name AS constructor_name, res.points, res.positionorder, ds.wins AS driver_wins, cs.wins AS constructor_wins FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid JOIN constructorstandings cs ON r.raceid = cs.raceid AND res.constructorid = cs.constructorid WHERE r.year = 2010 AND res.points >= '0' INTERSECT SELECT r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, con.name AS constructor_name, res.points, res.positionorder, ds.wins AS driver_wins, cs.wins AS constructor_wins FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid JOIN constructorstandings cs ON r.raceid = cs.raceid AND res.constructorid = cs.constructorid WHERE r.round <= 9 AND res.positionorder <= 19 ORDER BY raceid, driver_name;

SELECT r.year, c.country, con.nationality, d.driverref, COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) AS race_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) AS total_laps_analyzed, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, SUM(CASE WHEN res.positionorder = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wins, SUM(ps.stop) AS total_pit_stops, AVG(q.position) AS avg_qualifying_position FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND res.driverid = q.driverid AND res.constructorid = q.constructorid LEFT JOIN constructorresults cr ON r.raceid = cr.raceid AND res.constructorid = cr.constructorid LEFT JOIN constructorstandings cs ON r.raceid = cs.raceid AND res.constructorid = cs.constructorid LEFT JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid WHERE r.year >= 1992 AND r.year <= 1953 AND res.points > '0' AND (lt.milliseconds IS NULL OR lt.milliseconds > 95595) AND d.dob >= '1950-01-01' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (r.year, c.country, con.nationality, d.driverref), (r.year, c.country, con.nationality), (r.year, c.country), (r.year), () ) HAVING SUM(res.points) > '10' AND COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) >= 5 ORDER BY r.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT c.circuitid, c.name AS circuit_name, c.country, r.year, r.round, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.driverid) AS unique_drivers_lapped, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.driverid) AS unique_drivers_pitted, COUNT(DISTINCT q.driverid) AS unique_drivers_qualified, COUNT(DISTINCT res.driverid) AS unique_drivers_finished, SUM(cr.points) AS total_constructor_points, AVG(ds.points) AS avg_driver_points, SUM(lt.milliseconds) / 1000.0 AS total_lap_time_seconds, SUM(ps.milliseconds) / 1000.0 AS total_pitstop_time_seconds FROM circuits c JOIN races r ON c.circuitid = r.circuitid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND lt.driverid = ps.driverid AND lt.lap = ps.lap JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND lt.driverid = q.driverid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid AND lt.driverid = res.driverid JOIN constructorresults cr ON r.raceid = cr.raceid JOIN constructors con ON cr.constructorid = con.constructorid AND res.constructorid = con.constructorid JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND lt.driverid = ds.driverid JOIN drivers d ON lt.driverid = d.driverid JOIN status s ON res.statusid = s.statusid WHERE r.year >= 2006 AND r.year <= 1959 AND r.date >= '1950-01-01' AND r.date <= '1950-01-01' AND lt.milliseconds > 70217 AND ps.milliseconds > 17882 AND cr.points > '0.0' AND ds.points > '0.0' GROUP BY c.circuitid, c.name, c.country, r.year, r.round HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lt.driverid) > 22 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ps.driverid) > 40 AND COUNT(DISTINCT q.driverid) > 10 AND COUNT(DISTINCT res.driverid) > 50 AND SUM(cr.points) > '10.0' AND AVG(ds.points) > '1.0' ORDER BY r.year DESC, r.round DESC, total_constructor_points DESC;

SELECT c.circuitid, c.name AS circuit_name, c.country, r.year, r.round, d.driverid, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, con.constructorid, con.name AS constructor_name, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) AS distinct_laps_driven, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS distinct_pit_stops, COUNT(DISTINCT q.position) AS distinct_qualifying_positions, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, MAX(ds.wins) AS max_wins_in_season, SUM(cr.points) AS total_constructor_points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year, c.circuitid ORDER BY SUM(res.points) DESC) AS driver_rank_per_circuit_year FROM circuits c JOIN races r ON c.circuitid = r.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND res.driverid = q.driverid AND res.constructorid = q.constructorid JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid JOIN constructorresults cr ON r.raceid = cr.raceid AND res.constructorid = cr.constructorid JOIN constructorstandings cs ON r.raceid = cs.raceid AND res.constructorid = cs.constructorid JOIN seasons s ON r.year = s.year WHERE r.year >= 2017 AND r.year <= 1978 AND res.grid <= 25 AND lt.milliseconds > 196249 AND d.dob >= '1950-01-01' GROUP BY c.circuitid, c.name, c.country, r.year, r.round, d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, con.constructorid, con.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) >= 5 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) <= 5 ORDER BY r.year DESC, r.round, total_points DESC, driver_rank_per_circuit_year;

SELECT c.circuitid, c.name AS circuit_name, r.year, r.round, d.driverid, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, con.constructorid, con.name AS constructor_name, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, MIN(lt.milliseconds) AS fastest_lap_ms, MAX(lt.milliseconds) AS slowest_lap_ms, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) AS laps_analyzed, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops, AVG(ps.milliseconds) AS avg_pitstop_ms, SUM(cs.wins) AS constructor_wins, SUM(ds.wins) AS driver_wins, AVG(q.position) AS avg_qualifying_position, MIN(q.position) AS best_qualifying_position FROM circuits c JOIN races r ON c.circuitid = r.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN constructorstandings cs ON r.raceid = cs.raceid AND con.constructorid = cs.constructorid LEFT JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND d.driverid = ds.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND res.driverid = q.driverid AND res.constructorid = q.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 1994 AND r.year <= 2006 AND res.points > '0' AND lt.milliseconds > 118991 AND cs.wins >= 15 GROUP BY c.circuitid, c.name, r.year, r.round, d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, con.constructorid, con.name HAVING AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 157189 AND SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_lap_time_ms ASC LIMIT 100;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) AS races_participated, SUM(r.points) AS total_points FROM drivers d JOIN results r ON d.driverid = r.driverid WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM races rc WHERE rc.raceid = r.raceid AND rc.year >= 2004 AND rc.year <= 2016 ) GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(r.points) > '0' ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) AS races_participated, SUM(res.points) AS total_points FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid WHERE r.year = 2021 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM constructorstandings cs WHERE cs.constructorid = res.constructorid AND cs.raceid = r.raceid AND cs.position <= 4 ) GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) AS total_laps, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, MAX(ds.wins) AS max_wins_in_season, COUNT(ps.stop) AS total_pitstops, SUM(CASE WHEN q.position <= 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS top_3_qualifying, AVG(cr.points) AS avg_constructor_points, SUM(t.win) AS total_wins_target FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON d.driverid = lt.driverid AND r.raceid = lt.raceid JOIN driverstandings ds ON d.driverid = ds.driverid AND r.raceid = ds.raceid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON d.driverid = ps.driverid AND r.raceid = ps.raceid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON d.driverid = q.driverid AND r.raceid = q.raceid LEFT JOIN constructorresults cr ON c.constructorid = cr.constructorid AND r.raceid = cr.raceid LEFT JOIN target t ON d.driverid = t.driverid AND r.raceid = t.raceid WHERE r.year >= 2012 AND r.date <= '1950-01-01' AND res.points > '0' AND lt.milliseconds < 87935 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round, r.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '10' AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 107092 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_lap_time_ms ASC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) AS total_laps, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, MAX(ds.wins) AS season_wins, SUM(CASE WHEN t.win = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS target_wins FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON d.driverid = lt.driverid AND res.raceid = lt.raceid JOIN driverstandings ds ON d.driverid = ds.driverid AND res.raceid = ds.raceid LEFT JOIN target t ON d.driverid = t.driverid AND res.raceid = t.raceid JOIN seasons s ON r.year = s.year WHERE r.year >= 2006 AND r.year <= 2007 AND res.points > '0' AND lt.milliseconds < 61884 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round, r.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '10' AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 105949 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_lap_time_ms ASC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lap.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT pit.stop) AS total_pitstops, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM results res2 WHERE res2.driverid = d.driverid AND res2.position = 1) AS career_wins, (SELECT AVG(pos.position) FROM driverstandings pos WHERE pos.driverid = d.driverid AND pos.raceid IN (SELECT raceid FROM races WHERE year >= 2009)) AS avg_position_since_year, MAX(qual.position) AS best_qualifying, MIN(res.grid) AS worst_grid_start FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lap ON res.raceid = lap.raceid AND res.driverid = lap.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops pit ON res.raceid = pit.raceid AND res.driverid = pit.driverid JOIN qualifying qual ON res.raceid = qual.raceid AND res.driverid = qual.driverid JOIN constructorresults cr ON res.raceid = cr.raceid AND res.constructorid = cr.constructorid JOIN constructorstandings cs ON res.raceid = cs.raceid AND res.constructorid = cs.constructorid JOIN driverstandings ds ON res.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid WHERE r.date >= '1950-01-01' AND r.year <= 2022 AND res.points > '0' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round, r.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND AVG(lap.milliseconds) < 179281 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_lap_time_ms ASC LIMIT 640;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops, MAX(ds.wins) AS max_wins_in_season, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY SUM(res.points) DESC) AS yearly_rank FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON d.driverid = lt.driverid AND res.raceid = lt.raceid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON d.driverid = ps.driverid AND res.raceid = ps.raceid JOIN driverstandings ds ON d.driverid = ds.driverid AND res.raceid = ds.raceid WHERE r.year >= 1959 AND r.date <= '1950-01-01' AND res.positionorder <= 18 AND lt.milliseconds > 80480 AND d.driverid IN ( SELECT driverid FROM results WHERE points > '0' GROUP BY driverid HAVING COUNT(*) >= 35 ) GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round, r.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 78704 ORDER BY total_points DESC, yearly_rank LIMIT 28;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops, MAX(ds.wins) AS max_wins_in_season, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY SUM(res.points) DESC) AS yearly_rank FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON d.driverid = lt.driverid AND res.raceid = lt.raceid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON d.driverid = ps.driverid AND res.raceid = ps.raceid JOIN driverstandings ds ON d.driverid = ds.driverid AND res.raceid = ds.raceid WHERE r.year >= 2005 AND r.date <= '1950-01-01' AND res.grid <= 4 AND lt.position <= 8 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM qualifying q WHERE q.driverid = d.driverid AND q.raceid = r.raceid AND q.position <= 27 ) GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round, r.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 98223 ORDER BY total_points DESC, yearly_rank ASC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops, MAX(q.position) AS best_qualifying, CASE WHEN SUM(res.points) >= 223.57 THEN 'High Scorer' WHEN SUM(res.points) >= 61.56 THEN 'Medium Scorer' ELSE 'Low Scorer' END AS performance_category, CASE WHEN AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 85104 THEN 'Fast Laps' WHEN AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 92987 THEN 'Average Laps' ELSE 'Slow Laps' END AS lap_time_category FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND d.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND d.driverid = q.driverid JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND d.driverid = ds.driverid JOIN seasons s ON r.year = s.year WHERE r.year >= 2023 AND r.year <= 2020 AND r.date >= '2000-01-01' AND r.date <= '2000-01-01' AND ds.position <= 8 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round, r.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > 37.02 AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 160074 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_lap_time_ms ASC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, res.positionorder, res.points, SUM(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid ORDER BY r.date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_total_points, AVG(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid, r.circuitid) AS avg_points_per_circuit FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 1998 AND res.positionorder <= 18 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name, res.positionorder, res.points, r.date, r.circuitid ORDER BY d.driverid, r.date;

SELECT r.year, c.name AS circuit_name, con.name AS constructor_name, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid WHERE r.year >= 1995 AND r.year <= 1967 GROUP BY r.year, c.circuitid, con.constructorid, d.driverid HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_lap_time_ms ASC LIMIT 100;

SELECT r.year, c.name AS circuit_name, con.name AS constructor_name, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position AS lap_position, ps.stop AS pit_stop_number, ps.duration AS pit_stop_duration, q.position AS qualifying_position, ds.wins AS driver_wins, cs.wins AS constructor_wins FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND res.driverid = q.driverid AND res.constructorid = q.constructorid LEFT JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid LEFT JOIN constructorstandings cs ON r.raceid = cs.raceid AND res.constructorid = cs.constructorid WHERE r.year = 1993 AND res.positionorder <= 19 AND lt.lap >= 22 AND (ps.milliseconds IS NULL OR ps.milliseconds > 48014) AND d.dob >= '1950-01-01' GROUP BY r.year, c.circuitid, con.constructorid, d.driverid, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position, ps.stop, ps.duration, q.position, ds.wins, cs.wins HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY r.year, res.positionorder, SUM(res.points) DESC;

SELECT r.year, c.name AS constructor_name, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) AS distinct_laps_driven, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS distinct_pit_stops, AVG(res.points) AS avg_points_per_race, SUM(cs.wins) AS total_constructor_wins FROM races r JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN constructorstandings cs ON r.raceid = cs.raceid AND c.constructorid = cs.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 2018 AND r.year <= 2003 AND res.positionorder <= 6 GROUP BY r.year, c.constructorid, c.name, d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING AVG(res.points) > '0.0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) >= 36 ORDER BY r.year DESC, total_constructor_wins DESC, avg_points_per_race DESC;

SELECT r.year, c.name AS constructor_name, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) AS distinct_laps_driven, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS distinct_pit_stops, AVG(res.points) AS avg_points_per_race, SUM(cs.wins) AS total_constructor_wins FROM races r JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN constructorstandings cs ON r.raceid = cs.raceid AND c.constructorid = cs.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 2020 AND r.year <= 2008 AND res.positionorder <= 8 GROUP BY r.year, c.constructorid, c.name, d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING AVG(res.points) > '0.0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) >= 33 ORDER BY r.year DESC, total_constructor_wins DESC, avg_points_per_race DESC;

SELECT r.year, c.name AS constructor_name, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, COUNT(DISTINCT res.raceid) AS races_entered, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, CASE WHEN SUM(res.points) >= 160.36 THEN 'High Performer' WHEN SUM(res.points) >= 42.4 THEN 'Medium Performer' ELSE 'Low Performer' END AS performance_category, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms FROM results res JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON res.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid WHERE r.year >= 2019 GROUP BY r.year, c.constructorid, c.name, d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT res.raceid) > 38 ORDER BY r.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT c.circuitid, c.name AS circuit_name, c.country, r.year, r.round, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.driverid) AS unique_drivers_lapped, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.driverid) AS unique_drivers_pitted, COUNT(DISTINCT q.driverid) AS unique_drivers_qualified, COUNT(DISTINCT res.driverid) AS unique_drivers_finished, SUM(cr.points) AS total_constructor_points, AVG(ds.points) AS avg_driver_points, SUM(lt.milliseconds) / 1000.0 AS total_lap_time_seconds, SUM(ps.milliseconds) / 1000.0 AS total_pitstop_time_seconds FROM circuits c JOIN races r ON c.circuitid = r.circuitid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND lt.driverid = ps.driverid AND lt.lap = ps.lap JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND lt.driverid = q.driverid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid AND lt.driverid = res.driverid JOIN constructorresults cr ON r.raceid = cr.raceid JOIN constructors con ON cr.constructorid = con.constructorid AND res.constructorid = con.constructorid JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND lt.driverid = ds.driverid JOIN drivers d ON lt.driverid = d.driverid JOIN status s ON res.statusid = s.statusid WHERE r.year >= 2015 AND r.year <= 1955 AND r.date >= '1950-01-01' AND r.date <= '1950-01-01' AND lt.milliseconds > 208661 AND ps.milliseconds > 49310 AND cr.points > '0.0' AND ds.points > '0.0' GROUP BY c.circuitid, c.name, c.country, r.year, r.round HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lt.driverid) > 15 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ps.driverid) > 13 AND COUNT(DISTINCT q.driverid) > 22 AND COUNT(DISTINCT res.driverid) > 43 AND SUM(cr.points) > '10.0' AND AVG(ds.points) > '1.0' ORDER BY r.year DESC, r.round DESC, total_constructor_points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) AS races_entered, SUM(r.points) AS total_points, AVG(r.positionorder) AS avg_finish_position FROM drivers d JOIN results r ON d.driverid = r.driverid JOIN races rc ON r.raceid = rc.raceid WHERE rc.year IN (SELECT year FROM seasons WHERE year >= 1991 AND year <= 1971) AND r.positionorder <= 6 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(r.points) > '0' ORDER BY total_points DESC LIMIT 20;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(r.resultid) AS race_count, SUM(r.points) AS total_points FROM drivers d LEFT JOIN results r ON d.driverid = r.driverid LEFT JOIN races rc ON r.raceid = rc.raceid WHERE rc.year >= 2011 AND rc.year <= 1986 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING COUNT(r.resultid) < 15 ORDER BY total_points DESC NULLS LAST;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(r.resultid) AS total_races, SUM(r.points) AS total_points, AVG(r.positionorder) AS avg_finish_position, MAX(r.grid) AS best_grid_start FROM drivers d JOIN results r ON d.driverid = r.driverid JOIN races rc ON r.raceid = rc.raceid WHERE rc.year >= 2010 AND rc.year <= 1952 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(r.points) > '0' ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name AS constructor_name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name AS circuit_name, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points, SUM(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY r.year, c.constructorid ORDER BY r.date) AS cumulative_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) OVER (PARTITION BY r.raceid, d.driverid) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(ps.stop) OVER (PARTITION BY r.raceid, d.driverid) AS pitstop_count, q.position AS qualifying_position, ds.wins AS season_wins, cs.position AS constructor_position FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits cir ON r.circuitid = cir.circuitid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND d.driverid = ps.driverid JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND d.driverid = q.driverid AND res.constructorid = q.constructorid JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND d.driverid = ds.driverid JOIN constructorstandings cs ON r.raceid = cs.raceid AND c.constructorid = cs.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 1990 AND r.year <= 1950 AND cir.country = 'UK' AND res.points > '0' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM target t WHERE t.raceid = r.raceid AND t.driverid = d.driverid AND t.win = 1 ) GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points, r.date, lt.milliseconds, ps.stop, q.position, ds.wins, cs.position HAVING AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 68342 AND COUNT(ps.stop) >= 2 ORDER BY cumulative_points DESC, avg_lap_time_ms ASC LIMIT 39;

SELECT r.raceid, COUNT(l.driverid) AS total_laps FROM races r JOIN laptimes l ON r.raceid = l.raceid WHERE r.year = 2021 AND l.milliseconds < 113701 GROUP BY r.raceid ORDER BY total_laps DESC;

SELECT c.circuitid, c.name AS circuit_name, c.country, r.year, r.round, d.driverid, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, con.name AS constructor_name, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) AS distinct_laps_driven, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS distinct_pit_stops, COUNT(DISTINCT q.position) AS distinct_qualifying_positions, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, MAX(ds.wins) AS max_wins_in_season, SUM(cr.points) AS total_constructor_points FROM circuits c JOIN races r ON c.circuitid = r.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND d.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND d.driverid = q.driverid AND res.constructorid = q.constructorid JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND d.driverid = ds.driverid JOIN constructorresults cr ON r.raceid = cr.raceid AND con.constructorid = cr.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 1981 AND r.date <= '1950-01-01' AND res.grid <= 12 AND lt.position <= 30 AND ds.position <= 9 GROUP BY c.circuitid, c.name, c.country, r.year, r.round, d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, con.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 97908 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_lap_time_ms ASC LIMIT 926;

SELECT c.circuitid, c.name AS circuit_name, c.country, r.year, r.round, d.driverid, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, con.name AS constructor_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops, MAX(ds.wins) AS max_wins_in_season, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY SUM(res.points) DESC) AS yearly_points_rank FROM circuits c JOIN races r ON c.circuitid = r.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND d.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND d.driverid = ds.driverid LEFT JOIN constructorresults cr ON r.raceid = cr.raceid AND con.constructorid = cr.constructorid LEFT JOIN constructorstandings cs ON r.raceid = cs.raceid AND con.constructorid = cs.constructorid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND d.driverid = q.driverid AND con.constructorid = q.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 1963 AND r.year <= 1975 AND res.grid <= 29 AND d.dob >= '1950-01-01' AND c.alt >= 231 GROUP BY c.circuitid, c.name, c.country, r.year, r.round, d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, con.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 69506 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) >= 3 ORDER BY r.year DESC, r.round, total_points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, res.positionorder, res.points, SUM(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid, r.year ORDER BY r.round) AS cumulative_points FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid WHERE r.year = 1965 AND res.positionorder <= 14 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name, res.positionorder, res.points ORDER BY d.driverid, r.year, r.round;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position AS lap_position, ps.stop AS pit_stop_number, ps.lap AS pit_stop_lap FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN laptimes lt ON res.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON res.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid WHERE r.year = 1964 AND res.positionorder <= 8 AND lt.lap = ( SELECT MAX(lap) FROM laptimes WHERE raceid = lt.raceid AND driverid = lt.driverid ) GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position, ps.stop, ps.lap HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY r.year, r.round, res.positionorder;
