SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, res.positionorder, res.points, SUM(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid ORDER BY r.date) AS cumulative_points FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid WHERE r.year = 2022 AND res.positionorder <= 8 ORDER BY d.driverid, r.date;

SELECT r.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(*) AS race_count, SUM(r.points) AS total_points FROM results r JOIN drivers d ON r.driverid = d.driverid JOIN races rc ON r.raceid = rc.raceid WHERE r.points > '0' AND rc.year >= 2008 GROUP BY r.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(r.points) > '10' INTERSECT SELECT r.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(*) AS race_count, SUM(r.points) AS total_points FROM results r JOIN drivers d ON r.driverid = d.driverid JOIN races rc ON r.raceid = rc.raceid WHERE r.grid <= 3 AND rc.year <= 2013 GROUP BY r.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING COUNT(*) > 21 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT r.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(r.resultid) AS race_count, SUM(r.points) AS total_points FROM results r JOIN drivers d ON r.driverid = d.driverid JOIN races rc ON r.raceid = rc.raceid WHERE rc.year = 2001 AND r.positionorder <= 6 GROUP BY r.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(r.points) > '0' INTERSECT SELECT r.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(r.resultid) AS race_count, SUM(r.points) AS total_points FROM results r JOIN drivers d ON r.driverid = d.driverid JOIN races rc ON r.raceid = rc.raceid WHERE rc.year = 1991 AND r.positionorder <= 7 GROUP BY r.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(r.points) > '0' ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, con.name AS constructor_name, res.points, res.positionorder, ds.wins AS driver_wins, cs.wins AS constructor_wins FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid LEFT JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid LEFT JOIN constructorstandings cs ON r.raceid = cs.raceid AND res.constructorid = cs.constructorid WHERE r.year = 1956 AND res.points > '0' INTERSECT SELECT r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, con.name AS constructor_name, res.points, res.positionorder, ds.wins AS driver_wins, cs.wins AS constructor_wins FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid LEFT JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid LEFT JOIN constructorstandings cs ON r.raceid = cs.raceid AND res.constructorid = cs.constructorid WHERE r.year = 1951 AND res.positionorder <= 9 ORDER BY raceid, driver_name;

SELECT r.year, c.country, con.nationality, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, COUNT(DISTINCT res.driverid) AS unique_drivers, AVG(res.positionorder) AS avg_finish_pos FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 2004 AND r.year <= 1973 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (r.year, c.country, con.nationality), (r.year, c.country), (r.year, con.nationality), (r.year), () ) HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY r.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT r.year, c.name AS circuit_name, con.name AS constructor_name, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) AS distinct_laps_driven, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS distinct_pit_stops, COUNT(DISTINCT q.position) AS distinct_qualifying_positions, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, MAX(ds.wins) AS max_wins_in_season, SUM(cr.points) AS total_constructor_points FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND res.driverid = q.driverid AND res.constructorid = q.constructorid JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid JOIN constructorresults cr ON r.raceid = cr.raceid AND res.constructorid = cr.constructorid JOIN constructorstandings cs ON r.raceid = cs.raceid AND res.constructorid = cs.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 1965 AND r.year <= 1950 AND res.grid <= 2 AND d.dob >= '1950-01-01' AND lt.milliseconds > 192746 GROUP BY r.year, c.circuitid, con.constructorid, d.driverid HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) >= 31 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) <= 8 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_lap_time_ms ASC LIMIT 100;

SELECT r.year, c.name AS constructor_name, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY SUM(res.points) DESC) AS yearly_rank FROM races r JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid WHERE r.year >= 2014 AND r.year <= 2020 GROUP BY r.year, c.constructorid, c.name, d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY r.year DESC, yearly_rank ASC;

SELECT r.year, c.name AS constructor_name, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, SUM(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY r.year, c.constructorid ORDER BY r.date) AS cumulative_points, AVG(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY r.year, c.constructorid) AS avg_points_per_race FROM results res JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid WHERE r.year >= 1960 AND res.points > '0' ORDER BY r.year, c.constructorid, r.date;

SELECT r.year, r.name AS race_name, c.name AS circuit_name, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, con.name AS constructor_name, res.positionorder, res.points, AVG(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY r.year, con.constructorid) AS avg_constructor_points_per_year, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY res.points DESC) AS yearly_points_rank FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 1991 AND r.year <= 2002 AND res.positionorder <= 12 GROUP BY r.year, r.name, c.name, d.driverid, con.constructorid, res.positionorder, res.points HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY r.year DESC, yearly_points_rank ASC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) AS races_entered, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(res.positionorder) AS avg_finish_position, MAX(ds.wins) AS max_wins_in_season FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN driverstandings ds ON d.driverid = ds.driverid AND r.raceid = ds.raceid JOIN seasons s ON r.year = s.year WHERE r.year >= 1999 AND r.year <= 1997 AND res.points > '0' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(res.points) > '50' AND COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) >= 68 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_finish_position ASC LIMIT 50;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(r.resultid) AS race_count, COALESCE(SUM(r.points), 0) AS total_points FROM drivers d LEFT JOIN results r ON d.driverid = r.driverid LEFT JOIN races rc ON r.raceid = rc.raceid WHERE rc.year >= 2010 OR rc.year IS NULL GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING COALESCE(SUM(r.points), 0) > '0' ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(r.resultid) AS race_count, SUM(r.points) AS total_points, AVG(r.positionorder) AS avg_finish FROM drivers d JOIN results r ON d.driverid = r.driverid JOIN races rc ON r.raceid = rc.raceid WHERE rc.year >= 1998 AND r.points > '0' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING COUNT(r.resultid) >= 5 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(r.resultid) AS race_count, SUM(r.points) AS total_points, AVG(r.positionorder) AS avg_finish FROM drivers d JOIN results r ON d.driverid = r.driverid JOIN races rc ON r.raceid = rc.raceid WHERE rc.year >= 2008 AND rc.year <= 2021 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(r.points) > '0' ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name AS constructor_name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name AS circuit_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops, MAX(ds.wins) AS max_wins_in_season, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY SUM(res.points) DESC) AS yearly_rank FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits cir ON r.circuitid = cir.circuitid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND d.driverid = ps.driverid JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND d.driverid = ds.driverid JOIN seasons s ON r.year = s.year WHERE r.year >= 1951 AND r.date <= '1950-01-01' AND res.positionorder <= 16 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM qualifying q WHERE q.raceid = r.raceid AND q.driverid = d.driverid AND q.position <= 6 ) AND cir.alt > 564 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 81456 ORDER BY total_points DESC, yearly_rank, r.year, r.round LIMIT 233;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name AS constructor_name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name AS circuit_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops, MAX(q.position) AS best_qualifying, SUM(CASE WHEN res.positionorder = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wins, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(res.points) DESC) AS driver_rank FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits cir ON r.circuitid = cir.circuitid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND d.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND d.driverid = q.driverid JOIN seasons s ON r.year = s.year JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND d.driverid = ds.driverid JOIN constructorstandings cs ON r.raceid = cs.raceid AND c.constructorid = cs.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 2019 AND r.year <= 1977 AND cir.country = 'UK' AND res.grid <= 20 AND res.laps >= 32 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 74356 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) >= 1 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_lap_time_ms ASC LIMIT 96;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name AS constructor_name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name AS circuit_name, cir.country, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(res.positionorder) AS avg_finish_position, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) AS total_laps_raced, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops, MIN(lt.milliseconds) AS fastest_lap_ms, MAX(q.position) AS worst_qualifying, SUM(cr.points) AS constructor_points, SUM(ds.wins) AS driver_wins, SUM(cs.wins) AS constructor_wins, COUNT(DISTINCT res.resultid) AS races_finished, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY SUM(res.points) DESC) AS yearly_rank FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits cir ON r.circuitid = cir.circuitid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND d.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND d.driverid = q.driverid AND c.constructorid = q.constructorid LEFT JOIN constructorresults cr ON r.raceid = cr.raceid AND c.constructorid = cr.constructorid LEFT JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND d.driverid = ds.driverid LEFT JOIN constructorstandings cs ON r.raceid = cs.raceid AND c.constructorid = cs.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 2001 AND r.year <= 1987 AND cir.lat >= '-90.0' AND cir.lat <= '-90.0' AND res.points > '0.0' AND res.positionorder <= 7 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name, cir.country HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0.0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) > 24 AND AVG(res.positionorder) < 16 ORDER BY total_points DESC, yearly_rank, r.year, r.round LIMIT 38;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name AS constructor_name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name AS circuit_name, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points, ds.position AS driver_standing_position, ds.wins AS driver_wins, cs.position AS constructor_standing_position, cs.wins AS constructor_wins, lt.lap, lt.position AS lap_position, lt.milliseconds AS lap_time_ms, ps.stop AS pit_stop_number, ps.lap AS pit_stop_lap, ps.milliseconds AS pit_stop_duration_ms, q.position AS qualifying_position, cr.points AS constructor_result_points, t.win AS target_win, AVG(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid, r.year) AS avg_points_per_season, SUM(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY c.constructorid ORDER BY r.date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_constructor_points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.raceid ORDER BY res.positionorder) AS race_finish_rank FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits cir ON r.circuitid = cir.circuitid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN driverstandings ds ON d.driverid = ds.driverid AND r.raceid = ds.raceid JOIN constructorstandings cs ON c.constructorid = cs.constructorid AND r.raceid = cs.raceid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON d.driverid = lt.driverid AND r.raceid = lt.raceid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON d.driverid = ps.driverid AND r.raceid = ps.raceid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON d.driverid = q.driverid AND r.raceid = q.raceid LEFT JOIN constructorresults cr ON c.constructorid = cr.constructorid AND r.raceid = cr.raceid LEFT JOIN target t ON d.driverid = t.driverid AND r.raceid = t.raceid WHERE r.year >= 1983 AND r.year <= 1959 AND res.points > '0' AND ds.position <= 1 AND cs.position <= 9 AND cir.alt > 645 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points, ds.position, ds.wins, cs.position, cs.wins, lt.lap, lt.position, lt.milliseconds, ps.stop, ps.lap, ps.milliseconds, q.position, cr.points, t.win, r.date HAVING AVG(res.points) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) >= 64 ORDER BY r.year DESC, r.round DESC, res.positionorder ASC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name AS constructor_name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name AS circuit_name, res.positionorder, res.points, ds.position AS driver_standing_position, ds.wins AS driver_wins, cs.position AS constructor_standing_position, cs.wins AS constructor_wins, lt.lap, lt.position AS lap_position, lt.milliseconds AS lap_time_ms, ps.stop AS pit_stop_number, ps.lap AS pit_stop_lap, ps.milliseconds AS pit_stop_duration_ms, q.position AS qualifying_position, t.win AS target_win, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM results res2 WHERE res2.raceid = r.raceid AND res2.positionorder <= 10) AS top_finishers_in_race, (SELECT AVG(points) FROM results res3 WHERE res3.constructorid = c.constructorid AND res3.raceid IN (SELECT raceid FROM races WHERE year = r.year)) AS avg_constructor_points_per_season FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits cir ON r.circuitid = cir.circuitid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN driverstandings ds ON d.driverid = ds.driverid AND r.raceid = ds.raceid JOIN constructorstandings cs ON c.constructorid = cs.constructorid AND r.raceid = cs.raceid JOIN laptimes lt ON d.driverid = lt.driverid AND r.raceid = lt.raceid JOIN pitstops ps ON d.driverid = ps.driverid AND r.raceid = ps.raceid JOIN qualifying q ON d.driverid = q.driverid AND r.raceid = q.raceid AND c.constructorid = q.constructorid JOIN target t ON d.driverid = t.driverid AND r.raceid = t.raceid WHERE r.year >= 2001 AND r.year <= 2004 AND cir.country = 'UK' AND res.points > '0' AND ds.position <= 16 AND cs.position <= 7 AND lt.milliseconds < 69076 AND ps.milliseconds > 51289 AND q.position < 12 AND t.win = 0 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name, res.positionorder, res.points, ds.position, ds.wins, cs.position, cs.wins, lt.lap, lt.position, lt.milliseconds, ps.stop, ps.lap, ps.milliseconds, q.position, t.win HAVING SUM(res.points) > '10' AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 76388 ORDER BY SUM(res.points) DESC, AVG(lt.milliseconds) ASC LIMIT 23;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY SUM(res.points) DESC) AS yearly_rank FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON d.driverid = lt.driverid AND res.raceid = lt.raceid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON d.driverid = ps.driverid AND res.raceid = ps.raceid WHERE r.year IN ( SELECT DISTINCT year FROM seasons WHERE year > 2023 ) AND res.positionorder <= ( SELECT AVG(positionorder) + 11 FROM results WHERE raceid IN ( SELECT raceid FROM races WHERE circuitid IN ( SELECT circuitid FROM circuits WHERE alt > 552 ) ) ) GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round, r.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 81592 ORDER BY r.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON d.driverid = lt.driverid AND r.raceid = lt.raceid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON d.driverid = ps.driverid AND r.raceid = ps.raceid WHERE r.year IN ( SELECT year FROM seasons WHERE year BETWEEN 2021 AND 2012 ) AND res.positionorder <= ( SELECT AVG(positionorder) FROM results WHERE raceid = r.raceid ) GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round, r.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 86862 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_lap_time_ms ASC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops, MAX(ds.wins) AS max_wins_in_season, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY SUM(res.points) DESC) AS yearly_rank FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON d.driverid = lt.driverid AND res.raceid = lt.raceid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON d.driverid = ps.driverid AND res.raceid = ps.raceid JOIN driverstandings ds ON d.driverid = ds.driverid AND res.raceid = ds.raceid JOIN seasons s ON r.year = s.year WHERE r.year >= 2013 AND r.year <= 2011 AND res.grid <= 9 AND lt.milliseconds > 111021 AND ds.position <= 1 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round, r.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 88115 ORDER BY r.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, res.positionorder, res.points, SUM(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid, r.year ORDER BY r.date) AS cumulative_points, AVG(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY c.constructorid, r.year) AS avg_constructor_points_per_race FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN circuits ci ON r.circuitid = ci.circuitid WHERE (r.year = 1962 AND res.positionorder <= 7) OR (r.year = 1968 AND res.points > '0') AND NOT (ci.country = 'USA') GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round, r.name, res.positionorder, res.points, r.date, c.constructorid HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY cumulative_points DESC, r.year, r.round;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.raceid, r.name AS race_name, r.date, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(r.date, d.dob)) AS age_at_race, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position AS lap_position, ps.stop AS pit_stop_number, ps.duration FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND d.driverid = ps.driverid WHERE r.date >= '2000-01-01' AND r.date <= '2000-01-01' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(r.date, d.dob)) >= 28 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.raceid, r.name, r.date, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position, ps.stop, ps.duration HAVING AVG(res.points) > 18.14 ORDER BY r.date DESC, d.surname, d.forename;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.raceid, r.name AS race_name, r.date, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position AS lap_position, ps.stop AS pit_stop_number, ps.duration AS pit_stop_duration FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND d.driverid = ps.driverid WHERE r.date BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2000-01-01' AND res.positionorder <= 10 AND lt.milliseconds > 107952 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.raceid, r.name, r.date, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position, ps.stop, ps.duration HAVING SUM(res.points) > 26.61 ORDER BY r.date DESC, res.positionorder ASC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, res.positionorder, res.points, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM laptimes lt WHERE lt.raceid = r.raceid AND lt.driverid = d.driverid AND lt.position = 1) AS laps_led FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid WHERE r.year = 1997 AND res.points > '0' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name, res.positionorder, res.points, r.raceid HAVING SUM(res.points) > '10' ORDER BY SUM(res.points) DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, res.positionorder, res.points, CASE WHEN res.positionorder = 1 THEN 'Winner' WHEN res.positionorder BETWEEN 2 AND 3 THEN 'Podium' WHEN res.positionorder BETWEEN 4 AND 10 THEN 'Points' ELSE 'No Points' END AS finish_category, AVG(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid, r.year) AS avg_points_per_season, SUM(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid ORDER BY r.date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_points FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid WHERE r.year >= 2017 AND r.year <= 2010 AND res.points > '0.0' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name, res.positionorder, res.points, r.date HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0.0' ORDER BY r.year DESC, r.round ASC, res.positionorder ASC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, res.positionorder, res.points, CASE WHEN res.positionorder = 1 THEN 'Winner' WHEN res.positionorder BETWEEN 2 AND 3 THEN 'Podium' WHEN res.positionorder BETWEEN 4 AND 10 THEN 'Points' ELSE 'No Points' END AS finish_category, SUM(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid, r.year ORDER BY r.date) AS cumulative_points_season, AVG(res.positionorder) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid, r.year) AS avg_position_season FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid WHERE r.year = 1962 AND res.positionorder <= 18 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name, res.positionorder, res.points, r.date ORDER BY r.year, r.round, res.positionorder;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, res.positionorder, res.points, CASE WHEN res.positionorder = 1 THEN 'Winner' WHEN res.positionorder BETWEEN 2 AND 3 THEN 'Podium' WHEN res.positionorder BETWEEN 4 AND 10 THEN 'Points' ELSE 'No Points' END AS finish_category, SUM(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid, r.year ORDER BY r.date) AS cumulative_points_season, AVG(res.positionorder) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid, r.year) AS avg_position_season FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid WHERE r.year = 1970 AND res.points > '0' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name, res.positionorder, res.points, r.date ORDER BY r.year, r.round, res.positionorder;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, res.positionorder, res.points, SUM(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid ORDER BY r.date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_total_points, AVG(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid, r.circuitid) AS avg_points_per_circuit FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 1971 AND res.positionorder <= 16 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name, res.positionorder, res.points, r.date, r.circuitid ORDER BY d.driverid, r.date;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, res.positionorder, res.points, SUM(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid, r.year ORDER BY r.date) AS cumulative_points_season, AVG(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid, r.year) AS avg_points_season, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.raceid ORDER BY res.points DESC) AS race_points_rank FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid WHERE r.year = 1971 AND res.points > '0' ORDER BY d.driverid, r.date;

SELECT r.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(*) AS race_count, SUM(r.points) AS total_points FROM results r JOIN drivers d ON r.driverid = d.driverid JOIN races rc ON r.raceid = rc.raceid WHERE r.points > '0' AND rc.year >= 2017 GROUP BY r.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(r.points) > '10' INTERSECT SELECT r.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(*) AS race_count, SUM(r.points) AS total_points FROM results r JOIN drivers d ON r.driverid = d.driverid JOIN races rc ON r.raceid = rc.raceid WHERE r.grid <= 2 AND rc.year <= 2005 GROUP BY r.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING COUNT(*) > 41 ORDER BY total_points DESC;
SELECT r.raceid, COUNT(l.driverid) AS lap_count FROM races r JOIN laptimes l ON r.raceid = l.raceid WHERE r.year = 1980 AND l.lap > 10 GROUP BY r.raceid ORDER BY lap_count DESC;

SELECT r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, con.name AS constructor_name, res.points, res.positionorder, ds.wins AS driver_wins, cs.wins AS constructor_wins FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid LEFT JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid LEFT JOIN constructorstandings cs ON r.raceid = cs.raceid AND res.constructorid = cs.constructorid WHERE r.year = 1981 AND res.points > '0' INTERSECT SELECT r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, con.name AS constructor_name, res.points, res.positionorder, ds.wins AS driver_wins, cs.wins AS constructor_wins FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid LEFT JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid LEFT JOIN constructorstandings cs ON r.raceid = cs.raceid AND res.constructorid = cs.constructorid WHERE r.year = 1985 AND res.positionorder <= 9 ORDER BY raceid, driver_name;

SELECT r.year, c.name AS circuit_name, con.name AS constructor_name, COUNT(DISTINCT d.driverid) AS unique_drivers, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) AS unique_laps_raced, SUM(res.points) AS total_points FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid WHERE r.year >= 1996 AND r.year <= 2009 GROUP BY r.year, c.name, con.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > 42.61 ORDER BY r.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, con.name AS constructor_name, res.positionorder, res.points, CASE WHEN res.positionorder = 1 THEN 'Winner' WHEN res.positionorder BETWEEN 2 AND 3 THEN 'Podium' WHEN res.positionorder BETWEEN 4 AND 10 THEN 'Points Finish' ELSE 'Outside Points' END AS finish_category, AVG(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY r.year, con.constructorid) AS avg_constructor_points_per_year, SUM(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY r.year, d.driverid ORDER BY r.round) AS driver_points_running_total FROM races r JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid WHERE r.year = 1981 AND res.positionorder <= 7 GROUP BY r.year, r.round, c.name, d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, con.constructorid, con.name, res.positionorder, res.points HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY r.round, res.positionorder;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) AS races_participated, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(res.positionorder) AS avg_finish_position FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid WHERE r.year >= 2013 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM constructorstandings cs WHERE cs.constructorid = res.constructorid AND cs.raceid = r.raceid AND cs.position <= 4 ) GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(res.points) > '50' ORDER BY total_points DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(r.resultid) AS total_races, SUM(r.points) AS total_points, AVG(r.positionorder) AS avg_finish_position FROM drivers d JOIN results r ON d.driverid = r.driverid JOIN races rc ON r.raceid = rc.raceid WHERE rc.year >= 2010 AND rc.year <= 2013 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(r.points) > '0' ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON d.driverid = lt.driverid AND res.raceid = lt.raceid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON d.driverid = ps.driverid AND res.raceid = ps.raceid WHERE r.year >= 1956 AND r.date <= '1950-01-01' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name, r.year, r.round HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 189672 INTERSECT SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON d.driverid = lt.driverid AND res.raceid = lt.raceid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON d.driverid = ps.driverid AND res.raceid = ps.raceid JOIN qualifying q ON d.driverid = q.driverid AND res.raceid = q.raceid WHERE r.circuitid IN (97, 15) AND q.position <= 11 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name, r.year, r.round HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT q.qualifyid) >= 4 AND MAX(res.grid) <= 13 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_lap_time_ms ASC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops, MAX(q.position) AS best_qualifying, SUM(cs.wins) AS constructor_wins, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY SUM(res.points) DESC) AS yearly_rank FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON d.driverid = lt.driverid AND res.raceid = lt.raceid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON d.driverid = ps.driverid AND res.raceid = ps.raceid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON d.driverid = q.driverid AND res.raceid = q.raceid LEFT JOIN constructorstandings cs ON c.constructorid = cs.constructorid AND r.raceid = cs.raceid WHERE r.year >= 2000 AND r.date <= '1950-01-01' AND res.positionorder <= 17 AND lt.milliseconds > 148953 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round, r.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 115700 ORDER BY total_points DESC, yearly_rank ASC LIMIT 133;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY SUM(res.points) DESC) AS yearly_rank FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid WHERE r.year >= 1972 AND r.year <= 1954 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY r.year, yearly_rank, r.round;

SELECT d1.driverid AS driver1_id, d1.forename AS driver1_forename, d1.surname AS driver1_surname, d2.driverid AS driver2_id, d2.forename AS driver2_forename, d2.surname AS driver2_surname, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, AVG(lt1.milliseconds - lt2.milliseconds) AS avg_time_diff_ms, SUM(CASE WHEN lt1.position < lt2.position THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS driver1_ahead_count, SUM(CASE WHEN lt2.position < lt1.position THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS driver2_ahead_count, COUNT(*) AS total_laps_compared FROM laptimes lt1 JOIN laptimes lt2 ON lt1.raceid = lt2.raceid AND lt1.lap = lt2.lap AND lt1.driverid < lt2.driverid JOIN races r ON lt1.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN drivers d1 ON lt1.driverid = d1.driverid JOIN drivers d2 ON lt2.driverid = d2.driverid JOIN results res1 ON lt1.raceid = res1.raceid AND lt1.driverid = res1.driverid JOIN results res2 ON lt2.raceid = res2.raceid AND lt2.driverid = res2.driverid JOIN constructorresults cr1 ON res1.raceid = cr1.raceid AND res1.constructorid = cr1.constructorid JOIN constructorresults cr2 ON res2.raceid = cr2.raceid AND res2.constructorid = cr2.constructorid JOIN qualifying q1 ON lt1.raceid = q1.raceid AND lt1.driverid = q1.driverid JOIN qualifying q2 ON lt2.raceid = q2.raceid AND lt2.driverid = q2.driverid WHERE r.year >= 2007 AND r.year <= 2006 AND lt1.milliseconds > 321099 AND lt2.milliseconds > 239632 AND res1.points >= '0' AND res2.points >= '0' GROUP BY d1.driverid, d1.forename, d1.surname, d2.driverid, d2.forename, d2.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name HAVING COUNT(*) > 11 AND AVG(lt1.milliseconds - lt2.milliseconds) BETWEEN -2473 AND 9215 ORDER BY avg_time_diff_ms DESC, total_laps_compared DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT r.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(*) AS race_count, SUM(r.points) AS total_points FROM results r JOIN drivers d ON r.driverid = d.driverid JOIN races rc ON r.raceid = rc.raceid WHERE r.points > 15.69 AND rc.year >= 2007 GROUP BY r.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(r.points) > 355.04 INTERSECT SELECT ds.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(DISTINCT ds.raceid) AS race_count, SUM(ds.points) AS total_points FROM driverstandings ds JOIN drivers d ON ds.driverid = d.driverid JOIN races rc ON ds.raceid = rc.raceid WHERE ds.points > 16.57 AND rc.year >= 2017 GROUP BY ds.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(ds.points) > 209.7 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT r.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(*) AS race_count, SUM(r.points) AS total_points FROM results r JOIN drivers d ON r.driverid = d.driverid JOIN races rc ON r.raceid = rc.raceid WHERE r.points > 19.46 AND rc.year = 2006 GROUP BY r.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(r.points) > 322.75 INTERSECT SELECT r.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(*) AS race_count, SUM(r.points) AS total_points FROM results r JOIN drivers d ON r.driverid = d.driverid JOIN races rc ON r.raceid = rc.raceid WHERE r.grid <= 3 AND rc.year = 2022 GROUP BY r.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING COUNT(*) >= 17 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT r.year, c.country, con.nationality, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, COUNT(DISTINCT res.driverid) AS unique_drivers, AVG(res.positionorder) AS avg_finish_position FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 1955 AND r.year <= 1980 AND res.positionorder <= 3 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (r.year, c.country, con.nationality), (r.year, c.country), (r.year, con.nationality), (c.country, con.nationality), (r.year), (c.country), (con.nationality), () ) HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY r.year, c.country, con.nationality;

SELECT r.year, c.country, con.nationality, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, COUNT(DISTINCT res.driverid) AS unique_drivers, AVG(res.positionorder) AS avg_finish_position FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 2008 AND r.year <= 2006 AND res.positionorder <= 8 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (r.year, c.country, con.nationality), (r.year, c.country), (r.year, con.nationality), (c.country, con.nationality), (r.year), (c.country), (con.nationality), () ) HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY r.year, c.country, con.nationality;

SELECT r.year, c.name AS circuit_name, con.name AS constructor_name, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid WHERE r.year >= 1954 AND r.year <= 1950 AND res.positionorder <= 8 AND d.dob >= '1950-01-01' GROUP BY r.year, c.circuitid, con.constructorid, d.driverid HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 138270 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_lap_time_ms ASC;

SELECT c.circuitid, c.name AS circuit_name, c.country, r.year, r.round, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.driverid) AS unique_drivers_lapped, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.driverid) AS unique_drivers_pitted, COUNT(DISTINCT q.driverid) AS unique_drivers_qualified, COUNT(DISTINCT res.driverid) AS unique_drivers_finished, SUM(cr.points) AS total_constructor_points, AVG(ds.points) AS avg_driver_points, SUM(lt.milliseconds) / 1000.0 AS total_lap_time_seconds, SUM(ps.milliseconds) / 1000.0 AS total_pitstop_time_seconds FROM circuits c JOIN races r ON c.circuitid = r.circuitid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND lt.driverid = ps.driverid AND lt.lap = ps.lap JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND lt.driverid = q.driverid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid AND lt.driverid = res.driverid JOIN constructorresults cr ON r.raceid = cr.raceid JOIN constructors con ON cr.constructorid = con.constructorid AND res.constructorid = con.constructorid JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND lt.driverid = ds.driverid JOIN drivers d ON lt.driverid = d.driverid JOIN status s ON res.statusid = s.statusid WHERE r.year >= 2007 AND r.year <= 2020 AND r.date >= '1950-01-01' AND r.date <= '1950-01-01' AND lt.milliseconds > 306653 AND ps.milliseconds > 14689 AND cr.points > '0.0' AND ds.points > '0.0' GROUP BY c.circuitid, c.name, c.country, r.year, r.round HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lt.driverid) > 29 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ps.driverid) > 34 AND COUNT(DISTINCT q.driverid) > 4 AND COUNT(DISTINCT res.driverid) > 11 AND SUM(cr.points) > '10.0' AND AVG(ds.points) > '1.0' ORDER BY r.year DESC, r.round DESC, total_constructor_points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) AS races_entered, SUM(r.points) AS total_points, (SELECT AVG(points) FROM results WHERE driverid = d.driverid AND points > 11.77) AS avg_points_above_threshold FROM drivers d JOIN results r ON d.driverid = r.driverid JOIN races rc ON r.raceid = rc.raceid WHERE rc.year >= 2018 AND rc.year <= 2013 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(r.points) > 89.88 ORDER BY total_points DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) AS races_participated, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid WHERE r.year >= 2011 AND res.points > '0' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(res.points) > '10' ORDER BY total_points DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(r.resultid) AS total_races, SUM(r.points) AS total_points, AVG(r.positionorder) AS avg_finish_position FROM drivers d JOIN results r ON d.driverid = r.driverid JOIN races rc ON r.raceid = rc.raceid WHERE rc.year >= 2013 AND rc.year <= 2007 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(r.points) > '0' ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name AS constructor_name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name AS circuit_name, cir.country, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(res.positionorder) AS avg_finish_position, COUNT(DISTINCT res.raceid) AS races_entered, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN res.positionorder = 1 THEN res.raceid END) AS wins, SUM(lt.milliseconds) / 1000.0 AS total_race_seconds, AVG(ps.milliseconds) AS avg_pitstop_ms, MIN(q.position) AS best_qualifying, MAX(ds.wins) AS max_season_wins, SUM(cr.points) AS total_constructor_points FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits cir ON r.circuitid = cir.circuitid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON res.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON res.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON res.raceid = q.raceid AND res.driverid = q.driverid JOIN driverstandings ds ON res.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid JOIN constructorresults cr ON res.raceid = cr.raceid AND res.constructorid = cr.constructorid JOIN constructorstandings cs ON res.raceid = cs.raceid AND res.constructorid = cs.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 2021 AND r.year <= 1964 AND res.points > '0' AND cir.lat BETWEEN '-90' AND '-90' AND d.dob >= '1950-01-01' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name, cir.country HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT res.raceid) >= 39 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_finish_position ASC LIMIT 445;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name AS constructor_name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name AS circuit_name, res.positionorder, res.points, ds.position AS driver_standing_position, ds.wins AS driver_wins, cs.position AS constructor_standing_position, cs.wins AS constructor_wins, lt.lap, lt.position AS lap_position, lt.milliseconds AS lap_time_ms, ps.stop AS pit_stop_number, ps.lap AS pit_stop_lap, ps.milliseconds AS pit_stop_duration_ms, q.position AS qualifying_position, t.win AS target_win, AVG(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid, r.year) AS avg_points_per_season, SUM(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY c.constructorid ORDER BY r.date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_constructor_points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.raceid ORDER BY res.positionorder) AS race_finish_rank FROM drivers d LEFT JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid LEFT JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid LEFT JOIN circuits cir ON r.circuitid = cir.circuitid LEFT JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid LEFT JOIN driverstandings ds ON d.driverid = ds.driverid AND r.raceid = ds.raceid LEFT JOIN SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops, MAX(q.position) AS best_qualifying, CASE WHEN SUM(res.points) >= 138.95 THEN 'High Scorer' WHEN SUM(res.points) >= 92.44 THEN 'Medium Scorer' ELSE 'Low Scorer' END AS performance_category, CASE WHEN AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 89009 THEN 'Fast Laps' WHEN AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 93515 THEN 'Average Laps' ELSE 'Slow Laps' END AS lap_time_category FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND d.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND d.driverid = q.driverid JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND d.driverid = ds.driverid JOIN seasons s ON r.year = s.year WHERE r.year >= 2008 AND r.year <= 2006 AND r.date >= '2000-01-01' AND r.date <= '2000-01-01' AND ds.position <= 3 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round, r.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > 41.13 AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 123143 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_lap_time_ms ASC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops, MAX(q.position) AS best_qualifying, CASE WHEN SUM(res.points) >= 409.8 THEN 'High Scorer' WHEN SUM(res.points) >= 64.98 THEN 'Medium Scorer' ELSE 'Low Scorer' END AS performance_category, CASE WHEN AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 94236 THEN 'Fast Laps' WHEN AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 107035 THEN 'Average Laps' ELSE 'Slow Laps' END AS lap_time_category FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND d.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND d.driverid = q.driverid JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND d.driverid = ds.driverid JOIN constructorresults cr ON r.raceid = cr.raceid AND c.constructorid = cr.constructorid JOIN constructorstandings cs ON r.raceid = cs.raceid AND c.constructorid = cs.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 2022 AND r.year <= 2021 AND r.date >= '2000-01-01' AND r.date <= '2000-01-01' AND ds.position <= 8 AND cs.position <= 4 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round, r.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > 79.16 AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 124034 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) >= 3 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_lap_time_ms ASC LIMIT 29;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops, MAX(q.position) AS best_qualifying, SUM(cr.points) AS constructor_points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY SUM(res.points) DESC) AS driver_rank_year, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.circuitid ORDER BY AVG(lt.milliseconds)) AS lap_time_rank_circuit FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits cct ON r.circuitid = cct.circuitid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON res.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid JOIN pitstops ps ON res.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid JOIN qualifying q ON res.raceid = q.raceid AND res.driverid = q.driverid AND res.constructorid = q.constructorid JOIN constructorresults cr ON res.raceid = cr.raceid AND res.constructorid = cr.constructorid JOIN driverstandings ds ON res.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid JOIN constructorstandings cs ON res.raceid = cs.raceid AND res.constructorid = cs.constructorid JOIN status s ON res.statusid = s.statusid LEFT JOIN target t ON res.raceid = t.raceid AND res.driverid = t.driverid WHERE r.year >= 1953 AND r.date <= '1950-01-01' AND res.grid <= 18 AND lt.lap >= 95 AND ps.lap <= 85 AND q.position <= 21 AND cr.points > '0' AND ds.points >= '0' AND cs.position < 20 AND (t.win = 1 OR t.win IS NULL) GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round, r.name, r.circuitid HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 174063 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) >= 10 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_lap_time_ms ASC LIMIT 950;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position AS lap_position, ps.stop AS pit_stop_number, ps.lap AS pit_stop_lap, ds.position AS championship_position, ds.wins AS season_wins FROM drivers d INNER JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid INNER JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid INNER JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON res.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON res.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN driverstandings ds ON res.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid WHERE r.year = 1999 AND res.points >= '0' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round, r.name, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position, ps.stop, ps.lap, ds.position, ds.wins HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) > 9 ORDER BY res.points DESC, ds.position ASC LIMIT 100;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position AS lap_position, ps.stop, ps.duration, q.position AS qualifying_position, ds.position AS driver_standing_position, cs.position AS constructor_standing_position, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM laptimes lt2 WHERE lt2.raceid = r.raceid AND lt2.driverid = d.driverid AND lt2.milliseconds < 119731) AS laps_faster_than_threshold, (SELECT AVG(points) FROM results res2 WHERE res2.raceid IN (SELECT raceid FROM races WHERE year = r.year) AND res2.driverid = d.driverid) AS avg_points_per_season, (SELECT SUM(wins) FROM driverstandings ds2 WHERE ds2.raceid = r.raceid AND ds2.driverid = d.driverid) AS total_wins_up_to_race FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits cct ON r.circuitid = cct.circuitid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND d.driverid = ps.driverid JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND d.driverid = q.driverid JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND d.driverid = ds.driverid JOIN constructorstandings cs ON r.raceid = cs.raceid AND c.constructorid = cs.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 2013 AND r.year <= 2012 AND cct.country = 'UK' AND res.points > '0' AND lt.milliseconds IS NOT NULL AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM results res3 WHERE res3.raceid = r.raceid AND res3.positionorder <= 2) > 18 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round, r.name, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position, ps.stop, ps.duration, q.position, ds.position, cs.position, r.raceid HAVING SUM(res.points) > '50' AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 106528 ORDER BY total_wins_up_to_race DESC, avg_points_per_season DESC LIMIT 917;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.raceid, r.name AS race_name, r.date, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(r.date, d.dob)) AS age_at_race, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position AS lap_position, ps.stop AS pit_stop_number, ps.duration AS pit_stop_duration FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND d.driverid = ps.driverid WHERE r.date >= '2000-01-01' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM r.date) = 2000 AND res.points > '0' AND lt.lap = 36 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.raceid, r.name, r.date, d.dob, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position, ps.stop, ps.duration HAVING COUNT(ps.stop) >= 0 ORDER BY r.date DESC, res.positionorder ASC LIMIT 100;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.raceid, r.name AS race_name, r.date, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(r.date, d.dob)) AS age_at_race, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position AS lap_position, ps.stop, ps.duration FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND d.driverid = ps.driverid WHERE r.date >= '2000-01-01' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM r.date) = 2005 AND res.points > '0' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.raceid, r.name, r.date, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position, ps.stop, ps.duration HAVING COUNT(lt.lap) > 7 ORDER BY r.date DESC, res.positionorder ASC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position AS lap_position, ps.stop AS pit_stop_number, ps.lap AS pit_stop_lap, q.position AS qualifying_position FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN laptimes lt ON res.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON res.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON res.raceid = q.raceid AND res.driverid = q.driverid WHERE r.year = 2008 AND r.round BETWEEN 10 AND 11 AND res.positionorder <= 19 AND lt.lap >= 9 AND lt.position <= 19 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position, ps.stop, ps.lap, q.position HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) >= 6 ORDER BY SUM(res.points) DESC, d.surname, d.forename;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, COUNT(*) AS races_entered FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid WHERE r.year = 1979 AND res.positionorder <= 10 AND d.driverid IN ( SELECT driverid FROM results WHERE points > '0' GROUP BY driverid HAVING COUNT(*) >= 32 ) GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY total_points DESC, races_entered DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, res.positionorder, res.points, CASE WHEN res.positionorder = 1 THEN 'Winner' WHEN res.positionorder BETWEEN 2 AND 3 THEN 'Podium' WHEN res.positionorder BETWEEN 4 AND 10 THEN 'Points' ELSE 'No Points' END AS finish_category, AVG(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid, r.year) AS avg_points_per_season, SUM(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid ORDER BY r.date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_points FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid WHERE r.year >= 2008 AND r.year <= 2002 AND res.points > '0.0' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name, res.positionorder, res.points, r.date HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0.0' ORDER BY r.year DESC, r.round ASC, res.positionorder ASC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, res.positionorder, res.points, SUM(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid, r.year ORDER BY r.round) AS cumulative_points FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid WHERE r.year = 1962 AND res.positionorder <= 4 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name, res.positionorder, res.points ORDER BY d.driverid, r.year, r.round;

SELECT d1.driverid AS driver1_id, d1.forename AS driver1_forename, d1.surname AS driver1_surname, d2.driverid AS driver2_id, d2.forename AS driver2_forename, d2.surname AS driver2_surname, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, AVG(lt1.milliseconds - lt2.milliseconds) AS avg_time_diff_ms, SUM(CASE WHEN lt1.position < lt2.position THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS driver1_ahead_count, SUM(CASE WHEN lt2.position < lt1.position THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS driver2_ahead_count, COUNT(*) AS total_laps_compared FROM laptimes lt1 JOIN laptimes lt2 ON lt1.raceid = lt2.raceid AND lt1.lap = lt2.lap AND lt1.driverid < lt2.driverid JOIN races r ON lt1.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN drivers d1 ON lt1.driverid = d1.driverid JOIN drivers d2 ON lt2.driverid = d2.driverid JOIN results res1 ON lt1.raceid = res1.raceid AND lt1.driverid = res1.driverid JOIN results res2 ON lt2.raceid = res2.raceid AND lt2.driverid = res2.driverid JOIN constructorresults cr1 ON res1.raceid = cr1.raceid AND res1.constructorid = cr1.constructorid JOIN constructorresults cr2 ON res2.raceid = cr2.raceid AND res2.constructorid = cr2.constructorid JOIN qualifying q1 ON lt1.raceid = q1.raceid AND lt1.driverid = q1.driverid JOIN qualifying q2 ON lt2.raceid = q2.raceid AND lt2.driverid = q2.driverid WHERE r.year >= 1965 AND r.year <= 1962 AND lt1.milliseconds > 130331 AND lt2.milliseconds > 180300 AND res1.points >= '0' AND res2.points >= '0' GROUP BY d1.driverid, d1.forename, d1.surname, d2.driverid, d2.forename, d2.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name HAVING COUNT(*) > 46 AND AVG(lt1.milliseconds - lt2.milliseconds) BETWEEN -9104 AND 3949 ORDER BY avg_time_diff_ms DESC, total_laps_compared DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT r.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(*) AS race_count FROM results r JOIN drivers d ON r.driverid = d.driverid WHERE r.positionorder <= 7 GROUP BY r.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING COUNT(*) >= 50 INTERSECT SELECT ds.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(*) AS race_count FROM driverstandings ds JOIN drivers d ON ds.driverid = d.driverid WHERE ds.position <= 10 GROUP BY ds.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING COUNT(*) >= 28 ORDER BY race_count DESC;

SELECT r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, d.driverid, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, res.positionorder, res.points, AVG(res.points) OVER ( PARTITION BY r.circuitid, d.driverid ORDER BY r.date ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS avg_points_last_3_races FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 2018 AND r.year <= 2009 AND res.positionorder <= 10 AND d.dob >= '1970-01-01' GROUP BY r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name, d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, res.positionorder, res.points, r.circuitid, r.date HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY r.year, r.round, avg_points_last_3_races DESC;

SELECT r.year, c.country, con.name AS constructor_name, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) AS races_entered, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, SUM(ps.milliseconds) AS total_pitstop_time_ms, COUNT(ps.stop) AS total_pitstops, MAX(ds.wins) AS max_wins_in_season FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid WHERE r.year >= 1999 AND r.year <= 2021 AND res.points > '0' AND d.dob >= '1960-01-01' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (r.year, c.country, con.name, d.forename, d.surname), (r.year, c.country, con.name), (r.year, c.country), (r.year), () ) HAVING SUM(res.points) > '10' ORDER BY r.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT r.year, c.country, d.nationality, COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) AS race_count, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid WHERE r.year >= 1957 AND r.year <= 1988 AND res.points > '0' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (r.year, c.country, d.nationality), (r.year, c.country), (r.year), () ) ORDER BY r.year, c.country, d.nationality;

SELECT r.year, c.name AS circuit_name, con.name AS constructor_name, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.driverid) AS distinct_drivers, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) AS distinct_laps_led, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid AND lt.driverid = res.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 2006 AND lt.milliseconds <= 111563 GROUP BY r.year, c.name, con.name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lt.driverid) > 5 ORDER BY r.year DESC, distinct_drivers DESC;

SELECT r.year, c.name AS circuit_name, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, con.name AS constructor_name, res.positionorder, res.points, CASE WHEN res.positionorder = 1 THEN 'Winner' WHEN res.positionorder BETWEEN 2 AND 3 THEN 'Podium' WHEN res.positionorder BETWEEN 4 AND 10 THEN 'Points' ELSE 'No Points' END AS finish_category, AVG(l.milliseconds) OVER (PARTITION BY r.raceid, d.driverid) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(p.stop) OVER (PARTITION BY r.raceid, d.driverid) AS total_pitstops FROM races r JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid LEFT JOIN laptimes l ON r.raceid = l.raceid AND res.driverid = l.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops p ON r.raceid = p.raceid AND res.driverid = p.driverid WHERE r.year >= 2007 AND r.year <= 2021 AND res.points > '0' GROUP BY r.year, c.name, d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, con.name, res.positionorder, res.points, r.raceid, l.milliseconds, p.stop ORDER BY r.year DESC, res.positionorder ASC;

SELECT r.year, c.name AS constructor_name, COUNT(DISTINCT res.driverid) AS unique_drivers, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(res.positionorder) AS avg_finish FROM results res JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 2000 AND res.points > '0' GROUP BY r.year, c.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '50' ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT r.year, c.name AS constructor_name, COUNT(DISTINCT res.driverid) AS unique_drivers, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(res.positionorder) AS avg_finish FROM results res JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 2001 AND res.points > '0' GROUP BY r.year, c.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '10' ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT r.year, c.name AS constructor_name, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, COUNT(DISTINCT res.raceid) AS races_entered, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, CASE WHEN SUM(res.points) >= 177.34 THEN 'High Performer' WHEN SUM(res.points) >= 38.55 THEN 'Medium Performer' ELSE 'Low Performer' END AS performance_category, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms FROM results res JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON res.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid WHERE r.year >= 2023 GROUP BY r.year, c.constructorid, c.name, d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT res.raceid) > 5 ORDER BY r.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT r.year, r.name AS race_name, c.name AS circuit_name, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, con.name AS constructor_name, res.positionorder, res.points, AVG(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY r.year, con.constructorid) AS avg_constructor_points_per_year, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY res.points DESC) AS yearly_points_rank FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 2021 AND r.year <= 1999 AND res.positionorder <= 1 GROUP BY r.year, r.name, c.name, d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, con.constructorid, con.name, res.positionorder, res.points HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY r.year DESC, yearly_points_rank ASC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM results r2 WHERE r2.driverid = d.driverid AND r2.position = 1) AS career_wins, COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) AS races_entered, SUM(r.points) AS total_points, AVG(l.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms FROM drivers d JOIN results r ON d.driverid = r.driverid JOIN races rc ON r.raceid = rc.raceid JOIN laptimes l ON r.raceid = l.raceid AND r.driverid = l.driverid WHERE rc.year >= 2001 AND rc.year <= 1958 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(r.points) > '0' ORDER BY total_points DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) AS races_entered, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(res.positionorder) AS avg_finish_position, MAX(ds.wins) AS max_wins_in_season FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN driverstandings ds ON d.driverid = ds.driverid AND r.raceid = ds.raceid JOIN seasons s ON r.year = s.year WHERE r.year >= 2021 AND res.points > '0' AND d.dob <= '1950-01-01' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(res.points) > '10' ORDER BY total_points DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) AS total_races, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM results res2 WHERE res2.driverid = d.driverid AND res2.position = 1) AS total_wins FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid WHERE r.year >= 1961 AND r.year <= 1972 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(r.resultid) AS race_count, SUM(r.points) AS total_points, AVG(r.positionorder) AS avg_finish FROM drivers d JOIN results r ON d.driverid = r.driverid JOIN races rc ON r.raceid = rc.raceid WHERE rc.year >= 2010 AND r.points > '0' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING COUNT(r.resultid) >= 35 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(r.resultid) AS total_races, SUM(r.points) AS total_points, AVG(r.positionorder) AS avg_finish_position FROM drivers d JOIN results r ON d.driverid = r.driverid JOIN races rc ON r.raceid = rc.raceid WHERE rc.year >= 2017 AND rc.year <= 1998 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(r.points) > '0' ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name AS constructor_name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name AS circuit_name, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) AS total_laps_raced, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, MIN(ps.milliseconds) AS min_pitstop_ms, MAX(q.position) AS worst_qualifying_position, SUM(CASE WHEN res.positionorder = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wins, SUM(t.win) AS target_wins FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits cir ON r.circuitid = cir.circuitid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND d.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND d.driverid = q.driverid LEFT JOIN target t ON r.raceid = t.raceid AND d.driverid = t.driverid WHERE r.year >= 1985 AND r.year <= 1960 AND res.points > '0' AND lt.milliseconds < 63204 AND cir.alt > 575 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '10' AND COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) >= 86 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_lap_time_ms ASC LIMIT 764;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, res.positionorder, res.points, AVG(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid, r.year) AS avg_points_per_season, SUM(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid ORDER BY r.date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.raceid ORDER BY res.points DESC) AS race_points_rank, lt.total_laps, ps.total_pitstops, q.avg_qualifying_position FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN ( SELECT raceid, driverid, COUNT(DISTINCT lap) AS total_laps FROM laptimes GROUP BY raceid, driverid ) lt ON res.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN ( SELECT raceid, driverid, COUNT(stop) AS total_pitstops FROM pitstops GROUP BY raceid, driverid ) ps ON res.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN ( SELECT raceid, driverid, AVG(position) AS avg_qualifying_position FROM qualifying GROUP BY raceid, driverid ) q ON res.raceid = q.raceid AND res.driverid = q.driverid JOIN seasons s ON r.year = s.year JOIN circuits ci ON r.circuitid = ci.circuitid JOIN driverstandings ds ON res.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid JOIN constructorstandings cs ON res.raceid = cs.raceid AND res.constructorid = cs.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 2012 AND r.year <= 1974 AND res.points > '0' AND ci.alt > 652 AND ds.position <= 6 AND cs.position <= 7 AND d.dob >= '1950-01-01' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round, r.name, res.positionorder, res.points, r.date, r.raceid, lt.total_laps, ps.total_pitstops, q.avg_qualifying_position HAVING SUM(res.points) > '10' ORDER BY cumulative_points DESC, race_points_rank ASC LIMIT 869;
