SELECT r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, con.name AS constructor_name, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points, ds.wins AS driver_wins, cs.wins AS constructor_wins, AVG(lt.milliseconds) OVER (PARTITION BY r.raceid, d.driverid) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(p.stop) OVER (PARTITION BY r.raceid, d.driverid) AS pit_stops FROM races r INNER JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid INNER JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid INNER JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid INNER JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid LEFT JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND d.driverid = ds.driverid LEFT JOIN constructorstandings cs ON r.raceid = cs.raceid AND con.constructorid = cs.constructorid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops p ON r.raceid = p.raceid AND d.driverid = p.driverid WHERE r.year >= 1956 AND r.year <= 1961 AND res.points > '0' GROUP BY r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name, d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, con.constructorid, con.name, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points, ds.wins, cs.wins, p.stop, lt.milliseconds HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) >= 99 ORDER BY r.year DESC, r.round DESC, res.points DESC LIMIT 826;

SELECT r.year, c.country, con.nationality, d.driverref, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) AS total_laps_analyzed, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, SUM(cr.points) AS total_constructor_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pit_stops, MIN(q.position) AS best_qualifying, AVG(res.grid) AS avg_grid_position, SUM(CASE WHEN res.positionorder = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wins, SUM(ds.wins) AS driver_season_wins, SUM(cs.wins) AS constructor_season_wins FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND res.driverid = q.driverid AND res.constructorid = q.constructorid LEFT JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid LEFT JOIN constructorstandings cs ON r.raceid = cs.raceid AND res.constructorid = cs.constructorid LEFT JOIN constructorresults cr ON r.raceid = cr.raceid AND res.constructorid = cr.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 1970 AND r.year <= 1997 AND res.points > '0' AND lt.milliseconds > 78701 AND (q.position IS NULL OR q.position < 20) GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (r.year, c.country, con.nationality, d.driverref), (r.year, c.country, con.nationality), (r.year, c.country), (r.year), () ) HAVING SUM(res.points) > '10' AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 132146 ORDER BY r.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT r.year, c.name AS circuit_name, con.name AS constructor_name, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid WHERE r.year >= 2016 AND r.year <= 2022 GROUP BY r.year, c.circuitid, con.constructorid, d.driverid HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_lap_time_ms ASC LIMIT 100;

SELECT r.year, c.name AS constructor_name, COUNT(DISTINCT res.raceid) AS races_entered, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(res.positionorder) AS avg_finish_position, MAX(ds.wins) AS max_wins_in_season FROM constructors c JOIN results res ON c.constructorid = res.constructorid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN driverstandings ds ON res.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid WHERE r.year >= 2023 AND res.points > '0' GROUP BY r.year, c.constructorid, c.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '10' ORDER BY total_points DESC, r.year ASC;

SELECT r.year, c.name AS constructor_name, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY SUM(res.points) DESC) AS yearly_rank FROM races r JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid WHERE r.year >= 1996 AND r.year <= 1966 GROUP BY r.year, c.constructorid, c.name, d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY r.year DESC, yearly_rank ASC;

SELECT r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, con.name AS constructor_name, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position AS lap_position, ps.stop AS pit_stop_number, ps.lap AS pit_stop_lap, q.position AS qualifying_position, ds.wins AS driver_wins, cs.wins AS constructor_wins FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND res.driverid = q.driverid AND res.constructorid = q.constructorid LEFT JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid LEFT JOIN constructorstandings cs ON r.raceid = cs.raceid AND res.constructorid = cs.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 2016 AND r.year <= 2000 AND res.points > '0' AND d.dob >= '1970-01-01' GROUP BY r.year, r.round, c.name, d.forename, d.surname, con.name, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position, ps.stop, ps.lap, q.position, ds.wins, cs.wins HAVING AVG(lt.position) < 10 OR AVG(lt.position) IS NULL ORDER BY r.year DESC, r.round, res.points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) AS races_entered, SUM(r.points) AS total_points, (SELECT AVG(points) FROM results WHERE driverid = d.driverid AND points > 10.71) AS avg_points_above_threshold FROM drivers d JOIN results r ON d.driverid = r.driverid JOIN races rc ON r.raceid = rc.raceid WHERE rc.year >= 2008 AND rc.year <= 2005 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(r.points) > 97.51 ORDER BY total_points DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) AS races_entered, SUM(r.points) AS total_points, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM results r2 WHERE r2.driverid = d.driverid AND r2.position = 1) AS career_wins FROM drivers d JOIN results r ON d.driverid = r.driverid JOIN races rc ON r.raceid = rc.raceid JOIN circuits c ON rc.circuitid = c.circuitid WHERE rc.year >= 2016 AND rc.year <= 1982 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(r.points) > '0' ORDER BY total_points DESC LIMIT 20;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) AS races_participated, SUM(r.points) AS total_points FROM drivers d JOIN results r ON d.driverid = r.driverid JOIN races rc ON r.raceid = rc.raceid WHERE rc.year IN (SELECT year FROM seasons WHERE year >= 2002 AND year <= 1984) GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(r.points) > '0' ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) AS races_participated, SUM(r.points) AS total_points FROM drivers d JOIN results r ON d.driverid = r.driverid JOIN races rc ON r.raceid = rc.raceid WHERE rc.year IN (SELECT year FROM seasons WHERE year >= 2023 AND year <= 1991) GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(r.points) > '0' ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) AS races_participated, SUM(r.points) AS total_points FROM drivers d JOIN results r ON d.driverid = r.driverid WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM races rc WHERE rc.raceid = r.raceid AND rc.year >= 2016 AND rc.year <= 1998 ) GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(r.points) > '0' ORDER BY total_points DESC;

s.status, r.date, r.circuitid HAVING SUM(res.points) > '10' AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 89177 ORDER BY yearly_points_rank, running_constructor_points DESC LIMIT 542;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, cir.name AS circuit_name, COUNT(DISTINCT res.raceid) AS races_entered, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(res.positionorder) AS avg_finish_position, MAX(ds.wins) AS max_wins_in_season, SUM(CASE WHEN res.positionorder = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wins, SUM(lt.milliseconds) / 1000.0 AS total_racing_seconds, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops, AVG(q.position) AS avg_qualifying_position FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits cir ON r.circuitid = cir.circuitid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN driverstandings ds ON d.driverid = ds.driverid AND r.raceid = ds.raceid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON d.driverid = lt.driverid AND r.raceid = lt.raceid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON d.driverid = ps.driverid AND r.raceid = ps.raceid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON d.driverid = q.driverid AND r.raceid = q.raceid WHERE r.year >= 2016 AND r.year <= 2007 AND cir.country = 'UK' AND res.points > '0' AND d.dob >= '1950-01-01' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name, r.year, r.round, cir.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '50' AND COUNT(DISTINCT res.raceid) >= 26 AND AVG(res.positionorder) <= 8 ORDER BY total_points DESC, wins DESC, avg_finish_position ASC LIMIT 75;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, COUNT(r.resultid) AS total_races, SUM(r.points) AS total_points, AVG(r.positionorder) AS avg_finish_position FROM drivers d JOIN results r ON d.driverid = r.driverid JOIN constructors c ON r.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN races rc ON r.raceid = rc.raceid WHERE rc.year >= 2013 AND rc.year <= 2014 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name HAVING SUM(r.points) > '50' ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) AS laps_led, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, MIN(ps.milliseconds) AS fastest_pitstop_ms, MAX(q.position) AS worst_qualifying_position, SUM(CASE WHEN ds.position = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wins, SUM(t.win) AS target_wins FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON d.driverid = lt.driverid AND res.raceid = lt.raceid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON d.driverid = ps.driverid AND res.raceid = ps.raceid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON d.driverid = q.driverid AND res.raceid = q.raceid LEFT JOIN driverstandings ds ON d.driverid = ds.driverid AND res.raceid = ds.raceid LEFT JOIN target t ON d.driverid = t.driverid AND res.raceid = t.raceid WHERE r.year >= 1961 AND r.date <= '1950-01-01' AND res.points > '0' AND lt.position = 1 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round, r.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '10' AND COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) >= 35 ORDER BY total_points DESC, wins DESC LIMIT 387;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops, MAX(ds.wins) AS max_wins_in_season, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY SUM(res.points) DESC) AS yearly_rank FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON d.driverid = lt.driverid AND res.raceid = lt.raceid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON d.driverid = ps.driverid AND res.raceid = ps.raceid JOIN driverstandings ds ON d.driverid = ds.driverid AND res.raceid = ds.raceid WHERE r.year >= 1993 AND r.date <= '1950-01-01' AND res.grid <= 26 AND lt.milliseconds < 173876 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM qualifying q WHERE q.raceid = r.raceid AND q.driverid = d.driverid AND q.position <= 11 ) GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round, r.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) >= 2 ORDER BY total_points DESC, yearly_rank LIMIT 847;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops, MAX(ds.wins) AS max_wins_in_season, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY SUM(res.points) DESC) AS yearly_rank FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON d.driverid = lt.driverid AND res.raceid = lt.raceid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON d.driverid = ps.driverid AND res.raceid = ps.raceid JOIN driverstandings ds ON d.driverid = ds.driverid AND res.raceid = ds.raceid WHERE r.year >= 2001 AND r.date <= '1950-01-01' AND res.positionorder <= 4 AND lt.milliseconds > 171043 AND d.driverid IN ( SELECT driverid FROM results WHERE points > '0' GROUP BY driverid HAVING COUNT(*) >= 42 ) GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round, r.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 114532 ORDER BY total_points DESC, yearly_rank LIMIT 715;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops, MAX(q.position) AS best_qualifying FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND d.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND d.driverid = q.driverid WHERE r.year >= 1980 AND r.date <= '1950-01-01' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round, r.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 115082 INTERSECT SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops, MAX(q.position) AS best_qualifying FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND d.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND d.driverid = q.driverid JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND d.driverid = ds.driverid WHERE r.circuitid IN (SELECT circuitid FROM circuits WHERE alt > 54) GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round, r.name HAVING MAX(ds.wins) >= 6 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) <= 10 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_lap_time_ms ASC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops, MAX(q.position) AS best_qualifying FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON d.driverid = lt.driverid AND res.raceid = lt.raceid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON d.driverid = ps.driverid AND res.raceid = ps.raceid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON d.driverid = q.driverid AND res.raceid = q.raceid WHERE r.year >= 1981 AND r.date <= '1950-01-01' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round, r.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 148569 UNION ALL SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, SUM(cr.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops, MAX(q.position) AS best_qualifying FROM drivers d JOIN constructorresults cr ON d.driverid = 634 JOIN races r ON cr.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON cr.constructorid = c.constructorid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON d.driverid = lt.driverid AND cr.raceid = lt.raceid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON d.driverid = ps.driverid AND cr.raceid = ps.raceid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON d.driverid = q.driverid AND cr.raceid = q.raceid WHERE r.year >= 2010 AND r.date <= '1950-01-01' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round, r.name HAVING SUM(cr.points) > '0' AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 113694 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_lap_time_ms ASC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.raceid, r.name AS race_name, r.date, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(r.date, d.dob)) AS driver_age_at_race, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) AS laps_analyzed FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid WHERE r.date >= '2000-01-01'::date AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM r.date) = 2011 AND d.dob <= r.date - INTERVAL '30 years' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.raceid, r.name, r.date HAVING AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 105058.9 ORDER BY avg_lap_time_ms ASC LIMIT 100;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, res.positionorder, res.points, SUM(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid, r.year ORDER BY r.date) AS cumulative_points_season, AVG(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid, r.year) AS avg_points_season FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid WHERE r.year = 1969 AND res.positionorder <= 9 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name, res.positionorder, res.points, r.date ORDER BY d.driverid, r.year, r.round;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, c.name AS circuit_name, res.positionorder, res.points, (SELECT AVG(subq.avg_points) FROM ( SELECT rs.constructorid, AVG(rs.points) AS avg_points FROM results rs WHERE rs.raceid IN (SELECT raceid FROM races WHERE year = r.year) GROUP BY rs.constructorid HAVING AVG(rs.points) > 0.33 ) subq ) AS avg_constructor_points_above_threshold FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid WHERE r.date >= '2000-01-01' AND r.date <= '2011-01-01' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, r.name, c.name, res.positionorder, res.points HAVING SUM(res.points) > 84.54 ORDER BY r.year DESC, r.round DESC, res.positionorder ASC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, c.name AS circuit_name, res.positionorder, res.points, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM laptimes lt WHERE lt.raceid = r.raceid AND lt.driverid = d.driverid AND lt.position = 1) AS laps_led, (SELECT AVG(ps.milliseconds) FROM pitstops ps WHERE ps.raceid = r.raceid AND ps.driverid = d.driverid) AS avg_pitstop_ms FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid WHERE r.year = 1978 AND res.points > '0' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, r.name, c.name, res.positionorder, res.points, r.raceid HAVING AVG(res.positionorder) < 8 ORDER BY res.points DESC, laps_led DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, res.points, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM laptimes lt WHERE lt.raceid = r.raceid AND lt.driverid = d.driverid AND lt.position = 14) AS laps_in_position FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid WHERE r.year = 1955 AND res.points > '0' ORDER BY res.points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position AS lap_position, lt.milliseconds AS lap_time_ms FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid WHERE r.year = 1987 AND res.positionorder <= 1 AND lt.lap = ( SELECT MAX(lap) FROM laptimes WHERE raceid = r.raceid AND driverid = d.driverid ) ORDER BY r.round, res.positionorder, lt.lap;
SELECT r.raceid, COUNT(l.driverid) AS driver_count FROM races r JOIN laptimes l ON r.raceid = l.raceid WHERE r.year = 1998 AND l.milliseconds > 146439 GROUP BY r.raceid ORDER BY driver_count DESC;

SELECT r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, d.driverid, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, res.positionorder, res.points, AVG(res.points) OVER ( PARTITION BY r.year, d.driverid ORDER BY r.date ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_points_last_3_races FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid WHERE r.year >= 2013 AND r.year <= 2002 AND res.positionorder <= 6 GROUP BY r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name, d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, res.positionorder, res.points, r.date HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0.0' ORDER BY r.year, r.round, moving_avg_points_last_3_races DESC;

SELECT r.year, c.name AS circuit_name, con.name AS constructor_name, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid WHERE r.year >= 1995 AND r.year <= 2013 GROUP BY r.year, c.circuitid, c.name, con.constructorid, con.name, d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY r.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT r.year, c.name AS constructor_name, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) AS distinct_laps_driven, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS distinct_pit_stops, AVG(res.points) AS avg_points_per_race, SUM(cs.wins) AS total_constructor_wins FROM races r JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN constructorstandings cs ON r.raceid = cs.raceid AND c.constructorid = cs.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 2022 AND r.year <= 2002 AND res.positionorder <= 6 GROUP BY r.year, c.constructorid, c.name, d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING AVG(res.points) > '0.0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) >= 25 ORDER BY r.year DESC, total_constructor_wins DESC, avg_points_per_race DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name AS constructor_name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name AS circuit_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(res.positionorder) AS avg_finish_position, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) AS total_laps_led, MIN(ps.milliseconds) AS fastest_pitstop_ms, MAX(q.position) AS worst_qualifying, SUM(cs.wins) AS constructor_wins, SUM(ds.wins) AS driver_wins, COUNT(DISTINCT res.resultid) AS races_finished, CORR(res.grid, res.positionorder) AS grid_finish_correlation FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits cir ON r.circuitid = cir.circuitid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON res.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid AND lt.position = 1 LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON res.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON res.raceid = q.raceid AND res.driverid = q.driverid LEFT JOIN constructorstandings cs ON res.raceid = cs.raceid AND res.constructorid = cs.constructorid LEFT JOIN driverstandings ds ON res.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid WHERE r.year >= 1976 AND r.year <= 2009 AND res.positionorder IS NOT NULL AND res.points > '0' AND cir.alt > 327 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '10' AND COUNT(DISTINCT res.resultid) >= 31 AND AVG(res.positionorder) < 2 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_finish_position ASC LIMIT 697;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name AS constructor_name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name AS circuit_name, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position AS lap_position, lt.milliseconds AS lap_time_ms, ps.stop, ps.lap AS pit_lap, ps.milliseconds AS pit_time_ms, q.position AS qualifying_position, ds.points AS driver_standing_points, ds.wins AS driver_wins, cs.points AS constructor_standing_points, cs.wins AS constructor_wins, AVG(lt.milliseconds) OVER (PARTITION BY r.raceid, d.driverid) AS avg_lap_time_per_race, SUM(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY r.year, d.driverid ORDER BY r.date) AS cumulative_points_season, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.raceid ORDER BY res.positionorder) AS race_finish_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY ds.points DESC) AS season_driver_rank FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits cir ON r.circuitid = cir.circuitid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND d.driverid = ps.driverid JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND d.driverid = q.driverid JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND d.driverid = ds.driverid JOIN constructorstandings cs ON r.raceid = cs.raceid AND c.constructorid = cs.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 1998 AND r.year <= 2016 AND res.points > '0' AND lt.milliseconds < 112192 AND cir.alt > 643 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position, lt.milliseconds, ps.stop, ps.lap, ps.milliseconds, q.position, ds.points, ds.wins, cs.points, cs.wins HAVING AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 110857 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) > 11 ORDER BY r.year DESC, r.round DESC, cumulative_points_season DESC;

SELECT d1.driverid AS driver1_id, d1.forename AS driver1_forename, d1.surname AS driver1_surname, d2.driverid AS driver2_id, d2.forename AS driver2_forename, d2.surname AS driver2_surname, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, AVG(lt1.milliseconds - lt2.milliseconds) AS avg_time_diff_ms, SUM(CASE WHEN res1.positionorder < res2.positionorder THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS driver1_wins_against_driver2, SUM(cr1.points) AS driver1_constructor_points, SUM(cr2.points) AS driver2_constructor_points, COUNT(DISTINCT lt1.lap) AS laps_compared, CORR(lt1.position, lt2.position) AS lap_position_correlation FROM laptimes lt1 JOIN laptimes lt2 ON lt1.raceid = lt2.raceid AND lt1.lap = lt2.lap AND lt1.driverid < lt2.driverid JOIN drivers d1 ON lt1.driverid = d1.driverid JOIN drivers d2 ON lt2.driverid = d2.driverid JOIN races r ON lt1.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid LEFT JOIN results res1 ON lt1.raceid = res1.raceid AND lt1.driverid = res1.driverid LEFT JOIN results res2 ON lt2.raceid = res2.raceid AND lt2.driverid = res2.driverid LEFT JOIN constructorresults cr1 ON res1.raceid = cr1.raceid AND res1.constructorid = cr1.constructorid LEFT JOIN constructorresults cr2 ON res2.raceid = cr2.raceid AND res2.constructorid = cr2.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 1988 AND r.date <= '1950-01-01' AND lt1.milliseconds IS NOT NULL AND lt2.milliseconds IS NOT NULL AND c.alt > 138 GROUP BY d1.driverid, d1.forename, d1.surname, d2.driverid, d2.forename, d2.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lt1.lap) > 15 AND AVG(lt1.milliseconds - lt2.milliseconds) BETWEEN -3307 AND 8490 ORDER BY avg_time_diff_ms DESC, driver1_wins_against_driver2 DESC LIMIT 749;

SELECT r.year, c.name AS circuit_name, con.name AS constructor_name, COUNT(DISTINCT d.driverid) AS unique_drivers, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) AS unique_laps_raced, SUM(res.points) AS total_points FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid WHERE r.year >= 1990 AND r.year <= 2005 GROUP BY r.year, c.circuitid, c.name, con.constructorid, con.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY r.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT r.year, c.name AS constructor_name, COUNT(DISTINCT res.driverid) AS unique_drivers, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(res.positionorder) AS avg_finish FROM results res JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 2017 AND res.points > '0' GROUP BY r.year, c.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '10' ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, COUNT(*) AS races_entered FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid WHERE r.year = 1972 AND res.grid <= 8 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' UNION ALL SELECT d.driverid, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) AS laps_analyzed FROM drivers d JOIN laptimes lt ON d.driverid = lt.driverid JOIN races r ON lt.raceid = r.raceid JOIN results res ON lt.raceid = res.raceid AND lt.driverid = res.driverid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid WHERE r.year = 2005 AND lt.position <= 27 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round HAVING AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 152550 ORDER BY driver_name, year, round;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) AS races_entered, SUM(r.points) AS total_points, (SELECT AVG(l.milliseconds) FROM laptimes l WHERE l.driverid = d.driverid AND l.lap = 14) AS avg_lap_time_ms FROM drivers d JOIN results r ON d.driverid = r.driverid JOIN races rc ON r.raceid = rc.raceid WHERE rc.year >= 2003 AND rc.year <= 2007 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(r.points) > '0' ORDER BY total_points DESC LIMIT 72;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) AS races_entered, SUM(r.points) AS total_points, AVG(r.positionorder) AS avg_finish_position FROM drivers d JOIN results r ON d.driverid = r.driverid JOIN races rc ON r.raceid = rc.raceid WHERE rc.year IN (SELECT year FROM seasons WHERE year >= 1981 AND year <= 1965) AND r.positionorder <= 19 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(r.points) > '0' ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) AS races_participated, SUM(r.points) AS total_points, AVG(r.positionorder) AS avg_finish_position FROM drivers d JOIN results r ON d.driverid = r.driverid JOIN races rc ON r.raceid = rc.raceid WHERE rc.year = 1973 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM constructorstandings cs WHERE cs.constructorid = r.constructorid AND cs.raceid = r.raceid AND cs.position <= 1 ) GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(r.points) > '0' ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name AS constructor_name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops, MAX(ds.wins) AS max_wins_in_season, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY SUM(res.points) DESC) AS yearly_rank FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND d.driverid = ps.driverid JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND d.driverid = ds.driverid JOIN seasons s ON r.year = s.year WHERE r.year >= 1957 AND r.year <= 1968 AND res.grid <= 26 AND lt.milliseconds > 88156 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) >= 4 INTERSECT SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name AS constructor_name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops, MAX(ds.wins) AS max_wins_in_season, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY SUM(res.points) DESC) AS yearly_rank FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND d.driverid = ps.driverid JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND d.driverid = ds.driverid JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND d.driverid = q.driverid WHERE r.year >= 1955 AND r.year <= 2007 AND q.position <= 12 AND lt.milliseconds < 71452 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round HAVING SUM(res.points) < '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) <= 0 ORDER BY yearly_rank, total_points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name AS constructor_name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name AS circuit_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops, MAX(ds.wins) AS max_wins_in_season, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY SUM(res.points) DESC) AS yearly_rank FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits cir ON r.circuitid = cir.circuitid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND d.driverid = ps.driverid JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND d.driverid = ds.driverid JOIN seasons s ON r.year = s.year WHERE r.year IN (SELECT year FROM races WHERE date >= '1950-01-01' AND date <= '1950-01-01' GROUP BY year HAVING COUNT(raceid) > 27) AND cir.lat BETWEEN '-90' AND '-90' AND res.grid <= 10 AND lt.position <= 13 AND ds.position <= 2 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d.dob) <= 1985 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 80065 ORDER BY total_points DESC, yearly_rank LIMIT 789;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name AS constructor_name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name AS circuit_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops, MAX(ds.wins) AS max_wins_in_season, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY SUM(res.points) DESC) AS yearly_rank FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits cir ON r.circuitid = cir.circuitid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND d.driverid = ps.driverid JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND d.driverid = ds.driverid JOIN seasons s ON r.year = s.year WHERE r.year IN (SELECT year FROM seasons WHERE year >= 1978 AND year <= 1978) AND res.positionorder <= 4 AND lt.milliseconds > 297410 AND cir.alt > 339 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) >= 9 ORDER BY total_points DESC, yearly_rank, r.year, r.round LIMIT 463;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name AS constructor_name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name AS circuit_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(res.positionorder) AS avg_finish_position, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) AS total_laps_raced, SUM(ps.milliseconds) / 1000.0 AS total_pitstop_time_seconds, MAX(ds.wins) AS max_wins_in_season, AVG(q.position) AS avg_qualifying_position FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits cir ON r.circuitid = cir.circuitid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON res.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON res.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid JOIN driverstandings ds ON res.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid JOIN qualifying q ON res.raceid = q.raceid AND res.driverid = q.driverid AND res.constructorid = q.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 1986 AND r.year <= 1987 AND res.positionorder <= 14 AND cir.alt >= 542 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND AVG(res.positionorder) < 8 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_finish_position ASC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name AS constructor_name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name AS circuit_name, cir.country, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points, res.laps, res.milliseconds AS race_milliseconds, lt.lap, lt.position AS lap_position, lt.milliseconds AS lap_milliseconds, ps.stop, ps.lap AS pit_lap, ps.milliseconds AS pit_milliseconds, q.position AS qualifying_position, ds.points AS driver_standing_points, ds.wins AS driver_standing_wins, cs.points AS constructor_standing_points, cs.wins AS constructor_standing_wins, cr.points AS constructor_result_points, t.win AS target_win, AVG(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid, r.year) AS avg_driver_points_per_year, SUM(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY c.constructorid, r.year ORDER BY r.date) AS running_constructor_points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.raceid ORDER BY res.positionorder) AS race_finish_rank, LAG(res.positionorder, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid ORDER BY r.date) AS prev_race_position FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits cir ON r.circuitid = cir.circuitid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON res.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid JOIN pitstops ps ON res.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid JOIN qualifying q ON res.raceid = q.raceid AND res.driverid = q.driverid AND res.constructorid = q.constructorid JOIN driverstandings ds ON res.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid JOIN constructorstandings cs ON res.raceid = cs.raceid AND res.constructorid = cs.constructorid JOIN constructorresults cr ON res.raceid = cr.raceid AND res.constructorid = cr.constructorid JOIN target t ON res.raceid = t.raceid AND res.driverid = t.driverid WHERE r.year BETWEEN 1997 AND 2022 AND res.points > '0' AND res.grid <= 2 AND lt.position <= 11 AND ps.milliseconds >= 39074 AND q.position < 1 AND ds.points >= '0' AND cs.points > '0' AND cr.points >= '0' AND t.win = 1 AND cir.lat BETWEEN '-90' AND '-90' AND cir.alt > 382 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name, cir.country, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points, res.laps, res.milliseconds, lt.lap, lt.position, lt.milliseconds, ps.stop, ps.lap, ps.milliseconds, q.position, ds.points, ds.wins, cs.points, cs.wins, cr.points, t.win HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 118805 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) >= 1 ORDER BY running_constructor_points DESC, avg_driver_points_per_year DESC, race_finish_rank;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name AS constructor_name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name AS circuit_name, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position AS lap_position, ps.stop AS pit_stop_number, ps.lap AS pit_stop_lap, q.position AS qualifying_position FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN laptimes lt ON res.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON res.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON res.raceid = q.raceid AND res.driverid = q.driverid WHERE r.year = 2021 AND r.round >= 16 AND res.positionorder <= 4 AND lt.lap BETWEEN 36 AND 52 AND (ps.milliseconds IS NULL OR ps.milliseconds > 52894) GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position, ps.stop, ps.lap, q.position HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY SUM(res.points) DESC, d.surname, r.round;

SELECT r.year, c.name AS circuit_name, con.name AS constructor_name, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position AS lap_position, ps.stop AS pit_stop_number, ps.duration AS pit_stop_duration, q.position AS qualifying_position, ds.wins AS driver_wins, cs.wins AS constructor_wins FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND res.driverid = q.driverid AND res.constructorid = q.constructorid LEFT JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid LEFT JOIN constructorstandings cs ON r.raceid = cs.raceid AND res.constructorid = cs.constructorid WHERE r.year = 2014 AND res.positionorder <= 14 AND lt.lap >= 52 AND (ps.milliseconds IS NULL OR ps.milliseconds > 61866) AND d.dob >= '1950-01-01' GROUP BY r.year, c.circuitid, con.constructorid, d.driverid, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position, ps.stop, ps.duration, q.position, ds.wins, cs.wins HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY r.year, res.positionorder, SUM(res.points) DESC;

SELECT r.year, c.name AS circuit_name, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, con.name AS constructor_name, res.positionorder, res.points, CASE WHEN res.positionorder = 1 THEN 'Winner' WHEN res.positionorder BETWEEN 2 AND 3 THEN 'Podium' WHEN res.positionorder BETWEEN 4 AND 10 THEN 'Points' ELSE 'No Points' END AS finish_category, AVG(l.milliseconds) OVER (PARTITION BY r.raceid, d.driverid) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(p.stop) OVER (PARTITION BY r.raceid, d.driverid) AS total_pitstops FROM races r JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid LEFT JOIN laptimes l ON r.raceid = l.raceid AND res.driverid = l.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops p ON r.raceid = p.raceid AND res.driverid = p.driverid WHERE r.year >= 2009 AND r.year <= 2007 AND res.points > '0' GROUP BY r.year, c.name, d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, con.name, res.positionorder, res.points, r.raceid, l.milliseconds, p.stop ORDER BY r.year DESC, res.positionorder ASC;

SELECT r.year, c.name AS constructor_name, COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) AS races_entered, COUNT(DISTINCT res.driverid) AS distinct_drivers, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(res.positionorder) AS avg_finish FROM constructors c JOIN results res ON c.constructorid = res.constructorid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid WHERE r.year >= 2016 AND res.points > '0' GROUP BY r.year, c.name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) > 9 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name AS constructor_name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name AS circuit_name, res.positionorder, res.points, res.grid, res.laps, lt.lap, lt.position AS lap_position, lt.milliseconds AS lap_time_ms, ps.stop, ps.lap AS pit_lap, ps.milliseconds AS pit_time_ms, q.position AS qualifying_position, ds.points AS driver_standing_points, ds.position AS driver_standing_position, ds.wins AS driver_wins, cs.points AS constructor_standing_points, cs.position AS constructor_standing_position, cs.wins AS constructor_wins, AVG(lt.milliseconds) OVER (PARTITION BY r.raceid, d.driverid) AS avg_lap_time_per_race, SUM(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY r.year, d.driverid ORDER BY r.date) AS cumulative_points_per_season, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.raceid ORDER BY res.positionorder) AS race_finish_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year, c.constructorid ORDER BY SUM(res.points) DESC) AS constructor_season_rank FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits cir ON r.circuitid = cir.circuitid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND d.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND d.driverid = q.driverid AND res.constructorid = q.constructorid LEFT JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND d.driverid = ds.driverid LEFT JOIN constructorstandings cs ON r.raceid = cs.raceid AND c.constructorid = cs.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 1962 AND r.year <= 1964 AND res.positionorder <= 5 AND lt.milliseconds > 145391 AND cir.alt > 1097 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name, res.positionorder, res.points, res.grid, res.laps, lt.lap, lt.position, lt.milliseconds, ps.stop, ps.lap, ps.milliseconds, q.position, ds.points, ds.position, ds.wins, cs.points, cs.position, cs.wins, r.date HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY r.year DESC, r.round DESC, cumulative_points_per_season DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM laptimes lt WHERE lt.raceid = r.raceid AND lt.driverid = d.driverid AND lt.position = 1) AS laps_led, res.points FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid WHERE r.year = 1968 AND c.country = 'Australia' AND res.points > '0' ORDER BY laps_led DESC, res.points DESC;

SELECT r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.driverid) AS distinct_drivers, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) AS distinct_laps, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS distinct_pitstops, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND lt.driverid = ps.driverid WHERE r.year >= 2019 AND r.date <= '2010-03-01' GROUP BY r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lt.driverid) > 9 AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 137758 ORDER BY r.year DESC, r.round ASC;

SELECT r.year, c.name AS constructor_name, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY SUM(res.points) DESC) AS yearly_rank FROM races r JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid WHERE r.year >= 1995 AND r.year <= 1970 GROUP BY r.year, c.constructorid, c.name, d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY r.year DESC, yearly_rank;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) AS races_entered, SUM(r.points) AS total_points, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM results r2 WHERE r2.driverid = d.driverid AND r2.position = 1) AS career_wins FROM drivers d JOIN results r ON d.driverid = r.driverid JOIN races rc ON r.raceid = rc.raceid JOIN circuits c ON rc.circuitid = c.circuitid WHERE rc.year >= 2009 AND rc.year <= 2016 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(r.points) > '0' ORDER BY total_points DESC LIMIT 20;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) AS races_entered, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(res.positionorder) AS avg_finish_position, MAX(ds.wins) AS max_wins_in_season FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN driverstandings ds ON d.driverid = ds.driverid AND r.raceid = ds.raceid JOIN seasons s ON r.year = s.year WHERE r.year >= 1968 AND r.year <= 1950 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) >= 92 ORDER BY total_points DESC LIMIT 50;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) AS races_entered, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(res.positionorder) AS avg_finish_position, MAX(ds.wins) AS max_wins_in_season FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN driverstandings ds ON d.driverid = ds.driverid AND r.raceid = ds.raceid JOIN seasons s ON r.year = s.year WHERE r.year >= 2023 AND r.year <= 1989 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) >= 27 ORDER BY total_points DESC LIMIT 50;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name AS constructor_name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops, MAX(q.position) AS best_qualifying FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND d.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND d.driverid = q.driverid AND res.constructorid = q.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 1980 AND r.year <= 1981 AND res.positionorder <= 17 AND lt.milliseconds > 167305 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 143175 INTERSECT SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name AS constructor_name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops, MAX(q.position) AS best_qualifying FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND d.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND d.driverid = q.driverid AND res.constructorid = q.constructorid WHERE r.circuitid IN (SELECT circuitid FROM circuits WHERE alt > 1479) AND res.grid <= 30 AND lt.position <= 7 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) >= 1 AND MAX(q.position) <= 19 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_lap_time_ms ASC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name AS constructor_name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name AS circuit_name, COUNT(DISTINCT res.resultid) AS total_results, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(res.positionorder) AS avg_finish_position, MAX(ds.wins) AS max_wins_in_season, SUM(lt.milliseconds) / 1000.0 AS total_race_seconds, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops, AVG(q.position) AS avg_qualifying_position FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits cir ON r.circuitid = cir.circuitid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN driverstandings ds ON d.driverid = ds.driverid AND r.raceid = ds.raceid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON d.driverid = lt.driverid AND r.raceid = lt.raceid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON d.driverid = ps.driverid AND r.raceid = ps.raceid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON d.driverid = q.driverid AND r.raceid = q.raceid WHERE r.year >= 1963 AND r.year <= 2022 AND res.points > '0' AND cir.alt > 787 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '10' AND COUNT(DISTINCT res.resultid) >= 44 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_finish_position ASC LIMIT 699;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name AS constructor_name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name AS circuit_name, cir.country, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points, res.laps, res.milliseconds AS race_milliseconds, lt.lap, lt.position AS lap_position, lt.milliseconds AS lap_milliseconds, ps.stop, ps.lap AS pit_lap, ps.milliseconds AS pit_milliseconds, q.position AS qualifying_position, ds.points AS driver_standing_points, ds.position AS driver_standing_position, ds.wins AS driver_wins, cs.points AS constructor_standing_points, cs.position AS constructor_standing_position, cs.wins AS constructor_wins, cr.points AS constructor_result_points, s.status, t.win, AVG(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid, r.year) AS avg_points_per_season, SUM(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY c.constructorid, r.year ORDER BY r.date) AS running_constructor_points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.raceid ORDER BY res.positionorder) AS race_finish_rank, LAG(res.positionorder, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid ORDER BY r.date) AS prev_race_position FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits cir ON r.circuitid = cir.circuitid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON res.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid JOIN pitstops ps ON res.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid JOIN qualifying q ON res.raceid = q.raceid AND res.driverid = q.driverid AND res.constructorid = q.constructorid JOIN driverstandings ds ON res.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid JOIN constructorstandings cs ON res.raceid = cs.raceid AND res.constructorid = cs.constructorid JOIN constructorresults cr ON res.raceid = cr.raceid AND res.constructorid = cr.constructorid JOIN status s ON res.statusid = s.statusid LEFT JOIN target t ON res.raceid = t.raceid AND res.driverid = t.driverid WHERE r.year >= 1955 AND r.year <= 1983 AND res.points > '0' AND res.grid BETWEEN 4 AND 9 AND lt.position <= 15 AND ps.milliseconds > 86689 AND ds.position <= 17 AND cs.position <= 5 AND cr.points >= '0' AND cir.lat > '-90' AND cir.lat < '-90' AND cir.lng > '-180' AND cir.lng < '-180' AND d.dob >= '1950-01-01' AND d.dob <= '1950-01-01' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name, cir.country, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points, res.laps, res.milliseconds, lt.lap, lt.position, lt.milliseconds, ps.stop, ps.lap, ps.milliseconds, q.position, ds.points, ds.position, ds.wins, cs.points, cs.position, cs.wins, cr.points, s.status, t.win HAVING SUM(res.points) > '10' AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 110070 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) >= 3 AND MAX(q.position) <= 4 ORDER BY SUM(res.points) DESC, AVG(lt.milliseconds) ASC LIMIT 33;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name AS constructor_name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name AS circuit_name, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position AS lap_position, lt.milliseconds AS lap_time_ms, ps.stop AS pit_stop_number, ps.lap AS pit_stop_lap, ps.milliseconds AS pit_stop_duration_ms, q.position AS qualifying_position, ds.points AS driver_standing_points, ds.position AS driver_standing_position, cs.points AS constructor_standing_points, cs.position AS constructor_standing_position, AVG(lt.milliseconds) OVER (PARTITION BY r.raceid, d.driverid) AS avg_lap_time_per_race, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.raceid ORDER BY res.points DESC) AS race_points_rank, SUM(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY r.year, d.driverid ORDER BY r.date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_points_season FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits cir ON r.circuitid = cir.circuitid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND d.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND d.driverid = q.driverid LEFT JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND d.driverid = ds.driverid LEFT JOIN constructorstandings cs ON r.raceid = cs.raceid AND c.constructorid = cs.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 2008 AND r.year <= 1970 AND res.points > '0' AND lt.milliseconds < 78747 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position, lt.milliseconds, ps.stop, ps.lap, ps.milliseconds, q.position, ds.points, ds.position, cs.points, cs.position, r.date HAVING COUNT(lt.lap) > 37 ORDER BY r.year DESC, r.round DESC, race_points_rank;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.raceid, r.name AS race_name, r.date, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(r.date, d.dob)) AS driver_age_at_race, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position AS lap_position, ps.stop AS pit_stop_number, ps.duration FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND d.driverid = ps.driverid WHERE r.date >= '2000-01-01' AND r.date <= '2000-01-01' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM r.date) = 2004 AND res.points > '0' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.raceid, r.name, r.date, d.dob, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position, ps.stop, ps.duration HAVING COUNT(lt.lap) > 37 ORDER BY r.date DESC, res.points DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, res.positionorder, res.points, CASE WHEN res.positionorder = 1 THEN 'Winner' WHEN res.positionorder BETWEEN 2 AND 3 THEN 'Podium' WHEN res.positionorder BETWEEN 4 AND 10 THEN 'Points Finish' ELSE 'Outside Points' END AS finish_category, AVG(l.milliseconds) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid, r.year) AS avg_lap_time_ms, SUM(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid ORDER BY r.date) AS cumulative_points FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid LEFT JOIN laptimes l ON res.raceid = l.raceid AND res.driverid = l.driverid WHERE r.year = 2006 AND res.grid <= 10 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name, res.positionorder, res.points, r.date, l.milliseconds HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY cumulative_points DESC, r.round ASC;

SELECT r.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(*) AS race_count, SUM(r.points) AS total_points FROM results r JOIN drivers d ON r.driverid = d.driverid JOIN races rc ON r.raceid = rc.raceid WHERE r.points > '0' AND rc.year = 2005 GROUP BY r.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(r.points) > '10' INTERSECT SELECT r.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(*) AS race_count, SUM(r.points) AS total_points FROM results r JOIN drivers d ON r.driverid = d.driverid JOIN races rc ON r.raceid = rc.raceid WHERE r.grid <= 9 AND rc.year BETWEEN 2020 AND 2020 GROUP BY r.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING COUNT(*) >= 16 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT r.year, c.name AS circuit_name, con.name AS constructor_name, COUNT(DISTINCT d.driverid) AS unique_drivers, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) AS unique_laps_raced, SUM(res.points) AS total_points FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid WHERE r.year >= 2008 AND r.year <= 1990 GROUP BY r.year, c.circuitid, c.name, con.constructorid, con.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY r.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT r.year, c.name AS constructor_name, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, COUNT(DISTINCT res.raceid) AS races_entered, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(ps.stop) AS total_pitstops FROM results res JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON res.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON res.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid WHERE r.year >= 2021 AND res.points > '0' AND d.dob >= '1980-01-01' GROUP BY r.year, c.constructorid, c.name, d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(res.points) > '10' ORDER BY r.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name AS constructor_name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name AS circuit_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(res.positionorder) AS avg_finish_position, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) AS total_laps_raced, MIN(ps.milliseconds) AS fastest_pitstop_ms, MAX(q.position) AS worst_qualifying_position, SUM(ds.wins) AS total_wins, SUM(cs.wins) AS constructor_wins, COUNT(DISTINCT t.targetid) AS targets_met FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits cir ON r.circuitid = cir.circuitid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON res.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON res.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON res.raceid = q.raceid AND res.driverid = q.driverid JOIN driverstandings ds ON res.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid JOIN constructorstandings cs ON res.raceid = cs.raceid AND res.constructorid = cs.constructorid LEFT JOIN target t ON res.raceid = t.raceid AND res.driverid = t.driverid WHERE r.year >= 1988 AND r.year <= 2009 AND res.positionorder <= 1 AND cir.alt >= 1530 AND d.dob <= '1950-01-01' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND AVG(res.positionorder) < 15 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) >= 60 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_finish_position ASC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name AS constructor_name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name AS circuit_name, cir.country, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position AS lap_position, lt.milliseconds AS lap_time_ms, ps.stop, ps.lap AS pit_lap, ps.milliseconds AS pit_time_ms, q.position AS qualifying_position, ds.points AS driver_standing_points, ds.wins AS driver_standing_wins, cs.points AS constructor_standing_points, cs.wins AS constructor_standing_wins, cr.points AS constructor_result_points, t.win, AVG(lt.milliseconds) OVER (PARTITION BY r.raceid, d.driverid) AS avg_lap_time_per_race, SUM(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY r.year, d.driverid ORDER BY r.date) AS cumulative_points_season, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.raceid ORDER BY res.positionorder) AS race_finish_rank FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits cir ON r.circuitid = cir.circuitid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND d.driverid = ps.driverid SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) AS total_laps_led, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, MIN(ps.milliseconds) AS fastest_pitstop_ms FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits cct ON r.circuitid = cct.circuitid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON d.driverid = lt.driverid AND res.raceid = lt.raceid AND lt.position = 1 LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON d.driverid = ps.driverid AND res.raceid = ps.raceid JOIN driverstandings ds ON d.driverid = ds.driverid AND res.raceid = ds.raceid WHERE r.year >= 2016 AND r.date <= '2000-03-01' AND res.grid <= 6 AND cct.alt >= 158 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) >= 5 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_lap_time_ms ASC;
