SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops, MAX(ds.wins) AS max_wins_in_season, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY SUM(res.points) DESC) AS yearly_rank FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON d.driverid = lt.driverid AND res.raceid = lt.raceid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON d.driverid = ps.driverid AND res.raceid = ps.raceid JOIN driverstandings ds ON d.driverid = ds.driverid AND res.raceid = ds.raceid JOIN seasons s ON r.year = s.year WHERE r.year >= 2012 AND r.year <= 2015 AND res.grid <= 15 AND lt.milliseconds > 66527 AND ds.position <= 8 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round, r.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 146868 ORDER BY r.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops, MAX(ds.wins) AS max_wins_in_season, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY SUM(res.points) DESC) AS yearly_rank FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON d.driverid = lt.driverid AND res.raceid = lt.raceid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON d.driverid = ps.driverid AND res.raceid = ps.raceid JOIN driverstandings ds ON d.driverid = ds.driverid AND res.raceid = ds.raceid WHERE r.year IN ( SELECT year FROM seasons WHERE year >= 2004 AND year <= 1964 ) AND res.positionorder <= ( SELECT AVG(positionorder) FROM results WHERE raceid IN ( SELECT raceid FROM races WHERE year = r.year ) ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM qualifying q WHERE q.driverid = d.driverid AND q.raceid = r.raceid AND q.position < 18 ) GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round, r.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) >= 48 ORDER BY r.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, rs.positionorder, rs.points, lt.lap, lt.position AS lap_position, ps.stop AS pit_stop_number, ps.duration AS pit_duration, q.position AS qualifying_position, cs.points AS constructor_points, ds.wins AS driver_wins, t.win AS target_win FROM drivers d LEFT JOIN results rs ON d.driverid = rs.driverid LEFT JOIN races r ON rs.raceid = r.raceid LEFT JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON rs.raceid = lt.raceid AND rs.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON rs.raceid = ps.raceid AND rs.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON rs.raceid = q.raceid AND rs.driverid = q.driverid LEFT JOIN constructorstandings cs ON rs.raceid = cs.raceid AND rs.constructorid = cs.constructorid LEFT JOIN driverstandings ds ON rs.raceid = ds.raceid AND rs.driverid = ds.driverid LEFT JOIN target t ON rs.raceid = t.raceid AND rs.driverid = t.driverid WHERE r.year >= 2018 AND rs.points > '0' AND lt.lap >= 55 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name, rs.positionorder, rs.points, lt.lap, lt.position, ps.stop, ps.duration, q.position, cs.points, ds.wins, t.win HAVING COUNT(lt.lap) > 59 ORDER BY rs.points DESC, ds.wins DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) AS races_participated, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(res.positionorder) AS avg_finish_position FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid WHERE r.year >= 2012 AND c.country = 'Monaco' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year HAVING SUM(res.points) > '10' ORDER BY total_points DESC, r.year, d.surname;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY SUM(res.points) DESC) AS yearly_rank FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid WHERE r.year >= 1956 AND r.year <= 1982 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY r.year, yearly_rank, r.round;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, res.positionorder, res.points, AVG(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid, r.year) AS avg_points_per_season, SUM(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid ORDER BY r.date) AS cumulative_points FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 2001 AND res.points > '0' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name, res.positionorder, res.points, r.date ORDER BY d.driverid, r.year, r.round;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, res.positionorder, res.points, AVG(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY r.year, d.driverid) AS avg_points_per_season, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY SUM(res.points) DESC) AS season_rank FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 1985 AND r.year <= 2011 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name, res.positionorder, res.points HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY r.year DESC, season_rank, d.surname;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, res.positionorder, res.points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY SUM(res.points) DESC) AS yearly_rank FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid WHERE r.year >= 1986 AND r.year <= 1967 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name, res.positionorder, res.points HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY r.year, yearly_rank, r.round;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position AS lap_position, ps.stop AS pit_stop_number, ps.duration AS pit_stop_duration, SUM(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid, r.year ORDER BY r.date) AS cumulative_points, AVG(lt.position) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid, r.raceid) AS avg_lap_position FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON res.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON res.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid WHERE r.year = 2000 AND r.round BETWEEN 1 AND 19 AND res.positionorder <= 5 AND (lt.position IS NULL OR lt.position <= 3) AND (ps.duration IS NULL OR ps.milliseconds >= 67543) GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position, ps.stop, ps.duration, r.date, r.raceid HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY cumulative_points DESC, r.round, res.positionorder;

SELECT r.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(*) AS race_count, SUM(r.points) AS total_points FROM results r JOIN drivers d ON r.driverid = d.driverid JOIN races rc ON r.raceid = rc.raceid WHERE r.points > 15.18 AND rc.year >= 2010 GROUP BY r.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(r.points) > 494.53 INTERSECT SELECT ds.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(DISTINCT ds.raceid) AS race_count, SUM(ds.points) AS total_points FROM driverstandings ds JOIN drivers d ON ds.driverid = d.driverid JOIN races rc ON ds.raceid = rc.raceid WHERE ds.points > 22.42 AND rc.year >= 2020 GROUP BY ds.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(ds.points) > 282.11 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT r.year, c.name AS constructor_name, SUM(cs.points) AS total_points, AVG(cs.wins) AS avg_wins FROM races r JOIN constructorstandings cs ON r.raceid = cs.raceid JOIN constructors c ON cs.constructorid = c.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 1996 AND cs.points > '0' GROUP BY r.year, c.name HAVING SUM(cs.points) > '100' ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name AS constructor_name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name AS circuit_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops, MAX(q.position) AS best_qualifying, SUM(CASE WHEN res.positionorder = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wins, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(res.points) DESC) AS driver_rank FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits cir ON r.circuitid = cir.circuitid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND d.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND d.driverid = q.driverid JOIN seasons s ON r.year = s.year JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND d.driverid = ds.driverid JOIN constructorstandings cs ON r.raceid = cs.raceid AND c.constructorid = cs.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 2007 AND r.year <= 2009 AND cir.country = 'UK' AND res.grid <= 10 AND res.laps >= 27 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 89793 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) >= 4 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_lap_time_ms ASC LIMIT 84;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) AS laps_led, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, MIN(ps.milliseconds) AS fastest_pitstop_ms, MAX(q.position) AS worst_qualifying_position, SUM(CASE WHEN ds.position = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wins, SUM(t.win) AS target_wins FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON d.driverid = lt.driverid AND res.raceid = lt.raceid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON d.driverid = ps.driverid AND res.raceid = ps.raceid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON d.driverid = q.driverid AND res.raceid = q.raceid LEFT JOIN driverstandings ds ON d.driverid = ds.driverid AND res.raceid = ds.raceid LEFT JOIN target t ON d.driverid = t.driverid AND res.raceid = t.raceid WHERE r.year >= 1988 AND r.date <= '1950-01-01' AND res.points > '0' AND lt.position = 1 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round, r.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '10' AND COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) >= 44 ORDER BY total_points DESC, wins DESC LIMIT 781;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN laptimes lt ON res.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid WHERE r.year = 1990 AND res.positionorder <= 15 AND lt.lap > 96 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_lap_time_ms ASC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position AS lap_position, ps.stop AS pit_stop_number, ps.lap AS pit_stop_lap FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN laptimes lt ON res.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON res.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid WHERE r.year = 1996 AND res.positionorder <= 10 AND lt.lap = ( SELECT MAX(lap) FROM laptimes WHERE raceid = lt.raceid AND driverid = lt.driverid ) GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position, ps.stop, ps.lap HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY r.year, r.round, res.positionorder;

SELECT d1.driverid AS driver1_id, d1.forename AS driver1_forename, d1.surname AS driver1_surname, d2.driverid AS driver2_id, d2.forename AS driver2_forename, d2.surname AS driver2_surname, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, AVG(lt1.milliseconds - lt2.milliseconds) AS avg_time_diff_ms, SUM(CASE WHEN res1.positionorder < res2.positionorder THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS driver1_wins_against_driver2, SUM(cr1.points) AS driver1_constructor_points, SUM(cr2.points) AS driver2_constructor_points, COUNT(DISTINCT lt1.lap) AS laps_compared, CORR(lt1.position, lt2.position) AS lap_position_correlation FROM laptimes lt1 JOIN laptimes lt2 ON lt1.raceid = lt2.raceid AND lt1.lap = lt2.lap AND lt1.driverid < lt2.driverid JOIN drivers d1 ON lt1.driverid = d1.driverid JOIN drivers d2 ON lt2.driverid = d2.driverid JOIN races r ON lt1.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid LEFT JOIN results res1 ON lt1.raceid = res1.raceid AND lt1.driverid = res1.driverid LEFT JOIN results res2 ON lt2.raceid = res2.raceid AND lt2.driverid = res2.driverid LEFT JOIN constructorresults cr1 ON res1.raceid = cr1.raceid AND res1.constructorid = cr1.constructorid LEFT JOIN constructorresults cr2 ON res2.raceid = cr2.raceid AND res2.constructorid = cr2.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 1970 AND r.date <= '1950-01-01' AND lt1.milliseconds IS NOT NULL AND lt2.milliseconds IS NOT NULL AND c.alt > 788 GROUP BY d1.driverid, d1.forename, d1.surname, d2.driverid, d2.forename, d2.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lt1.lap) > 22 AND AVG(lt1.milliseconds - lt2.milliseconds) BETWEEN -2189 AND 6667 ORDER BY avg_time_diff_ms DESC, driver1_wins_against_driver2 DESC LIMIT 637;

SELECT r.year, c.country, con.nationality, d.driverref, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) AS total_laps_analyzed, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, SUM(cr.points) AS total_constructor_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pit_stops, MIN(q.position) AS best_qualifying, AVG(res.grid) AS avg_grid_position, SUM(CASE WHEN res.positionorder = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wins, SUM(ds.wins) AS driver_season_wins, SUM(cs.wins) AS constructor_season_wins FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND res.driverid = q.driverid AND res.constructorid = q.constructorid LEFT JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid LEFT JOIN constructorstandings cs ON r.raceid = cs.raceid AND res.constructorid = cs.constructorid LEFT JOIN constructorresults cr ON r.raceid = cr.raceid AND res.constructorid = cr.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 1955 AND r.year <= 1999 AND res.points > '0' AND lt.milliseconds > 112822 AND (q.position IS NULL OR q.position < 14) GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (r.year, c.country, con.nationality, d.driverref), (r.year, c.country, con.nationality), (r.year, c.country), (r.year), () ) HAVING SUM(res.points) > '10' AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 100794 ORDER BY r.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, d.driverid, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, res.positionorder, res.points, AVG(res.points) OVER ( PARTITION BY r.circuitid, d.driverid ORDER BY r.date ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS avg_points_last_3_races FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid WHERE r.year >= 2013 AND r.year <= 2002 AND res.positionorder <= 5 AND r.date >= '2000-03-01' GROUP BY r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name, d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, res.positionorder, res.points, r.circuitid, r.date HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0.0' ORDER BY r.year, r.round, avg_points_last_3_races DESC;

SELECT r.year, c.name AS constructor_name, COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) AS races_entered, COUNT(DISTINCT res.driverid) AS distinct_drivers, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(res.positionorder) AS avg_finish FROM races r JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN circuits ci ON r.circuitid = ci.circuitid WHERE r.year >= 2001 AND r.year <= 2016 AND res.grid <= 12 GROUP BY r.year, c.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT r.year, c.name AS constructor_name, COUNT(DISTINCT res.driverid) AS unique_drivers, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(res.positionorder) AS avg_finish FROM results res JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 2023 AND res.points > '0' GROUP BY r.year, c.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '10' ORDER BY r.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) AS races_entered, SUM(r.points) AS total_points, (SELECT AVG(lt.milliseconds) FROM laptimes lt WHERE lt.driverid = d.driverid AND lt.lap = 6) AS avg_lap_time_ms FROM drivers d JOIN results r ON d.driverid = r.driverid JOIN races rc ON r.raceid = rc.raceid JOIN circuits c ON rc.circuitid = c.circuitid WHERE rc.year >= 2006 AND rc.year <= 2016 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(r.points) > '0' ORDER BY total_points DESC LIMIT 76;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(r.resultid) AS race_count, SUM(r.points) AS total_points FROM drivers d LEFT JOIN results r ON d.driverid = r.driverid LEFT JOIN races rc ON r.raceid = rc.raceid WHERE rc.year >= 1975 AND rc.year <= 1985 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING COUNT(r.resultid) < 25 ORDER BY total_points DESC NULLS LAST;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops, MAX(q.position) AS best_qualifying, SUM(CASE WHEN res.positionorder = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wins FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON d.driverid = lt.driverid AND r.raceid = lt.raceid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON d.driverid = ps.driverid AND r.raceid = ps.raceid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON d.driverid = q.driverid AND r.raceid = q.raceid WHERE r.year >= 1966 AND r.date <= '1950-01-01' AND res.points > '0' AND lt.milliseconds < 72898 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round, r.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '10' AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 119141 UNION ALL SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, SUM(cs.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops, MAX(q.position) AS best_qualifying, SUM(cs.wins) AS wins FROM drivers d JOIN constructorstandings cs ON d.driverid = cs.constructorid JOIN races r ON cs.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON cs.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON d.driverid = lt.driverid AND r.raceid = lt.raceid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON d.driverid = ps.driverid AND r.raceid = ps.raceid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON d.driverid = q.driverid AND r.raceid = q.raceid WHERE r.year >= 2014 AND r.date <= '1950-01-01' AND cs.points > '0' AND lt.milliseconds < 107238 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round, r.name HAVING SUM(cs.points) > '10' AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 95040 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_lap_time_ms ASC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, res.positionorder, res.points, SUM(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid, r.year ORDER BY r.date) AS cumulative_points, AVG(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY c.constructorid, r.year) AS avg_constructor_points_per_race FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN circuits ci ON r.circuitid = ci.circuitid WHERE (r.year = 1998 AND res.positionorder <= 7) OR (r.year = 1952 AND res.points > '0') AND NOT (ci.country = 'USA') GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round, r.name, res.positionorder, res.points, r.date, c.constructorid HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY cumulative_points DESC, r.year, r.round;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN laptimes lt ON d.driverid = lt.driverid AND res.raceid = lt.raceid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON d.driverid = ps.driverid AND res.raceid = ps.raceid WHERE r.year >= 2004 AND r.date <= '2000-03-01' AND res.positionorder <= 6 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0.5' ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_lap_time_ms ASC LIMIT 100;
SELECT r.raceid, COUNT(l.driverid) AS total_laps FROM races r JOIN laptimes l ON r.raceid = l.raceid WHERE r.year = 1961 AND l.milliseconds < 100863 GROUP BY r.raceid ORDER BY total_laps DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) AS races_entered, SUM(r.points) AS total_points, (SELECT AVG(lt.milliseconds) FROM laptimes lt WHERE lt.driverid = d.driverid AND lt.lap = 61) AS avg_lap_time_ms FROM drivers d JOIN results r ON d.driverid = r.driverid JOIN races rc ON r.raceid = rc.raceid WHERE rc.year >= 2015 AND rc.year <= 1950 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(r.points) > '0' ORDER BY total_points DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) AS races_entered, SUM(r.points) AS total_points, AVG(r.positionorder) AS avg_finish_position FROM drivers d JOIN results r ON d.driverid = r.driverid JOIN races rc ON r.raceid = rc.raceid WHERE rc.year IN (SELECT year FROM seasons WHERE year >= 2015 AND year <= 1987) AND r.positionorder <= 15 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(r.points) > '0' ORDER BY total_points DESC LIMIT 96;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) AS races_participated, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid WHERE r.year = 2002 AND d.driverid IN ( SELECT driverid FROM results WHERE points > '0' GROUP BY driverid HAVING COUNT(raceid) >= 7 ) GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(r.resultid) AS race_count, COALESCE(SUM(r.points), 0) AS total_points FROM drivers d LEFT JOIN results r ON d.driverid = r.driverid LEFT JOIN races rc ON r.raceid = rc.raceid WHERE rc.year >= 1991 OR rc.year IS NULL GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING COALESCE(SUM(r.points), 0) > '0' ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(r.resultid) AS race_count, SUM(r.points) AS total_points, AVG(r.positionorder) AS avg_finish FROM drivers d JOIN results r ON d.driverid = r.driverid JOIN races rc ON r.raceid = rc.raceid WHERE rc.year >= 1963 AND rc.year <= 1963 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(r.points) > '0' ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, c.name AS circuit_name, res.positionorder, res.points, (SELECT AVG(subq.avg_points) FROM ( SELECT rs.constructorid, AVG(rs.points) AS avg_points FROM results rs WHERE rs.raceid IN (SELECT raceid FROM races WHERE year = r.year) GROUP BY rs.constructorid HAVING AVG(rs.points) > 1.87 ) subq ) AS avg_constructor_points_above_threshold FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid WHERE r.date >= '2000-01-01' AND r.date <= '2011-01-01' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, r.name, c.name, res.positionorder, res.points HAVING SUM(res.points) > 5.33 ORDER BY r.year DESC, r.round DESC, res.positionorder ASC;

SELECT r.year, c.country, con.nationality, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, COUNT(DISTINCT res.driverid) AS unique_drivers, AVG(res.positionorder) AS avg_finish FROM races r JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 1966 AND r.year <= 2003 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (r.year, c.country, con.nationality), (r.year, c.country), (r.year, con.nationality), (c.country, con.nationality), (r.year), (c.country), (con.nationality), () ) HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY r.year, c.country, con.nationality;

SELECT r.year, c.country, con.nationality, d.driverref, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) AS total_laps_analyzed, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, MIN(ps.milliseconds) AS min_pitstop_ms, MAX(q.position) AS worst_qualifying, SUM(cr.points) AS constructor_points, SUM(cs.wins) AS constructor_wins, SUM(ds.wins) AS driver_wins, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND res.driverid = q.driverid AND res.constructorid = q.constructorid LEFT JOIN constructorresults cr ON r.raceid = cr.raceid AND res.constructorid = cr.constructorid LEFT JOIN constructorstandings cs ON r.raceid = cs.raceid AND res.constructorid = cs.constructorid LEFT JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid WHERE r.year >= 1996 AND r.year <= 2002 AND res.grid <= 4 AND lt.milliseconds > 278297 AND (ps.milliseconds IS NULL OR ps.milliseconds < 35139) GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (r.year, c.country, con.nationality, d.driverref), (r.year, c.country, con.nationality), (r.year, c.country), (r.year), () ) HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) >= 2 ORDER BY r.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT c.circuitid, c.name AS circuit_name, c.country, r.year, r.round, d.driverid, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, con.name AS constructor_name, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position AS lap_position, lt.milliseconds AS lap_time_ms, ps.stop AS pit_stop_number, ps.lap AS pit_stop_lap, ps.milliseconds AS pit_stop_duration_ms, q.position AS qualifying_position, ds.points AS driver_standing_points, ds.wins AS driver_wins, cs.points AS constructor_standing_points, cs.wins AS constructor_wins, cr.points AS constructor_result_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) OVER (PARTITION BY r.raceid, d.driverid) AS avg_lap_time_per_race_driver, SUM(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY r.year, d.driverid ORDER BY r.date) AS cumulative_points_driver_season, COUNT(ps.stop) OVER (PARTITION BY r.raceid, d.driverid) AS total_pit_stops_per_race_driver FROM circuits c JOIN races r ON c.circuitid = r.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND d.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND d.driverid = q.driverid AND res.constructorid = q.constructorid LEFT JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND d.driverid = ds.driverid LEFT JOIN constructorstandings cs ON r.raceid = cs.raceid AND con.constructorid = cs.constructorid LEFT JOIN constructorresults cr ON r.raceid = cr.raceid AND con.constructorid = cr.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 1973 AND r.year <= 1974 AND c.country = 'UK' AND res.positionorder <= 11 AND lt.milliseconds > 80383 GROUP BY c.circuitid, c.name, c.country, r.year, r.round, d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, con.name, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position, lt.milliseconds, ps.stop, ps.lap, ps.milliseconds, q.position, ds.points, ds.wins, cs.points, cs.wins, cr.points, r.raceid, r.date HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 144744 AND COUNT(ps.stop) >= 4 ORDER BY r.year DESC, r.round DESC, res.positionorder ASC, lt.lap ASC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) AS races_entered, SUM(r.points) AS total_points, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM results r2 WHERE r2.driverid = d.driverid AND r2.position = 1) AS career_wins FROM drivers d JOIN results r ON d.driverid = r.driverid JOIN races rc ON r.raceid = rc.raceid JOIN circuits c ON rc.circuitid = c.circuitid WHERE rc.year >= 1967 AND rc.year <= 1979 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(r.points) > '0' ORDER BY total_points DESC LIMIT 20;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) AS races_participated, SUM(r.points) AS total_points FROM drivers d JOIN results r ON d.driverid = r.driverid JOIN races rc ON r.raceid = rc.raceid WHERE rc.year IN (SELECT year FROM seasons WHERE year >= 1985 AND year <= 2009) GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(r.points) > '0' ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name AS constructor_name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name AS circuit_name, AVG(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY res.driverid, res.constructorid) AS avg_points_per_entry, SUM(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY res.driverid ORDER BY r.date) AS cumulative_points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.raceid ORDER BY res.points DESC) AS race_rank, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM laptimes lt WHERE lt.raceid = r.raceid AND lt.driverid = d.driverid AND lt.position = 1) AS laps_led, (SELECT AVG(ps.milliseconds) FROM pitstops ps WHERE ps.raceid = r.raceid AND ps.driverid = d.driverid) AS avg_pitstop_ms, (SELECT SUM(cr.points) FROM constructorresults cr WHERE cr.raceid = r.raceid AND cr.constructorid = c.constructorid) AS constructor_race_points, (SELECT MAX(ds.wins) FROM driverstandings ds WHERE ds.raceid = r.raceid AND ds.driverid IN (SELECT driverid FROM results WHERE constructorid = c.constructorid AND raceid = r.raceid)) AS max_wins_by_constructor_driver FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits cir ON r.circuitid = cir.circuitid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND d.driverid = q.driverid AND c.constructorid = q.constructorid LEFT JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND d.driverid = ds.driverid LEFT JOIN constructorstandings cs ON r.raceid = cs.raceid AND c.constructorid = cs.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 1950 AND r.year <= 2018 AND res.grid <= 12 AND res.positionorder <= 5 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM laptimes lt2 WHERE lt2.raceid = r.raceid AND lt2.driverid = d.driverid) >= 55 AND (SELECT AVG(lt3.milliseconds) FROM laptimes lt3 WHERE lt3.raceid = r.raceid AND lt3.driverid = d.driverid) <= 81648 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name, res.points, r.date, res.driverid, res.constructorid HAVING AVG(res.points) > '0.0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) >= 9 ORDER BY cumulative_points DESC, race_rank ASC LIMIT 518;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name AS constructor_name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name AS circuit_name, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) AS total_laps_raced, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, MIN(ps.milliseconds) AS min_pitstop_ms, MAX(q.position) AS worst_qualifying, SUM(cs.wins) AS constructor_wins, SUM(ds.wins) AS driver_wins, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops, CORR(lt.position, res.positionorder) AS lap_vs_finish_correlation FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits cir ON r.circuitid = cir.circuitid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND d.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND d.driverid = q.driverid LEFT JOIN constructorstandings cs ON r.raceid = cs.raceid AND c.constructorid = cs.constructorid LEFT JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND d.driverid = ds.driverid LEFT JOIN constructorresults cr ON r.raceid = cr.raceid AND c.constructorid = cr.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 2001 AND r.year <= 2007 AND cir.alt >= 261 AND res.grid <= 15 AND lt.milliseconds > 102241 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 175130 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) >= 3 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_lap_time_ms ASC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name AS constructor_name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name AS circuit_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(res.positionorder) AS avg_finish_position, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) AS total_laps_raced, MIN(ps.milliseconds) AS fastest_pitstop_ms, MAX(q.position) AS worst_qualifying_position, SUM(ds.wins) AS total_wins, SUM(cs.wins) AS constructor_wins, COUNT(DISTINCT t.targetid) AS targets_met FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits cir ON r.circuitid = cir.circuitid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON res.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON res.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON res.raceid = q.raceid AND res.driverid = q.driverid JOIN driverstandings ds ON res.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid JOIN constructorstandings cs ON res.raceid = cs.raceid AND res.constructorid = cs.constructorid LEFT JOIN target t ON res.raceid = t.raceid AND res.driverid = t.driverid WHERE r.year >= 1995 AND r.year <= 2021 AND res.positionorder <= 5 AND cir.alt >= 241 AND d.dob <= '1950-01-01' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND AVG(res.positionorder) < 19 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) >= 31 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_finish_position ASC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name AS constructor_name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name AS circuit_name, cir.country, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(res.positionorder) AS avg_finish_position, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) AS total_laps_led, MIN(ps.milliseconds) AS fastest_pitstop_ms, MAX(q.position) AS worst_qualifying, SUM(ds.wins) AS total_wins, SUM(cs.wins) AS constructor_wins, COUNT(DISTINCT res.resultid) AS races_finished, CORR(res.grid, res.positionorder) AS grid_finish_correlation FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits cir ON r.circuitid = cir.circuitid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON res.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid AND lt.position = 1 JOIN pitstops ps ON res.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid JOIN qualifying q ON res.raceid = q.raceid AND res.driverid = q.driverid JOIN driverstandings ds ON res.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid JOIN constructorstandings cs ON res.raceid = cs.raceid AND res.constructorid = cs.constructorid JOIN seasons s ON r.year = s.year WHERE r.year >= 1983 AND r.year <= 1973 AND res.positionorder IS NOT NULL AND res.positionorder <= 17 AND cir.alt >= 916 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name, cir.country HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT res.resultid) >= 98 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_finish_position ASC LIMIT 199;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name AS constructor_name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name AS circuit_name, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position AS lap_position, lt.milliseconds AS lap_time_ms, ps.stop AS pit_stop_number, ps.lap AS pit_stop_lap, ps.milliseconds AS pit_stop_duration_ms, q.position AS qualifying_position, ds.points AS driver_standing_points, ds.wins AS driver_standing_wins, cs.points AS constructor_standing_points, cs.wins AS constructor_standing_wins, AVG(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid, r.year ORDER BY r.round ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS avg_points_running, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.raceid ORDER BY res.positionorder) AS race_finish_rank, SUM(lt.milliseconds) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid, r.raceid ORDER BY lt.lap) AS cumulative_lap_time_ms FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits cir ON r.circuitid = cir.circuitid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND d.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND d.driverid = q.driverid AND res.constructorid = q.constructorid LEFT JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND d.driverid = ds.driverid LEFT JOIN constructorstandings cs ON r.raceid = cs.raceid AND c.constructorid = cs.constructorid LEFT JOIN constructorresults cr ON r.raceid = cr.raceid AND c.constructorid = cr.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 1977 AND r.year <= 1977 AND res.positionorder <= 17 AND lt.milliseconds > 69260 AND cir.alt > 317 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position, lt.milliseconds, ps.stop, ps.lap, ps.milliseconds, q.position, ds.points, ds.wins, cs.points, cs.wins HAVING AVG(res.points) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) >= 65 ORDER BY r.year DESC, r.round DESC, res.positionorder ASC, cumulative_lap_time_ms DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops, MAX(ds.wins) AS max_wins_in_season, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY SUM(res.points) DESC) AS yearly_rank FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON d.driverid = lt.driverid AND res.raceid = lt.raceid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON d.driverid = ps.driverid AND res.raceid = ps.raceid JOIN driverstandings ds ON d.driverid = ds.driverid AND res.raceid = ds.raceid JOIN seasons s ON r.year = s.year WHERE r.year >= 2015 AND r.year <= 2007 AND res.points > '0' AND lt.milliseconds < 67190 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round, r.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '10' AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 115422 ORDER BY r.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops, MAX(q.position) AS best_qualifying, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM target t WHERE t.driverid = d.driverid AND t.raceid = r.raceid AND t.win = 1) AS target_wins FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND d.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND d.driverid = q.driverid WHERE r.year >= 2006 AND r.date <= '1950-01-01' AND res.points > '0' AND lt.milliseconds < 84188 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round, r.name, r.raceid HAVING SUM(res.points) > '10' AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 117009 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_lap_time_ms ASC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, res.positionorder, res.points, AVG(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY r.year, d.driverid) AS avg_points_per_season, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY SUM(res.points) DESC) AS season_rank FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid WHERE r.year >= 2004 AND r.year <= 1993 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name, res.positionorder, res.points HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY r.year DESC, season_rank, d.surname;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, c.name AS circuit_name, res.positionorder, res.points, (SELECT AVG(sub.points) FROM (SELECT r2.year, res2.driverid, SUM(res2.points) AS points FROM results res2 JOIN races r2 ON res2.raceid = r2.raceid WHERE r2.year = r.year GROUP BY r2.year, res2.driverid) sub WHERE sub.driverid = d.driverid) AS avg_yearly_points FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 2019 AND res.positionorder <= 8 AND c.country = 'UK' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, r.name, c.name, res.positionorder, res.points HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY r.year DESC, r.round ASC, res.positionorder ASC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, res.points, res.positionorder, ds.wins, AVG(lt.milliseconds) OVER (PARTITION BY lt.raceid, lt.driverid) AS avg_lap_ms FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN driverstandings ds ON res.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON res.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid WHERE r.year = 1964 AND res.points > '0' AND d.driverid IN ( SELECT driverid FROM results WHERE positionorder <= 8 ) ORDER BY res.points DESC, avg_lap_ms ASC;

SELECT r.year, c.name AS circuit_name, con.name AS constructor_name, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid WHERE r.year >= 1999 AND r.year <= 1990 AND res.positionorder <= 5 GROUP BY r.year, c.circuitid, con.constructorid, d.driverid HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_lap_time_ms ASC LIMIT 100;

SELECT r.year, c.name AS constructor_name, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.driverid) AS distinct_drivers, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) AS distinct_laps, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms FROM laptimes lt JOIN races r ON lt.raceid = r.raceid JOIN results res ON lt.raceid = res.raceid AND lt.driverid = res.driverid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 2005 AND lt.milliseconds <= 83946 GROUP BY r.year, c.name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lt.driverid) > 1 ORDER BY r.year DESC, avg_lap_time_ms ASC;

SELECT r.year, c.name AS constructor_name, COUNT(DISTINCT res.driverid) AS unique_drivers, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(res.positionorder) AS avg_finish FROM results res JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid WHERE r.year = 1996 AND res.points > '0' GROUP BY r.year, c.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '10' ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT r.year, r.name AS race_name, c.name AS circuit_name, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, con.name AS constructor_name, res.positionorder, res.points, AVG(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY r.year, con.constructorid) AS avg_constructor_points_per_year, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY res.points DESC) AS yearly_points_rank FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 1997 AND r.year <= 1999 AND res.positionorder <= 4 GROUP BY r.year, r.name, c.name, d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, con.constructorid, con.name, res.positionorder, res.points HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY r.year DESC, yearly_points_rank ASC;

SELECT r.year, r.name AS race_name, c.name AS circuit_name, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, con.name AS constructor_name, res.positionorder, res.points, AVG(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY r.year, con.constructorid) AS avg_constructor_points_per_year, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY res.points DESC) AS yearly_points_rank FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 2003 AND r.year <= 1962 AND res.positionorder <= 3 GROUP BY r.year, r.name, c.name, d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, con.constructorid, con.name, res.positionorder, res.points HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY r.year DESC, yearly_points_rank ASC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, 'race_points' AS source_type, SUM(r.points) AS total_points FROM drivers d JOIN results r ON d.driverid = r.driverid JOIN races rc ON r.raceid = rc.raceid WHERE rc.year = 2004 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname UNION ALL SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, 'standings_points' AS source_type, SUM(ds.points) AS total_points FROM drivers d JOIN driverstandings ds ON d.driverid = ds.driverid JOIN races rc ON ds.raceid = rc.raceid WHERE rc.year = 1957 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name AS constructor_name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name AS circuit_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops, MAX(ds.wins) AS max_wins_in_season, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY SUM(res.points) DESC) AS yearly_rank FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits cir ON r.circuitid = cir.circuitid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND d.driverid = ps.driverid JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND d.driverid = ds.driverid JOIN seasons s ON r.year = s.year WHERE r.year IN (SELECT year FROM races WHERE date >= '1950-01-01' AND date <= '1950-01-01' GROUP BY year HAVING COUNT(raceid) > 10) AND cir.country = 'UK' AND res.positionorder <= 9 AND lt.milliseconds > 64494 AND ds.points > '0' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 76634 ORDER BY total_points DESC, yearly_rank LIMIT 456;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name AS constructor_name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name AS circuit_name, cir.country, res.positionorder, res.points, ds.position AS driver_standing_position, ds.wins AS driver_wins, cs.position AS constructor_standing_position, cs.wins AS constructor_wins, lt.lap, lt.position AS lap_position, lt.milliseconds AS lap_time_ms, ps.stop AS pit_stop_number, ps.lap AS pit_stop_lap, ps.milliseconds AS pit_stop_duration_ms, q.position AS qualifying_position, t.win AS target_win, AVG(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid, r.year) AS avg_points_per_season, SUM(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY c.constructorid, r.year ORDER BY r.date) AS cumulative_constructor_points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.raceid ORDER BY res.positionorder) AS race_finish_rank FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits cir ON r.circuitid = cir.circuitid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN driverstandings ds ON d.driverid = ds.driverid AND r.raceid = ds.raceid JOIN constructorstandings cs ON c.constructorid = cs.constructorid AND r.raceid = cs.raceid JOIN laptimes lt ON d.driverid = lt.driverid AND r.raceid = lt.raceid JOIN pitstops ps ON d.driverid = ps.driverid AND r.raceid = ps.raceid JOIN qualifying q ON d.driverid = q.driverid AND r.raceid = q.raceid JOIN target t ON d.driverid = t.driverid AND r.raceid = t.raceid WHERE r.year >= 1953 AND r.year <= 1977 AND res.points > '0' AND ds.position <= 20 AND cs.position <= 10 AND lt.milliseconds < 84407 AND ps.milliseconds > 31131 AND q.position < 13 AND t.win = 1 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM results res2 WHERE res2.driverid = d.driverid AND res2.raceid IN ( SELECT raceid FROM races WHERE circuitid IN ( SELECT circuitid FROM circuits WHERE country = 'UK' ) ) ) GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name, cir.country, res.positionorder, res.points, ds.position, ds.wins, cs.position, cs.wins, lt.lap, lt.position, lt.milliseconds, ps.stop, ps.lap, ps.milliseconds, q.position, t.win, r.date HAVING SUM(res.points) > '10' AND COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) >= 40 ORDER BY cumulative_constructor_points DESC, avg_points_per_season DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON d.driverid = lt.driverid AND res.raceid = lt.raceid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON d.driverid = ps.driverid AND res.raceid = ps.raceid WHERE r.year >= 2008 AND r.date <= '1950-01-01' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 88856 INTERSECT SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON d.driverid = lt.driverid AND res.raceid = lt.raceid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON d.driverid = ps.driverid AND res.raceid = ps.raceid JOIN qualifying q ON d.driverid = q.driverid AND res.raceid = q.raceid WHERE r.year >= 1968 AND r.date <= '1950-01-01' AND q.position <= 3 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 153530 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_lap_time_ms ASC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) AS races_entered, SUM(r.points) AS total_points, (SELECT AVG(points) FROM results WHERE driverid = d.driverid AND points > 10.21) AS avg_points_above_threshold FROM drivers d JOIN results r ON d.driverid = r.driverid JOIN races rc ON r.raceid = rc.raceid WHERE rc.year >= 2017 AND rc.year <= 2008 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(r.points) > 287.42 ORDER BY total_points DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(r.resultid) AS race_count, SUM(r.points) AS total_points FROM drivers d JOIN results r ON d.driverid = r.driverid JOIN races rc ON r.raceid = rc.raceid WHERE rc.year IN (SELECT year FROM seasons WHERE year >= 2016) AND r.positionorder <= 2 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(r.points) > '50' ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, SUM(r.points) AS total_points, COUNT(r.resultid) AS races_finished FROM drivers d JOIN results r ON d.driverid = r.driverid WHERE r.positionorder <= 3 AND r.points > '0.0' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname UNION ALL SELECT c.constructorid, c.name AS forename, NULL AS surname, SUM(cs.points) AS total_points, COUNT(cs.constructorstandingsid) AS races_finished FROM constructors c JOIN constructorstandings cs ON c.constructorid = cs.constructorid WHERE cs.position <= 7 AND cs.points > '0.0' GROUP BY c.constructorid, c.name ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name AS constructor_name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name AS circuit_name, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position AS lap_position, ps.stop AS pit_stop_number, ps.duration AS pit_stop_duration, q.position AS qualifying_position, ds.wins AS driver_wins, cs.wins AS constructor_wins, SUM(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid, r.year ORDER BY r.round) AS cumulative_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid, r.raceid) AS avg_lap_time_ms FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits cir ON r.circuitid = cir.circuitid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND d.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND d.driverid = q.driverid LEFT JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND d.driverid = ds.driverid LEFT JOIN constructorstandings cs ON r.raceid = cs.raceid AND c.constructorid = cs.constructorid WHERE r.year IN (SELECT year FROM seasons WHERE year >= 2006 AND year <= 2006) AND res.positionorder <= 19 AND lt.milliseconds > 81082 AND r.date >= '1950-05-13' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position, ps.stop, ps.duration, q.position, ds.wins, cs.wins, lt.milliseconds HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY cumulative_points DESC, r.year, r.round;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops, MAX(q.position) AS best_qualifying, CASE WHEN SUM(res.points) >= 141.1 THEN 'High Scorer' WHEN SUM(res.points) >= 68.13 THEN 'Medium Scorer' ELSE 'Low Scorer' END AS performance_category, CASE WHEN AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 81186 THEN 'Fast Laps' WHEN AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 107606 THEN 'Average Laps' ELSE 'Slow Laps' END AS lap_time_category FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND d.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND d.driverid = q.driverid JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND d.driverid = ds.driverid JOIN seasons s ON r.year = s.year WHERE r.year >= 2003 AND r.year <= 2011 AND r.date >= '2000-01-01' AND r.date <= '2000-01-01' AND ds.position <= 10 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round, r.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > 27.45 AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 129522 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_lap_time_ms ASC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, rs.positionorder, rs.points, lt.lap, lt.position AS lap_position, ps.stop AS pit_stop_number, ps.duration AS pit_duration, q.position AS qualifying_position, cs.points AS constructor_points, ds.wins AS driver_wins, t.win AS target_win FROM drivers d LEFT JOIN results rs ON d.driverid = rs.driverid LEFT JOIN races r ON rs.raceid = r.raceid LEFT JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON rs.raceid = lt.raceid AND rs.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON rs.raceid = ps.raceid AND rs.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON rs.raceid = q.raceid AND rs.driverid = q.driverid LEFT JOIN constructorstandings cs ON rs.raceid = cs.raceid AND rs.constructorid = cs.constructorid LEFT JOIN driverstandings ds ON rs.raceid = ds.raceid AND rs.driverid = ds.driverid LEFT JOIN target t ON rs.raceid = t.raceid AND rs.driverid = t.driverid WHERE r.year >= 2000 AND rs.points > '0' AND lt.lap >= 22 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name, rs.positionorder, rs.points, lt.lap, lt.position, ps.stop, ps.duration, q.position, cs.points, ds.wins, t.win HAVING COUNT(lt.lap) > 29 ORDER BY rs.points DESC, ds.wins DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, res.positionorder, res.points, SUM(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid, r.year ORDER BY r.date) AS cumulative_points, AVG(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid, r.year) AS avg_points_per_race, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid, r.year) AS races_entered FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid WHERE r.year = 2006 AND res.positionorder <= 9 AND res.points > '0.0' AND d.dob >= '1950-01-01' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name, res.positionorder, res.points, r.date HAVING SUM(res.points) > '1.0' ORDER BY cumulative_points DESC, r.round ASC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position AS lap_position, ps.stop AS pit_stop_number, ps.lap AS pit_stop_lap FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN laptimes lt ON res.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON res.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid WHERE r.year = 1957 AND res.positionorder <= 3 AND lt.lap = ( SELECT MAX(lap) FROM laptimes WHERE raceid = lt.raceid AND driverid = lt.driverid ) GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position, ps.stop, ps.lap HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY r.year, r.round, res.positionorder;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, c.name AS circuit_name, res.positionorder, res.points, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM laptimes lt WHERE lt.raceid = r.raceid AND lt.driverid = d.driverid AND lt.position = 1) AS laps_led FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid WHERE r.year = 2012 AND res.points > '0' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, r.name, c.name, res.positionorder, res.points, r.raceid HAVING SUM(res.points) > '10' ORDER BY SUM(res.points) DESC, laps_led DESC;

SELECT r.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(*) AS race_count, SUM(r.points) AS total_points FROM results r JOIN drivers d ON r.driverid = d.driverid JOIN races rc ON r.raceid = rc.raceid WHERE r.points > '0' AND rc.year = 2008 GROUP BY r.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(r.points) > '10' INTERSECT SELECT r.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(*) AS race_count, SUM(r.points) AS total_points FROM results r JOIN drivers d ON r.driverid = d.driverid JOIN races rc ON r.raceid = rc.raceid WHERE r.grid <= 7 AND rc.year BETWEEN 2021 AND 2022 GROUP BY r.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING COUNT(*) >= 15 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name AS constructor_name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name AS circuit_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(res.positionorder) AS avg_finish_position, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) AS total_laps_led, MAX(ps.stop) AS max_pit_stops_in_race, MIN(q.position) AS best_qualifying FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits cir ON r.circuitid = cir.circuitid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON res.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid AND lt.position = 1 LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON res.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON res.raceid = q.raceid AND res.driverid = q.driverid WHERE r.year >= 2001 AND r.date <= '1950-01-01' AND res.grid <= 6 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND AVG(res.positionorder) < 16 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_finish_position ASC;
