SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops, MAX(ds.wins) AS max_wins_in_season, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY SUM(res.points) DESC) AS yearly_rank FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON d.driverid = lt.driverid AND res.raceid = lt.raceid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON d.driverid = ps.driverid AND res.raceid = ps.raceid JOIN driverstandings ds ON d.driverid = ds.driverid AND res.raceid = ds.raceid WHERE r.year IN ( SELECT year FROM seasons WHERE year > 2014 ) AND r.date >= ( SELECT MIN(date) FROM races WHERE circuitid IN ( SELECT circuitid FROM circuits WHERE alt > 784 ) ) AND res.positionorder <= 8 AND lt.milliseconds < 83354 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round, r.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '50' AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 91353 ORDER BY r.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops, CASE WHEN SUM(res.points) >= 352.27 THEN 'High Scorer' WHEN SUM(res.points) >= 97.87 THEN 'Medium Scorer' ELSE 'Low Scorer' END AS performance_category, CASE WHEN AVG(lt.milliseconds) <= 82822 THEN 'Fast Lap' WHEN AVG(lt.milliseconds) <= 92815 THEN 'Average Lap' ELSE 'Slow Lap' END AS lap_performance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY SUM(res.points) DESC) AS yearly_rank FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON d.driverid = lt.driverid AND res.raceid = lt.raceid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON d.driverid = ps.driverid AND res.raceid = ps.raceid JOIN seasons s ON r.year = s.year WHERE r.date >= '2010-01-01' AND r.date <= '2010-01-01' AND res.grid <= 5 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round, r.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > 46.2 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) >= 0 ORDER BY r.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops, MAX(q.position) AS best_qualifying FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON d.driverid = lt.driverid AND res.raceid = lt.raceid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON d.driverid = ps.driverid AND res.raceid = ps.raceid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON d.driverid = q.driverid AND res.raceid = q.raceid WHERE r.year >= 1999 AND r.date <= '1950-01-01' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round, r.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 99040 UNION ALL SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, SUM(cr.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops, MAX(q.position) AS best_qualifying FROM drivers d JOIN constructorresults cr ON d.driverid = 545 JOIN races r ON cr.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON cr.constructorid = c.constructorid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON d.driverid = lt.driverid AND cr.raceid = lt.raceid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON d.driverid = ps.driverid AND cr.raceid = ps.raceid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON d.driverid = q.driverid AND cr.raceid = q.raceid WHERE r.year >= 1967 AND r.date <= '1950-01-01' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round, r.name HAVING SUM(cr.points) > '0' AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 192749 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_lap_time_ms ASC;

SELECT d1.driverid AS driver1_id, d1.forename AS driver1_forename, d1.surname AS driver1_surname, d2.driverid AS driver2_id, d2.forename AS driver2_forename, d2.surname AS driver2_surname, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, AVG(lt1.milliseconds - lt2.milliseconds) AS avg_time_diff_ms, SUM(res1.points) AS driver1_total_points, SUM(res2.points) AS driver2_total_points, COUNT(DISTINCT lt1.raceid) AS races_compared, SUM(CASE WHEN res1.positionorder < res2.positionorder THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS driver1_wins_over_driver2 FROM laptimes lt1 JOIN laptimes lt2 ON lt1.raceid = lt2.raceid AND lt1.lap = lt2.lap AND lt1.driverid < lt2.driverid JOIN drivers d1 ON lt1.driverid = d1.driverid JOIN drivers d2 ON lt2.driverid = d2.driverid JOIN races r ON lt1.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res1 ON lt1.raceid = res1.raceid AND lt1.driverid = res1.driverid JOIN results res2 ON lt2.raceid = res2.raceid AND lt2.driverid = res2.driverid LEFT JOIN constructorstandings cs1 ON res1.raceid = cs1.raceid AND res1.constructorid = cs1.constructorid LEFT JOIN constructorstandings cs2 ON res2.raceid = cs2.raceid AND res2.constructorid = cs2.constructorid LEFT JOIN qualifying q1 ON lt1.raceid = q1.raceid AND lt1.driverid = q1.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q2 ON lt2.raceid = q2.raceid AND lt2.driverid = q2.driverid WHERE r.year >= 1994 AND r.date <= '1950-01-01' AND lt1.milliseconds > 203889 AND lt2.milliseconds > 88058 AND c.circuitid IN (47, 75, 73) GROUP BY d1.driverid, d1.forename, d1.surname, d2.driverid, d2.forename, d2.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name HAVING AVG(lt1.milliseconds - lt2.milliseconds) > 2183 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lt1.raceid) >= 65 ORDER BY avg_time_diff_ms DESC, races_compared DESC LIMIT 444;

SELECT r.year, c.name AS constructor_name, COUNT(DISTINCT res.raceid) AS races_entered, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(res.positionorder) AS avg_finish_position, MAX(ds.wins) AS max_wins_in_season FROM results res JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN driverstandings ds ON res.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid WHERE r.year >= 2010 AND r.year <= 2009 GROUP BY r.year, c.constructorid, c.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND AVG(res.positionorder) <= 7 ORDER BY r.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT r.year, c.name AS constructor_name, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, SUM(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY r.year, c.constructorid ORDER BY r.date) AS cumulative_points, AVG(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY r.year, c.constructorid) AS avg_points_per_race, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY SUM(res.points) DESC) AS yearly_rank FROM results res JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid WHERE r.year >= 1951 AND r.year <= 1980 GROUP BY r.year, r.date, c.constructorid, c.name, d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, res.points HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY r.year, cumulative_points DESC;

SELECT r.year, r.name AS race_name, c.name AS circuit_name, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, con.name AS constructor_name, res.positionorder, res.points, AVG(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY r.year, con.constructorid) AS avg_constructor_points_per_year, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY res.points DESC) AS yearly_points_rank FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 1980 AND r.year <= 1962 AND res.positionorder <= 16 GROUP BY r.year, r.name, c.name, d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, con.constructorid, con.name, res.positionorder, res.points HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY r.year DESC, yearly_points_rank;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name AS constructor_name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, rs.points AS race_points, ds.points AS driver_standings_points, cs.points AS constructor_standings_points, lt.total_laps, ps.total_pitstops, q.avg_qualifying_position, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM results rs2 WHERE rs2.driverid = d.driverid AND rs2.position = 1) AS career_wins, (SELECT AVG(lt2.milliseconds) FROM laptimes lt2 WHERE lt2.driverid = d.driverid AND lt2.raceid = r.raceid) AS avg_lap_time_ms FROM drivers d JOIN results rs ON d.driverid = rs.driverid JOIN races r ON rs.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits ci ON r.circuitid = ci.circuitid JOIN constructors c ON rs.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN driverstandings ds ON d.driverid = ds.driverid AND r.raceid = ds.raceid JOIN constructorstandings cs ON c.constructorid = cs.constructorid AND r.raceid = cs.raceid LEFT JOIN (SELECT driverid, raceid, COUNT(*) AS total_laps FROM laptimes GROUP BY driverid, raceid) lt ON d.driverid = lt.driverid AND r.raceid = lt.raceid LEFT JOIN (SELECT driverid, raceid, COUNT(*) AS total_pitstops FROM pitstops GROUP BY driverid, raceid) ps ON d.driverid = ps.driverid AND r.raceid = ps.raceid LEFT JOIN (SELECT driverid, raceid, AVG(position) AS avg_qualifying_position FROM qualifying GROUP BY driverid, raceid) q ON d.driverid = q.driverid AND r.raceid = q.raceid WHERE r.year >= 1976 AND r.year <= 1950 AND ci.country = 'Argentina' AND rs.points > '0' AND ds.position <= 17 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, rs.points, ds.points, cs.points, lt.total_laps, ps.total_pitstops, q.avg_qualifying_position HAVING SUM(rs.points) > '10' AND COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) >= 94 ORDER BY career_wins DESC, SUM(rs.points) DESC LIMIT 78;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops, MAX(q.position) AS best_qualifying, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM driverstandings ds2 WHERE ds2.driverid = d.driverid AND ds2.position = 1) AS career_wins, (SELECT AVG(sub.avg_points) FROM (SELECT raceid, AVG(points) AS avg_points FROM results GROUP BY raceid) sub WHERE sub.raceid IN (SELECT raceid FROM races WHERE circuitid = cir.circuitid)) AS avg_points_on_circuit FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits cir ON r.circuitid = cir.circuitid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON d.driverid = lt.driverid AND r.raceid = lt.raceid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON d.driverid = ps.driverid AND r.raceid = ps.raceid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON d.driverid = q.driverid AND r.raceid = q.raceid JOIN seasons s ON r.year = s.year WHERE r.year >= 1985 AND r.year <= 2017 AND cir.alt > 793 AND res.grid <= 4 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round, r.name, cir.circuitid HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 70121 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_lap_time_ms ASC LIMIT 73;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops, MAX(q.position) AS best_qualifying, SUM(cr.points) AS constructor_points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY SUM(res.points) DESC) AS driver_rank_year, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.circuitid ORDER BY AVG(lt.milliseconds)) AS lap_time_rank_circuit FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits cct ON r.circuitid = cct.circuitid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON res.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid JOIN pitstops ps ON res.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid JOIN qualifying q ON res.raceid = q.raceid AND res.driverid = q.driverid AND res.constructorid = q.constructorid JOIN constructorresults cr ON res.raceid = cr.raceid AND res.constructorid = cr.constructorid JOIN driverstandings ds ON res.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid JOIN constructorstandings cs ON res.raceid = cs.raceid AND res.constructorid = cs.constructorid JOIN status s ON res.statusid = s.statusid LEFT JOIN target t ON res.raceid = t.raceid AND res.driverid = t.driverid WHERE r.year >= 2015 AND r.date <= '1950-01-01' AND res.grid <= 27 AND lt.lap >= 48 AND ps.lap <= 8 AND q.position <= 25 AND cr.points > '0' AND ds.points >= '0' AND cs.position < 5 AND (t.win = 1 OR t.win IS NULL) GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round, r.name, r.circuitid HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 122486 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) >= 4 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_lap_time_ms ASC LIMIT 612;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, res.positionorder, res.points, AVG(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid, r.year) AS avg_points_per_season, SUM(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid ORDER BY r.date) AS cumulative_points FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 2016 AND res.points > '0' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name, res.positionorder, res.points, r.date ORDER BY d.driverid, r.year, r.round;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, res.positionorder, res.points, AVG(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid, r.year) AS avg_points_per_season, SUM(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid ORDER BY r.date) AS running_total_points FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid WHERE r.year >= 2016 AND r.year <= 2008 AND res.points > '0' ORDER BY d.driverid, r.date;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, res.positionorder, res.points, AVG(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY r.year, d.driverid) AS avg_points_per_season, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY SUM(res.points) DESC) AS season_rank FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 1994 AND r.year <= 1965 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name, res.positionorder, res.points HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY r.year DESC, season_rank, d.surname;

SELECT r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, d.driverid, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, con.name AS constructor_name, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position AS lap_position, lt.milliseconds AS lap_time_ms, ps.stop AS pit_stop_number, ps.lap AS pit_stop_lap, ps.milliseconds AS pit_stop_duration_ms, q.position AS qualifying_position, ds.points AS driver_standings_points, ds.wins AS driver_standings_wins, cs.points AS constructor_standings_points, cs.wins AS constructor_standings_wins, AVG(lt.milliseconds) OVER ( PARTITION BY r.raceid, d.driverid ORDER BY lt.lap ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_lap_time_ms, SUM(res.points) OVER ( PARTITION BY r.year, d.driverid ORDER BY r.date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS cumulative_points_season FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND res.driverid = q.driverid AND res.constructorid = q.constructorid LEFT JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid LEFT JOIN constructorstandings cs ON r.raceid = cs.raceid AND res.constructorid = cs.constructorid LEFT JOIN constructorresults cr ON r.raceid = cr.raceid AND res.constructorid = cr.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 1953 AND r.year <= 1989 AND res.positionorder <= 20 AND lt.milliseconds > 79118 AND (ps.milliseconds IS NULL OR ps.milliseconds < 41110) GROUP BY r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name, d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, con.name, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position, lt.milliseconds, ps.stop, ps.lap, ps.milliseconds, q.position, ds.points, ds.wins, cs.points, cs.wins, r.date HAVING AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 103925 ORDER BY r.year DESC, r.round DESC, cumulative_points_season DESC;

SELECT r.year, c.country, con.name AS constructor_name, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) AS races_entered, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, SUM(ps.milliseconds) AS total_pitstop_time_ms, COUNT(ps.stop) AS total_pitstops, MAX(ds.wins) AS max_wins_in_season FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid WHERE r.year >= 1994 AND r.year <= 1992 AND res.points > '0' AND d.dob >= '1960-01-01' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (r.year, c.country, con.name, d.forename, d.surname), (r.year, c.country, con.name), (r.year, c.country), (r.year), () ) HAVING SUM(res.points) > '10' ORDER BY r.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) AS races_entered, SUM(r.points) AS total_points, AVG(r.positionorder) AS avg_finish_position FROM drivers d JOIN results r ON d.driverid = r.driverid JOIN races rc ON r.raceid = rc.raceid WHERE rc.year IN (SELECT year FROM seasons WHERE year >= 1991 AND year <= 1952) AND r.positionorder <= 10 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(r.points) > '0' ORDER BY total_points DESC LIMIT 20;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name AS constructor_name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name AS circuit_name, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position AS lap_position, lt.milliseconds AS lap_time_ms, ps.stop AS pit_stop_number, ps.lap AS pit_stop_lap, ps.milliseconds AS pit_stop_duration_ms, q.position AS qualifying_position, ds.points AS driver_standing_points, ds.wins AS driver_standing_wins, cs.points AS constructor_standing_points, cs.wins AS constructor_standing_wins, AVG(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid, r.year ORDER BY r.round ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS avg_points_running, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.raceid ORDER BY res.positionorder) AS race_finish_rank, SUM(lt.milliseconds) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid, r.raceid ORDER BY lt.lap) AS cumulative_lap_time_ms FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits cir ON r.circuitid = cir.circuitid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND d.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND d.driverid = q.driverid AND res.constructorid = q.constructorid LEFT JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND d.driverid = ds.driverid LEFT JOIN constructorstandings cs ON r.raceid = cs.raceid AND c.constructorid = cs.constructorid LEFT JOIN constructorresults cr ON r.raceid = cr.raceid AND c.constructorid = cr.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 1960 AND r.year <= 1963 AND res.positionorder <= 16 AND lt.milliseconds > 84140 AND cir.alt > 4 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position, lt.milliseconds, ps.stop, ps.lap, ps.milliseconds, q.position, ds.points, ds.wins, cs.points, cs.wins HAVING AVG(res.points) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) >= 30 ORDER BY r.year DESC, r.round DESC, res.positionorder ASC, cumulative_lap_time_ms DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops, CASE WHEN SUM(res.points) >= 430.57 THEN 'High Scorer' WHEN SUM(res.points) >= 56.43 THEN 'Medium Scorer' ELSE 'Low Scorer' END AS performance_category, CASE WHEN AVG(lt.milliseconds) <= 82743 THEN 'Fast Lap' WHEN AVG(lt.milliseconds) <= 98720 THEN 'Average Lap' ELSE 'Slow Lap' END AS lap_performance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY SUM(res.points) DESC) AS yearly_rank FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON d.driverid = lt.driverid AND res.raceid = lt.raceid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON d.driverid = ps.driverid AND res.raceid = ps.raceid JOIN seasons s ON r.year = s.year WHERE r.date >= '2010-01-01' AND r.date <= '2010-01-01' AND res.grid <= 3 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round, r.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > 31.43 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) >= 4 ORDER BY r.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, SUM(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid, r.year ORDER BY r.date) AS cumulative_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid, r.raceid) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(ps.stop) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid, r.raceid) AS pitstop_count, ds.position AS final_standing_position, cs.position AS constructor_standing_position FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN driverstandings ds ON d.driverid = ds.driverid AND r.raceid = ds.raceid JOIN constructorstandings cs ON c.constructorid = cs.constructorid AND r.raceid = cs.raceid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON d.driverid = lt.driverid AND r.raceid = lt.raceid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON d.driverid = ps.driverid AND r.raceid = ps.raceid WHERE r.year IN (SELECT year FROM seasons WHERE year >= 1966 AND year <= 1999) AND res.points > '0' AND r.date >= '1950-01-01' AND ds.position <= 4 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round, r.name, r.date, ds.position, cs.position, lt.milliseconds, ps.stop, res.points, r.raceid HAVING SUM(res.points) > '10' AND COUNT(ps.stop) >= 3 ORDER BY cumulative_points DESC, avg_lap_time_ms ASC LIMIT 77;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, res.positionorder, res.points, SUM(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid ORDER BY r.date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_total_points, AVG(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid, r.year) AS avg_points_per_season FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 1974 AND res.positionorder <= 14 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name, res.positionorder, res.points, r.date ORDER BY d.driverid, r.date;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM laptimes lt WHERE lt.raceid = r.raceid AND lt.driverid = d.driverid AND lt.position = 1) AS laps_led, res.points FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid WHERE r.year = 2023 AND c.country = 'Australia' AND res.points > '0' ORDER BY laps_led DESC, res.points DESC;
SELECT r.raceid, COUNT(l.driverid) AS lap_count FROM races r JOIN laptimes l ON r.raceid = l.raceid WHERE r.year = 1996 AND l.lap > 89 GROUP BY r.raceid ORDER BY lap_count DESC;

SELECT r.year, c.country, d.nationality, COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) AS race_count, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_ms FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid WHERE r.year >= 1964 AND r.year <= 1975 AND res.points > '0' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (r.year, c.country, d.nationality), (r.year, c.country), (r.year), () ) ORDER BY r.year, c.country, d.nationality;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(r.resultid) AS race_count, SUM(r.points) AS total_points, AVG(r.positionorder) AS avg_finish_position FROM drivers d JOIN results r ON d.driverid = r.driverid JOIN races rc ON r.raceid = rc.raceid JOIN circuits c ON rc.circuitid = c.circuitid WHERE rc.year >= 2016 AND rc.year <= 2009 AND c.country = 'UK' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(r.points) > '50' AND AVG(r.positionorder) < 16 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) AS total_laps, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, MAX(ds.wins) AS max_wins_in_season, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops, AVG(ps.milliseconds) AS avg_pitstop_ms, MIN(q.position) AS best_qualifying, SUM(cr.points) AS constructor_points, AVG(cs.position) AS avg_constructor_position FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON d.driverid = lt.driverid AND res.raceid = lt.raceid JOIN pitstops ps ON d.driverid = ps.driverid AND res.raceid = ps.raceid JOIN qualifying q ON d.driverid = q.driverid AND res.raceid = q.raceid JOIN driverstandings ds ON d.driverid = ds.driverid AND res.raceid = ds.raceid JOIN constructorresults cr ON c.constructorid = cr.constructorid AND res.raceid = cr.raceid JOIN constructorstandings cs ON c.constructorid = cs.constructorid AND res.raceid = cs.raceid WHERE r.year >= 1960 AND r.date <= '1950-01-01' AND res.points > '0' AND lt.milliseconds < 173552 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round, r.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '10' AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 62909 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_lap_time_ms ASC;
SELECT r.raceid, COUNT(l.driverid) AS driver_count FROM races r JOIN laptimes l ON r.raceid = l.raceid WHERE r.year = 2019 AND l.milliseconds > 197221 GROUP BY r.raceid ORDER BY driver_count DESC;

SELECT r.year, c.name AS circuit_name, con.name AS constructor_name, COUNT(DISTINCT d.driverid) AS unique_drivers, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) AS unique_laps_raced, SUM(res.points) AS total_points FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid WHERE r.year >= 2018 AND r.year <= 2009 GROUP BY r.year, c.name, con.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > 73.38 ORDER BY r.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) AS races_participated, SUM(res.points) AS total_points FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid WHERE r.year = 1962 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM constructorstandings cs WHERE cs.constructorid = res.constructorid AND cs.raceid = r.raceid AND cs.position <= 4 ) GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name AS constructor_name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name AS circuit_name, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) AS total_laps_raced, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, MIN(ps.milliseconds) AS min_pitstop_ms, MAX(q.position) AS worst_qualifying_position, SUM(CASE WHEN res.positionorder = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wins, SUM(t.win) AS target_wins FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits cir ON r.circuitid = cir.circuitid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND d.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND d.driverid = q.driverid LEFT JOIN target t ON r.raceid = t.raceid AND d.driverid = t.driverid WHERE r.year >= 1990 AND r.year <= 1976 AND res.points > '0' AND lt.milliseconds < 108280 AND cir.alt > 821 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '10' AND COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) >= 85 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_lap_time_ms ASC LIMIT 357;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name AS constructor_name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name AS circuit_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops, MAX(q.position) AS best_qualifying, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY SUM(res.points) DESC) AS yearly_rank FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits cir ON r.circuitid = cir.circuitid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND d.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND d.driverid = q.driverid WHERE r.year >= 1954 AND r.date <= '1950-01-01' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM driverstandings ds WHERE ds.driverid = d.driverid AND ds.raceid = r.raceid AND ds.position <= 11 ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM constructorstandings cs WHERE cs.constructorid = c.constructorid AND cs.raceid = r.raceid AND cs.wins >= 3 ) GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) >= 42 ORDER BY total_points DESC, yearly_rank LIMIT 841;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name AS constructor_name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name AS circuit_name, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position AS lap_position, lt.milliseconds AS lap_time_ms, ps.stop AS pit_stop_number, ps.lap AS pit_stop_lap, ps.milliseconds AS pit_stop_duration_ms, q.position AS qualifying_position, ds.points AS driver_standing_points, ds.wins AS driver_standing_wins, cs.points AS constructor_standing_points, cs.wins AS constructor_standing_wins, cr.points AS constructor_result_points, t.win AS target_win, AVG(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid, r.year) AS avg_points_per_year, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year, c.constructorid ORDER BY SUM(res.points) DESC) AS constructor_rank_in_year, SUM(lt.milliseconds) OVER (PARTITION BY r.raceid, d.driverid ORDER BY lt.lap) AS cumulative_lap_time FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits cir ON r.circuitid = cir.circuitid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND d.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND d.driverid = q.driverid AND c.constructorid = q.constructorid LEFT JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND d.driverid = ds.driverid LEFT JOIN constructorstandings cs ON r.raceid = cs.raceid AND c.constructorid = cs.constructorid LEFT JOIN constructorresults cr ON r.raceid = cr.raceid AND c.constructorid = cr.constructorid LEFT JOIN target t ON r.raceid = t.raceid AND d.driverid = t.driverid WHERE r.year >= 1984 AND r.year <= 1970 AND res.points > '0' AND lt.milliseconds < 109222 AND (ps.milliseconds IS NULL OR ps.milliseconds > 23148) GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position, lt.milliseconds, ps.stop, ps.lap, ps.milliseconds, q.position, ds.points, ds.wins, cs.points, cs.wins, cr.points, t.win HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) > 8 AND AVG(res.points) < '0' ORDER BY r.year DESC, r.round DESC, constructor_rank_in_year, cumulative_lap_time;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position AS lap_position, ps.stop AS pit_stop_number, ps.lap AS pit_stop_lap, q.position AS qualifying_position FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN laptimes lt ON res.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON res.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON res.raceid = q.raceid AND res.driverid = q.driverid WHERE r.year = 1960 AND r.round BETWEEN 25 AND 3 AND res.positionorder <= 3 AND lt.lap >= 14 AND lt.position <= 9 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position, ps.stop, ps.lap, q.position HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) >= 3 ORDER BY SUM(res.points) DESC, d.surname, d.forename;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position AS lap_position, ps.stop, ps.duration FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND d.driverid = ps.driverid WHERE r.year = 2006 AND (res.positionorder <= 17 OR res.points > '0') AND NOT (lt.position > 20 AND lt.lap < 44) GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position, ps.stop, ps.duration HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' OR AVG(lt.position) < 6 ORDER BY r.year, r.round, d.surname;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, res.points, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM laptimes lt WHERE lt.raceid = res.raceid AND lt.driverid = res.driverid AND lt.position = 1) AS laps_led FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid WHERE r.year = 1988 AND res.points > '0' ORDER BY res.points DESC;

SELECT r.year, c.name AS circuit_name, con.name AS constructor_name, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) AS distinct_laps_driven, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS distinct_pit_stops, COUNT(DISTINCT q.position) AS distinct_qualifying_positions, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, MAX(ds.wins) AS max_wins_in_season, SUM(cr.points) AS total_constructor_points FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND res.driverid = q.driverid AND res.constructorid = q.constructorid JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid JOIN constructorresults cr ON r.raceid = cr.raceid AND res.constructorid = cr.constructorid JOIN constructorstandings cs ON r.raceid = cs.raceid AND res.constructorid = cs.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 2009 AND r.year <= 1992 AND res.grid <= 29 AND d.dob >= '1950-01-01' AND lt.milliseconds > 147282 GROUP BY r.year, c.circuitid, con.constructorid, d.driverid HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) >= 89 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) <= 2 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_lap_time_ms ASC LIMIT 100;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.name AS race_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON d.driverid = lt.driverid AND r.raceid = lt.raceid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON d.driverid = ps.driverid AND r.raceid = ps.raceid WHERE r.year >= 2014 AND (res.points > '0' OR res.grid <= 7) AND NOT (c.nationality = 'British' AND r.circuitid = 5) GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '10' AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 80408 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_lap_time_ms ASC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, res.positionorder, res.points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY SUM(res.points) DESC) AS yearly_rank FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid WHERE r.year >= 1979 AND r.year <= 1987 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name, res.positionorder, res.points HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY r.year, yearly_rank, r.round;

SELECT r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.driverid) AS distinct_drivers, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) AS distinct_laps, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS distinct_pitstops, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND lt.driverid = ps.driverid WHERE r.year >= 2011 AND r.date <= '2010-03-01' GROUP BY r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lt.driverid) > 14 AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 163075 ORDER BY r.year DESC, r.round ASC;

SELECT r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, con.name AS constructor_name, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position AS lap_position, lt.milliseconds AS lap_time_ms, ps.stop AS pit_stop_number, ps.duration AS pit_stop_duration, q.position AS qualifying_position, ds.points AS driver_standing_points, cs.points AS constructor_standing_points, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM laptimes lt2 WHERE lt2.raceid = r.raceid AND lt2.driverid = d.driverid AND lt2.milliseconds < 107401) AS laps_faster_than_threshold, (SELECT AVG(points) FROM results res2 WHERE res2.raceid = r.raceid AND res2.constructorid = con.constructorid AND res2.points > '0') AS avg_constructor_points_above_threshold, (SELECT SUM(wins) FROM constructorstandings cs2 WHERE cs2.constructorid = con.constructorid AND cs2.raceid IN (SELECT raceid FROM races WHERE year = r.year)) AS constructor_wins_in_season FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND d.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND d.driverid = q.driverid AND con.constructorid = q.constructorid LEFT JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND d.driverid = ds.driverid LEFT JOIN constructorstandings cs ON r.raceid = cs.raceid AND con.constructorid = cs.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 2004 AND r.year <= 2005 AND res.points >= '0' AND (lt.milliseconds IS NULL OR lt.milliseconds > 72426) AND d.dob <= '1960-01-01' GROUP BY r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name, d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, con.constructorid, con.name, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position, lt.milliseconds, ps.stop, ps.duration, q.position, ds.points, cs.points HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) >= 6 OR COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) > 4 ORDER BY r.year DESC, r.round DESC, res.positionorder ASC, lt.lap ASC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, rs.positionorder, rs.points, lt.lap, lt.position AS lap_position, ps.stop AS pit_stop_number, ps.duration AS pit_duration, q.position AS qualifying_position, cs.points AS constructor_points, ds.wins AS driver_wins, t.win AS target_win FROM drivers d LEFT JOIN results rs ON d.driverid = rs.driverid LEFT JOIN races r ON rs.raceid = r.raceid LEFT JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON rs.raceid = lt.raceid AND rs.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON rs.raceid = ps.raceid AND rs.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON rs.raceid = q.raceid AND rs.driverid = q.driverid LEFT JOIN constructorstandings cs ON rs.raceid = cs.raceid AND rs.constructorid = cs.constructorid LEFT JOIN driverstandings ds ON rs.raceid = ds.raceid AND rs.driverid = ds.driverid LEFT JOIN target t ON rs.raceid = t.raceid AND rs.driverid = t.driverid WHERE r.year >= 2009 AND rs.points > '0' AND lt.lap >= 65 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name, rs.positionorder, rs.points, lt.lap, lt.position, ps.stop, ps.duration, q.position, cs.points, ds.wins, t.win HAVING COUNT(lt.lap) > 24 ORDER BY rs.points DESC, ds.wins DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, CASE WHEN SUM(res.points) >= 153.82 THEN 'High Performer' WHEN SUM(res.points) >= 19.44 THEN 'Medium Performer' ELSE 'Low Performer' END AS performance_category FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid WHERE r.year = 2014 AND r.round >= 11 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, c.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > 7.56 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, c.name AS circuit_name, res.positionorder, res.points, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM laptimes lt WHERE lt.raceid = r.raceid AND lt.driverid = d.driverid AND lt.position = 1) AS laps_led FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid WHERE r.year = 1992 AND res.points > '0' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, r.name, c.name, res.positionorder, res.points, r.raceid HAVING COUNT(res.resultid) > 2 ORDER BY res.points DESC, laps_led DESC;

SELECT r.year, c.name AS constructor_name, COUNT(DISTINCT res.driverid) AS unique_drivers, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(res.positionorder) AS avg_finish FROM results res JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid WHERE r.year = 2004 AND res.points > '0' GROUP BY r.year, c.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '10' ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(r.resultid) AS total_races, SUM(r.points) AS total_points, AVG(r.positionorder) AS avg_finish_position FROM drivers d JOIN results r ON d.driverid = r.driverid JOIN races rc ON r.raceid = rc.raceid WHERE rc.year >= 2007 AND rc.year <= 2007 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(r.points) > '0' ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name AS constructor_name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name AS circuit_name, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position AS lap_position, lt.milliseconds AS lap_time_ms, ps.stop, ps.lap AS pit_lap, ps.milliseconds AS pit_time_ms, q.position AS qualifying_position, ds.points AS driver_standing_points, ds.wins AS driver_wins, cs.points AS constructor_standing_points, cs.wins AS constructor_wins, t.win AS target_win, AVG(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid, r.year) AS avg_points_per_year, SUM(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY c.constructorid ORDER BY r.date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_constructor_points, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY r.circuitid) AS races_at_circuit FROM res.constructorid = c.constructorid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON res.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON res.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON res.raceid = q.raceid AND res.driverid = q.driverid AND res.constructorid = q.constructorid LEFT JOIN driverstandings ds ON res.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, rs.points AS race_points, ds.position AS driver_position, cs.position AS constructor_position, lt.lap, lt.position AS lap_position, ps.stop AS pit_stop_number, ps.lap AS pit_stop_lap, q.position AS qualifying_position, t.win, AVG(rs.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid, r.year) AS avg_points_per_season, SUM(rs.points) OVER (PARTITION BY c.constructorid, r.year ORDER BY r.date) AS cumulative_constructor_points, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.raceid ORDER BY rs.points DESC) AS points_rank_in_race, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM laptimes lt2 WHERE lt2.driverid = d.driverid AND lt2.position = 1 AND lt2.raceid IN (SELECT raceid FROM races WHERE year = r.year)) AS season_fastest_laps FROM drivers d JOIN results rs ON d.driverid = rs.driverid JOIN races r ON rs.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON rs.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN circuits ci ON r.circuitid = ci.circuitid JOIN driverstandings ds ON d.driverid = ds.driverid AND r.raceid = ds.raceid JOIN constructorstandings cs ON c.constructorid = cs.constructorid AND r.raceid = cs.raceid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON d.driverid = lt.driverid AND r.raceid = lt.raceid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON d.driverid = ps.driverid AND r.raceid = ps.raceid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON d.driverid = q.driverid AND r.raceid = q.raceid LEFT JOIN target t ON d.driverid = t.driverid AND r.raceid = t.raceid WHERE r.year >= 1969 AND r.year <= 1991 AND rs.points > '0' AND ds.position <= 18 AND cs.position <= 7 AND ci.alt > 416 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round, r.name, rs.points, ds.position, cs.position, lt.lap, lt.position, ps.stop, ps.lap, q.position, t.win, c.constructorid, r.raceid, r.date HAVING SUM(rs.points) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) >= 31 ORDER BY r.year DESC, r.round DESC, rs.points DESC LIMIT 615;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) AS total_laps_led, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, MIN(ps.milliseconds) AS min_pitstop_ms, MAX(q.position) AS worst_qualifying, SUM(CASE WHEN res.positionorder = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wins, SUM(cr.points) AS constructor_points, SUM(cs.wins) AS constructor_wins FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits ci ON r.circuitid = ci.circuitid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON res.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON res.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON res.raceid = q.raceid AND res.driverid = q.driverid LEFT JOIN constructorresults cr ON res.raceid = cr.raceid AND res.constructorid = cr.constructorid LEFT JOIN constructorstandings cs ON res.raceid = cs.raceid AND res.constructorid = cs.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 1986 AND r.year <= 1982 AND ci.country = 'UK' AND res.grid <= 4 AND lt.position = 1 AND d.dob <= '1950-01-01' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name, r.year, r.round HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) >= 39 AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 79479 ORDER BY total_points DESC, wins DESC, total_laps_led DESC LIMIT 21;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(res.positionorder) AS avg_finish_position FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid WHERE r.year IN ( SELECT year FROM seasons WHERE year BETWEEN 2013 AND 1995 ) AND res.positionorder <= 11 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.year, r.round, r.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_finish_position ASC;

SELECT d1.driverid AS driver1_id, d1.forename AS driver1_forename, d1.surname AS driver1_surname, d2.driverid AS driver2_id, d2.forename AS driver2_forename, d2.surname AS driver2_surname, r.year, r.name AS race_name, c.name AS circuit_name, AVG(lt1.milliseconds - lt2.milliseconds) AS avg_time_diff_ms, COUNT(*) AS lap_count FROM laptimes lt1 JOIN laptimes lt2 ON lt1.raceid = lt2.raceid AND lt1.lap = lt2.lap JOIN drivers d1 ON lt1.driverid = d1.driverid JOIN drivers d2 ON lt2.driverid = d2.driverid JOIN races r ON lt1.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res1 ON lt1.raceid = res1.raceid AND lt1.driverid = res1.driverid JOIN results res2 ON lt2.raceid = res2.raceid AND lt2.driverid = res2.driverid WHERE lt1.position IS NOT NULL AND lt2.position IS NOT NULL AND lt1.milliseconds IS NOT NULL AND lt2.milliseconds IS NOT NULL AND lt1.driverid < lt2.driverid AND r.year >= 2008 AND c.circuitid = 17 AND res1.grid <= 8 AND res2.grid <= 7 GROUP BY d1.driverid, d1.forename, d1.surname, d2.driverid, d2.forename, d2.surname, r.year, r.name, c.name HAVING COUNT(*) > 46 AND AVG(lt1.milliseconds - lt2.milliseconds) > 4126 ORDER BY avg_time_diff_ms DESC, lap_count DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) AS races_participated, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid WHERE r.year = 1961 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM constructorstandings cs WHERE cs.constructorid = res.constructorid AND cs.raceid = r.raceid AND cs.position <= 8 ) GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY total_points DESC LIMIT 20;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.raceid, r.name AS race_name, r.date, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(r.date, d.dob)) AS age_at_race, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position AS lap_position, ps.stop, ps.duration FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND d.driverid = ps.driverid WHERE r.date >= '2000-01-01' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM r.date) = 2017 AND res.points > '0' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, r.raceid, r.name, r.date, res.positionorder, res.points, lt.lap, lt.position, ps.stop, ps.duration HAVING COUNT(lt.lap) > 6 ORDER BY r.date DESC, res.positionorder ASC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points, SUM(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid, r.year ORDER BY r.round) AS cumulative_points, AVG(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid, r.year) AS avg_points_per_race FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid WHERE r.year = 1982 AND (res.grid <= 7 OR res.positionorder <= 1) AND NOT (res.points = 0 AND res.positionorder > 19) AND r.date >= '1950-01-01' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round, r.name, res.grid, res.positionorder, res.points HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY cumulative_points DESC, r.round ASC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) AS distinct_laps_led, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS distinct_pit_stops, COUNT(DISTINCT q.position) AS distinct_qualifying_positions, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, MAX(ds.wins) AS max_wins_in_season FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND d.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND d.driverid = q.driverid JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND d.driverid = ds.driverid JOIN seasons s ON r.year = s.year WHERE r.year >= 1999 AND r.date <= '1990-01-01' AND res.grid <= 15 AND lt.position = 1 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name, r.year HAVING SUM(res.points) > '10' AND COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) >= 44 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_lap_time_ms ASC;

SELECT r.year, c.name AS circuit_name, con.name AS constructor_name, COUNT(DISTINCT d.driverid) AS unique_drivers, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) AS unique_laps_raced, SUM(res.points) AS total_points FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid WHERE r.year >= 2003 AND r.year <= 1996 GROUP BY r.year, c.name, con.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY r.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON d.driverid = lt.driverid AND r.raceid = lt.raceid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON d.driverid = ps.driverid AND r.raceid = ps.raceid WHERE r.year IN (SELECT year FROM seasons WHERE year >= 1951 AND year <= 1970) AND res.positionorder <= 10 AND lt.milliseconds > 69111 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round, r.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_lap_time_ms ASC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(r.resultid) AS race_count, COALESCE(SUM(r.points), 0) AS total_points FROM drivers d LEFT JOIN results r ON d.driverid = r.driverid LEFT JOIN races rc ON r.raceid = rc.raceid WHERE rc.year >= 1992 OR rc.year IS NULL GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING COALESCE(SUM(r.points), 0) > '0' ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(r.resultid) AS race_count, SUM(r.points) AS total_points, AVG(r.positionorder) AS avg_finish FROM drivers d JOIN results r ON d.driverid = r.driverid JOIN races rc ON r.raceid = rc.raceid WHERE rc.year >= 2003 AND r.points > '0' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING COUNT(r.resultid) >= 8 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT r.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(r.resultid) AS race_count, SUM(r.points) AS total_points FROM results r JOIN drivers d ON r.driverid = d.driverid JOIN races rc ON r.raceid = rc.raceid WHERE rc.year = 1971 AND r.positionorder <= 10 GROUP BY r.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(r.points) > '0' INTERSECT SELECT r.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(r.resultid) AS race_count, SUM(r.points) AS total_points FROM results r JOIN drivers d ON r.driverid = d.driverid JOIN races rc ON r.raceid = rc.raceid WHERE rc.year = 1976 AND r.positionorder <= 1 GROUP BY r.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(r.points) > '0' ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(r.resultid) AS race_count, SUM(r.points) AS total_points, AVG(r.positionorder) AS avg_finish_position FROM drivers d JOIN results r ON d.driverid = r.driverid JOIN races rc ON r.raceid = rc.raceid WHERE rc.year >= 2013 AND rc.year <= 2019 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(r.points) > '0' ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, res.positionorder, res.points, SUM(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid, r.year ORDER BY r.date) AS cumulative_points_year, AVG(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY c.constructorid, r.year) AS avg_constructor_points_per_race_year, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.raceid ORDER BY res.points DESC) AS race_points_rank FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN circuits ci ON r.circuitid = ci.circuitid JOIN seasons s ON r.year = s.year LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON res.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON res.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON res.raceid = q.raceid AND res.driverid = q.driverid AND res.constructorid = q.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 2023 AND r.year <= 2004 AND res.points > '0' AND ci.alt > 454 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, c.constructorid, r.year, r.round, r.name, r.date, r.raceid, res.positionorder, res.points HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) > 24 OR COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) IS NULL ORDER BY r.year, r.round, cumulative_points_year DESC;
SELECT r.raceid, COUNT(l.driverid) AS lap_count FROM races r JOIN laptimes l ON r.raceid = l.raceid WHERE r.year = 1994 AND l.lap > 2 GROUP BY r.raceid ORDER BY lap_count DESC;

SELECT c.circuitid, c.name AS circuit_name, c.country, r.year, r.round, d.driverid, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, con.name AS constructor_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops, MAX(ds.wins) AS max_wins_in_season, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY SUM(res.points) DESC) AS yearly_points_rank FROM circuits c JOIN races r ON c.circuitid = r.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND d.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND d.driverid = ds.driverid LEFT JOIN constructorresults cr ON r.raceid = cr.raceid AND con.constructorid = cr.constructorid LEFT JOIN constructorstandings cs ON r.raceid = cs.raceid AND con.constructorid = cs.constructorid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND d.driverid = q.driverid AND con.constructorid = q.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 1987 AND r.year <= 2008 AND res.grid <= 16 AND d.dob >= '1950-01-01' AND c.alt >= 299 GROUP BY c.circuitid, c.name, c.country, r.year, r.round, d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, con.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 110323 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) >= 10 ORDER BY r.year DESC, r.round, total_points DESC;

SELECT r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name AS circuit_name, d.driverid, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, res.positionorder, res.points, AVG(res.points) OVER ( PARTITION BY r.circuitid, d.driverid ORDER BY r.date ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS avg_points_last_3_races FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 2019 AND r.year <= 2020 AND res.positionorder <= 5 AND d.dob >= '1970-01-01' GROUP BY r.raceid, r.year, r.round, c.name, d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, res.positionorder, res.points, r.circuitid, r.date HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY r.year, r.round, avg_points_last_3_races DESC;

SELECT ds.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, SUM(ds.points) AS total_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ds.raceid) AS races_count FROM driverstandings ds JOIN drivers d ON ds.driverid = d.driverid JOIN races r ON ds.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid WHERE r.year >= 2007 AND c.alt >= 283 GROUP BY ds.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(ds.points) > '10' INTERSECT SELECT ds.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, SUM(ds.points) AS total_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ds.raceid) AS races_count FROM driverstandings ds JOIN drivers d ON ds.driverid = d.driverid JOIN races r ON ds.raceid = r.raceid JOIN results res ON ds.raceid = res.raceid AND ds.driverid = res.driverid WHERE res.grid <= 7 AND res.positionorder <= 4 GROUP BY ds.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ds.raceid) >= 12 ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops, MAX(q.position) AS best_qualifying FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND d.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND d.driverid = q.driverid WHERE r.year >= 1952 AND r.date <= '1950-01-01' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round, r.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 120315 INTERSECT SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops, MAX(q.position) AS best_qualifying FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND d.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND d.driverid = q.driverid JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND d.driverid = ds.driverid WHERE r.circuitid IN (SELECT circuitid FROM circuits WHERE alt > 561) GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round, r.name HAVING MAX(ds.wins) >= 4 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) <= 3 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_lap_time_ms ASC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(r.resultid) AS race_count, COALESCE(SUM(r.points), 0) AS total_points FROM drivers d LEFT JOIN results r ON d.driverid = r.driverid LEFT JOIN races rc ON r.raceid = rc.raceid WHERE rc.year >= 2023 AND rc.year <= 1973 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING COALESCE(SUM(r.points), 0) > '0' ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT r.year, c.country, con.nationality, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, COUNT(DISTINCT res.driverid) AS unique_drivers, AVG(res.positionorder) AS avg_finish_pos FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid JOIN results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid JOIN constructors con ON res.constructorid = con.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 1972 AND r.year <= 2020 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (r.year, c.country, con.nationality), (r.year, c.country), (r.year, con.nationality), (r.year), () ) HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY r.year DESC, total_points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name AS constructor_name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name AS circuit_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops, MAX(ds.wins) AS max_wins_in_season, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY SUM(res.points) DESC) AS yearly_rank FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits cir ON r.circuitid = cir.circuitid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND d.driverid = ps.driverid JOIN driverstandings ds ON r.raceid = ds.raceid AND d.driverid = ds.driverid JOIN seasons s ON r.year = s.year WHERE r.year >= 1974 AND r.date <= '1950-01-01' AND res.positionorder <= 4 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM qualifying q WHERE q.raceid = r.raceid AND q.driverid = d.driverid AND q.position <= 8 ) AND cir.alt > 48 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 156725 ORDER BY total_points DESC, yearly_rank, r.year, r.round LIMIT 988;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, r.round, r.name AS race_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON res.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON res.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid WHERE r.year = 2013 AND res.grid <= 19 AND res.positionorder IS NOT NULL AND res.positionorder <= 13 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.name, r.year, r.round, r.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 174116 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_lap_time_ms ASC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name AS constructor_name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND d.driverid = ps.driverid WHERE r.year >= 1999 AND r.date <= '1950-01-01' GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 160870 INTERSECT SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name AS constructor_name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND d.driverid = ps.driverid JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND d.driverid = q.driverid WHERE r.year >= 2012 AND r.date <= '1950-01-01' AND q.position <= 2 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 175198 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_lap_time_ms ASC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name AS constructor_name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name AS circuit_name, res.positionorder, res.points, ds.position AS driver_standing_position, ds.wins AS driver_wins, cs.position AS constructor_standing_position, cs.wins AS constructor_wins, lt.lap, lt.position AS lap_position, lt.milliseconds AS lap_time_ms, ps.stop AS pit_stop_number, ps.milliseconds AS pit_stop_duration_ms, q.position AS qualifying_position, t.win AS target_win, AVG(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY d.driverid, r.year) AS avg_points_per_season, SUM(res.points) OVER (PARTITION BY c.constructorid ORDER BY r.date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_constructor_points, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY r.circuitid) AS races_at_circuit FROM drivers d LEFT JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid LEFT JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid LEFT JOIN circuits cir ON r.circuitid = cir.circuitid LEFT JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid LEFT JOIN driverstandings ds ON d.driverid = ds.driverid AND r.raceid = ds.raceid LEFT JOIN constructorstandings cs ON c.constructorid = JOIN qualifying q ON d.driverid = q.driverid AND r.raceid = q.raceid LEFT JOIN target t ON d.driverid = t.driverid AND r.raceid = t.raceid LEFT JOIN seasons s ON r.year = s.year WHERE r.year >= 1996 AND r.year <= 1999 AND res.positionorder IS NOT NULL AND (cir.lat > '-90' OR cir.lng < '-180') AND (lt.milliseconds > 68248 OR ps.milliseconds < 21216) GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid) AS total_races, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM results res2 WHERE res2.driverid = d.driverid AND res2.position = 1) AS total_wins FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid WHERE r.year >= 1980 AND r.year <= 2020 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' ORDER BY total_points DESC;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name AS constructor_name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name AS circuit_name, cir.country, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.stop) AS total_pitstops, MAX(q.position) AS best_qualifying, SUM(CASE WHEN res.positionorder = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wins, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY SUM(res.points) DESC) AS yearly_rank FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits cir ON r.circuitid = cir.circuitid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid LEFT JOIN laptimes lt ON res.raceid = lt.raceid AND res.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON res.raceid = ps.raceid AND res.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON res.raceid = q.raceid AND res.driverid = q.driverid AND res.constructorid = q.constructorid LEFT JOIN driverstandings ds ON res.raceid = ds.raceid AND res.driverid = ds.driverid LEFT JOIN constructorresults cr ON res.raceid = cr.raceid AND res.constructorid = cr.constructorid LEFT JOIN constructorstandings cs ON res.raceid = cs.raceid AND res.constructorid = cs.constructorid WHERE r.year >= 1990 AND r.year <= 1952 AND cir.lat >= '-90' AND cir.lat <= '-90' AND cir.lng >= '-180' AND cir.lng <= '-180' AND d.dob >= '1920-01-01' AND d.dob <= '1920-01-01' AND res.grid <= 13 AND res.laps >= 39 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name, cir.country HAVING SUM(res.points) > '0' AND AVG(lt.milliseconds) < 120539 ORDER BY total_points DESC, yearly_rank, r.year, r.round LIMIT 719;

SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name AS constructor_name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name AS circuit_name, COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) AS total_laps_raced, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms, MIN(ps.milliseconds) AS min_pitstop_ms, MAX(q.position) AS worst_qualifying_position, SUM(CASE WHEN res.positionorder = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wins, SUM(t.win) AS target_wins FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid JOIN circuits cir ON r.circuitid = cir.circuitid JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorid = c.constructorid JOIN laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid AND d.driverid = lt.driverid LEFT JOIN pitstops ps ON r.raceid = ps.raceid AND d.driverid = ps.driverid LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON r.raceid = q.raceid AND d.driverid = q.driverid LEFT JOIN target t ON r.raceid = t.raceid AND d.driverid = t.driverid WHERE r.year >= 1991 AND r.year <= 2012 AND cir.country = 'Australia' AND res.points > '0' AND lt.milliseconds < 116826 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, c.constructorid, c.name, r.raceid, r.year, r.round, cir.name HAVING SUM(res.points) > '10' AND COUNT(DISTINCT lt.lap) >= 1 ORDER BY total_points DESC, avg_lap_time_ms ASC LIMIT 103;
